{"id": "AT000538", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/runtime/hudbank.c", "originalBytes": 9208, "originalSha256": "8570be7c3f239a368c7f01b3ebc0cb5056abc4087a60b59705b6cfd30eff9be2", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 9208, "utf8TotalBytes": 9208}

/* hudbank.c -- two parts of career free roam's HUD only when they say
 * something.  Original: both always there in career free roam.
 *
 * The Bank (top right, "Bank: 1,609,790"): for BANK_CHANGE_S after the bank
 * changed (a race's or an outrun's prize, a shop's price, a money icon), for
 * BANK_START_S once free roam starts (the world loaded, a new HUD) and for
 * BANK_BACK_S once the HUD is back after a menu (the pause menu, the map, a
 * shop's screens); else hidden.
 *
 * The box at the top left (a dark box, the D-pad and its icons: the envelope
 * of an SMS waiting, Engage at a marker or a door, an outrun's tuner): for
 * BOX_NEW_S after a message came (an SMS, the career's note), while the car
 * is at a marker, a door or an outrun's tuner and BOX_HERE_S after, for
 * BOX_START_S once free roam starts and BOX_BACK_S after a menu; else hidden.
 *
 * The HUD's parts show by bits: Player::Update's HUD step (0x600590) has
 * them made every frame (0x600090: eax the low ones, edx the high ones) and
 * hands them to the HUD (0x4CA090) when they change, which shows or hides
 * the parts whose bits changed (0x4C6690: a part is on while its masks, +0x10
 * and +0x14, meet the bits; its objects shown or hidden there, and its own
 * update keeps them so).  The Bank is the HUD's +0x80 (0x4F4F10: Cash_Bank,
 * Cash_data, Cash_header, Show_case_backing; its update 0x4A9EF0), the high
 * 0x80000, which 0x600090 sets in the career (0x850078 1) out of a race
 * (0x89E7B0 0).  The box is the HUD's +0x58 (0x4F83D0; its update 0x4DA9A0),
 * the high 2, which 0x600090 sets out of a race (0x5EA8E0).  Here, right
 * after 0x600090, a part's bit goes while it has nothing to say: the HUD
 * hides the part as for any change of the bits.
 *
 * A money icon's "Bank Reward" (0x4AC1B0, the part's +0x28, which its update
 * shows) comes with a change of the bank, so it shows.  The reward pop-up
 * (Cash_Reward, 0x4F5060, the HUD's +0x78, the high 0x80) is another part,
 * as it was.  The Bank comes and goes at once: its objects have no fade of
 * their own (their scripts: INIT, HIDE, ZoomIn, Cash_Animate).
 *
 * The box's messages are 8 slots of 0x14 bytes at the part's +0x60: +0 the
 * state (0 none, 1 posted, 2 new: its sound and pulse, 1 s; 3 its blink, 4 s;
 * 4 resting, its icon still there), +1 the kind.  0x4C9170 posts one (or
 * makes a resting one of the kind new again), 0x4DAB80 takes one away.
 * Kinds: a marker's or a door's Engage 1-8, 0xB-0x12 (0x5EAFB0 posts it as
 * the car comes onto it, 0x4DB820 takes it away), an outrun's tuner 9
 * (0x4DB890), an SMS waiting 0x13 (0x4DB8C0, the envelope, until it is
 * read), the career's note 0x14 (0x534290, never taken away).  The part's
 * update runs only while it is shown, so a message posted while it is hidden
 * waits as posted (1) until the box shows: it shows the box, and the update
 * then plays its sound and pulse as it would have.  A posted one that a
 * resting one of a higher kind keeps waiting (0x4C90B0 shows the highest:
 * Engage, outrun, SMS, note) shows the box once, when it came.  A new HUD
 * posts the SMS waiting again (0x4DB8C0 counts from 0): messages in free
 * roam's first BOX_START_S are its start's.
 *
 * Free roam starts when the Player's HUD is another one; the HUD is back
 * after a menu when the bit comes after a step without it (0x600090 gives
 * no bits while the game is paused), or the HUD step did not run for
 * GAP_S (screens that stop the world). */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "widescreen.h"           /* HOOK_SITE */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <time.h>

#define BANK_CHANGE_S 20.0        /* shown after the bank changed */
#define BANK_START_S  10.0        /* ... after free roam starts */
#define BANK_BACK_S   8.0         /* ... after a menu */
#define BOX_NEW_S     20.0        /* the box shown after a message came */
#define BOX_HERE_S    2.0         /* ... while the car is at a marker, a door or an outrun's tuner, and this after */
#define BOX_START_S   10.0        /* ... after free roam starts */
#define BOX_BACK_S    8.0         /* ... after a menu */
#define GAP_S         1.0         /* the HUD step not run this long: the world stood (a menu, a loading screen) */
#define A_BANK        0x00861e74u /* the career's bank (Career 0x85AD40 +0x7134) */
#define PL_HUD        0x9a4u      /* Player: its HUD */
#define HUD_BOX       0x58u       /* the HUD: the box's part */
#define BOX_SLOTS     0x60u       /* the box's part: its messages, BOX_N of BOX_SLOT bytes (+0 state, +1 kind) */
#define BOX_N         8u
#define BOX_SLOT      0x14u
#define KIND_SMS      0x13u       /* an SMS waiting */
#define KIND_NOTE     0x14u       /* the career's note */
#define BIT_BANK      0x80000u    /* the HUD's high bits: the Bank */
#define BIT_BOX       0x2u        /* ... the box */

struct Item { uint32_t hud; int had, shown; double until, start; };   /* the HUD its last step with the bit saw, the last
                                                                        * step had the bit, it is shown, shown until,
                                                                        * free roam's start (seconds) */
static struct St {
    uint32_t pl, bank, came, here;               /* the Player, the bank its last step saw, the box's posted or new
                                                  * slots, its slots at a marker, a door or a tuner */
    int known;                                   /* bank is one */
    double last;                                 /* the last step */
    struct Item b, x;                            /* the Bank, the box */
} g_st[2];                                       /* player 1's, co-op's player 2's */

static double now_s(void){ struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts); return ts.tv_sec + ts.tv_nsec * 1e-9; }

static void show_for(struct Item *it, double t, double sec){ if (it->until < t + sec) it->until = t + sec; }

/* the part's bit in this step: shown for start once free roam starts, for back once the HUD is back after a menu */
static const char *bit_came(struct Item *it, uint32_t hud, double t, int gap, double start, double back){
    const char *why = 0;
    if (hud != it->hud){ it->hud = hud; it->start = t; show_for(it, t, start); why = "free roam"; }
    else if (!it->had || gap){ show_for(it, t, back); why = "back"; }
    it->had = 1;
    return why;
}

static void bank(CPU *c, struct St *s, uint32_t hud, double t, int gap){
    struct Item *it = &s->b;
    if (!(c->edx & BIT_BANK)){ it->had = 0; return; }
    uint32_t bank = MR32(A_BANK);
    const char *why = bit_came(it, hud, t, gap, BANK_START_S, BANK_BACK_S);
    if (s->known && bank != s->bank){ show_for(it, t, BANK_CHANGE_S); why = "changed"; }
    s->known = 1; s->bank = bank;
    int on = t < it->until;
    if (why || on != it->shown)
        fprintf(stderr, "[bank] %s (%s, bank %u)\n", on ? "shown" : "hidden", why ? why : "time's up", bank);
    it->shown = on;
    if (!on) c->edx &= ~BIT_BANK;
}

static void box(CPU *c, struct St *s, uint32_t hud, double t, int gap){
    struct Item *it = &s->x;
    if (!(c->edx & BIT_BOX)){ it->had = 0; return; }
    uint32_t part = hud && mem_is_committed(hud + HUD_BOX) ? MR32(hud + HUD_BOX) : 0, slots = part + BOX_SLOTS;
    if (!part || !mem_is_committed(slots) || !mem_is_committed(slots + BOX_N * BOX_SLOT - 1u)) return;
    const char *why = bit_came(it, hud, t, gap, BOX_START_S, BOX_BACK_S);
    uint32_t came = 0, here = 0;
    int pulse = 0;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < BOX_N; k++){
        uint8_t st = MR8(slots + k * BOX_SLOT), kind = MR8(slots + k * BOX_SLOT + 1u);
        if (!st || !kind) continue;
        if (kind != KIND_SMS && kind != KIND_NOTE) here |= 1u << k;
        else if (st == 1 || st == 2){ came |= 1u << k; pulse |= st == 2; }
    }
    int settled = t - it->start >= BOX_START_S;   /* (before: the new HUD's own SMS waiting, posted again) */
    if (settled && (came & ~s->came)){ show_for(it, t, BOX_NEW_S); why = "message"; }
    else if (settled && pulse) show_for(it, t, BOX_NEW_S);   /* (an SMS the game keeps new, 0x4C8AC0: all along) */
    if (here){ show_for(it, t, BOX_HERE_S); if ((here & ~s->here) && !why) why = "here"; }
    s->came = came; s->here = here;
    int on = t < it->until;
    if (why || on != it->shown) fprintf(stderr, "[box] %s (%s)\n", on ? "shown" : "hidden", why ? why : "time's up");
    it->shown = on;
    if (!on) c->edx &= ~BIT_BOX;
}

/* Player::Update's HUD step, its bits just made: esi the Player, edx the high bits */
static void step(CPU *c){
    uint32_t pl = c->esi, hud = MR32(pl + PL_HUD);
    struct St *s = g_st[0].pl == pl || !g_st[0].pl ? &g_st[0] : g_st[1].pl == pl || !g_st[1].pl ? &g_st[1] :
                   g_st[0].last < g_st[1].last ? &g_st[0] : &g_st[1];
    double t = now_s();
    if (s->pl != pl) *s = (struct St){ .pl = pl };
    int gap = s->last > 0 && t - s->last > GAP_S;
    s->last = t;
    bank(c, s, hud, t, gap);
    box(c, s, hud, t, gap);
}

int hudbank_hook(CPU *c, uint32_t ip){
    switch (ip){
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0060059a): step(c); return 1;   /* Player::Update's HUD step: its bits (0x600090), before it compares them */
    }
    return 0;
}

/* intro.c -- the boot movies: skippable (default), original, or off.
 *
 *   NFSU2_INTRO=skippable | original | off      (settings.ini: intro = ...)
 *   NFSU2_INTRO_LOG=1   also log every message the boot-movie screens get
 *
 * The game boots through a list of front-end screens (tables 0x7f65e8 /
 * 0x7f6620, in the boot-flow object [0x836488] made by 0x4d9580): MC_Bootup,
 * LS_BlankMovie (blank.vp6), LS_EAlogo (ealogo.vp6), LS_THXMovie
 * (THX_logo.vp6), LS_PSAMovie (PSA.vp6), UG_LS_IntroFMV (FMVOpening.vp6),
 * UG_LS_Splash (the title).  Each movie
 * screen ends in its NotificationMessage handler (thiscall: msg, obj, p1, p2;
 * ret 0x10), which goes on to the next screen with 0x4c4f50:
 *
 *   0x4c53a0  LS_BlankMovie, LS_EAlogo, LS_THXMovie: only on 0xc3960eb9, the
 *             message the movie player posts when a movie ends (0x5660f0) or
 *             cannot be opened (0x566240).  Input is ignored: unskippable.
 *   0x4c53d0  LS_PSAMovie: on 0xc3960eb9 (sets [0x8383a8], saves the video
 *             options with 0x5beea0, sets "boot done" [0x836494]); on
 *             PAD_ACCEPT/PAD_START only when the memory-card object
 *             [0x836498] has byte +5 set, i.e. a saved profile exists
 *             (0x4c618c, from 0x4a9c40).  First startup: unskippable.
 *   0x4c5330  UG_LS_IntroFMV: on 0xc3960eb9, PAD_ACCEPT or PAD_START.
 *
 * What reaches these handlers (cFEng 0x54d4b0 only sends a pad message that
 * the package has a response for): Enter, pad A and a left click arrive as
 * PAD_ACCEPT, pad Start as PAD_START.  Escape and pad B raise the joy event
 * FEPad_Back, but no boot package responds to PAD_BACK, so nothing arrives;
 * Space is no front-end key at all.
 *
 * skippable: PAD_ACCEPT/PAD_START (and PAD_BACK, should one come) end every
 * boot movie, and so does a new press of Escape, Space (DirectInput key
 * events, keyboard.c) or pad B (gamepad_read), seen on the screen's per-frame
 * tick 0xc98356ba.  Those three never produce PAD_ACCEPT/PAD_START here, so
 * one press ends one movie.  Where the game has its own skip (the intro; the
 * PSA with a profile) the screen gets PAD_ACCEPT; elsewhere it gets
 * 0xc3960eb9 and takes the same path as when its movie plays to the end (the
 * player is stopped by the package teardown, 0x511bc0, which posts nothing).
 * off: the movie player's start (0x566020, called by the FE movie object
 * 0x566240 with "<dir>MOVIES\<name>.vp6") posts 0xc3960eb9 at once for the
 * boot movies instead of opening them, as 0x566020 itself does when
 * [0x8650a8] is set (and 0x566240 for a missing file, which WidescreenFix's
 * SkipIntro relies on).  Every screen then ends as after a full play.
 * original: none of this.  Story, tutorial and region movies (IG_PlayMovie)
 * are never touched. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "guest.h"
#include "game.h"
#include "kbd.h"
#include "gamepad.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <strings.h>

long autotest_frame(void);
const char *autotest_screen(void);
void sub_0055dc50(CPU *c);

#define MSG_PAD_ACCEPT 0x406415e3u   /* bStringHash("PAD_ACCEPT") */
#define MSG_PAD_START  0xb5af2461u   /* bStringHash("PAD_START") */
#define MSG_PAD_BACK   0x911ab364u   /* bStringHash("PAD_BACK") */
#define MSG_MOVIE_END  0xc3960eb9u   /* posted by the movie player */
#define MSG_TICK       0xc98356bau   /* every front-end update */

enum { INTRO_SKIPPABLE, INTRO_ORIGINAL, INTRO_OFF };
static int g_mode = -1, g_log, g_pad = 1;

static int intro_mode(void){
    if (g_mode < 0){
        const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_INTRO");
        g_mode = INTRO_SKIPPABLE;
        if (e && *e){
            if (!strcasecmp(e, "original")) g_mode = INTRO_ORIGINAL;
            else if (!strcasecmp(e, "off") || !strcasecmp(e, "no") || !strcasecmp(e, "false") || !strcmp(e, "0"))
                g_mode = INTRO_OFF;          /* settings.ini's false words mean off there too (bundle.m enum_value) */
            else if (strcasecmp(e, "skippable"))
                fprintf(stderr, "[intro] NFSU2_INTRO=%s is not skippable, original or off; using skippable\n", e);
        }
        const char *l = getenv("NFSU2_INTRO_LOG"); g_log = l && *l && *l != '0';
        /* no controller for the game (NFSU2_PAD=off, dinput_pad.c): none here either */
        const char *p = getenv("NFSU2_PAD");
        g_pad = (p && !strcasecmp(p, "hotplug")) || gamepad_env_flag("NFSU2_PAD", 1);
        fprintf(stderr, "[intro] boot movies: %s\n",
                g_mode == INTRO_OFF ? "off" : g_mode == INTRO_ORIGINAL ? "original" : "skippable");
    }
    return g_mode;
}

static const char *msg_name(uint32_t m){
    switch (m){
    case MSG_PAD_ACCEPT: return "PAD_ACCEPT";
    case MSG_PAD_START:  return "PAD_START";
    case MSG_PAD_BACK:   return "PAD_BACK";
    case MSG_MOVIE_END:  return "movie end";
    default:             return 0;
    }
}
static int is_pad(uint32_t m){ return m == MSG_PAD_ACCEPT || m == MSG_PAD_START || m == MSG_PAD_BACK; }
static const char *screen(void){ const char *s = autotest_screen(); return s ? s : "?"; }

/* NFSU2_INTRO_LOG=1: every message but the per-update tick */
static void trace(const char *who, uint32_t m){
    if (!g_log || m == MSG_TICK) return;
    const char *n = msg_name(m);
    if (n) fprintf(stderr, "[intro] f=%ld %s (%s): %s\n", autotest_frame(), who, screen(), n);
    else   fprintf(stderr, "[intro] f=%ld %s (%s): 0x%08x\n", autotest_frame(), who, screen(), m);
}

/* ---- presses the front end does not pass on: Escape, Space, pad B ---------
 * Counted from the first message a screen object gets (a new object, or one
 * that got nothing for half a second: a live screen gets a tick every frame),
 * so a press made before it (on the previous movie, or held over) never
 * ends it. */
static struct { uint32_t self, kseq, pad; long frame; } g_base;
static uint32_t pad_buttons(void){
    if (!g_pad) return 0;
    PadState s;
    return gamepad_read(&s) ? s.buttons : 0;
}
static void rebase(uint32_t self){ g_base.self = self; g_base.kseq = kbd_ev_head(); g_base.pad = pad_buttons(); }
static const char *new_press(void){
    const char *what = 0;
    uint32_t head = kbd_ev_head();
    if (head - g_base.kseq > 256u) g_base.kseq = head - 256u;
    for (uint32_t s = g_base.kseq; s != head; s++){
        KbdEv e;
        if (kbd_ev_get(s, &e) == 1 && e.down && !what)
            what = e.dik == 0x01 ? "Escape" : e.dik == 0x39 ? "Space" : 0;
    }
    g_base.kseq = head;
    uint32_t b = pad_buttons();
    if (!what && (b & ~g_base.pad & (1u << PAD_B))) what = "pad B";
    g_base.pad = b;
    return what;
}

/* The skip for one message: 0 = none, else the message the screen gets
 * instead.  own = the screen's own skip message (0: it has none). */
static uint32_t skip(CPU *c, const char *who, uint32_t own){
    uint32_t m = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
    intro_mode();
    trace(who, m);                       /* in every mode, so the unchanged game can be watched too */
    if (g_mode == INTRO_ORIGINAL) return 0;
    if (g_mode != INTRO_SKIPPABLE) return 0;
    long f = autotest_frame();
    if (c->ecx != g_base.self || f - g_base.frame > 30) rebase(c->ecx);
    g_base.frame = f;
    const char *by = 0;
    if (is_pad(m)) by = msg_name(m);
    else if (m == MSG_TICK) by = new_press();
    if (!by) return 0;
    uint32_t to = own ? own : MSG_MOVIE_END;
    if (is_pad(m) && own && m != MSG_PAD_BACK) to = m;        /* the game's own skip, as is */
    fprintf(stderr, "[intro] f=%ld %s skipped by %s (%s)\n", autotest_frame(), screen(), by, msg_name(to));
    rebase(c->ecx);
    return to;
}

/* LS_BlankMovie, LS_EAlogo, LS_THXMovie */
void sub_004c53a0_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_004c53a0(CPU *c){
    uint32_t to = skip(c, "movie screen", 0);
    if (to) MR32(c->esp + 4u) = to;
    sub_004c53a0_orig(c);
}

/* LS_PSAMovie: its own skip needs a saved profile (byte +5 of the
 * memory-card object [0x836498], as 0x4c53ee tests) */
void sub_004c53d0_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_004c53d0(CPU *c){
    uint32_t mc = MR32(0x836498u);
    uint32_t to = skip(c, "PSA screen", mc && MR8(mc + 5u) ? MSG_PAD_ACCEPT : 0);
    if (to) MR32(c->esp + 4u) = to;
    sub_004c53d0_orig(c);
}

/* UG_LS_IntroFMV (also the title screen's attract replay after 30 s) */
void sub_004c5330_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_004c5330(CPU *c){
    uint32_t to = skip(c, "intro screen", MSG_PAD_ACCEPT);
    if (to) MR32(c->esp + 4u) = to;
    sub_004c5330_orig(c);
}

/* ---- off ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* the boot movies by file name; blank.vp6 only on its own boot screen */
static int boot_movie(uint32_t path){
    if (!path || !mem_is_committed(path)) return 0;
    char p[128]; int n = 0;
    while (n < (int)sizeof p - 1 && mem_is_committed(path + (uint32_t)n) && MR8(path + (uint32_t)n)){
        p[n] = (char)MR8(path + (uint32_t)n); n++; }
    p[n] = 0;
    const char *b = p;
    for (const char *q = p; *q; q++) if (*q == '\\' || *q == '/') b = q + 1;
    size_t l = strlen(b);
    if (l > 4 && !strcasecmp(b + l - 4, ".vp6")) l -= 4;
    static const char *const names[] = { "ealogo", "THX_logo", "THX_logo_fr", "PSA", "FMVOpening" };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof names / sizeof names[0]; i++)
        if (strlen(names[i]) == l && !strncasecmp(b, names[i], l)) return 1;
    return l == 5 && !strncasecmp(b, "blank", 5) && !strcasecmp(screen(), "LS_BlankMovie.fng");
}

/* 0x566020(path, 1, flags), cdecl: start the movie player */
void sub_00566020_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_00566020(CPU *c){
    if (intro_mode() == INTRO_OFF && boot_movie(MR32(c->esp + 4u))){
        fprintf(stderr, "[intro] f=%ld %s: movie not played (off)\n", autotest_frame(), screen());
        /* as 0x56602a: FEManager (0x8637b0) ->QueueMessage(0xc3960eb9, 0)
         * (thiscall, ret 8); ecx comes back as it was (push/pop ecx) */
        uint32_t ecx = c->ecx;
        PUSH32(0u); PUSH32(MSG_MOVIE_END); c->ecx = 0x8637b0u;
        PUSH32(0x56603bu); sub_0055dc50(c);
        c->ecx = ecx;
        POP32(c->eip);
        return;
    }
    sub_00566020_orig(c);
}

/* ---- the title's second line ----------------------------------------------
 * The title screen (UG_LS_Splash.fng) has EA's copyright in a band at the
 * bottom: string 0xC70CCFC7, a top-level object centred at (0, 194) in HUD
 * units (640 x 480 about the centre), size 0.9, in the band (group 0x356DE316
 * at y 195.5: two images 40 high).  Under it goes the site's address, in a
 * copy of that string (optslider.c's fe_copy) 12 units lower at 3/4 of its
 * size, inside the band, made each time the package is loaded (the title
 * comes back after its attract movie: a new package, a new copy).  The copy's
 * animation (the copyright's, cloned) puts it back where the copyright is, so
 * every frame it gets its place and size again, and the colour of "Press
 * Enter Key" (string 0xC4DF3FF2, the game's green) with the copyright's
 * alpha: it fades in and out with the copyright.  An object's drawing data (+0x2C):
 * colour (b, g, r, a ints) +0, position +0x1C, size +0x38; a change sets its
 * rebuild flag (+0x1C 0x400000), as FEng's setters do (menusize.c).
 * In the browser the page draws the line instead (web/src/app/titlemark.ts),
 * in the look of the mark on F12 pictures (bold italic, ".xyz" green, which
 * the game's font can't do): the game makes no copy there and tells the page
 * where the copyright is and how far it has faded in, every frame (status
 * "title_a" its alpha 0..1, 0 off the title; "title_x"/"title_y" its middle
 * in HUD units; "title_s" its size). */
const char *autotest_top_fng(void);
uint32_t fe_copy(CPU *c, uint32_t pk, uint32_t o, uint32_t hash);

#define TITLE_FNG     "UG_LS_Splash.fng"
#define TITLE_LINE    "nfsu2.xyz"
#define LINE_DY       12.f          /* HUD units under the copyright's centre */
#define LINE_SIZE     0.75f         /* of the copyright's size */
#define H_COPYRIGHT   0xc70ccfc7u
#define H_PRESS       0xc4df3ff2u   /* "Press Enter Key" (its group slides in) */

static struct { uint32_t scr, hash; int off, told; } g_tl;

static uint32_t gstr(uint32_t a, const char *s){
    uint32_t i = 0;
    for (; s[i] && i < 63u; i++) MR8(a + i) = (uint8_t)s[i];
    MR8(a + i) = 0;
    return a;
}

#ifdef __wasm__
int host_status_slot(const char *name);
void host_status_set_n(const int *slot, const double *value, int n);
/* the copyright as the page draws the line under it (titlemark.ts); a 0 when it is not up */
static void title_tell(uint32_t o){
    static int slot[4] = { -2 };
    static double last[4] = { -1 };
    if (slot[0] == -2){ slot[0] = host_status_slot("title_a"); slot[1] = host_status_slot("title_x"); slot[2] = host_status_slot("title_y"); slot[3] = host_status_slot("title_s"); }
    double v[4] = { 0, last[1], last[2], last[3] };
    if (o){
        uint32_t d0 = MR32(o + 0x2cu);
        int32_t a = (int32_t)MR32(d0 + 0xcu);
        v[0] = a <= 0 ? 0 : a >= 255 ? 1 : a / 255.0;
        v[1] = MRF32(d0 + 0x1cu); v[2] = MRF32(d0 + 0x20u); v[3] = MRF32(d0 + 0x38u);
        if (!g_tl.told){
            g_tl.told = 1;
            fprintf(stderr, "[intro] title: the page draws \"%s\" under the copyright (y %.1f, size %.2f)\n", TITLE_LINE, v[2], v[3]);
        }
    }
    if (slot[0] < 0 || !memcmp(v, last, sizeof v)) return;
    memcpy(last, v, sizeof v);
    host_status_set_n(slot, v, 4);
}
#endif

/* the title's copyright while the title screen is up (and its package in *pk), else 0 */
static uint32_t title_copyright(CPU *c, uint32_t *pk){
    if (g_tl.off) return 0;
    const char *top = autotest_top_fng();
    if (!top || strcasecmp(top, TITLE_FNG)) return 0;
    if (!g_tl.scr){
        uint32_t n = 64u;
        if (!(g_tl.scr = gcall(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &n))){ g_tl.off = 1; return 0; }
        uint32_t a = gstr(g_tl.scr, "SITE_ADDRESS_LINE");
        g_tl.hash = gcall(c, FN_FE_HASH, 0, 1, &a);
    }
    uint32_t a = gstr(g_tl.scr, TITLE_FNG), h = H_COPYRIGHT;
    *pk = gcall(c, FN_FE_PACKAGE, 0, 1, &a);
    uint32_t o = guest_ok(*pk, 0x54) ? gcall(c, FN_PKG_FIND, *pk, 1, &h) : 0;
    return guest_ok(o, 0x70) && MR32(o + 0x18u) == 2u && guest_ok(MR32(o + 0x2cu), 0x40) ? o : 0;   /* 2: a string */
}

#ifdef __wasm__
/* a loading screen up (PC_Loading: into a race, into free roam or out of it; HUD_World_Loading: free roam's world
 * catching up): the page draws the site's address in the picture's bottom right corner (titlemark.ts), status
 * "loading" 1 */
static void loading_tell(void){
    static int slot = -2;
    static double last = -1;
    const char *top = autotest_top_fng();
    double v = top && (!strcasecmp(top, "PC_Loading.fng") || !strcasecmp(top, "HUD_World_Loading.fng"));
    if (slot == -2) slot = host_status_slot("loading");
    if (slot < 0 || v == last) return;
    if (v > 0 && last < 0.5){ static int said; if (!said++) fprintf(stderr, "[intro] a loading screen (%s): the page draws the site's address in its corner\n", top); }
    last = v;
    host_status_set_n(&slot, &v, 1);
}
#endif
void intro_frame(CPU *c){
    uint32_t pk = 0, o = title_copyright(c, &pk), a;
#ifdef __wasm__
    title_tell(o);                               /* the page draws the line: no copy */
    loading_tell();
    return;
#endif
    if (!o) return;
    uint32_t line = gcall(c, FN_PKG_FIND, pk, 1, &g_tl.hash);
    if (!line){
        if (!(line = fe_copy(c, pk, o, g_tl.hash)) || !guest_ok(MR32(line + 0x2cu), 0x40)){
            fprintf(stderr, "[intro] the title's copyright could not be copied: no line under it\n");
            g_tl.off = 1;
            return;
        }
        a = gstr(g_tl.scr, TITLE_LINE);
        gcall(c, FN_FE_SETSTR, line, 1, &a);
        MR32(line + 0x1cu) |= 2u;                /* a text of its own, as FEPrintf leaves it (0x537B30) */
        uint32_t d0 = MR32(o + 0x2cu);
        char tx[64]; uint32_t w = MR32(o + 0x64u), k = 0;
        for (; guest_ok(w, 2u * k + 1u) && k + 1 < sizeof tx && MR16(w + 2u * k); k++) tx[k] = (char)MR16(w + 2u * k);
        tx[k] = 0;
        fprintf(stderr, "[intro] title: \"%s\" under \"%s\" (y %.1f, size %.2f)\n", TITLE_LINE, tx,
                (double)(MRF32(d0 + 0x20u) + LINE_DY), (double)(MRF32(d0 + 0x38u) * LINE_SIZE));
    }
    /* every frame, as the copy's animation (the copyright's, cloned) puts it back where the copyright is */
    uint32_t d0 = MR32(o + 0x2cu), d1 = MR32(line + 0x2cu), hp = H_PRESS;
    float want[4] = { MRF32(d0 + 0x1cu), MRF32(d0 + 0x20u) + LINE_DY, MRF32(d0 + 0x38u) * LINE_SIZE, MRF32(d0 + 0x3cu) * LINE_SIZE };
    static const uint32_t AT[4] = { 0x1cu, 0x20u, 0x38u, 0x3cu };
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        if (MRF32(d1 + AT[i]) != want[i]){ MRF32(d1 + AT[i]) = want[i]; MR32(line + 0x1cu) |= 0x400000u; }
    uint32_t p = gcall(c, FN_PKG_FIND, pk, 1, &hp), dp = guest_ok(p, 0x70) ? MR32(p + 0x2cu) : 0;
    int32_t col[4];
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 4; i++) col[i] = (int32_t)MR32((i < 3 && guest_ok(dp, 16) ? dp : d0) + 4u * i);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        if ((int32_t)MR32(d1 + 4u * i) != col[i]){ MR32(d1 + 4u * i) = (uint32_t)col[i]; MR32(line + 0x1cu) |= 0x400000u; }
}

/* kbd.h -- keyboard and mouse input between the host and the guest.
 *
 * Producers: the AppKit main thread (runtime/keyboard_mac.m: real and
 * synthesised NSEvents; metal.m: mouse), the autotest script (guest thread)

 * keyboard device (runtime/dinput_kbd.c, guest thread) and the guest's

 * PeekMessageA/GetMessageA so that queue stays single-threaded. */

{"id": "AT000541", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/runtime/keyboard.c", "originalBytes": 6074, "originalSha256": "8a59da844f183b7358dc51f88957200255b37cecf39fc8dc188977a3b0fe666a", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 6074, "utf8TotalBytes": 6074}

/* keyboard.c -- key state, DirectInput key events and host window messages.
 *
 * Key state: one bit per source and key (kbd.h); a key is down for
 * DirectInput while any source holds it.  Each change of the combined state
 * goes into a ring of events with the game's clock (GetTickCount) and a
 * sequence number, from which every DirectInput keyboard device reads its
 * buffered data at its own pace (runtime/dinput_kbd.c).  So a key pressed
 * and released between two of the game's polls is still reported, as
 * DirectInput's buffer does, instead of being lost to a state comparison.
 *
 * Window messages made by the host (WM_KEYDOWN/WM_CHAR/..., mouse) are
 * queued here under a lock and moved into the guest's own message queue by
 * kbd_pump() on the guest thread, from PeekMessageA/GetMessageA.  Mouse
 * moves are coalesced into the newest one, as Windows does.
 * Everything here may be called from any thread. */
#include "kbd.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

uint32_t host_ms(void);                    /* win32.c: GetTickCount's clock */
void win32_post_message(uint32_t msg, uint32_t wp, uint32_t lp);   /* win32_ext.c */
int  win32_msg_room(void);                                       /* win32_ext.c */

int kbd_log(void){
    static int l = -1;
    if (l < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_KEY_LOG"); l = (e && *e && *e != '0') ? 1 : 0; }
    return l;
}
const char *kbd_msg_name(uint32_t m){
    switch (m){
    case 0x0100: return "WM_KEYDOWN";     case 0x0101: return "WM_KEYUP";
    case 0x0102: return "WM_CHAR";        case 0x0103: return "WM_DEADCHAR";
    case 0x0104: return "WM_SYSKEYDOWN";  case 0x0105: return "WM_SYSKEYUP";
    case 0x0106: return "WM_SYSCHAR";     case 0x0200: return "WM_MOUSEMOVE";
    case 0x0201: return "WM_LBUTTONDOWN"; case 0x0202: return "WM_LBUTTONUP";
    case 0x0204: return "WM_RBUTTONDOWN"; case 0x0205: return "WM_RBUTTONUP";
    case 0x0207: return "WM_MBUTTONDOWN"; case 0x0208: return "WM_MBUTTONUP";
    case 0x020A: return "WM_MOUSEWHEEL";
    default:     return "WM_?";
    }
}

/* ---- key state and DirectInput events ----------------------------------- */
static pthread_mutex_t g_kmx = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static uint8_t  g_src[256];              /* bit per KSRC_* */
#define EVN 1024u                        /* power of two */
static KbdEv    g_ev[EVN];
static uint32_t g_seq = 1;               /* next sequence number (0 = never used) */

static void push_ev_locked(unsigned dik, int down){
    KbdEv *e = &g_ev[g_seq & (EVN - 1u)];
    e->dik = (uint8_t)dik; e->down = (uint8_t)(down ? 1 : 0);
    e->ms = host_ms();                   /* dwTimeStamp in GetTickCount time */
    e->seq = g_seq++;
}
void kbd_set_key(int src, unsigned dik, int down){
    if (dik == 0 || dik > 255u || src < 0 || src > 7) return;
    uint8_t bit = (uint8_t)(1u << src);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_kmx);
    int was = g_src[dik] != 0;
    if (down) g_src[dik] |= bit; else g_src[dik] &= (uint8_t)~bit;
    int now = g_src[dik] != 0;
    if (now != was) push_ev_locked(dik, now);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_kmx);
}
void kbd_release_source(int src){
    if (src < 0 || src > 7) return;
    uint8_t bit = (uint8_t)(1u << src);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_kmx);
    for (unsigned k = 1; k < 256u; k++)
        if (g_src[k] & bit){
            g_src[k] &= (uint8_t)~bit;
            if (!g_src[k]) push_ev_locked(k, 0);
        }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_kmx);
}
void kbd_state(uint8_t *dst, unsigned n){
    if (n > 256u) n = 256u;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_kmx);
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < n; k++) dst[k] = g_src[k] ? 0x80 : 0x00;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_kmx);
}
int kbd_key_down(unsigned dik){
    if (dik > 255u) return 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_kmx);
    int d = g_src[dik] != 0;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_kmx);
    return d;
}
uint32_t kbd_ev_head(void){
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_kmx);
    uint32_t s = g_seq;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_kmx);
    return s;
}
int kbd_ev_get(uint32_t seq, KbdEv *e){
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_kmx);
    int r;
    if ((int32_t)(seq - g_seq) >= 0) r = 0;
    else if (g_seq - seq > EVN) r = -1;
    else { *e = g_ev[seq & (EVN - 1u)]; r = 1; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_kmx);
    return r;
}

/* ---- host -> guest window messages --------------------------------------- */
#define MQN 1024u
static struct { uint32_t m, wp, lp; } g_mq[MQN];
static unsigned g_mq_h = 0, g_mq_t = 0;   /* head (read), tail (write) */
static pthread_mutex_t g_mmx = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static uint64_t g_mq_drop = 0;

static void post_locked(uint32_t m, uint32_t wp, uint32_t lp){
    unsigned nx = (g_mq_t + 1u) % MQN;
    if (nx == g_mq_h){ g_mq_drop++; return; }
    g_mq[g_mq_t].m = m; g_mq[g_mq_t].wp = wp; g_mq[g_mq_t].lp = lp;
    g_mq_t = nx;
}
void kbd_post(uint32_t m, uint32_t wp, uint32_t lp){
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mmx);
    post_locked(m, wp, lp);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mmx);
}
void kbd_post_mousemove(uint32_t wp, uint32_t lp){
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mmx);
    unsigned last = (g_mq_t + MQN - 1u) % MQN;
    if (g_mq_h != g_mq_t && g_mq[last].m == 0x0200u){ g_mq[last].wp = wp; g_mq[last].lp = lp; }
    else post_locked(0x0200u, wp, lp);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mmx);
}
void kbd_pump(void){
    int room = win32_msg_room();
    for (;;){
        uint32_t m, wp, lp;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mmx);
        if (g_mq_h == g_mq_t || room <= 8){ pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mmx); break; }
        m = g_mq[g_mq_h].m; wp = g_mq[g_mq_h].wp; lp = g_mq[g_mq_h].lp;
        g_mq_h = (g_mq_h + 1u) % MQN;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mmx);
        win32_post_message(m, wp, lp);
        room--;
        if (kbd_log() && m != 0x0200u)
            fprintf(stderr, "[key] guest gets %-13s wParam 0x%08x lParam 0x%08x\n", kbd_msg_name(m), wp, lp);
    }
    if (g_mq_drop){ static uint64_t said = 0;
        if (said != g_mq_drop){ said = g_mq_drop;
            fprintf(stderr, "[key] host message queue full: %llu message(s) dropped\n",
                    (unsigned long long)g_mq_drop); } }
}

/* keyboard_mac.m -- real keyboard input: NSEvent -> Win32 keyboard messages
 * and DirectInput key state, the way Windows delivers a key to the game.
 *
 * For every key the game sees (AppKit main thread, from metal.m's event loop):
 *   - DirectInput: the key's position as a DIK scan code (layout
 *     independent: the key right of Tab is DIK_Q on every layout), into the
 *     shared key state and event ring (runtime/keyboard.c);
 *   - WM_KEYDOWN / WM_KEYUP (WM_SYSKEYDOWN / WM_SYSKEYUP while Option = Alt
 *     is held and the key types nothing) with the Windows virtual-key code
 *     (letters follow the layout, as Windows' do), and lParam = repeat count
 *     1 | scan code << 16 | extended << 24 | Alt << 29 | previous state << 30
 *     | transition << 31;
 *   - WM_CHAR with the characters the keyboard layout produces (Shift,
 *     Caps Lock and Option included; Option+key that types a character is
 *     treated like AltGr on Windows), in the game's ANSI code page 1252.
 *     Dead keys work as on Windows: WM_DEADCHAR, then the composed
 *     character from the next key (UCKeyTranslate keeps the dead-key state,
 *     what ToUnicode does on Windows).  Return, Backspace, Escape and Tab
 *     give 0x0D, 0x08, 0x1B, 0x09 (a Mac Delete key's own character is 0x7F);
 *   - autorepeat: further WM_KEYDOWN (previous-state bit set) and WM_CHAR,
 *     no new DirectInput event (DirectInput reports changes only).
 * Command keys are the app's (Cmd-Q, Cmd-H, Cmd-M, Cmd-F, Ctrl-Cmd-F, Cmd-Tab
 * never reaches us): a key pressed with Command goes to the menu and the game
 * never sees it, nor the Command key itself.  A key's release always reaches
 * the game if its press did, Command or not, so nothing sticks.  Losing focus
 * (another app, another window of ours) releases every key the game holds:
 * DirectInput key-up events and WM_KEYUP.
 *
 * NFSU2_KEYLAYOUT=<input source id> (test): use that keyboard layout (for
 * example com.apple.keylayout.German) instead of the one selected in macOS,
 * for characters, key names and the ns* script commands. */

#define WM_DEADCHAR   0x0103u

#define WM_SYSCHAR    0x0106u

    [0x29] = {"SEMICOLON", 0x27, 0xBA, 0}, [0x2A] = {"BACKSLASH", 0x2B, 0xDC, 0},
    [0x2B] = {"COMMA", 0x33, 0xBC, 0}, [0x2C] = {"SLASH", 0x35, 0xBF, 0}, [0x2D] = {"N", 0x31, 'N', 0},
    [0x2E] = {"M", 0x32, 'M', 0}, [0x2F] = {"PERIOD", 0x34, 0xBE, 0}, [0x30] = {"TAB", 0x0F, 0x09, 0},
    [0x31] = {"SPACE", 0x39, 0x20, 0}, [0x32] = {"GRAVE", 0x29, 0xC0, 0}, [0x33] = {"BACK", 0x0E, 0x08, 0},
    [0x35] = {"ESCAPE", 0x01, 0x1B, 0},
    [0x36] = {"RCMD", 0, 0, 1}, [0x37] = {"LCMD", 0, 0, 1},            /* the app's, never the game's */
    [0x38] = {"LSHIFT", 0x2A, 0x10, 1}, [0x39] = {"CAPSLOCK", 0x3A, 0x14, 1},
    [0x3A] = {"LOPTION", 0x38, 0x12, 1}, [0x3B] = {"LCONTROL", 0x1D, 0x11, 1},
    [0x3C] = {"RSHIFT", 0x36, 0x10, 1}, [0x3D] = {"ROPTION", 0xB8, 0x12, 1},
    [0x3E] = {"RCONTROL", 0x9D, 0x11, 1}, [0x3F] = {"FN", 0, 0, 1},
    [0x40] = {"F17", 0, 0x80, 1}, [0x41] = {"DECIMAL", 0x53, 0x6E, 0}, [0x43] = {"MULTIPLY", 0x37, 0x6A, 0},
    [0x45] = {"ADD", 0x4E, 0x6B, 0}, [0x47] = {"CLEAR", 0x45, 0x90, 1},  /* Clear sits where Num Lock is */
    [0x4B] = {"DIVIDE", 0xB5, 0x6F, 0}, [0x4C] = {"NUMPADENTER", 0x9C, 0x0D, 0},
    [0x4E] = {"SUBTRACT", 0x4A, 0x6D, 0}, [0x4F] = {"F18", 0, 0x81, 1}, [0x50] = {"F19", 0, 0x82, 1},
    [0x51] = {"NUMPADEQUALS", 0x8D, 0x92, 0}, [0x52] = {"NUMPAD0", 0x52, 0x60, 0},
    [0x53] = {"NUMPAD1", 0x4F, 0x61, 0}, [0x54] = {"NUMPAD2", 0x50, 0x62, 0},
    [0x55] = {"NUMPAD3", 0x51, 0x63, 0}, [0x56] = {"NUMPAD4", 0x4B, 0x64, 0},
    [0x57] = {"NUMPAD5", 0x4C, 0x65, 0}, [0x58] = {"NUMPAD6", 0x4D, 0x66, 0},
    [0x59] = {"NUMPAD7", 0x47, 0x67, 0}, [0x5A] = {"F20", 0, 0x83, 1}, [0x5B] = {"NUMPAD8", 0x48, 0x68, 0},
    [0x5C] = {"NUMPAD9", 0x49, 0x69, 0}, [0x5D] = {"YEN", 0x7D, 0xDC, 0}, [0x5E] = {"RO", 0x73, 0xE2, 0},
    [0x5F] = {"NUMPADCOMMA", 0xB3, 0x6C, 0},
    [0x60] = {"F5", 0x3F, 0x74, 1}, [0x61] = {"F6", 0x40, 0x75, 1}, [0x62] = {"F7", 0x41, 0x76, 1},
    [0x63] = {"F3", 0x3D, 0x72, 1}, [0x64] = {"F8", 0x42, 0x77, 1}, [0x65] = {"F9", 0x43, 0x78, 1},
    [0x66] = {"EISU", 0x7B, 0x1D, 1}, [0x67] = {"F11", 0x57, 0x7A, 1}, [0x68] = {"KANA", 0x70, 0x15, 1},
    [0x69] = {"F13", 0x64, 0x7C, 1}, [0x6A] = {"F16", 0, 0x7F, 1}, [0x6B] = {"F14", 0x65, 0x7D, 1},
    [0x6D] = {"F10", 0x44, 0x79, 1}, [0x6E] = {"APPS", 0xDD, 0x5D, 1}, [0x6F] = {"F12", 0x58, 0x7B, 1},
    [0x71] = {"F15", 0x66, 0x7E, 1}, [0x72] = {"INSERT", 0xD2, 0x2D, 1},   /* Help sits where Insert is */
    [0x73] = {"HOME", 0xC7, 0x24, 1}, [0x74] = {"PRIOR", 0xC9, 0x21, 1}, [0x75] = {"DELETE", 0xD3, 0x2E, 1},
    [0x76] = {"F4", 0x3E, 0x73, 1}, [0x77] = {"END", 0xCF, 0x23, 1}, [0x78] = {"F2", 0x3C, 0x71, 1},
    [0x79] = {"NEXT", 0xD1, 0x22, 1}, [0x7A] = {"F1", 0x3B, 0x70, 1}, [0x7B] = {"LEFT", 0xCB, 0x25, 1},
    [0x7C] = {"RIGHT", 0xCD, 0x27, 1}, [0x7D] = {"DOWN", 0xD0, 0x28, 1}, [0x7E] = {"UP", 0xC8, 0x26, 1},
};
static const struct { const char *alias, *name; } k_alias[] = {
    {"ENTER", "RETURN"}, {"ESC", "ESCAPE"}, {"BACKSPACE", "BACK"}, {"SHIFT", "LSHIFT"},
    {"CTRL", "LCONTROL"}, {"CONTROL", "LCONTROL"}, {"ALT", "LOPTION"}, {"OPTION", "LOPTION"},
    {"LMENU", "LOPTION"}, {"RMENU", "ROPTION"}, {"LALT", "LOPTION"}, {"RALT", "ROPTION"},
    {"CMD", "LCMD"}, {"COMMAND", "LCMD"}, {"CAPITAL", "CAPSLOCK"}, {"CAPS", "CAPSLOCK"},
    {"PGUP", "PRIOR"}, {"PAGEUP", "PRIOR"}, {"PGDN", "NEXT"}, {"PAGEDOWN", "NEXT"},
    {"HELP", "INSERT"}, {"FORWARDDELETE", "DELETE"}, {"NUMLOCK", "CLEAR"}, {"SECTION", "OEM_102"},
};

/* ISO keyboards report the key left of 1 as kVK_ISO_Section (0x0A) and the
 * extra key right of the left Shift as kVK_ANSI_Grave (0x32), so by position
 * those two swap their DIK codes (DIK_GRAVE / DIK_OEM_102) there. */
static int g_iso = -1;
static uint8_t key_dik(uint16_t kc){
    if (kc >= 128) return 0;
    if (g_iso == 1 && kc == 0x0A) return 0x29;
    if (g_iso == 1 && kc == 0x32) return 0x56;
    return K[kc].dik;
}

/* ---- keyboard layout ----------------------------------------------------- */
static CFDataRef g_layout_data;
static const UCKeyboardLayout *g_layout;
static UInt32 g_dead;                       /* dead-key state of the text being typed */
static uint8_t g_vk_layout[128];            /* VK of letter keys on this layout (0 = table) */
/* key names on this layout, for DIK codes (double buffered: the guest reads) */
static char g_names[2][256][12];
static _Atomic int g_names_cur = -1;

static int uc_translate(uint16_t kc, UInt32 mods, int dead_keys, UInt32 *state, UniChar *out, UniCharCount *n){
    *n = 0;
    if (!g_layout) return 0;
    UInt32 st0 = 0;
    OSStatus e = UCKeyTranslate(g_layout, kc, kUCKeyActionDown, mods, LMGetKbdType(),
                                dead_keys ? 0 : kUCKeyTranslateNoDeadKeysMask,
                                state ? state : &st0, 8, n, out);
    return e == noErr;
}
static int cp1252(uint32_t u){
    if (u < 0x80u || (u >= 0xA0u && u <= 0xFFu)) return (int)u;
    static const uint16_t hi[32] = {
        0x20AC, 0, 0x201A, 0x0192, 0x201E, 0x2026, 0x2020, 0x2021, 0x02C6, 0x2030, 0x0160, 0x2039,
        0x0152, 0, 0x017D, 0, 0, 0x2018, 0x2019, 0x201C, 0x201D, 0x2022, 0x2013, 0x2014, 0x02DC,
        0x2122, 0x0161, 0x203A, 0x0153, 0, 0x017E, 0x0178 };
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) if (hi[i] && hi[i] == u) return 0x80 + i;
    return -1;
}
static void build_layout_tables(void){
    int nb = atomic_load(&g_names_cur) == 0 ? 1 : 0;
    memset(g_names[nb], 0, sizeof g_names[nb]);
    memset(g_vk_layout, 0, sizeof g_vk_layout);
    for (uint16_t kc = 0; kc < 128; kc++){
        uint8_t dik = key_dik(kc);
        if (!K[kc].name || K[kc].nochar || !dik) continue;
        if (kc == 0x24 || kc == 0x30 || kc == 0x31 || kc == 0x33 || kc == 0x35) continue;  /* named keys */
        if (kc >= 0x41 && kc <= 0x5C) continue;                                          /* keypad */
        if (kc == 0x5F) continue;
        UniChar u[8]; UniCharCount n;
        if (!uc_translate(kc, 0, 0, NULL, u, &n) || n != 1 || u[0] < 0x21 || u[0] == 0x7F) continue;
        /* letters in capitals, as on the keys; one that has none (ß) as it is */
        NSString *s = [[NSString stringWithCharacters:u length:1] uppercaseString];
        unichar up = [s length] == 1 ? [s characterAtIndex:0] : u[0];
        int b = cp1252(up);
        if (b < 0x21) continue;
        g_names[nb][dik][0] = (char)b; g_names[nb][dik][1] = 0;
        if (up >= 'A' && up <= 'Z') g_vk_layout[kc] = (uint8_t)up;
        else if (K[kc].vk >= 'A' && K[kc].vk <= 'Z'){
            /* a letter position with a non-letter here (AZERTY's M position) */
            switch (u[0]){
            case ',': g_vk_layout[kc] = 0xBC; break; case '.': g_vk_layout[kc] = 0xBE; break;
            case '-': g_vk_layout[kc] = 0xBD; break; case ';': g_vk_layout[kc] = 0xBA; break;
            default: break; }
        }
    }
    atomic_store(&g_names_cur, nb);
}
static void load_layout(void){
    TISInputSourceRef src = NULL;
    const char *want = getenv("NFSU2_KEYLAYOUT");
    if (want && *want){
        NSDictionary *f = @{ (__bridge NSString *)kTISPropertyInputSourceID: [NSString stringWithUTF8String:want] };
        CFArrayRef a = TISCreateInputSourceList((__bridge CFDictionaryRef)f, true);
        if (a && CFArrayGetCount(a)) src = (TISInputSourceRef)CFRetain(CFArrayGetValueAtIndex(a, 0));
        if (a) CFRelease(a);
        if (!src) fprintf(stderr, "[key] NFSU2_KEYLAYOUT %s: no such keyboard layout\n", want);
    }
    if (!src) src = TISCopyCurrentKeyboardLayoutInputSource();
    CFDataRef d = src ? (CFDataRef)TISGetInputSourceProperty(src, kTISPropertyUnicodeKeyLayoutData) : NULL;
    if (d) CFRetain(d);
    if (g_layout_data) CFRelease(g_layout_data);
    g_layout_data = d;
    g_layout = d ? (const UCKeyboardLayout *)CFDataGetBytePtr(d) : NULL;
    g_dead = 0;
    g_iso = KBGetLayoutType(LMGetKbdType()) == kKeyboardISO;
    NSString *sid = src ? (__bridge NSString *)TISGetInputSourceProperty(src, kTISPropertyInputSourceID) : nil;
    fprintf(stderr, "[key] keyboard layout %s%s, keyboard type %u%s\n",
            sid ? [sid UTF8String] : "?", g_layout ? "" : " (no layout data: OS characters only)",
            (unsigned)LMGetKbdType(), g_iso ? " (ISO)" : "");
    if (src) CFRelease(src);
    build_layout_tables();
}
const char *kbdmac_layout_name(unsigned dik){
    int c = atomic_load(&g_names_cur);
    if (c < 0 || dik > 255 || !g_names[c][dik][0]) return 0;
    return g_names[c][dik];
}

static int g_inited;
static void kinit(void){
    if (g_inited) return;
    g_inited = 1;
    load_layout();
    [[NSDistributedNotificationCenter defaultCenter]
        addObserverForName:(__bridge NSString *)kTISNotifySelectedKeyboardInputSourceChanged object:nil
                     queue:[NSOperationQueue mainQueue]
                usingBlock:^(NSNotification *n){ (void)n;
                    const char *w = getenv("NFSU2_KEYLAYOUT");
                    if (!(w && *w)) load_layout(); }];
}

/* ---- delivering keys to the game ------------------------------------------ */
/* alttext: pressed with Option and typed text (AltGr-like), so its release
 * is a WM_KEYUP even while Option is still down, as with AltGr on Windows */
typedef struct { uint8_t down, dik, vk, sys, alttext; } Down;
static Down g_down[128];            /* keys the game has seen go down */
static int  g_alt_other;            /* a key was pressed while Option was down */

static uint32_t key_lparam(uint8_t dik, int alt, int prev, int up){
    return 1u | ((uint32_t)(dik & 0x7Fu) << 16) | ((dik & 0x80u) ? (1u << 24) : 0u)
         | (alt ? (1u << 29) : 0u) | (prev ? (1u << 30) : 0u) | (up ? (1u << 31) : 0u);
}
static uint8_t key_vk(uint16_t kc){
    if (g_vk_layout[kc]) return g_vk_layout[kc];
    /* the ISO swap of key_dik: the VK follows the key's position too, so
     * VK and scan code name the same key (VK_OEM_3 left of 1, VK_OEM_102
     * right of the left Shift) */
    if (g_iso == 1 && kc == 0x0A) return K[0x32].vk;
    if (g_iso == 1 && kc == 0x32) return K[0x0A].vk;
    return K[kc].vk;
}

static void post(uint32_t m, uint32_t wp, uint32_t lp){
    kbd_post(m, wp, lp);
    if (kbd_log()) fprintf(stderr, "[key]   -> %s 0x%02x lParam 0x%08x\n", kbd_msg_name(m), wp, lp);
}
static void press(uint16_t kc, int sys, int repeat){
    uint8_t dik = key_dik(kc), vk = key_vk(kc);
    if (!repeat){
        g_down[kc].down = 1; g_down[kc].dik = dik; g_down[kc].vk = vk; g_down[kc].sys = (uint8_t)sys;
        g_down[kc].alttext = 0;
        if (dik) kbd_set_key(KSRC_HOST, dik, 1);
    }
    if (vk) post(sys ? WM_SYSKEYDOWN : WM_KEYDOWN, vk, key_lparam(dik, sys, repeat, 0));
}
static void release(uint16_t kc, int alt){
    Down *d = &g_down[kc];
    if (!d->down) return;
    d->down = 0;
    if (d->dik) kbd_set_key(KSRC_HOST, d->dik, 0);
    /* Alt alone: WM_SYSKEYUP; a key released while Alt is down too, unless
     * it was pressed as Option text (WM_KEYDOWN, so WM_KEYUP) */
    int sys = (kc == 0x3A || kc == 0x3D) ? !g_alt_other : (alt && !d->alttext);
    if (d->vk) post(sys ? WM_SYSKEYUP : WM_KEYUP, d->vk, key_lparam(d->dik, sys, 1, 1));
}
void kbdmac_release_all(const char *why){
    int n = 0;
    for (uint16_t kc = 0; kc < 128; kc++) if (g_down[kc].down){ release(kc, 0); n++; }
    kbd_release_source(KSRC_HOST);
    g_dead = 0; g_alt_other = 0;
    if (n || kbd_log()) fprintf(stderr, "[key] %s: %d held key(s) released\n", why, n);
}

/* The characters a key down types, in code page 1252.  Returns the count;
 * *dead = the spacing character of a dead key (no WM_CHAR then). */
static int key_chars(NSEvent *ev, uint16_t kc, NSEventModifierFlags fl, uint8_t *out, int cap, int *dead){
    *dead = 0;
    switch (kc){
    case 0x24: case 0x4C: out[0] = 0x0D; g_dead = 0; return 1;      /* Return, keypad Enter */
    case 0x33: out[0] = 0x08; g_dead = 0; return 1;                  /* Delete = Backspace */
    case 0x35: out[0] = 0x1B; g_dead = 0; return 1;
    case 0x30: out[0] = 0x09; g_dead = 0; return 1;                  /* Tab, also with Shift */
    default: break;
    }
    if (K[kc].nochar){ g_dead = 0; return 0; }
    UniChar u[8]; UniCharCount n = 0; int composed = 0;
    if (g_layout){
        UInt32 mods = ((fl & NSEventModifierFlagShift) ? (shiftKey >> 8) : 0)
                    | ((fl & NSEventModifierFlagCapsLock) ? (alphaLock >> 8) : 0)
                    | ((fl & NSEventModifierFlagOption) ? (optionKey >> 8) : 0)
                    | ((fl & NSEventModifierFlagControl) ? (controlKey >> 8) : 0);
        UInt32 before = g_dead;
        if (uc_translate(kc, mods, 1, &g_dead, u, &n)){
            if (n == 0 && g_dead){
                UniChar s[8]; UniCharCount sn;
                if (uc_translate(kc, mods, 0, NULL, s, &sn) && sn >= 1){ int b = cp1252(s[0]); *dead = b > 0 ? b : '?'; }
                else *dead = '?';
                return 0;
            }
            if (before){
                UniChar p[8]; UniCharCount pn;
                composed = !uc_translate(kc, mods, 0, NULL, p, &pn) || pn != n || memcmp(p, u, n * sizeof *u);
            }
        }
    }
    if (!composed){
        /* the characters macOS produced for the event */
        NSString *s = [ev characters];
        NSUInteger l = [s length];
        if (l){ if (l > 8) l = 8; [s getCharacters:u range:NSMakeRange(0, l)]; n = l; }
    }
    int k = 0;
    for (UniCharCount i = 0; i < n && k < cap; i++){
        if (u[i] >= 0xF700 && u[i] <= 0xF8FF) continue;              /* function keys */
        if (u[i] == 0x7F){ out[k++] = 0x08; continue; }
        int b = cp1252(u[i]);
        out[k++] = (uint8_t)(b >= 0 ? b : '?');                      /* as Windows does for an ANSI window */
    }
    return k;
}

static NSEventModifierFlags g_syn_mods;    /* modifiers held by synthesised events */
static void key_down(NSEvent *ev){
    uint16_t kc = [ev keyCode];
    NSEventModifierFlags fl = [ev modifierFlags];
    if (kc >= 128 || !K[kc].name){ if (kbd_log()) fprintf(stderr, "[key] key code 0x%02x ignored\n", kc); return; }
    int repeat = [ev isARepeat];
    if (repeat && !g_down[kc].down) return;                    /* pressed with Command */
    if (!repeat && g_down[kc].down) repeat = 1;                /* its key up was lost */
    uint8_t ch[8]; int dead = 0;
    int nch = key_chars(ev, kc, fl, ch, 8, &dead);
    /* Option+key that types something (a character or a dead key) is text,
     * like AltGr on Windows; otherwise it is Alt+key: WM_SYSKEYDOWN */
    int opt = (fl & NSEventModifierFlagOption) && !(fl & NSEventModifierFlagControl);
    int text = dead != 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nch; i++) if (ch[i] >= 0x20 && ch[i] != '?') text = 1;
    int sys = opt && !text;
    if (sys) nch = 0;
    if (g_down[0x3A].down || g_down[0x3D].down) g_alt_other = 1;
    if (kbd_log())
        fprintf(stderr, "[key] host %s kc=0x%02x %s flags 0x%lx chars %d%s\n", repeat ? "repeat " : "keyDown",
                kc, K[kc].name, (unsigned long)fl, nch, dead ? " (dead key)" : "");
    press(kc, sys, repeat);
    if (!repeat) g_down[kc].alttext = (uint8_t)(opt && text);
    if (dead) post(sys ? 0x0107u : WM_DEADCHAR, (uint32_t)dead, key_lparam(key_dik(kc), sys, repeat, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < nch; i++) post(WM_CHAR, ch[i], key_lparam(key_dik(kc), 0, repeat, 0));
    if (sys && !K[kc].nochar){                                 /* Alt+key: WM_SYSCHAR with the key's character */
        NSString *s = [ev charactersIgnoringModifiers];
        int b = [s length] ? cp1252([s characterAtIndex:0]) : -1;
        if (b >= 0x20 && b != 0x7F) post(WM_SYSCHAR, (uint32_t)b, key_lparam(key_dik(kc), 1, repeat, 0));
    }
}
static void key_up(NSEvent *ev){
    uint16_t kc = [ev keyCode];
    if (kc >= 128) return;
    NSEventModifierFlags fl = [ev modifierFlags];
    if (kbd_log() && g_down[kc].down) fprintf(stderr, "[key] host keyUp   kc=0x%02x %s\n", kc, K[kc].name);
    release(kc, (fl & NSEventModifierFlagOption) != 0);
}
/* Modifier keys come as flagsChanged; the device-dependent bits tell left
 * from right.  Caps Lock reports each press (it toggles): a short tap. */
static void flags_changed(NSEvent *ev){
    uint16_t kc = [ev keyCode];
    NSEventModifierFlags fl = [ev modifierFlags];
    static const struct { uint16_t kc; uint32_t dev; NSEventModifierFlags gen; } M[] = {
        {0x38, 0x0002, NSEventModifierFlagShift},   {0x3C, 0x0004, NSEventModifierFlagShift},
        {0x3B, 0x0001, NSEventModifierFlagControl}, {0x3E, 0x2000, NSEventModifierFlagControl},
        {0x3A, 0x0020, NSEventModifierFlagOption},  {0x3D, 0x0040, NSEventModifierFlagOption},
        {0x37, 0x0008, NSEventModifierFlagCommand}, {0x36, 0x0010, NSEventModifierFlagCommand} };
    if (kc == 0x39){                                           /* Caps Lock */
        if (fl & NSEventModifierFlagCommand) return;
        if (kbd_log()) fprintf(stderr, "[key] host Caps Lock %s\n", (fl & NSEventModifierFlagCapsLock) ? "on" : "off");
        press(kc, 0, 0); release(kc, 0);
        return;
    }
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof M / sizeof *M; i++){
        if (M[i].kc != kc) continue;
        int down = (fl & 0x207Fu) ? (fl & M[i].dev) != 0 : (fl & M[i].gen) != 0;
        if (!K[kc].dik) return;                                /* Command: the app's */
        if (down && !g_down[kc].down){
            if (fl & NSEventModifierFlagCommand) return;       /* part of a Command shortcut */
            int alt = kc == 0x3A || kc == 0x3D;
            if (alt) g_alt_other = 0; else if (g_down[0x3A].down || g_down[0x3D].down) g_alt_other = 1;
            if (kbd_log()) fprintf(stderr, "[key] host %s down\n", K[kc].name);
            press(kc, alt || (fl & NSEventModifierFlagOption), 0);
        } else if (!down && g_down[kc].down){
            if (kbd_log()) fprintf(stderr, "[key] host %s up\n", K[kc].name);
            release(kc, (fl & NSEventModifierFlagOption) != 0);
        }
        return;
    }
}

/* metal.m's event loop, for key and flagsChanged events: 1 = handled, 0 =
 * AppKit's (a Command shortcut: the caller passes it to [NSApp sendEvent:]). */
int kbdmac_handle(NSEvent *ev){
    kinit();
    NSEventType t = [ev type];
    if (t == NSEventTypeFlagsChanged){ flags_changed(ev); return 1; }
    if (t == NSEventTypeKeyDown){
        if ([ev modifierFlags] & NSEventModifierFlagCommand){
            uint16_t kc = [ev keyCode];
            /* a key the game holds that repeats once Command is down too: no
             * shortcut, and no more key downs for the game either */
            if (kc < 128 && g_down[kc].down){
                if (kbd_log()) fprintf(stderr, "[key] host repeat  kc=0x%02x with Command: held by the game, dropped\n", kc);
                return 1;
            }
            if (kbd_log()) fprintf(stderr, "[key] host keyDown kc=0x%02x with Command -> app, not the game\n", kc);
            return 0;
        }
        key_down(ev);
        return 1;
    }
    if (t == NSEventTypeKeyUp){
        uint16_t kc = [ev keyCode];
        if (kc < 128 && g_down[kc].down){ key_up(ev); return 1; }
        return ([ev modifierFlags] & NSEventModifierFlagCommand) ? 0 : 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* ---- synthesised events (autotest ns* commands) ---------------------------
 * Requests come from the guest thread; kbdmac_tick() (main thread, once per
 * event-loop pass, before the queue is read) turns them into NSEvents posted
 * to AppKit's queue, so they arrive like a real keyboard's. */
typedef struct { int type; char key[40]; uint32_t ch; double a, b; } Req;
static Req g_rq[256]; static unsigned g_rq_h, g_rq_t;
static pthread_mutex_t g_rq_mx = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static void enqueue(const Req *r){
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_rq_mx);
    unsigned nx = (g_rq_t + 1u) % 256u;
    if (nx != g_rq_h){ g_rq[g_rq_t] = *r; g_rq_t = nx; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rq_mx);
}
static int lookup_key(const char *nm){
    if (!strncasecmp(nm, "kc:", 3)){ unsigned v = (unsigned)strtoul(nm + 3, 0, 0); return v < 128 ? (int)v : -1; }
    if (!strncasecmp(nm, "DIK_", 4)) nm += 4;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof k_alias / sizeof *k_alias; i++)
        if (!strcasecmp(nm, k_alias[i].alias)){ nm = k_alias[i].name; break; }
    for (int kc = 0; kc < 128; kc++) if (K[kc].name && !strcasecmp(K[kc].name, nm)) return kc;
    return -1;
}
int kbdmac_synth_key(int type, const char *key){
    /* validate here (guest thread) so the script logs a bad name */
    char tmp[40]; snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s", key);
    char *last = tmp;
    for (char *p = tmp; (p = strchr(p, '+')) && p[1]; p++) last = p + 1;
    if (lookup_key(last) < 0) return 0;
    Req r = { type, {0}, 0, 0, 0 };
    snprintf(r.key, sizeof r.key, "%s", key);
    enqueue(&r);
    return 1;
}
int kbdmac_synth_char(int type, uint32_t u){
    Req r = { type, {0}, u, 0, 0 };
    enqueue(&r);
    return 1;
}
void kbdmac_synth_simple(int type, double a, double b){
    Req r = { type, {0}, 0, a, b };
    enqueue(&r);
}

NSWindow *metal_nswindow(void);                    /* metal.m */
static NSInteger win_number(void){ NSWindow *w = metal_nswindow(); return w ? [w windowNumber] : 0; }
static NSTimeInterval now_ts(void){ return [[NSProcessInfo processInfo] systemUptime]; }

/* modifier flags bits of a modifier key (generic | device-dependent) */
static NSEventModifierFlags mod_bits(uint16_t kc){
    switch (kc){
    case 0x38: return NSEventModifierFlagShift | 0x0002;   case 0x3C: return NSEventModifierFlagShift | 0x0004;
    case 0x3B: return NSEventModifierFlagControl | 0x0001; case 0x3E: return NSEventModifierFlagControl | 0x2000;
    case 0x3A: return NSEventModifierFlagOption | 0x0020;  case 0x3D: return NSEventModifierFlagOption | 0x0040;
    case 0x37: return NSEventModifierFlagCommand | 0x0008; case 0x36: return NSEventModifierFlagCommand | 0x0010;
    case 0x3F: return NSEventModifierFlagFunction;
    default: return 0;
    }
}
static int is_modifier(uint16_t kc){ return mod_bits(kc) != 0 || kc == 0x39; }
static void post_flags(uint16_t kc, int down){
    if (kc == 0x39){
        if (down){ g_syn_mods ^= NSEventModifierFlagCapsLock; } else return;   /* one event per press */
    } else if (down) g_syn_mods |= mod_bits(kc);
    else {
        g_syn_mods &= ~(mod_bits(kc) & 0xFFFFu);
        NSEventModifierFlags gen = mod_bits(kc) & ~(NSEventModifierFlags)0xFFFFu;
        /* the generic flag stays while the other side's key is held */
        int other = 0;
        for (uint16_t o = 0x36; o <= 0x3E; o++)
            if (o != kc && (mod_bits(o) & gen) && (g_syn_mods & mod_bits(o) & 0xFFFFu)) other = 1;
        if (!other) g_syn_mods &= ~gen;
    }
    NSEvent *e = [NSEvent keyEventWithType:NSEventTypeFlagsChanged location:NSZeroPoint modifierFlags:g_syn_mods
                                 timestamp:now_ts() windowNumber:win_number() context:nil characters:@""
                charactersIgnoringModifiers:@"" isARepeat:NO keyCode:kc];
    if (e) [NSApp postEvent:e atStart:NO];
}
/* the characters a key types with g_syn_mods, as macOS would put in the event */
static NSString *syn_chars(uint16_t kc, NSEventModifierFlags fl, int ignoring){
    switch (kc){
    case 0x24: return @"\r";  case 0x4C: return @"\x03"; case 0x33: return @"\x7f";
    case 0x35: return @"\x1b"; case 0x30: return (fl & NSEventModifierFlagShift) ? @"\x19" : @"\t";
    case 0x7B: return [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%C", (unichar)NSLeftArrowFunctionKey];
    case 0x7C: return [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%C", (unichar)NSRightArrowFunctionKey];
    case 0x7D: return [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%C", (unichar)NSDownArrowFunctionKey];
    case 0x7E: return [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%C", (unichar)NSUpArrowFunctionKey];
    case 0x73: return [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%C", (unichar)NSHomeFunctionKey];
    case 0x77: return [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%C", (unichar)NSEndFunctionKey];
    case 0x74: return [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%C", (unichar)NSPageUpFunctionKey];
    case 0x79: return [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%C", (unichar)NSPageDownFunctionKey];
    case 0x75: return [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%C", (unichar)NSDeleteFunctionKey];
    case 0x72: return [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%C", (unichar)NSHelpFunctionKey];
    default: break;
    }
    static const uint8_t fk[] = {0x7A, 0x78, 0x63, 0x76, 0x60, 0x61, 0x62, 0x64, 0x65, 0x6D, 0x67, 0x6F,
                                 0x69, 0x6B, 0x71, 0x6A, 0x40, 0x4F, 0x50, 0x5A};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof fk; i++)
        if (fk[i] == kc) return [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%C", (unichar)(NSF1FunctionKey + i)];
    if (K[kc].nochar) return @"";
    UInt32 mods = ((fl & NSEventModifierFlagShift) ? (shiftKey >> 8) : 0)
                | ((fl & NSEventModifierFlagCapsLock) ? (alphaLock >> 8) : 0)
                | (!ignoring && (fl & NSEventModifierFlagOption) ? (optionKey >> 8) : 0)
                | (!ignoring && (fl & NSEventModifierFlagControl) ? (controlKey >> 8) : 0);
    UniChar u[8]; UniCharCount n;
    if (!uc_translate(kc, mods, 0, NULL, u, &n)) return @"";
    return [NSString stringWithCharacters:u length:n];
}
static NSEventModifierFlags key_extra_flags(uint16_t kc){
    if (kc >= 0x7B && kc <= 0x7E) return NSEventModifierFlagFunction | NSEventModifierFlagNumericPad;
    if (kc >= 0x41 && kc <= 0x5C && !K[kc].nochar) return NSEventModifierFlagNumericPad;
    if (K[kc].nochar && !is_modifier(kc)) return NSEventModifierFlagFunction;
    return 0;
}
static void post_key(uint16_t kc, int type){
    if (is_modifier(kc)){ post_flags(kc, type != KSYN_UP); return; }
    NSEventModifierFlags fl = g_syn_mods | key_extra_flags(kc);
    NSEvent *e = [NSEvent keyEventWithType:type == KSYN_UP ? NSEventTypeKeyUp : NSEventTypeKeyDown
                                  location:NSZeroPoint modifierFlags:fl timestamp:now_ts()
                              windowNumber:win_number() context:nil
                                characters:syn_chars(kc, fl, 0)
               charactersIgnoringModifiers:syn_chars(kc, fl, 1)
                                 isARepeat:type == KSYN_REPEAT keyCode:kc];
    if (e) [NSApp postEvent:e atStart:NO];
}
/* "cmd+shift+Q": modifiers down in order, the key, and (key up) the reverse */
static void synth_key(const Req *r){
    char tmp[40]; snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s", r->key);
    uint16_t mods[4]; int nm = 0;
    char *p = tmp, *plus;
    while ((plus = strchr(p, '+')) && plus[1]){
        *plus = 0;
        int m = lookup_key(!strcasecmp(p, "cmd") ? "LCMD" : !strcasecmp(p, "shift") ? "LSHIFT"
                         : !strcasecmp(p, "ctrl") ? "LCONTROL" : !strcasecmp(p, "opt") || !strcasecmp(p, "alt")
                         ? "LOPTION" : p);
        if (m >= 0 && nm < 4) mods[nm++] = (uint16_t)m;
        p = plus + 1;
    }
    int kc = lookup_key(p);
    if (kc < 0) return;
    if (r->type == KSYN_UP){
        post_key((uint16_t)kc, KSYN_UP);
        for (int i = nm - 1; i >= 0; i--) post_flags(mods[i], 0);
    } else {
        if (r->type == KSYN_DOWN) for (int i = 0; i < nm; i++) post_flags(mods[i], 1);
        post_key((uint16_t)kc, r->type);
    }
}
/* nstype: the key (and Shift / Option) typing u on this layout, or a dead
 * key followed by one */
typedef struct { int kc, mods, dkc, dmods; } Stroke;
static int find_stroke(uint32_t u, Stroke *s){
    static const int mset[4] = {0, shiftKey >> 8, optionKey >> 8, (shiftKey | optionKey) >> 8};
    s->dkc = -1;
    switch (u){
    case '\r': case '\n': s->kc = 0x24; s->mods = 0; return 1;
    case '\b': s->kc = 0x33; s->mods = 0; return 1;
    case '\t': s->kc = 0x30; s->mods = 0; return 1;
    case 0x1B: s->kc = 0x35; s->mods = 0; return 1;
    default: break;
    }
    for (int m = 0; m < 4; m++)
        for (int kc = 0; kc < 128; kc++){
            if (!K[kc].name || K[kc].nochar || (kc >= 0x41 && kc <= 0x5F)) continue;   /* main keys */
            UniChar c[8]; UniCharCount n;
            if (uc_translate((uint16_t)kc, (UInt32)mset[m], 0, NULL, c, &n) && n == 1 && c[0] == u){
                UInt32 st = 0; UniCharCount n2;
                uc_translate((uint16_t)kc, (UInt32)mset[m], 1, &st, c, &n2);
                if (n2 == 0 && st) continue;                       /* a dead key there */
                s->kc = kc; s->mods = mset[m]; return 1;
            }
        }
    for (int dm = 0; dm < 4; dm++)
        for (int dk = 0; dk < 128; dk++){
            if (!K[dk].name || K[dk].nochar) continue;
            UniChar c[8]; UniCharCount n; UInt32 st = 0;
            if (!uc_translate((uint16_t)dk, (UInt32)mset[dm], 1, &st, c, &n) || n || !st) continue;
            for (int m = 0; m < 4; m++)
                for (int kc = 0; kc < 0x41; kc++){
                    if (!K[kc].name || K[kc].nochar) continue;
                    UInt32 st2 = st;
                    if (uc_translate((uint16_t)kc, (UInt32)mset[m], 1, &st2, c, &n) && n == 1 && c[0] == u){
                        s->dkc = dk; s->dmods = mset[dm]; s->kc = kc; s->mods = mset[m]; return 1; }
                }
        }
    return 0;
}
static void stroke_mods(int mods, int down){
    if (mods & (shiftKey >> 8)) post_flags(0x38, down);
    if (mods & (optionKey >> 8)) post_flags(0x3A, down);
}
static void synth_char(const Req *r){
    Stroke s;
    if (!find_stroke(r->ch, &s)){
        if (r->type == KSYN_CHAR_DOWN) fprintf(stderr, "[key] nstype: no key types U+%04X on this layout\n", r->ch);
        return;
    }
    if (r->type == KSYN_CHAR_DOWN){
        if (s.dkc >= 0){
            stroke_mods(s.dmods, 1);
            post_key((uint16_t)s.dkc, KSYN_DOWN); post_key((uint16_t)s.dkc, KSYN_UP);
            stroke_mods(s.dmods, 0);
        }
        stroke_mods(s.mods, 1);
        post_key((uint16_t)s.kc, KSYN_DOWN);
    } else {
        post_key((uint16_t)s.kc, KSYN_UP);
        stroke_mods(s.mods, 0);
    }
}
static void synth_mouse(const Req *r){
    NSWindow *w = metal_nswindow();
    if (!w) return;
    static NSPoint at = {0, 0}; static int have = 0;
    NSRect cr = [[w contentView] frame];
    if (r->type == KSYN_MOUSE_MOVE || !have){
        double x = r->type == KSYN_MOUSE_MOVE ? r->a : 0.5, y = r->type == KSYN_MOUSE_MOVE ? r->b : 0.5;
        at = NSMakePoint(cr.origin.x + x * cr.size.width, cr.origin.y + (1.0 - y) * cr.size.height);
        have = 1;
    }
    if (r->type == KSYN_SCROLL){
        /* AppKit has no constructor for scroll events: a CGEvent, posted the same way */
        CGEventRef cg = CGEventCreateScrollWheelEvent(NULL, kCGScrollEventUnitLine, 1, (int32_t)r->a);
        NSEvent *e = cg ? [NSEvent eventWithCGEvent:cg] : nil;
        if (cg) CFRelease(cg);
        if (e) [NSApp postEvent:e atStart:NO];
        return;
    }
    int b = (int)r->a;
    NSEventType t = r->type == KSYN_MOUSE_MOVE ? NSEventTypeMouseMoved
                  : r->type == KSYN_MOUSE_DOWN ? (b == 0 ? NSEventTypeLeftMouseDown : b == 1 ? NSEventTypeRightMouseDown : NSEventTypeOtherMouseDown)
                  : (b == 0 ? NSEventTypeLeftMouseUp : b == 1 ? NSEventTypeRightMouseUp : NSEventTypeOtherMouseUp);
    NSEvent *e = [NSEvent mouseEventWithType:t location:at modifierFlags:g_syn_mods timestamp:now_ts()
                                windowNumber:[w windowNumber] context:nil eventNumber:0 clickCount:1
                                    pressure:r->type == KSYN_MOUSE_DOWN ? 1.f : 0.f];
    if (e) [NSApp postEvent:e atStart:NO];
}
void kbdmac_tick(void){
    kinit();
    for (;;){
        Req r;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_rq_mx);
        if (g_rq_h == g_rq_t){ pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rq_mx); break; }
        r = g_rq[g_rq_h]; g_rq_h = (g_rq_h + 1u) % 256u;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rq_mx);
        switch (r.type){
        case KSYN_DOWN: case KSYN_UP: case KSYN_REPEAT: synth_key(&r); break;
        case KSYN_CHAR_DOWN: case KSYN_CHAR_UP: synth_char(&r); break;
        case KSYN_FOCUS_OUT: case KSYN_FOCUS_IN: {
            /* AppKit's own handlers (metal.m's NfsuDelegate), as for a real switch */
            id del = [NSApp delegate];
            NSString *nm = r.type == KSYN_FOCUS_OUT ? NSApplicationDidResignActiveNotification
                                                    : NSApplicationDidBecomeActiveNotification;
            NSNotification *n = [NSNotification notificationWithName:nm object:NSApp];
            SEL sel = r.type == KSYN_FOCUS_OUT ? @selector(applicationDidResignActive:)
                                               : @selector(applicationDidBecomeActive:);
            fprintf(stderr, "[key] simulated %s\n", r.type == KSYN_FOCUS_OUT ? "focus loss" : "focus gain");
            if ([del respondsToSelector:sel]){
                #pragma clang diagnostic push
                #pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Warc-performSelector-leaks"
                [del performSelector:sel withObject:n];
                #pragma clang diagnostic pop
            }
            break; }
        default: synth_mouse(&r); break;
        }
    }
}

/* language.c -- the game's language: NFSU2_LANGUAGE (settings.ini "language").
 *
 *   english (default), french, german, italian, spanish, dutch, swedish,
 *   danish, korean, chinese, japanese, russian, thai, portuguese, polish,
 *   turkish, hungarian, ukrainian, czech, slovak, greek
 *
 * SPEED2.EXE reads its language once at startup from the registry value
 * "Language" (0x5b7955, against the names at 0x7fca08: "English US" ...
 * "Thai") and loads LANGUAGES\<NAME>.BIN through its language table
 * (0x7f7020: 16-byte entries id, name, file, font block; the current id at
 * 0x7f70d0, right after the table).  For French, German, Italian, Spanish and
 * Japanese it also opens its own dubbed speech bank,
 * speech/UG2_Speech_FR/GR/IT/SP/JP.*, if there is one (0x484250), and the
 * English one otherwise.  win32_ext.c answers "Language" with
 * language_registry().
 *
 * What a language needs beyond the retail folder (the dubbed speech and
 * movies, the full Chinese, Japanese and Thai text with the fonts drawn for
 * it, Russian, Portuguese, Polish, Turkish, Hungarian, Ukrainian, Czech, Slovak, Greek) comes from LANGPACKS/<language>
 * in the game folder, built by tools/langpacks.py: fileio.c reads a file there
 * in place of the game folder's file of the same path.  A language without a
 * pack plays its text with English voices and movies.  English's own pack,
 * if the server has one, is its text with the movies' lines whole (below).
 *
 * Two things the North American exe cannot do by itself, which the
 * multilingual mod's U2_ThaiSupport.asi patches into its code; here they are
 * changes to its data, before the game runs:
 *  - the language pool (0x4ff680, "LanguageMemoryPool") is sized for the
 *    fonts of the English entry (147 KB), but the Korean, Chinese, Japanese
 *    and Thai fonts are 868 KB: they would not fit.  Its font size table
 *    (0x7f6de8, read only there) gives the first English font the difference.
 *  - the table ends at Japanese (id 10): Thai (11) is in the registry names
 *    but has no entry.  In a Thai game Japanese's entry becomes Thai's: its
 *    id, its name and file ("JAPANESE" -> "THAILAND", the same length) and
 *    the font hashes of its block.
 * Russian, Portuguese (Brazil's), Polish, Turkish, Hungarian, Ukrainian,
 * Czech, Slovak and Greek are no languages of the North American game: they
 * play as English, with English's files from LANGPACKS/russian, /portuguese,
 * /polish, /turkish, /hungarian, /ukrainian, /czech, /slovak or /greek.  Ukrainian's are
 * Russian's fonts with its text in their letters (І і Ї ї Є є at 0xE2-0xE7).
 * Polish's and Turkish's texts spell their letters with accented ones of the
 * game's fonts, whose textures in their packs draw them as the Polish or
 * Turkish ones.  Hungarian's spells its o and u with the double acute as the
 * fonts' o with the tilde and u with the circumflex, as its translation does.
 * Czech's keeps the game's fonts and writes its letters with the caron and u
 * with the ring without them (c, r, s, z, e, u ...), as its translation does.
 * Slovak's text is Windows-1250 (s-caron 0x9A, c-caron 0xE8, l-caron 0xBE
 * ...), which its pack's fonts draw.  Greek's pack is made by
 * tools/greekfont/build_greek.py: the game's fonts with Greek letters added,
 * which its text writes as bytes 0xA1-0xEC (EL below); the bigger fonts get
 * the language pool 64 KB more.
 *
 * The movies' subtitles (SUBTITLES/<movie>: when to show which of the
 * language's texts) are shown by the game's region ([0x864f24], 0x570a30),
 * not by its language: in regions 2 and 5 for every language but English, in
 * 4 and 12 for all, and in this exe's own, 0, never.  language_hook() shows
 * them (NFSU2_SUBTITLES, on by default) for a language whose text has the
 * movies' lines: not the dubbed French, German, Italian and Spanish, whose
 * texts leave the lines their dubs speak empty (the game would still draw an
 * empty line's bar), and English only with its pack: the game folder's
 * English lines stop at their first apostrophe ("But if you").  The pack's
 * are VileStuff's English Subtitles Fixed (tools/langpacks.py --subs): whole,
 * and with who speaks them. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "guest.h"
#include "game.h"
#include "widescreen.h"           /* HOOK_SITE */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <strings.h>

int fileio_set_language_pack(const char *rel);

#define FONT_SIZES  0x7f6de8u      /* 15 x { hash, size }, read by 0x4ff680 only */
#define LATIN_FONTS 0x7f6e60u      /* font blocks: the hashes, then 0 */
#define KO_FONTS    0x7f6ed0u

#define ZH_FONTS    0x7f6fb0u

static const struct lang *g_lang = &LANGS[0];

static int g_english_pack;        /* English's text is its pack's, with the movies' lines whole */
