/* win32_call, after a ws2_32 import of a lifted module returned */
void module_note_socket_call(int mod, const char *name, uint32_t arg0, uint32_t r){
    if (mod < 1 || mod > NMOD) return;
    GuestMod *m = &g_mods[mod - 1];
    if ((!strcmp(name, "socket") || !strcmp(name, "accept")) && r != 0xFFFFFFFFu && r){
        if (m->nsocks < 256) m->socks[m->nsocks++] = r;
    } else if (!strcmp(name, "closesocket") && r == 0){
        for (int i = 0; i < m->nsocks; i++)
            if (m->socks[i] == arg0){ m->socks[i] = m->socks[--m->nsocks]; break; }
    }
}

static void build_index(GuestMod *m){
    if (m->idx || !mod_lifted(m)) return;
    const ModInfo *mi = m->info;
    m->idx = calloc(mi->text_size, sizeof *m->idx);
    if (!m->idx){ fprintf(stderr, "[module] %s: no memory for the dispatch index\n", mi->name); return; }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < *m->fn_count; i++){
        uint32_t off = m->fn_addr[i] - mi->text;
        if (off < mi->text_size) m->idx[off] = i + 1;
    }
}

/* "server", "SERVER.DLL", "C:\\x\\server.dll" -> "server.dll" (Windows adds
 * ".dll" when the name has no extension; a trailing dot means none). */
static void norm_name(const char *in, char *out, size_t n){
    const char *b = in;
    for (const char *p = in; *p; p++) if (*p == '\\' || *p == '/') b = p + 1;
    size_t k = 0;
    for (; b[k] && k + 5 < n; k++) out[k] = (char)tolower((unsigned char)b[k]);
    out[k] = 0;
    if (k && out[k-1] == '.') out[k-1] = 0;
    else if (!strchr(out, '.') && k + 5 < n) strcat(out, ".dll");
}
static GuestMod *by_name(const char *name){
    char nm[260]; norm_name(name, nm, sizeof nm);
    for (int i = 0; i < NMOD; i++) if (g_mods[i].info->name[0] && !strcmp(nm, g_mods[i].info->name)) return &g_mods[i];
    return 0;
}
static GuestMod *by_handle(uint32_t h){
    for (int i = 0; i < NMOD; i++) if (g_mods[i].info->name[0] && h == g_mods[i].info->base) return &g_mods[i];
    return 0;
}

static void hexsha(const uint8_t *buf, size_t n, char out[65]){
    uint8_t d[CC_SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH];
    CC_SHA256(buf, (CC_LONG)n, d);
    for (int i = 0; i < CC_SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH; i++) snprintf(out + 2*i, 3, "%02x", d[i]);
}

static uint32_t rd32(const uint8_t *p){ return (uint32_t)p[0] | (uint32_t)p[1] << 8 | (uint32_t)p[2] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[3] << 24; }
static uint16_t rd16(const uint8_t *p){ return (uint16_t)(p[0] | p[1] << 8); }

/* Map, relocate and bind.  Returns 0 and sets *err (Win32 error) on failure. */
static int map_image(GuestMod *m, uint32_t *err){
    const ModInfo *mi = m->info;
    char host[1024];
    if (!fileio_resolve_game(mi->name, host, sizeof host)){
        fprintf(stderr, "[module] %s: not found in the game folder: LAN hosting is not available\n", mi->name);
        *err = 126u; return 0;                                   /* ERROR_MOD_NOT_FOUND */
    }
    FILE *f = fopen(host, "rb");
    if (!f){ fprintf(stderr, "[module] %s: cannot read %s\n", mi->name, host); *err = 126u; return 0; }
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END); long sz = ftell(f); fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint8_t *buf = sz > 0 ? malloc((size_t)sz) : 0;
    if (!buf || fread(buf, 1, (size_t)sz, f) != (size_t)sz){ fclose(f); free(buf); *err = 126u; return 0; }
    fclose(f);
    char sha[65]; hexsha(buf, (size_t)sz, sha);
    if (strcmp(sha, mi->sha256)){
        if (!m->refused++)
            fprintf(stderr, "[module] %s in the game folder (%s, %ld bytes, sha256 %s) is not the file this build"
                            " was lifted from (sha256 %s, %u bytes): it is NOT loaded, LAN hosting is disabled."
                            " Restore the original server.dll of NFSU2 v1.2, or re-run gen.sh with this file.\n",
                    mi->name, host, sz, sha, mi->sha256, mi->file_size);
        free(buf); *err = 193u; return 0;                        /* ERROR_BAD_EXE_FORMAT */
    }
    /* The hash pins the file, so these only guard against a broken gen. */
    uint32_t lfa = rd32(buf + 0x3c);
    const uint8_t *nt = buf + lfa, *opt = nt + 24;
    uint16_t nsec = rd16(nt + 6), optsz = rd16(nt + 20);
    uint32_t pref = rd32(opt + 28), imgsz = rd32(opt + 56), hdrsz = rd32(opt + 60), ep = rd32(opt + 16);
    if (rd32(nt) != 0x4550u || pref != mi->pref || imgsz != mi->size || mi->base + ep != mi->entry){
        fprintf(stderr, "[module] %s: PE layout does not match gen/ (base 0x%x size 0x%x entry 0x%x)\n",
                mi->name, pref, imgsz, ep);
        free(buf); *err = 193u; return 0;
    }
    uint32_t base = mi->base, delta = base - pref;
    mem_commit(base, imgsz);
    memset(g_mem + base, 0, imgsz);
    memcpy(g_mem + base, buf, hdrsz < (uint32_t)sz ? hdrsz : (uint32_t)sz);
    const uint8_t *sh = opt + optsz;
    for (int i = 0; i < nsec; i++, sh += 40){
        uint32_t vs = rd32(sh + 8), va = rd32(sh + 12), rs = rd32(sh + 16), ro = rd32(sh + 20);
        uint32_t n = rs < vs ? rs : vs;
        if (va + n > imgsz || ro + n > (uint32_t)sz){ free(buf); *err = 193u; return 0; }
        memcpy(g_mem + base + va, buf + ro, n);
    }
    free(buf);
    /* base relocations (DataDirectory[5]) */
    uint32_t rva = MR32(base + lfa + 24 + 96 + 5*8), rsz = MR32(base + lfa + 24 + 96 + 5*8 + 4);
    uint32_t nfix = 0;
    for (uint32_t off = 0; off + 8 <= rsz; ){
        uint32_t page = MR32(base + rva + off), bsz = MR32(base + rva + off + 4);
        if (bsz < 8) break;
        for (uint32_t k = 8; k + 2 <= bsz; k += 2){
            uint16_t e = MR16(base + rva + off + k);
            uint32_t t = e >> 12, at = base + page + (e & 0xfffu);
            if (t == 0) continue;                                /* ABSOLUTE: padding */
            if (t != 3 || at + 4 > base + imgsz){
                fprintf(stderr, "[module] %s: unsupported relocation type %u at 0x%08x\n", mi->name, t, at);
                *err = 193u; return 0; }
            MR32(at) += delta; nfix++;
        }
        off += bsz;
    }
    MR32(base + lfa + 24 + 28) = base;                           /* the loader records the actual base */
    /* imports: one index space with the exe's (win32_call) */
    uint32_t first = module_imp_first((int)(m - g_mods) + 1);
    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < *m->imp_count; j++){
        uint32_t iat = m->imp[j].iat;
        if (iat - base >= imgsz){ *err = 193u; return 0; }
        MR32(iat) = IMP_MAGIC + first + j;
    }
    snprintf(m->path, sizeof m->path, "%s", host);
    fprintf(stderr, "[module] %s mapped at 0x%08x-0x%08x from %s (sha256 ok, %u fixups, %u imports bound)\n",
            mi->name, base, base + imgsz, host, nfix, *m->imp_count);
    return 1;
}

uint32_t module_load(CPU *c, const char *name, uint32_t *err){
    GuestMod *m = by_name(name);
    *err = 126u;
    if (!m) return 0;
    if (!mod_lifted(m)){
        fprintf(stderr, "[module] %s: not lifted into this build (gen.sh found no %s next to SPEED2.EXE):"
                        " LAN hosting is not available\n", m->info->name, m->info->name);
        return 0;
    }
    if (m->mapped){ m->refs++; return m->info->base; }
    if (!map_image(m, err)) return 0;
    build_index(m);
    m->mapped = 1; m->refs = 1; m->loads++;
    m->nsocks = 0; m->fds_at_load = host_fds_open();
    const uint32_t args[3] = { m->info->base, DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH, 0 };
    uint32_t ok = call_guest(c, m->info->entry, 3, args);
    fprintf(stderr, "[module] %s: DllMain(PROCESS_ATTACH) -> %u (load %llu)\n", m->info->name, ok,
            (unsigned long long)m->loads);
    if (!ok){
        /* Windows: DETACH right away, then unload; LoadLibrary returns NULL */
        const uint32_t a2[3] = { m->info->base, DLL_PROCESS_DETACH, 0 };
        call_guest(c, m->info->entry, 3, a2);
        m->mapped = 0; m->refs = 0; m->unloads++;
        *err = 1114u;                                            /* ERROR_DLL_INIT_FAILED */
        return 0;
    }
    *err = 0;
    return m->info->base;
}

int module_free(CPU *c, uint32_t h){
    GuestMod *m = by_handle(h);
    if (!m) return 0;
    if (!m->mapped || m->refs <= 0) return 1;
    if (--m->refs > 0) return 1;
    const uint32_t args[3] = { m->info->base, DLL_PROCESS_DETACH, 0 };
    uint32_t r = call_guest(c, m->info->entry, 3, args);
    m->mapped = 0; m->unloads++;
    fprintf(stderr, "[module] %s: DllMain(PROCESS_DETACH) -> %u, unloaded (pages kept); %d of its sockets still open,"
                    " host fds %d (%d at load)\n", m->info->name, r, m->nsocks, host_fds_open(), m->fds_at_load);
    for (int i = 0; i < m->nsocks && i < 8; i++) fprintf(stderr, "[module]   still open: SOCKET 0x%x\n", m->socks[i]);
    return 1;
}

int module_handle(uint32_t h){ return by_handle(h) != 0; }
int module_known_name(const char *name){ return by_name(name) != 0; }
uint32_t module_by_name(const char *name){
    GuestMod *m = by_name(name);
    return m && m->mapped ? m->info->base : 0u;
}

/* GetProcAddress on a mapped module: export by name, or by ordinal when
 * the "name" is <= 0xFFFF. */
uint32_t module_proc(uint32_t h, uint32_t nm, uint32_t *err){
    GuestMod *m = by_handle(h);
    *err = 127u;                                                 /* ERROR_PROC_NOT_FOUND */
    if (!m || !m->mapped){ *err = 126u; return 0; }
    uint32_t base = m->info->base, lfa = MR32(base + 0x3c);
    uint32_t ed = MR32(base + lfa + 24 + 96), esz = MR32(base + lfa + 24 + 96 + 4);
    if (!ed) return 0;
    uint32_t E = base + ed;
    uint32_t obase = MR32(E + 0x10), nfun = MR32(E + 0x14), nnam = MR32(E + 0x18);
    uint32_t funs = base + MR32(E + 0x1c), nams = base + MR32(E + 0x20), ords = base + MR32(E + 0x24);
    uint32_t fi = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    if (nm <= 0xFFFFu){ if (nm >= obase && nm - obase < nfun) fi = nm - obase; }
    else if (mem_is_committed(nm)){
        const char *want = (const char *)(g_mem + nm);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nnam; i++)
            if (!strcmp((const char *)(g_mem + base + MR32(nams + 4*i)), want)){ fi = MR16(ords + 2*i); break; }
    }
    if (fi >= nfun) return 0;
    uint32_t frva = MR32(funs + 4*fi);
    if (!frva || (frva >= ed && frva < ed + esz)) return 0;      /* empty or forwarded */
    *err = 0;
    return base + frva;
}

int module_file_name(uint32_t h, char *out, int n){
    GuestMod *m = by_handle(h);
    if (!m || !m->mapped) return 0;
    snprintf(out, (size_t)n, "C:\\NFSU2\\%s", m->info->name);
    return 1;
}

uint32_t module_imp_first(int m){ return m == 1 ? g_imp_count : 0u; }
int module_of_import(uint32_t idx){ return idx >= g_imp_count ? 1 : 0; }

mod_fn module_fn_at(uint32_t addr){
    GuestMod *m = &g_mods[0];
    uint32_t off = addr - m->info->text;
    if (off >= m->info->text_size || !m->idx) return 0;
    uint32_t k = m->idx[off];
    if (!k) return 0;
    if (!m->mapped){
        static int said = 0;
        if (said++ < 4) fprintf(stderr, "[module] WARNING: call to 0x%08x in %s while it is not loaded\n",
                                addr, m->info->name);
    }
    return m->fn_ptr[k - 1];
}

uint32_t module_nearest_fn(uint32_t a, const char **mod){
    for (int i = 0; i < NMOD; i++){
        GuestMod *m = &g_mods[i];
        if (!mod_lifted(m) || a - m->info->text >= m->info->text_size) continue;
        uint32_t lo = 0, hi = *m->fn_count, best = 0;
        while (lo < hi){ uint32_t md = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (m->fn_addr[md] <= a){ best = m->fn_addr[md]; lo = md + 1; } else hi = md; }
        if (mod) *mod = m->info->name;
        return best;
    }
    return 0;
}

uint32_t module_fn_from_host(const void *pc){
    uintptr_t p = (uintptr_t)pc, best = 0; uint32_t bestg = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < NMOD; i++){
        GuestMod *m = &g_mods[i];
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < *m->fn_count; k++){
            uintptr_t f = (uintptr_t)m->fn_ptr[k];
            if (f <= p && f > best){ best = f; bestg = m->fn_addr[k]; }
        }
    }
    return bestg;
}

void module_report(void){
    for (int i = 0; i < NMOD; i++){
        GuestMod *m = &g_mods[i];
        if (!mod_lifted(m)){ fprintf(stderr, "  module %-10s : not lifted into this build (gen.sh found none)\n", m->info->name); continue; }
        fprintf(stderr, "  module %-10s : %u functions lifted, %llu loads, %llu unloads, %s%s\n",
                m->info->name, *m->fn_count, (unsigned long long)m->loads, (unsigned long long)m->unloads,
                m->mapped ? "loaded" : "not loaded", m->refused ? ", REFUSED (sha256 mismatch)" : "");
    }
}

/* ---- test: host start/stop cycles through the game's own glue ------------
 * Script command "srvcycle N [hold_ms]" (autotest.c), on the guest main
 * thread at Present: N times StartLANServer (SPEED2.EXE 0x5FA300, thiscall
 * on 0x89CF48: LoadLibraryA("server"), GetProcAddress x3, StartServer(name,
 * region)), keep it running hold_ms with the guest lock released, then
 * UnloadServer (0x5F08F0: StopServer, FreeLibrary).  Each cycle logs what
 * would leak: threads, kernel-object slots, TLS indices, heap bytes (the
 * bytes in live blocks of the game's heaps, heap.c: the reserved address
 * space would hide a leak, because freed space is reused). */
uint64_t win32_ext_threads(void); uint64_t win32_ext_threads_exited(void);
uint32_t win32_heap_live(void); int win32_tls_in_use(void); int win32_obj_live(void);
uint32_t com_scratch(uint32_t n);
void guest_sleep_ns(int64_t ns);             /* win32_ext.c (int64_t: a long is 32 bits on wasm) */
int module_test_cycle(CPU *c, int n, int hold_ms){
    static uint32_t nm = 0;
    if (!nm) nm = com_scratch(64);
    GuestMod *m = &g_mods[0];
    int bad = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++){
        uint64_t t0 = win32_ext_threads(), e0 = win32_ext_threads_exited();
        uint32_t h0 = win32_heap_live(); int tls0 = win32_tls_in_use(), ob0 = win32_obj_live();
        snprintf((char *)(g_mem + nm), 64, "CYCLE%02d", i);
        uint32_t ecx = c->ecx; c->ecx = 0x0089CF48u;
        uint32_t ok = call_guest(c, 0x005FA300u, 1, &nm) & 0xFFu;
        c->ecx = ecx;
        uint32_t isrun = MR32(0x00890128u), running = isrun ? call_guest(c, isrun, 0, 0) & 0xFFu : 0u;
        if (hold_ms > 0) guest_sleep_ns((int64_t)hold_ms * 1000000);
        uint32_t t1 = (uint32_t)(win32_ext_threads() - t0);
        c->ecx = 0x0089CF48u;
        call_guest(c, 0x005F08F0u, 0, 0);
        c->ecx = ecx;
        guest_sleep_ns((int64_t)100 * 1000000);  /* threads that were told to end, end */
        uint32_t ended = (uint32_t)(win32_ext_threads_exited() - e0);
        int dh = (int)(win32_heap_live() - h0), dtls = win32_tls_in_use() - tls0, dob = win32_obj_live() - ob0;
        int fail = !ok || !running || m->mapped || ended != t1 || dtls != 0;
        bad += fail;
        fprintf(stderr, "[srvcycle] %d/%d start=%u running=%u threads +%u started, %u ended; loaded after stop=%d;"
                        " heap %+d KB, TLS indices %+d, object slots %+d%s\n",
                i, n, ok, running, t1, ended, m->mapped, dh / 1024, dtls, dob, fail ? "  FAIL" : "");
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[srvcycle] %d cycles, %d failed\n", n, bad);
    return bad;
}

/* tests/srvoracle.c: map and bind the module without running DllMain (the
 * differential test calls single functions of the lifted code). */
uint32_t module_map_for_test(const char *name){
    GuestMod *m = by_name(name);
    uint32_t err = 0;
    if (!m || !mod_lifted(m) || !map_image(m, &err)) return 0;
    build_index(m);
    m->mapped = 1; m->refs = 1;
    return m->info->base;
}

 * player reads them, and the browser decodes their pictures.

 * The movie player (RealCore's VP6 codec object, vtable 0x7c35b8: its

 * linked in SPEED2.EXE ("ON2.COM VERSION VP60D 6.1.0.5") behind three calls:

}
static void count_frame(uint32_t dec){
    if (!dump_list()) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < SLOTS; i++) if (g_cnt[i].dec == dec){ g_cnt[i].frames++; return; }
    for (int i = 0; i < SLOTS; i++) if (!g_cnt[i].dec){ g_cnt[i].dec = dec; g_cnt[i].frames = 1; g_cnt[i].n = ++g_movies; return; }
}
static void dump_frame(uint32_t dec, uint32_t o){
    const char *l = dump_list();
    if (!l) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < SLOTS; i++) if (g_cnt[i].dec == dec){
        uint32_t f = g_cnt[i].frames - 1u, w = MR32(o), h = MR32(o + 4u);
        int hit = 0;
        for (const char *p = l; *p; ){ char *e; unsigned long v = strtoul(p, &e, 10); if (e == p) break; if (v == f) hit = 1; p = *e ? e + 1 : e; }
        if (!hit) return;
        char path[256]; const char *home = getenv("HOME");
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/moviedump_%u_%u.yuv", home ? home : ".", g_cnt[i].n, f);
        FILE *fp = fopen(path, "wb");
        if (!fp) return;
        for (uint32_t r = 0; r < h; r++) fwrite(g_mem + MR32(o + 24u) + r * MR32(o + 8u), 1, w, fp);
        for (uint32_t pl = 0; pl < 2u; pl++)
            for (uint32_t r = 0; r < h / 2u; r++) fwrite(g_mem + MR32(o + 28u + 4u * pl) + r * MR32(o + 20u), 1, w / 2u, fp);
        fclose(fp);
        fprintf(stderr, "[movie] dump: movie %u frame %u (%ux%u)\n", g_cnt[i].n, f, w, h);
        return;
    }
}
static void uncount(uint32_t dec){
    for (int i = 0; i < SLOTS; i++) if (g_cnt[i].dec == dec) g_cnt[i].dec = 0;
}

static Movie *find(uint32_t dec){
    for (int i = 0; i < SLOTS; i++) if (g_mv[i].dec == dec) return &g_mv[i];
    return 0;
}

static uint32_t plane_y(const Movie *m){ return m->buf + BORDER * m->ys + BORDER; }
static uint32_t plane_u(const Movie *m){ return m->buf + m->ys * (m->h + 2u * BORDER) + BORDER / 2u * m->uvs + BORDER / 2u; }
static uint32_t plane_v(const Movie *m){ return plane_u(m) + m->uvs * (m->h / 2u + BORDER); }

static Movie *open_movie(uint32_t dec, uint32_t w, uint32_t h){
    Movie *m = find(0);
    if (!m) return 0;
    memset(m, 0, sizeof *m);
    m->w = w; m->h = h; m->ys = w + 2u * BORDER; m->uvs = m->ys / 2u;
    uint32_t ysz = m->ys * (h + 2u * BORDER), csz = m->uvs * (h / 2u + BORDER);
    m->buf = gheap_alloc(1, ysz + 2u * csz, 0);
    if (!m->buf){ fprintf(stderr, "[movie] no memory for a %ux%u picture\n", w, h); return 0; }
    memset(g_mem + m->buf, 16, ysz);                       /* black, as a frame not decoded yet */
    memset(g_mem + m->buf + ysz, 128, 2u * csz);
    m->dec = dec;
    int hd = nfsu2_movie_open((int)w, (int)h);
    m->handle = HANDLE(hd) ? hd : -1;
    if (m->handle < 0) fprintf(stderr, "[movie] AV1 %ux%u: this page has no AV1 decoder, the movie stays black\n", w, h);
    return m;
}

static void close_movie(Movie *m){
    if (m->handle >= 0) nfsu2_movie_close(m->handle);
    fprintf(stderr, "[movie] AV1 %ux%u: %u frames, %u without a picture, decode %.2f ms a frame (max %.1f), %u catch-ups\n",
            m->w, m->h, m->frames, m->missed, m->frames ? m->ms / m->frames : 0.0, m->max, MR32(CATCHUPS));
    gheap_free(1, m->buf);
    memset(m, 0, sizeof *m);
}

/* 0x702e47(decoder, data, size, w, h): decode one video chunk's payload */
void sub_00702e47_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_00702e47(CPU *c){
    uint32_t dec = MR32(c->esp + 4u), data = MR32(c->esp + 8u), size = MR32(c->esp + 12u);
    count_frame(dec);
    if (size < 8u || MR32(data) != TAG){ sub_00702e47_orig(c); return; }
    Movie *m = find(dec);
    if (!m) m = open_movie(dec, MR32(c->esp + 16u), MR32(c->esp + 20u));
    if (m){
        m->frames++;
        if (m->handle < 0) m->missed++;
        else {
            double t0 = now_ms();
            int r = nfsu2_movie_decode(m->handle, (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)(g_mem + data), size,
                                       (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)(g_mem + plane_y(m)), (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)(g_mem + plane_u(m)),
                                       (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)(g_mem + plane_v(m)), (int)m->ys, (int)m->uvs);
            double dt = now_ms() - t0;
            m->ms += dt; if (dt > m->max) m->max = dt;
            if (r) m->missed++;    /* no picture in time: the last one stays */
        }
    }
    c->eax = 0;
    POP32(c->eip);
}

/* 0x70288e(decoder, &yv12): the decoded picture's planes */
void sub_0070288e_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_0070288e(CPU *c){
    uint32_t dec = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
    Movie *m = find(dec);
    if (!m){
        /* a VP6 movie's planes, once a decoder (the layout above) */
        static uint32_t seen;
        uint32_t o = MR32(c->esp + 8u);
        sub_0070288e_orig(c);
        if (movie_log() && dec != seen){
            seen = dec;
            uint32_t b = MR32(o + 36u);
            fprintf(stderr, "[movie] VP6 %ux%u strides %u/%u, planes at +%u/+%u/+%u of the buffer\n",
                    MR32(o), MR32(o + 4u), MR32(o + 8u), MR32(o + 20u), MR32(o + 24u) - b, MR32(o + 28u) - b, MR32(o + 32u) - b);
        }
        dump_frame(dec, o);
        return;
    }
    uint32_t o = MR32(c->esp + 8u);
    MR32(o) = m->w; MR32(o + 4u) = m->h; MR32(o + 8u) = m->ys;
    MR32(o + 12u) = m->w / 2u; MR32(o + 16u) = m->h / 2u; MR32(o + 20u) = m->uvs;
    MR32(o + 24u) = plane_y(m); MR32(o + 28u) = plane_u(m); MR32(o + 32u) = plane_v(m);
    MR32(o + 36u) = m->buf;
    dump_frame(dec, o);
    c->eax = 0;
    POP32(c->eip);
}

/* 0x702e5e(&decoder): the movie's end (or its codec's) */
void sub_00702e5e_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_00702e5e(CPU *c){
    uint32_t slot = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
    Movie *m = slot ? find(MR32(slot)) : 0;
    if (slot) uncount(MR32(slot));
    if (m && m->dec) close_movie(m);
    else if (movie_log() && slot && MR32(slot)) fprintf(stderr, "[movie] VP6: %u catch-ups\n", MR32(CATCHUPS));
    sub_00702e5e_orig(c);
}

 * wants one, and those of its sponsors whose wins the stage has and whose reputation the stage before's average

static int sponsor_offers(CPU *c, uint32_t *o){

    }
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) o[i] = guest_rd32(info + 8u + 4u * (uint32_t)i);
    return k;
}

} g_ui;
/* (a movie that waits for Return to Explore Mode is not: the trip goes on to it) */
int mpcredit_busy(void){ return g_ui.st != UI_NONE && g_ui.st != UI_WAIT; }
/* movies on: NOMOVIES not mode 1, as fileio.c reads it (the page sets 1 where its movies are not kept; the movie
 * files then do not open, and the movie screen would wait for good: the world comes without it, as before) */
static int movies_on(void){
    const char *e = getenv("NOMOVIES");
    return ((e && *e && *e != '0') ? atoi(e) : 0) != 1;
}
/* the race's movie, as 0x513A50 picks it (the race won; stage_now: the stage after the win) */
static void race_scene(uint32_t r, uint32_t race_stage, uint32_t stage_now){
    char nm[16] = "";
    uint32_t s = guest_rd32(G_STRPOOL) + MR16(r + 4u);
    if (guest_ok(s, 15) && MR8(s)){ for (int i = 0; i < 15 && MR8(s + (uint32_t)i); i++) nm[i] = (char)MR8(s + (uint32_t)i); }
    else if (race_stage != stage_now && stage_now == 2u) snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "Scene07");
    else if (MR32(r + 8u) == RACE_LAST) snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "Scene15");
    if (!nm[0] || g_ui.nscene >= 4) return;
    snprintf(g_ui.scene[g_ui.nscene++], sizeof g_ui.scene[0], "%s", nm);
    if (!strcasecmp(nm, "Scene07") && g_ui.nscene < 4) snprintf(g_ui.scene[g_ui.nscene++], sizeof g_ui.scene[0], "UpperClass");   /* (0x53D7A0) */
}
/* a sponsor's name as the sponsor screen shows it: the game's text (Latin-1), and as UTF-8 */
static void sponsor_name(CPU *c, uint32_t sp, char *lat, int nl, char *utf, int nu){
    uint32_t h = call(c, FN_SP_NAMEHASH, sp, 0, 0), t = call(c, FN_TEXT, 0, 1, &h);
    int a = 0, b = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; guest_ok(t + i, 1) && MR8(t + i) && i < 40; i++){
        uint8_t ch = MR8(t + i);
        if (ch < 0x20 || ch == '%') ch = ' ';
        if (a + 1 < nl) lat[a++] = (char)ch;
        if (ch < 0x80){ if (b + 1 < nu) utf[b++] = (char)ch; }
        else if (b + 2 < nu){ utf[b++] = (char)(0xc0 | ch >> 6); utf[b++] = (char)(0x80 | (ch & 0x3f)); }
    }
    lat[a] = 0; utf[b] = 0;
}
static void gs(uint32_t a, const char *s, uint32_t cap){ uint32_t i = 0; for (; s[i] && i + 1 < cap; i++) MR8(a + i) = (uint8_t)s[i]; MR8(a + i) = 0; }
/* the crib screen's package name (the FE's own string), else ours */
static uint32_t crib_name(void){
    uint32_t n = guest_rd32(G_FEMGR);
    for (int k = 0; n && n != G_FEMGR && k < 256; k++, n = guest_rd32(n)){
        uint32_t sc = guest_rd32(n - 4u + 0x14u), nm = sc ? guest_rd32(sc + 4u) : 0;
        if (guest_ok(nm, 18) && !strcasecmp((const char *)(g_mem + nm), "UI_CareerCrib.fng")) return nm;
    }
    gs(g_ui.str + 0x200u, "UI_CareerCrib.fng", 0x20);
    return g_ui.str + 0x200u;
}
/* the dialog's answer goes to the crib's handler: ours, while we ask; the rest the game's */
void sub_004af3a0(CPU *c);
void dispatch_patch(uint32_t a, void (*f)(CPU *));
uint32_t language_add_text(const char *name, const char *text);
static void crib_msg(CPU *c){
    uint32_t m = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
    if ((m == MSG_SIGN || m == MSG_NEXT) && g_ui.st == UI_ASKED){
        g_ui.answer = m; POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 0x10u;
        fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld the answer: %s\n", autotest_frame(), m == MSG_SIGN ? "Sign" : "Next offer");
        return;
    }
    /* a race's movie waits: the crib's way to the world after Return to Explore Mode is held (the save over: the
     * memory card's 0x461A18EE, the world, then 0x251BF83E; no save to make: 0x9A3B571D), the movie plays, then
     * they go on as they came (ui_frame) */
    if (g_ui.st == UI_WAIT && m == MSG_CRIB_GO) g_ui.leaving = 1;
    if ((g_ui.st == UI_WAIT || (g_ui.st == UI_MOVIE && g_ui.nheld)) && g_ui.leaving && g_ui.nheld < 3
        && (m == MSG_SAVE_WORLD || m == MSG_SAVE_DONE || m == MSG_CRIB_WORLD)){
        if (!g_ui.nheld){ g_ui.held_this = c->ecx; g_ui.at = autotest_frame(); }
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 4; k++) g_ui.held[g_ui.nheld][k] = MR32(c->esp + 4u + 4u * k);
        g_ui.nheld++;
        g_ui.st = UI_MOVIE; POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 0x10u;
        fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld the crib's way to the world (%08x) held: the race's movie first\n", autotest_frame(), m);
        return;
    }
    sub_004af3a0(c);
}

};
const char *language_name(void);
void language_game_letters(const char *utf8, char *out, size_t n);
static int sp_tx(void){
    const char *l = language_name();
    for (int i = 1; l && i < (int)(sizeof SP_TX / sizeof SP_TX[0]); i++) if (!strcmp(l, SP_TX[i].lang)) return i;
    return 0;
}
static int ui_ready(CPU *c){
    if (!g_ui.patched){ dispatch_patch(FN_CRIB_MSG, crib_msg); g_ui.patched = 1; }
    /* (scratch: the dialog's package +0, its format +0x38, its text +0x40, the crib's name +0x200, the movie's +0x220) */
    if (!g_ui.str){ uint32_t sz = 0x240u; g_ui.str = call(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &sz); }
    static int lang = -1;
    if (!g_ui.lab_sign || lang != sp_tx()){
        char s[48]; lang = sp_tx();
        language_game_letters(SP_TX[lang].sign, s, sizeof s); g_ui.lab_sign = language_add_text("MPCREDIT_SIGN", s);
        language_game_letters(SP_TX[lang].next, s, sizeof s); g_ui.lab_next = language_add_text("MPCREDIT_NEXT", s);
        language_texts_frame(c);
    }
    return g_ui.str != 0;
}
/* the question about offer g_ui.i over the crib (the game's generic dialog, roam_game.c mp_ask's way: the text as a
 * "%s" argument, with no % in it) */
static int dialog_up(void){ return career_fe_active("GenericDialog_MED.fng") || career_fe_active("GenericDialog_SMALL.fng") || guest_rd32(G_DLG); }
static int ui_ask(CPU *c){
    if (!ui_ready(c) || dialog_up()) return 0;
    uint32_t sp = g_ui.offer[g_ui.i];
    char nm[48], utf[64], t[0x1c0], fmt_l[0x100], en[0x1c0];
    sponsor_name(c, sp, nm, sizeof nm, utf, sizeof utf);
    /* in the game's language and letters (the sponsor's name is the game's own already); the log's line in English */
    language_game_letters(SP_TX[sp_tx()].offer, fmt_l, sizeof fmt_l);
    snprintf(t, sizeof t, fmt_l, g_ui.i + 1, g_ui.n, nm, (int)(int16_t)MR16(sp + SP_BONUS), MR16(sp + SP_PRIZE));
    snprintf(en, sizeof en, SP_TX[0].offer, g_ui.i + 1, g_ui.n, nm, (int)(int16_t)MR16(sp + SP_BONUS), MR16(sp + SP_PRIZE));
    uint32_t dl = g_ui.str, fmt = g_ui.str + 0x38u, txt = g_ui.str + 0x40u;
    gs(dl, "GenericDialog_MED.fng", 0x38); gs(fmt, "%s", 8); gs(txt, t, 0x1c0);     /* (the front end's; IG_ is the world's) */
    uint32_t a[10] = { crib_name(), dl, g_ui.lab_sign, g_ui.lab_next, MSG_SIGN, MSG_NEXT, MSG_NEXT, 0, fmt, txt };
    call(c, FN_DIALOG2, 0, 10, a);
    uint32_t language_text(uint32_t hash);
    fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld asked: \"%s\"%s%s (its buttons' texts %s in the game's table: %08x %08x)\n", autotest_frame(), en,
            sp_tx() ? " in " : "", sp_tx() ? SP_TX[sp_tx()].lang : "", language_text(g_ui.lab_sign) && language_text(g_ui.lab_next) ? "found" : "NOT found",
            g_ui.lab_sign, g_ui.lab_next);
    return 1;
}
/* While the race's movie plays, the front end's other screens take no keys.  A key goes to the screens in the order
 * of the front end's list, each that its input mask (the package's +0x1C .. +0x28, 0 none) lets have it; the crib's
 * menu (0xFF) before the movie (1) took Enter, opened its "Return to Explore Mode?" under the movie, and the movie was
 * not skipped (measured).  Their masks are kept here, 0 while it plays, and given back before the crib's way to the
 * world goes on (as the screens are then, the crib's own too; a screen gone is left) */
#define PKG_NEXT        0x04u         /* a front-end package (cFEng +8: its lists at +0xE4 and +0xF4): the next */
#define PKG_NAME        0x0cu
#define PKG_MASK        0x1cu         /* ... its input masks, 4 dwords */
#define MASKED_MAX      8
static struct { uint32_t pkg, m[4]; } g_masked[MASKED_MAX];
static int g_nmasked;
static int pkg_listed(uint32_t mg, uint32_t q){
    for (uint32_t head = 0xe4u; head <= 0xf4u; head += 0x10u){
        uint32_t p = guest_rd32(mg + head);
        for (int k = 0; p && k < 64 && guest_ok(p, PKG_MASK + 15u); k++, p = guest_rd32(p + PKG_NEXT)) if (p == q) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
static void movie_keys(int only){
    uint32_t fe = guest_rd32(G_FENG), mg = fe ? guest_rd32(fe + 8u) : 0;
    if (!only){
        for (int i = 0; mg && i < g_nmasked; i++)
            if (pkg_listed(mg, g_masked[i].pkg)) for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 4; k++) MR32(g_masked[i].pkg + PKG_MASK + 4u * k) = g_masked[i].m[k];
        g_nmasked = 0;
        return;
    }
    for (uint32_t head = 0xe4u; mg && head <= 0xf4u; head += 0x10u){
        uint32_t p = guest_rd32(mg + head);
        for (int n = 0; p && n < 64 && guest_ok(p, PKG_MASK + 15u); n++, p = guest_rd32(p + PKG_NEXT)){
            uint32_t nm = guest_rd32(p + PKG_NAME);
            int seen = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < g_nmasked; i++) seen |= g_masked[i].pkg == p;
            if (seen || (guest_ok(nm, 16) && !strcasecmp((const char *)(g_mem + nm), "IG_PlayMovie.fng")) || g_nmasked >= MASKED_MAX) continue;
            g_masked[g_nmasked].pkg = p;
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 4; k++){ g_masked[g_nmasked].m[k] = MR32(p + PKG_MASK + 4u * k); MR32(p + PKG_MASK + 4u * k) = 0; }
            g_nmasked++;
        }
    }
}
/* the race's movie over the crib, as 0x53D7A0 plays its own (the names, mode 5 nothing after it; 0x43B640 on
 * 0x827E88 first: without it the movies stopped after about 2.5 s).  The game's own takes the place of the screen it
 * is played from (0x5377A0); here the crib's screens stay (the held messages go to the crib), so the movie goes
 * after them, drawn last.  At the list's head (0x555E80, as 0x4C57C0 adds PC_Loading) it is drawn first, and the
 * crib's menu shows over it, see-through, the whole movie long (a player's report; tests/scripts/mpcredit_movie.txt) */
static int ui_movie(CPU *c){
    if (!ui_ready(c) || !guest_rd32(G_FENG)) return 0;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 4; k++) MR8(G_MOVIES + 0x40u * k) = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < g_ui.nscene; k++) gs(G_MOVIES + 0x40u * (uint32_t)k, g_ui.scene[k], 0x40);
    MR32(G_MOVIE_AT) = 0; MR32(G_MOVIE_MODE) = 5; MR32(G_MOVIES_DONE) = 0;
    call(c, FN_MOVIE_PREP, 0x00827e88u, 0, 0);
    uint32_t fe = guest_rd32(G_FENG), a[5] = { 4u, S_PLAYMOVIE, S_PLAYMOVIE, 0xffu, 0u };   /* (beside: none yet) */
    call(c, FN_FE_QUEUE, fe, 5, a);
    call(c, FN_FE_RUN, fe, 0, 0);
    fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld the race's movie: %s%s%s\n", autotest_frame(), g_ui.scene[0], g_ui.nscene > 1 ? ", then " : "",
            g_ui.nscene > 1 ? g_ui.scene[1] : "");
    return 1;
}
static void ui_frame(CPU *c){
    long f = autotest_frame();
    int crib = career_fe_active("UI_CareerCrib.fng"), movie = career_fe_active("IG_PlayMovie.fng");
    switch (g_ui.st){
    case UI_OFFER:
        if (crib && !career_fe_active("MC_Main.fng") && ui_ask(c)){ g_ui.st = UI_ASKED; g_ui.at = f; g_ui.answer = 0; }
        break;
    case UI_ASKED:
        if (g_ui.answer == MSG_SIGN){
            uint32_t sp = g_ui.offer[g_ui.i], b0 = guest_rd32(G_CAREER + C_BANK), st = guest_rd32(G_CAREER + C_STAGE);
            call(c, FN_SIGN, G_CAREER, 1, &sp);
            if (guest_rd32(stage_rec(st) + SR_SPONSOR) == sp){
                char nm[48];
                g_last.sponsor = sp; g_last.bonus = (int)(guest_rd32(G_CAREER + C_BANK) - b0);
                sponsor_name(c, sp, nm, sizeof nm, g_last.sponsor_name, sizeof g_last.sponsor_name);
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld signed with %s (offer %d of %d): bonus $%d, bank $%u -> $%u%s\n", f, g_last.sponsor_name,
                    g_ui.i + 1, g_ui.n, g_last.bonus, b0, guest_rd32(G_CAREER + C_BANK), g_last.sponsor == sp ? "" : " (the game did not sign it)");
            g_ui.st = g_ui.nscene ? UI_WAIT : UI_NONE;
        } else if (g_ui.answer == MSG_NEXT){
            g_ui.i = (g_ui.i + 1) % g_ui.n; g_ui.st = UI_OFFER;
        } else if (!dialog_up() && f - g_ui.at > 30) g_ui.st = UI_OFFER;     /* (gone another way: again) */
        g_ui.answer = 0;
        break;
    case UI_WAIT:                                  /* (crib_msg: Return to Explore Mode, its save over) */
        break;
    case UI_MOVIE:
        if (ui_movie(c)){ g_ui.st = UI_PLAYING; g_ui.at = f; g_ui.seen = 0; }
        else if (f - g_ui.at > 60){ g_ui.st = UI_PLAYING; g_ui.at = f - 100000; }   /* (could not: on to the world) */
        break;
    case UI_PLAYING:
        /* over once the movie screen came and went or said it is done ([0x8383A8]; the player may skip it), one that
         * never comes, or one still up after 10 minutes.  Then the held messages to the crib's handler, as they
         * came: the world.  (0x5404A0 called alone, with the crib's message not held, loaded the world twice: half
         * loaded, or a crash in the sound's streams; the world's loading under a playing movie cut it after 2 s) */
        if (movie){ g_ui.seen = 1; movie_keys(1); }
        if ((!movie && (g_ui.seen || guest_rd32(G_MOVIES_DONE) == 1u || f - g_ui.at > 300)) || f - g_ui.at > 60 * 600){
            movie_keys(0);
            fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld the race's movie %s: the world, as the crib goes there\n", f,
                    g_ui.seen || guest_rd32(G_MOVIES_DONE) == 1u ? "is over" : "did not play");
            g_ui.st = UI_NONE; g_ui.leaving = 0; g_ui.nscene = 0;
            int n = g_ui.nheld; g_ui.nheld = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) call(c, FN_CRIB_MSG, g_ui.held_this, 4, g_ui.held[i]);
        }
        break;
    }
}

static int win_now(CPU *c, uint32_t r, float margin){
    uint32_t h = MR32(r + 8u), kind = MR8(r + 0x34u), rs = MR8(r + 0x37u), st0 = guest_rd32(G_CAREER + C_STAGE);
    uint32_t sr = stage_rec(rs), cur = stage_rec(st0);
    if (!sr || !cur){ fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld %s: stage %u, no stage record: left\n", autotest_frame(), race_name(r), rs); return 0; }
    int open = race_open(r), wins0 = stage_wins(cur);
    uint32_t bank0 = guest_rd32(G_CAREER + C_BANK), runs0 = guest_rd32(sr + SR_RUNS);
    float pts0 = MRF32(sr + SR_POINTS);
    /* 1: the event entry, and the race started, as StartRace */
    uint32_t e = call(c, FN_ENTRY, G_CAREER, 1, &h);
    if (!guest_ok(e, 8) || MR32(e) != h){ fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld %s: no event entry (0x%08x): left\n", autotest_frame(), race_name(r), e); return 0; }
    MR32(G_CAREER + C_STARTED) += 1u;
    /* 2: the prize and the margin, as RaceWon's paying part (0x532E50, 0x513FE0 -> 0x513430) */
    uint32_t sp = kind == 1u ? guest_rd32(cur + SR_SPONSOR) : 0, prize = sp && guest_ok(sp, 4) ? MR16(sp + SP_PRIZE) : MR32(r + 0x30u);
    if (prize > 1000000u) prize = 0;
    MR32(G_CAREER + C_BANK) = bank0 + prize;
    if (margin < 0.f){
        /* (no margin: the race type's first step, the least points a win gets) */
        uint32_t ty = call(c, FN_RACE_TYPE, 0, 1, &r);
        margin = 0.f;
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 7; k++) if (guest_rd32(G_POINTS + 0x1cu * k) == ty){ margin = MRF32(G_POINTS + 0x1cu * k + 4u); break; }
    }
    uint32_t a[2] = { fbits(margin), r };
    call(c, FN_MARGIN_REC, sr, 2, a);
    /* 3: RaceWon, its paying part off */
    uint8_t pay = MR8(G_CAREER + C_RESULTS + 2u);
    MR8(G_CAREER + C_RESULTS + 2u) = 0;
    call(c, FN_RACEWON, G_CAREER, 1, &h);
    MR8(G_CAREER + C_RESULTS + 2u) = pay;
    /* 4: the open races again */
    call(c, FN_OPEN_LIST, G_CAREER, 0, 0);
    uint32_t st1 = guest_rd32(G_CAREER + C_STAGE);
    memset(&g_last, 0, sizeof g_last);
    g_last.race = r; g_last.prize = (int)prize; g_last.stage_from = (int)st0; g_last.stage_to = (int)st1;
    g_last.points = (int)(MRF32(sr + SR_POINTS) - pts0 + 0.5f);
    /* 5, 6: the sponsors the post-race list would offer now, and the race's movie: in the crib (ui_frame) */
    if (g_ui.st == UI_NONE || g_ui.st == UI_WAIT){
        /* (more wins in one crib: the test aid's; the game plays up to 4 movies in a row) */
        if (g_ui.st == UI_NONE){ g_ui.nscene = 0; g_ui.leaving = 0; }
        g_ui.n = sponsor_offers(c, g_ui.offer); g_ui.i = 0;
        int k = g_ui.nscene;
        if (movies_on()) race_scene(r, rs, st1);
        g_ui.st = g_ui.n ? UI_OFFER : g_ui.nscene ? UI_WAIT : UI_NONE;
        g_last.offers = g_ui.n;
        if (g_ui.nscene > k) snprintf(g_last.movie, sizeof g_last.movie, "%s", g_ui.scene[k]);
        /* the crib's handler ours now: the trip sends its Return to Explore Mode in this same frame, right after
         * the win (a LAN trip's movie never came while it was patched only at the next frame) */
        if (g_ui.st != UI_NONE) ui_ready(c);
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld %s (kind %u, stage %u, %s): won %d, still open %d; bank $%u -> $%u (prize $%u%s); stage %u record: "
            "%.0f points of %u races -> %.0f of %u (margin %.2f); wins of stage %u %d -> %d; stage %u -> %u; %d sponsor offers%s%s\n",
            autotest_frame(), race_name(r), kind, rs, open ? "open" : "not open", event_won(h), race_open(r), bank0, guest_rd32(G_CAREER + C_BANK),
            prize, sp ? ", the sponsor's" : "", rs, (double)pts0, runs0, (double)MRF32(sr + SR_POINTS), guest_rd32(sr + SR_RUNS), (double)margin,
            st0, wins0, stage_wins(cur), st0, st1, g_last.offers, g_last.movie[0] ? "; the movie " : "", g_last.movie);
    return event_won(h);
}

/* Wins to give at the next crib, in order (free roam, or the test aid), kept beside the profile until a save of the
 * profile has them: "NFS Underground 2/<NAME>/MPWINS.DAT" (a name with a dot is no profile's), as garage.c keeps
 * GARAGE.DAT there (fileio_resolve_save: the same folder on every platform; the page moves it with its profile,
 * backs it up and syncs it with the save folder, and a restore takes a profile folder's other files with it or
 * leaves them out: profilesIn).  A tab closed before the crib keeps the win: the career's next load reads the file
 * (mpcredit_frame, by the profile in play: player 1's, its name in the FEDatabase, a profile made this session too)
 * and the next crib gives it.  A win given (a waiting one, or the trip's in the crib) stays in the file until the
 * game writes the profile with it (garage_profile_written -> mpcredit_profile_written: a whole profile on disk whose
 * career has the race won; one the career no longer has, gone back to a load or to the payload the game kept, waits
 * again): with the game's autosave off it is in no save until the player saves, and a load before that (of this
 * profile again too: each load of player 1's profile reads the file again, garage_profile_loads) gives it again (a
 * race already won is left).  File: PEND_MAGIC, 1, the count, then a race's name hash and its margin (float) each.
 * The profile deleted: the file goes with it (garage_profile_deleted). */
#define PEND_MAX 32
#define PEND_FILE       "MPWINS.DAT"
#define PEND_MAGIC      0x574d324eu   /* "N2MW" */
int fileio_resolve_save(const char *win, char *out, size_t outsz);
int fileio_resolve_save_w(const char *win, char *out, size_t outsz);
unsigned garage_profile_loads(void);
static struct {
    uint32_t race[PEND_MAX]; float margin[PEND_MAX]; int n; long since;      /* waiting */
    uint32_t done[PEND_MAX]; float done_margin[PEND_MAX]; int ndone;         /* given, not saved yet (their hashes) */
    char     profile[33];                                                     /* whose file this is ("" none) */
    unsigned loads;                                                           /* garage_profile_loads when it was read */
} g_pend;
/* the profile in play (player 1's name in the FEDatabase; "" none) */
static void live_profile(char out[33]){
    unsigned i = 0;
    for (; i < 32u; i++){ uint8_t ch = MR8(G_PROFILE_NAME + i); if (ch < 0x20u || ch == 0x7fu) break; out[i] = (char)ch; }
    out[i] = 0;
}
static uint32_t race_by_hash(uint32_t h){
    uint32_t t = guest_rd32(G_RACES), n = guest_rd32(G_NRACES);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; t && i < n && i < 1024; i++) if (guest_rd32(t + i * RACE_SZ + 8u) == h) return t + i * RACE_SZ;
    return 0;
}
/* the file's host path; to write: where it goes (the resolve says 0 for a file not there yet: its folder's path, the
 * folder found case-blind, with the file's name) */
static int pend_path(const char *name, char *out, size_t n, int write){
    char win[128];
    if (!name[0]) return 0;
    snprintf(win, sizeof win, "NFS Underground 2\\%s\\%s", name, PEND_FILE);
    if (!write) return fileio_resolve_save(win, out, n);
    out[0] = 0;
    fileio_resolve_save_w(win, out, n);
    return out[0] != 0;
}
/* the file as the lists are now (none left: no file) */
static void pend_write(void){
    char path[1100];
    if (!pend_path(g_pend.profile, path, sizeof path, 1)){
        fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] %s: no place for " PEND_FILE " (no profile loaded?): the waiting wins are in memory only\n", g_pend.profile);
        return;
    }
    int n = g_pend.n + g_pend.ndone;
    if (!n){ if (remove(path) == 0) fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] %s: no wins wait, " PEND_FILE " gone\n", g_pend.profile); return; }
    FILE *o = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!o){ fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] %s: cannot write %s\n", g_pend.profile, path); return; }
    uint32_t hd[3] = { PEND_MAGIC, 1u, (uint32_t)n };
    int ok = fwrite(hd, sizeof hd, 1, o) == 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_pend.n; i++){ uint32_t e[2] = { MR32(g_pend.race[i] + 8u), fbits(g_pend.margin[i]) }; ok = ok && fwrite(e, sizeof e, 1, o) == 1; }
    for (int i = 0; i < g_pend.ndone; i++){ uint32_t e[2] = { g_pend.done[i], fbits(g_pend.done_margin[i]) }; ok = ok && fwrite(e, sizeof e, 1, o) == 1; }
    ok = fclose(o) == 0 && ok;
    fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] %s: " PEND_FILE " %s: %d waiting, %d given but not saved yet\n", g_pend.profile,
            ok ? "written" : "WRITE FAILED", g_pend.n, g_pend.ndone);
}
static int pend_waits(uint32_t r){ for (int k = 0; k < g_pend.n; k++) if (g_pend.race[k] == r) return 1; return 0; }
static void pend_wait(uint32_t r, float m){ if (r && !pend_waits(r) && g_pend.n < PEND_MAX){ g_pend.race[g_pend.n] = r; g_pend.margin[g_pend.n++] = m; } }
/* the profile in play changed, or was loaded again: its file's wins wait now (given ones too: the crib gives a race
 * the career has not won, and leaves one it has).  The same profile again keeps what waited in memory as well */
static void pend_load(const char *name, unsigned loads){
    char path[1100];
    int same = g_pend.profile[0] && !strcasecmp(name, g_pend.profile);
    if (same){
        for (int i = 0; i < g_pend.ndone; i++) pend_wait(race_by_hash(g_pend.done[i]), g_pend.done_margin[i]);
        g_pend.ndone = 0;
    } else memset(&g_pend, 0, sizeof g_pend);
    snprintf(g_pend.profile, sizeof g_pend.profile, "%s", name);
    g_pend.loads = loads; g_pend.since = 0;
    if (!pend_path(name, path, sizeof path, 0)){
        fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] %s: the profile in play%s, no " PEND_FILE " (%d wins wait)\n", name, same ? " (loaded again)" : "", g_pend.n);
        if (same && g_pend.n) pend_write();
        return;
    }
    FILE *in = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!in){ fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] %s: the career's profile, %d wins wait\n", name, g_pend.n); if (g_pend.n) pend_write(); return; }
    uint32_t hd[3] = { 0 }, e[2];
    int ok = fread(hd, sizeof hd, 1, in) == 1 && hd[0] == PEND_MAGIC && hd[1] == 1u && hd[2] <= 64u;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; ok && i < hd[2] && fread(e, sizeof e, 1, in) == 1; i++){
        float m; memcpy(&m, &e[1], 4);
        pend_wait(race_by_hash(e[0]), m);
    }
    fclose(in);
    fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] %s: " PEND_FILE "%s, %d wins wait for the crib%s\n", name, ok ? "" : " is not one of ours", g_pend.n,
            same ? " (the profile loaded again)" : "");
    if (same) pend_write();
}
/* a race waiting already (won twice before a crib): not again, the second win is the place's prize money (0) */
static int pend_add(uint32_t r, float margin){
    if (g_pend.n >= PEND_MAX || pend_waits(r)) return 0;
    g_pend.race[g_pend.n] = r; g_pend.margin[g_pend.n++] = margin; g_pend.since = 0;
    pend_write();
    return 1;
}
/* the first waiting win given: kept in the file until the profile is written */
static void pend_given(uint32_t r, float margin){
    if (g_pend.ndone < PEND_MAX){ g_pend.done[g_pend.ndone] = MR32(r + 8u); g_pend.done_margin[g_pend.ndone++] = margin; }
    pend_write();
}
/* garage.c: the game wrote a profile (its host path), or deleted one */
static const char *profile_of(const char *path){ const char *sl = strrchr(path, '/'); return sl ? sl + 1 : path; }
void mpcredit_profile_written(const char *path){
    if (!g_pend.profile[0] || strcasecmp(profile_of(path), g_pend.profile) || (!g_pend.ndone && !g_pend.n)) return;
    /* (wins waiting only: written beside it now, a profile made this session had no folder for them before) */
    if (!g_pend.ndone){ pend_write(); return; }
    /* the write has what the career has now: a given win it has won is saved; one it has not (it went back to a
     * load, or to the payload the game kept, without it) waits for the next crib again */
    int saved = 0, again = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_pend.ndone; i++){
        if (event_won(g_pend.done[i])){ saved++; continue; }
        uint32_t r = race_by_hash(g_pend.done[i]);
        if (r){ pend_wait(r, g_pend.done_margin[i]); again++; }
    }
    g_pend.ndone = 0;
    if (again) fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] %s written: %d given win%s saved, %d not in the career any more: waiting again\n",
                       g_pend.profile, saved, saved == 1 ? "" : "s", again);
    pend_write();
}
void mpcredit_profile_deleted(const char *path){
    char g[1100]; const char *sl = strrchr(path, '/');
    snprintf(g, sizeof g, "%.*s/%s", sl ? (int)(sl - path) : 1, sl ? path : ".", PEND_FILE);
    if (remove(g) == 0) fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] %s deleted with its profile\n", g);
    if (g_pend.profile[0] && !strcasecmp(profile_of(path), g_pend.profile)){ g_pend.n = g_pend.ndone = 0; }
}

int mpcredit_win(CPU *c, uint32_t race, float margin, int in_roam){
    if (!race_in_table(race)){ fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld race 0x%08x is not in the race table: left\n", autotest_frame(), race); return 0; }
    if (event_won(MR32(race + 8u))){ fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld %s is won already: left\n", autotest_frame(), race_name(race)); return 0; }
    if (guest_rd32(G_GAMEMODE) != 1u){ fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld %s: not in the career (mode 0x%x): left\n", autotest_frame(), race_name(race), guest_rd32(G_GAMEMODE)); return 0; }
    if (in_roam){
        if (!pend_add(race, margin)) return 0;
        fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld %s: in free roam, the win waits for the next crib\n", autotest_frame(), race_name(race));
        return 1;
    }
    /* given in the crib: kept in the file too until the profile is written (the game's autosave off, the tab closed
     * before the player's own save: the next load gives it again) */
    int ok = win_now(c, race, margin);
    if (ok) pend_given(race, margin);
    return ok;
}
int mpcredit_pending(void){ return g_pend.n; }

/* per frame: the sponsor question and the movie of a win (ui_frame); the waiting wins in the crib, one at a time
 * (each with its own question and movie), once the crib took its snapshot of the profile (180 frames at most: the
 * autosave off takes none).  A question or a movie whose crib went away (the player left it some other way) is
 * dropped */
void mpcredit_frame(CPU *c){
    if (guest_rd32(G_GAMEMODE) == 1u){
        char pn[33]; live_profile(pn);
        unsigned loads = garage_profile_loads();
        if (pn[0] && (strcasecmp(pn, g_pend.profile) || loads != g_pend.loads)) pend_load(pn, loads);
    }
    if (g_ui.st != UI_NONE){
        int gone = guest_rd32(G_GAMEMODE) != 1u || ((g_ui.st == UI_OFFER || g_ui.st == UI_ASKED || (g_ui.st == UI_WAIT && !g_ui.leaving))
                                            && !career_fe_active("UI_CareerCrib.fng"));
        if (gone){
            fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld the crib is gone: its %s left\n", autotest_frame(), g_ui.st == UI_WAIT ? "movie" : "sponsor question");
            movie_keys(0);
            g_ui.st = UI_NONE; g_ui.leaving = 0;
            return;
        }
        if (g_ui.st != UI_WAIT){ ui_frame(c); return; }
        ui_ready(c);                               /* (the crib's handler patched: its way to the world is ours) */
    }
    if (!g_pend.n) return;
    if (guest_rd32(G_GAMEMODE) != 1u || !career_fe_active("UI_CareerCrib.fng") || career_fe_active("MC_Main.fng")){ g_pend.since = 0; return; }
    long f = autotest_frame();
    if (!g_pend.since) g_pend.since = f;
    if (!guest_rd32(G_SNAPSHOT) && f - g_pend.since < 180) return;
    uint32_t r = g_pend.race[0]; float m = g_pend.margin[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < g_pend.n; i++){ g_pend.race[i - 1] = g_pend.race[i]; g_pend.margin[i - 1] = g_pend.margin[i]; }
    g_pend.n--;
    if (!race_in_table(r) || event_won(MR32(r + 8u))){ fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld a waiting win: won already or gone, left\n", f); pend_write(); return; }
    fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld the waiting win of %s, in the crib%s\n", f, race_name(r), guest_rd32(G_SNAPSHOT) ? "" : " (no snapshot: the autosave is off)");
    if (win_now(c, r, m)) pend_given(r, m); else pend_write();
}

/* test aid (career.c "mpcredit NAME[,NAME...] [MARGIN]"): the wins of those races at the next crib, in order;
 * "mpcredit unwin:NAME": the race not won in the career any more (its event entry's won flag, as a load of an older
 * save of the profile has it), for what a profile written then does with a win given but not saved */
int mpcredit_test(const char *names, float margin){
    uint32_t t = guest_rd32(G_RACES), n = guest_rd32(G_NRACES); int got = 0;
    if (!strncasecmp(names, "unwin:", 6)){
        uint32_t r = 0, ne = guest_rd32(G_CAREER + C_NEVENTS);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; t && i < n && i < 1024 && !r; i++) if (!strcasecmp(race_name(t + i * RACE_SZ), names + 6)) r = t + i * RACE_SZ;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; r && i < ne && i < 384; i++)
            if (MR32(G_CAREER + C_EVENTS + 8u * i) == MR32(r + 8u)){ MR8(G_CAREER + C_EVENTS + 8u * i + 6u) = 0; got = 1; }
        fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld test: %s %s\n", autotest_frame(), names + 6, got ? "not won in the career any more" : "has no event entry");
        return got;
    }
    for (const char *s = names; *s; ){
        const char *e = strchr(s, ','); size_t k = e ? (size_t)(e - s) : strlen(s);
        char nm[48]; snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "%.*s", (int)(k < 47 ? k : 47), s);
        s += k + (e ? 1 : 0);
        uint32_t r = 0;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; t && i < n && i < 1024 && !r; i++) if (!strcasecmp(race_name(t + i * RACE_SZ), nm)) r = t + i * RACE_SZ;
        if (!r){ fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld test: no race %s\n", autotest_frame(), nm); continue; }
        if (!pend_add(r, margin)){ fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld test: %s not queued (waiting already, or %d wait)\n", autotest_frame(), nm, g_pend.n); continue; }
        got++;
        fprintf(stderr, "[mpcredit] f=%ld test: the win of %s (margin %.2f) at the next crib; open %d, won %d\n", autotest_frame(), nm,
                (double)margin, race_open(r), event_won(MR32(r + 8u)));
    }
    return got;
}

/* mpcredit.h -- a race of the career won in a multiplayer race from free roam (mprace.c): the career gets the game's
 * own win of it, as a Solo win gives it (mpcredit.c). */
#ifndef MPCREDIT_H
#define MPCREDIT_H
#include <stdint.h>
struct CPU;
/* the game's own win of career race `race` (its record in the race table [0x8383E0]) for this career: the race won,
 * its prize, the stage's records, its story and sponsor steps, as after a Solo win.  margin: how far ahead the player
 * won, as the game measures it for the stage's reputation (0x513FE0: the next finisher's time over ours,
 * (1 - ours / theirs) x 100; a drift race's points, (ours / theirs - 1) x 100; 100 when nobody else finished);
 * a friend's win (the player came 2nd or later) has the winner's margin (they raced it together); below 0: the
 * least a win counts (the race type's first step: a test's, mpcredit_test).  in_roam: called in free roam (the
 * trip's way back missed the crib): the win waits for the next crib (mpcredit_frame).  Call it in the crib after
 * its snapshot of the profile ([0x851148]), so that Return to Explore Mode's autosave saves it.  1 done (or
 * waiting), 0 the game would not take it (logged: won already, not in the table, not the career) */
int mpcredit_win(struct CPU *c, uint32_t race, float margin, int in_roam);
/* what the last win gave: the race, its prize, the reputation points, the stage before and after (a stage's final
 * race moves on), the sponsors offered after it (0: one was signed already, or none offered yet), the one the player
 * signed in the crib (0 none yet), its signing bonus and its name (UTF-8, as the game's sponsor screen names it), and
 * the race's movie that played ("" none) */
typedef struct { uint32_t race, sponsor; int prize, points, stage_from, stage_to, offers, bonus; char sponsor_name[48], movie[16]; } MpCredit;
int mpcredit_last(MpCredit *o);
/* wins wait for the next crib (kept beside the profile, MPWINS.DAT, until a save of it has them) */
int mpcredit_pending(void);
/* garage.c (fileio.c's): the game wrote a profile, or deleted one (its host path): the waiting wins' file follows */
void mpcredit_profile_written(const char *path);
void mpcredit_profile_deleted(const char *path);
/* after a win, in the crib: the sponsor question is up or coming (the player picks from the sponsors offered), or
 * the race's movie plays (after Return to Explore Mode's save, before the world).  The trip waits for it (no Return
 * to Explore Mode, no answering of dialogs, its way back's time stopped), the input is the player's and the page's
 * cover off (mprace.c) */
int mpcredit_busy(void);
/* per frame (roam.c's main-loop hook): the sponsor question and the movie; a waiting win, in the crib; the career's
 * profile's waiting wins read when it loads */
void mpcredit_frame(struct CPU *c);
/* test aid (career.c "mpcredit NAME[,NAME...] [MARGIN]"): the wins of those races (as the race table names them) at the
 * next crib, in order; how many were found */
int mpcredit_test(const char *name, float margin);

/* mprace.c -- a multiplayer race from free roam: the trip from the career's
 * free roam to the game's own LAN race and back.
 *
 * The free-roam lobby (roam_game.c mp_*) starts it in every game of its
 * players at once.  It drives the game along what a player can do by hand
 * in the original game: pause, Quit (the game keeps where the car was and
 * saves nothing), the main menu's LAN, a LAN game on the career race's track
 * with the career car, the race, Resume Career, the crib, Return to Explore
 * Mode -- which puts the car back where it was.  The career is never called:
 * a LAN race does not touch it (a proof run diffed the career and the save
 * before and after: the save the same byte for byte, the career's saved
 * fields too), so the race neither counts in it nor changes it.  Only the
 * prize goes into the career's bank: in the crib, after it took its snapshot
 * of the profile and before Return to Explore Mode, whose autosave (the
 * profile changed) then saves it as any money; with the game's autosave off
 * the crib takes no snapshot and saves nothing, as for any money.  A player
 * who quits the race with its pause menu's Quit pays mprace_quit_fee out of
 * the bank there instead (never more than it holds).  A race that ends under
 * the player (the host's game gone, or in a race of two the other player's:
 * either one's quit ends it) costs nothing, and a closed tab saves nothing
 * anyway.
 *
 * It works as the career bot does (career.c): each frame it looks at the
 * screens and does the next step of its goal there -- the race, or, after
 * the race or when something went wrong, back to the career -- through the
 * game's own handlers and messages (no key needs a menu's focus), keys only
 * where a screen's own step is its first item.  The host starts the game's
 * LAN server and creates the game (track, laps, direction, type, a password
 * only the lobby's players know); the others connect to its virtual address
 * (no server list: a LAN server of another name or another player cannot
 * catch them) and join its game, found in the lobby's list by its host.
 * The player's input is muted while it drives (mprace_owns_input), not in
 * the race and not on the results.
 *
 * The game (SPEED2.EXE v1.2 NA), as read for this file:
 *  - Leaving free roam: the race coordinator ([0x8900D8], state +0: 4 racing,
 *    6 paused) pauses on 0x5F4230(the player's +8), which shows UI_Pause;
 *    its Quit's Yes is the message 0x30ED2368 to UI_Pause (0x4C2170 ->
 *    0x4A7CF0: the front end's first screen UI_Main, the spot kept, career
 *    +0x8744), sent with 0x55DDA0(msg, package) as the help bar's buttons do.
 *  - UI_Main: the LAN item's handler 0x4AEDE0 ("UI_Main.fng", 0x0C407210, 0,
 *    0, 0): [0x850078] = 0x200, UI_PC_LAN_ServerSelect.  Career: 0x537980
 *    (UI_Main, UI_StartCareer, 0); Resume Career there 0x495A30(1): mode 1,
 *    the crib.
 *  - UI_PC_LAN_ServerSelect (screen vtable 0x796420; +0x904 its "Looking
 *    for LAN servers" dialog, +0x908 the servers found, node +0x18 the
 *    address): Host LAN Server is PAD_BUTTON1 (0xC519BFC0) to it; joining
 *    writes the server's address as text to 0x7FBDDC, its port to [0x7FBE04]
 *    (9900), [0x8500C7] = 0, and switches to UI_PC_LAN.fng (0x537980): what
 *    picking a server does (the lobby's connect, 0x588692, reads only those).
 *  - UI_PC_LAN: its name entry (buffer 0x83A8B0, length [0x83A9B0], active
 *    [0x83A9C0], record [0x83A9C4]) accepts with 0x54C7F0 on the record: 1 to
 *    12 letters and digits; a host's game then starts server.dll, both log in
 *    on UI_OLMAIN (the LAN object's state [0x8500D0] 0x11 once idle).  The
 *    host's login waits 5 s from the start (0x4A2F87: the screen's +0x54, by
 *    [0x8651AC], 4000 a second) and needs about 2.5 of them: the server
 *    answers "no master" until its master's first update, and the game takes
 *    that for a lost connection (UI_OL_Disconnect, its server shut down).
 *  - The lobby client 0x86A858: its +0xC callback says the screen up
 *    (0x4D17F0 PC_OL_Lobby, 0x4D2760 PC_OL_GameRoom; +0x10 the screen); the
 *    game we are in at 0x86A874 (-1 none), its players' count 0x86AA30, each
 *    one's flags 0x86AA70 + 0x64 i (0x08000000 ready; player 0 the host).
 *    Create Game is the lobby's first button: Mode, Track, Options (where the
 *    settings object 0x850080 is set up), then the room's constructor sends
 *    the game from that object.  Join: gjoi 0x58D6B0(name, password, 0x49EB10,
 *    the lobby screen) for the game whose HOST (record +0x38) is the host's
 *    LAN name, in the list the lobby's Refresh (0x4BB0F0) fills, filtered by
 *    the settings object (mode and options as the host's).  Ready 0x58AD20
 *    (1); the host's Start 0x4BB6E0(room): now when all are ready, else the
 *    game's 10 s countdown and its KICK of the rest.
 *  - Results: the rows 0x851044 ([0x85105C] of them, entry +4 the car's id,
 *    +8 1 finished) in their order; ours by our car's id (car +0xA).
 *  - The pause menu's Quit (0x4C2820, a LAN race too: its dialog's text
 *    LAN_QUIT_TO_MAIN, or OL_UNRANKED_QUIT_SESSION by 0x5F0120) has the Yes
 *    0x30ED2368, as in free roam; UI_Pause's handler 0x4C2170 (only from its
 *    vtable, 0x797CB8) runs it at once, or later on 0xE1FDE1D1 when the
 *    message it held back (+0x13C) is that Yes: 0x4A7CF0, the coordinator's
 *    end of the race (event 8, 6).  Losing the host is the network code's
 *    dialog (OL_HOST_LOST, 0x4A0215), not this.
 *  - Leaving LAN: Yes of UI_OLMAIN's "exit LAN mode?" is 0xD05FC3A3 to it
 *    (0x4A0140: the lobby and the server closed, UI_Main).  The others leave
 *    before the host, whose leaving closes its server under them.
 *  - The crib: Return to Explore Mode's Yes is 0x451E768E to it (0x4AF3A0):
 *    the profile compared with the snapshot the crib took when it came up
 *    (0x52A460: only with the autosave on, [0x844AD8]); changed: MC_Main
 *    saves it; then free roam at the spot.
 *  - A dialog: its handle [0x838974] (0 none), its text 0x838640.
 */

/* The LAN server (server.dll, module.c): the game's glue object 0x89CF48 starts it with StartLANServer 0x5FA300
 * (thiscall, the server's name): the module loaded once ([0x89011C] its handle, [0x890128] its IsServerRunning),
 * then, unless IsServerRunning says it runs already, StartServer(name, region); UnloadServer 0x5F08F0 (StopServer,
 * FreeLibrary) is what leaving LAN calls (0x4A0183).  UI_PC_LAN (vtable 0x794FE8) starts it once the host's name is
 * in (its handler 0x4A2E20, message 0xDA5B8712), puts up a "please wait" (+0x50) and logs in on it (UI_OLMAIN)
 * once the game's clock is past +0x54 = the start + 5 s (20000 ticks) */
#define G_SRV_GLUE      0x0089cf48u
/* ...and the network race's state there: the host's Restart on the results sets +0x11A (0x601D00); the others'
 * games get it as +0x11B, the host asked, and +0x114, the game's clock 15 s later (0x5FE49F: 60000 ticks), until
 * when their results ask "The host has requested to restart the race." (0x4E99C2): OK (label 0x639, 0x34DC1BEC:
 * what the host's own Restart does) races again, Cancel (0x541389E5, 0x1FAB5998; the one picked when it comes)
 * and no answer by then (0x4E99EE) do not (0x609750, which clears both: the lobby) */
#define GLUE_REDO_ASKED 0x11bu
#define GLUE_REDO_AT    0x114u
#define G_SRV_MOD       0x0089011cu
#define G_SRV_ISRUN     0x00890128u
#define FN_SRV_START    0x005fa300u
#define FN_SRV_UNLOAD   0x005f08f0u
#define VT_PCLAN        0x00794fe8u
#define PCLAN_LOGIN_AT  0x54u
#define SRV_WARM        20000         /* the game's wait from its server's start to the host's login (ticks) */
/* The trip's waits are in its clock's ticks, 60 a second (clk): real time while the game runs; they were game
 * frames, which at 120 fps passed twice as fast (a player's results gone in 4 s, the room's waits halved) */
#define STEP_FRAMES     (60 * 120)    /* ticks a phase may take before the trip gives up: out and into the LAN; the race's loading */
/* the host's wait in its room for players who do not come (their game frozen, or an old one that does not say its
 * trip gave up), 30 s at most: the others come within seconds of the room (a minute before; live logs of
 * 2026-11-02: hosts sat out the whole minute for lobby players whose trips had failed) */
#define ROOM_FRAMES     (60 * 30)
#define BACK_FRAMES     (60 * 240)    /* back to the career */
/* A step's tap or message on a screen goes once the screen has been up SETTLE ticks, and again only while the same
 * screen is still up RETAP later (it was lost); the next screen came within two frames of it.  The steps waited 1.5
 * to 2 s after each at first (about 10 s of the way to the race and as much of the way back), then 1/3 s */
#define SETTLE          10
#define RETAP           90
#define MP_PRIZE_N      4             /* 1st to 4th get prize money; 5th and 6th nothing */
#define C_STAGE         0x7af8u       /* Career: the current stage */

enum { G_RACE_GOAL = 1, G_CAREER_GOAL = 2 };
static struct {
    int      phase, goal;
    MpRace   r;
    long     next, since, step_at, look_at, load_at, frame0, results_at, left_at;   /* step_at: in the game's room */
    const char *scr; long scr_at, scr_tap;         /* the screen a step acts on, since when, and when it last acted there */
    int      place, prize, paid, raced, owns;
    int      prizes[MP_PRIZE_N];                   /* the prize money of 1st to 4th (mprace_prize_of, at the start) */
    int      credit, credited;                     /* MPC_*: the race in the career; 1 the career took it, -1 it did not */
    int      topup;                                /* ...and the prize money paid on top of the career's prize (pay) */
    float    lead;                                 /* how far ahead we won, the game's margin (mpcredit.h), when we won */
    char     winner[16];                           /* the race's winner, its LAN name */
    int      logged_credit, logged_cplace; char logged_winner[16];   /* credit_decide's last line (credit + 1, 0 none) */
    MpResult res[MPRACE_RESULTS_MAX]; int nres;    /* the race's results, as the game has them */
    int      look_off;                             /* its search for LAN servers called off */
    int      pre;                                  /* the host: its LAN server was started early (mprace_server_start), */
    uint32_t pre_at;                               /* ...at this game clock; */
    int      pre_ok, pre_used;                     /* ...it still ran when the host's name went in; its login's wait cut */
    int      quit_race, fee;                       /* the player quit the race (its pause menu); the fee the bank paid */
    int      paused, quit, lan, hosted, named, carset, created, settings, joined, started, left, career, resumed, crib_go, ndlg, host_gone;
    int      ol_detours, ol_back;                  /* UI_OLMAIN's Enter took another icon than Lobby so often; just now */
    int      logged_place, perf_logged;
    int      unloaded, again, redo_asked;          /* the results' world went (race_again); the races restarted so far;
                                                    * the host's Restart asked on these results (logged) */
    uint32_t race_dlg;                             /* the game's dialog in the race last logged */
    CarPerf  rep_car;                              /* the race's report: our car as rated in the race, the race's cars, */
    int      rep_cars, rep_mode, rep_track, rep_laps;   /* the network race's type, track and laps, */
    float    rep_field;                            /* the cars' average rating */
    float    rep_factor;                           /* our engine power's factor (1: as it was) */
    uint32_t room[10];                             /* the host's room as last logged */
    long     ready, dlg_at, wait_at, join_at;
    long     held;                                 /* the way back's time so far, while the player is not deciding */
    char     keys[16]; int nkeys; long key_at;     /* keys to press, one every 20 frames: L LEFT, R RETURN, E ESCAPE */
    char     why[96];
    const char *step;                              /* where the trip is, for the player (mprace_step) */
} M;

/* the trip's clock in ticks of 1/60 s: real time, advanced once a frame (clk_step) by at most 0.1 s, so that a game
 * parked meanwhile (its tab in the background: no frames) does not run out the trip's waits */
static uint64_t g_clk_us, g_clk_last;
static void clk_step(void){
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    uint64_t us = (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000u + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000u, d = g_clk_last && us > g_clk_last ? us - g_clk_last : 0;
    g_clk_us += d > 100000u ? 100000u : d; g_clk_last = us;
}
static long clk(void){ return (long)(g_clk_us / 16667u); }
/* a guest function with ecx and stack arguments from the main-loop hook, 512 bytes below its stack (guest.h) */
static uint32_t call(CPU *c, uint32_t fn, uint32_t ecx, int n, const uint32_t *arg){
    return guest_call_ex(c, fn, ecx, c->edx, n, arg, GUEST_RET_MAINLOOP, 512u);
}
static void gs(uint32_t a, const char *s, uint32_t cap){
    uint32_t i = 0;
    for (; s[i] && i + 1 < cap; i++) MR8(a + i) = (uint8_t)s[i];
    MR8(a + i) = 0;
}
static int on(const char *pkg){ const char *t = autotest_top_fng(); return (t && !strcasecmp(t, pkg)) || career_fe_active(pkg); }
#define K_ESC   0x01u
#define K_RET   0x1cu
#define K_LEFT  0xcbu
/* a step on screen s (its package's name) may act now; acted(f) when it did */
static int act_ok(const char *s, long f){
    if (!M.scr || strcmp(s, M.scr)){ M.scr = s; M.scr_at = f; M.scr_tap = 0; }
    return f - M.scr_at >= SETTLE && (!M.scr_tap || f - M.scr_tap >= RETAP);
}
static void acted(long f){ M.scr_tap = f; M.next = f + 4; }
/* The screens UI_OLMAIN's other icons open (car select, options, rankings, messenger, ...), none of the trip's: its
 * icon scroller opens on the icon picked last there, not on Lobby, so an Enter could take one of them (a 2026-11-05
 * trip opened Options, sat out its 2 minutes and the way back's 4, the host's race long gone; 11-02 Car Select) */
static const char *const OL_DETOURS[] = { "UI_OLCarSelect.fng", "UI_OLCarLot.fng", "UI_OptionsMain.fng", "UI_Options.fng",
    "UI_Options_PC_Controller.fng", "UI_OLRankings.fng", "UI_OLRankings_Overall.fng", "UI_OLRankings_Monthly.fng",
    "UI_OLRankings_Personal.fng", "UI_OLEAMessenger.fng", "UI_OL_ViewCar.fng", "UI_OLViewCareer.fng", "UI_OL_News.fng" };
#define OL_DETOURS_N  (int)(sizeof OL_DETOURS / sizeof OL_DETOURS[0])
#define OL_TRIES      6
static const char *ol_detour(void){
    for (int i = 0; i < OL_DETOURS_N; i++) if (on(OL_DETOURS[i])) return OL_DETOURS[i];
    return 0;
}
static void keys(const char *k){ snprintf(M.keys, sizeof M.keys, "%s", k); M.nkeys = (int)strlen(M.keys); M.key_at = 0; }
static int keys_run(long f){
    if (!M.nkeys) return 0;
    if (f < M.key_at) return 1;
    char k = M.keys[0]; memmove(M.keys, M.keys + 1, sizeof M.keys - 1); M.nkeys--;
    autotest_tap(k == 'L' ? K_LEFT : k == 'E' ? K_ESC : K_RET, 6);
    M.key_at = f + 20;
    return 1;
}
static void state_log(const char *where){
    fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld state %s: mode 0x%x, race type %u, net host %d client %d, LAN mode %u, career race %08x, coordinator %u\n",
            autotest_frame(), where, guest_rd32(G_GAMEMODE), guest_rd32(G_RACETYPE), (int32_t)guest_rd32(G_NET_HOST), (int32_t)guest_rd32(G_NET_CLIENT),
            guest_rd32(G_NET + N_MODE), guest_rd32(G_CAREER_RACE), guest_rd32(guest_rd32(G_RACECO)));
    if (getenv("NFSU2_MPRACE_TEST_PARAMS")){                       /* (test aid) the race's parameters 0x89E7A0, as words */
        fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld params %s:", autotest_frame(), where);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 0x80u; i += 4u) fprintf(stderr, "%s%08x", i % 32u ? " " : "  ", guest_rd32(G_RACEPARAMS + i));
        fputc('\n', stderr);
        /* ...and the input actions' subscriptions of the two ports (0x579410: a ring at 0x8655A0 + 0x1C8 port, node
         * +0 next, +8 the action; 0x579550 makes ports 0 and 1), each as many nodes as it holds or LOOP when its walk
         * does not come back to its head (a free roam built as the LAN race whose start broke off hung in that walk) */
        fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld subscriptions %s:", autotest_frame(), where);
        for (uint32_t p = 0; p < 2u; p++){
            uint32_t h = SPLIT_PORT_TABLES + 0x1c8u * p, n = guest_rd32(h); int k = 0;
            fprintf(stderr, " port %u:", p);
            for (; n != h && k < 400; k++){
                if (!guest_ok(n, 12)){ fprintf(stderr, " BAD %08x", n); break; }
                if (k < 24) fprintf(stderr, " %x", guest_rd32(n + 8u));
                n = guest_rd32(n);
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "%s (%d)", k >= 400 ? " LOOP" : "", k);
        }
        fputc('\n', stderr);
    }
}
static void mlog(const char *fmt, const char *a){ fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld ", autotest_frame()); fprintf(stderr, fmt, a); fputc('\n', stderr); }
static int series_cut(const char *why);
static int restart_asked(void);
static void fail(const char *why){
    if (M.goal == G_CAREER_GOAL) return;
    if (series_cut(why)) return;                       /* (a URL race's heats broken off after one: not finished) */
    snprintf(M.why, sizeof M.why, "%s", why);
    mlog("FAILED: %s: back to the career", why); state_log("failed");
    M.goal = G_CAREER_GOAL; M.phase = MPR_BACK; M.since = clk();
    M.step = "Back to free roam";
}
static void to_phase(int ph){
    static const char *const nm[] = { "idle", "out of free roam", "in the LAN menus", "racing", "back to the career", "done", "failed" };
    if (ph != M.phase) fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld %s -> %s\n", autotest_frame(), nm[M.phase], nm[ph]);
    M.phase = ph; M.since = clk(); M.scr = 0;
}

/* ---- a car's performance, as the game rates it -------------------------------------------------- */
/* A car's physics info is [car + 0x10] + 0x10 (the ride's; the race's racer
 * setup 0x5B5CC0 and the front end's car stats read it so), built by
 * 0x5B4DC0 from its CarTypeInfo (+0 the type's index) and its performance
 * parts (+0x2E0, set by 0x5A64A0(level, category), -1 every category):
 *  - 0x5AC4F0 copies the type's physics block (CarTypeInfo +0x110, 0x2B0
 *    bytes) to +0x30 and puts each part category's changes in: 0x5A6B50 the
 *    weight (+0x140 the mass), 0x5A6BD0 the gearbox, 0x5A6D00 and 0x5A6E30
 *    the engine's torque curve (+0x230: 9 points from the idle rpm +0x220 to
 *    the most +0x228, 0x7881F4 = 8 steps), and so on;
 *  - 0x5B5AB0 makes the push per kg at every speed from the torque, gears
 *    and wheels (+0x55C, a table: +0 points, +4 its first speed, +8 its
 *    last, +0xC points per m/s, +0x10 the values; 0x5764D0 reads it);
 *  - its rating (+8, a float) adds up the push beyond drag (speed squared
 *    times +0x290, per kg) in steps of 3 mph (0x7A1A80) over those speeds,
 *    and the class (+4, a byte; -1 not rated yet) is 0 above 500, 1 above
 *    401, 2 above 273 (0x7A1A84), else 3; a type with CarTypeInfo +0x844
 *    set is class 3 unrated;
 *  - its top speed (0x5B5930) is the first of those speeds where drag is no
 *    less than the push, at most +0x2C0 mph when that is set.
 * The engine (0x594300 each step) gives the curve +0x230 at its rpm (the
 * turbo's curve, +0x254, is in it already: 0x5A6E30 adds it there) times
 * the throttle, plus the nitrous' +0x2DC while that is on; the push table
 * is the curve's alone (no nitrous, no grip: the tyres turn what they
 * cannot hold into wheelspin, 0x59D600).  A rebuild (0x5B4DC0: the race's
 * car messages, 0x5F0320 / 0x5F04D0) makes all of it again from the parts. */
#define PI_TYPE         0x000u
#define PI_CLASS        0x004u
#define PI_RATING       0x008u
#define PI_MASS         0x140u
#define PI_RPM_IDLE     0x220u
#define PI_RPM_MAX      0x228u
#define PI_TORQUE       0x230u
#define PI_DRAG         0x290u
#define PI_LIMIT_MPH    0x2c0u        /* the stock car's governor, copied to the chassis every frame (0x5A49A0, 0x59C1E0):
                                       * 125-159 mph; any ECU part makes it 0 (0x5A71C0) */
#define PI_NITROUS      0x2dcu        /* the nitrous' torque (kN m, 0.5 with any nitrous part, else 0), added to the
                                       * curve's by 0x594300 while it is on */
#define PI_PARTS        0x2e0u
#define PI_PARTS_SIZE   0x94u         /* up to +0x374, the next of its parts */
#define PI_PUSH         0x55cu
#define FN_PI_BUILD     0x005b4dc0u   /* thiscall info (mode 0, 1, 1): the copy, the push table, rating and class */
#define FN_PI_PARTS     0x005a64a0u   /* thiscall info +0x2E0 (level, category or -1) */
#define PI_STEP         1.3410819f    /* 0x7A1A80: 3 mph */
#define G_CATCHUP       0x0089e7f8u   /* the race option Catch Up (with two player cars 0x5F6740 sets vehicle +0x468
                                       * from their gap: their torque, governor and grip) */
#define CARTYPE_SIZE    0x890u
#define N_PLAYER_TYPES  31            /* CarTypeInfo 0..30: the player's cars; then traffic */
static uint32_t perf_info(uint32_t car){
    uint32_t r = guest_ok(car, 0x14) ? guest_rd32(car + 0x10u) : 0;
    return r && guest_ok(r + 0x10u, PI_PUSH + 0x14u) ? r + 0x10u : 0;
}
static float push_at(uint32_t t, float v){                               /* 0x5764D0 */
    int n = (int)guest_rd32(t); uint32_t vals = guest_rd32(t + 0x10u);
    if (n < 1 || n > 4096 || !guest_ok(vals, 4u * (uint32_t)n)) return 0.f;
    float x = (v - MRF32(t + 4u)) * MRF32(t + 0xcu);
    int i = (int)x;
    if (i < 0 || x <= 0.f) return MRF32(vals);
    if (i >= n - 1) return MRF32(vals + 4u * (uint32_t)(n - 1));
    float fr = x - (float)i;
    return MRF32(vals + 4u * (uint32_t)i) * (1.f - fr) + MRF32(vals + 4u * (uint32_t)(i + 1)) * fr;
}
int mprace_car_perf(uint32_t car, CarPerf *p){
    memset(p, 0, sizeof *p); p->cls = -1; p->type = -1;
    uint32_t pi = perf_info(car), types = guest_rd32(G_CARTYPES);
    if (!pi) return 0;
    p->type = (int)guest_rd32(pi + PI_TYPE);
    if (types && p->type >= 0 && p->type < 64 && guest_ok(types + CARTYPE_SIZE * (uint32_t)p->type, 0x40)){
        uint32_t nm = types + CARTYPE_SIZE * (uint32_t)p->type;
        int k = 0; for (; k < (int)sizeof p->name - 1 && MR8(nm + (uint32_t)k); k++) p->name[k] = (char)MR8(nm + (uint32_t)k);
        p->name[k] = 0;
    }
    /* (the game's units: the mass in tonnes, the torque in kN m) */
    float mass_t = MRF32(pi + PI_MASS);
    p->cls = (int)(int8_t)MR8(pi + PI_CLASS); p->rating = MRF32(pi + PI_RATING); p->mass = mass_t * 1000.f;
    p->rpm_idle = MRF32(pi + PI_RPM_IDLE); p->rpm_max = MRF32(pi + PI_RPM_MAX);
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++){
        p->torque[i] = MRF32(pi + PI_TORQUE + 4u * (uint32_t)i) * 1000.f;
        float rpm = p->rpm_idle + (float)i * (p->rpm_max - p->rpm_idle) / 8.f, w = p->torque[i] * rpm / 9.5493043f;
        if (w > p->power) p->power = w;
    }
    /* the top speed, as 0x5B5930 finds it */
    uint32_t t = pi + PI_PUSH;
    float v = MRF32(t + 4u), last = MRF32(t + 8u), k = MRF32(pi + PI_DRAG);
    if (mass_t > 0.f){
        while (v <= last){
            if (v * k * v / mass_t > push_at(t, v)) break;
            v += PI_STEP;
        }
        float lim = MRF32(pi + PI_LIMIT_MPH);
        if (lim > 0.f && lim * 0.44702727f < v) v = lim * 0.44702727f;
        p->top = v;
    }
    return 1;
}
int mprace_car_class(uint32_t car){
    uint32_t pi = perf_info(car);
    return pi ? (int)(int8_t)MR8(pi + PI_CLASS) : -1;
}
void mprace_perf_log(const char *who, uint32_t car){
    CarPerf p;
    if (!mprace_car_perf(car, &p)){ fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld %s: no physics info\n", autotest_frame(), who); return; }
    fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld %s: %s (type %d), class %d, rating %.1f, top speed %.0f km/h, %.0f kg, %.0f kW (%.0f hp), "
            "%.0f kW per t; torque %.0f..%.0f rpm:", autotest_frame(), who, p.name, p.type, p.cls, (double)p.rating,
