                if (!M.ready) mlog("ready%s", "");
                M.ready = f;
            }
            return;
        }
        int ready = 0;
        for (uint32_t i = 1; i < n && i < 6; i++) ready += (guest_rd32(G_GAME_FLAGS0 + 0x64u * i) & GF_READY) != 0;
        {   /* the room as the host sees it, when it changes */
            uint32_t now[10] = { n, MR8(ctx + 0x1178u), MR8(ctx + 0x1180u), (uint32_t)ready };
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 6; i++) now[4 + i] = guest_rd32(G_GAME_FLAGS0 + 0x64u * i);
            if (memcmp(now, M.room, sizeof now)){
                memcpy(M.room, now, sizeof now);
                fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld the room: %u in the game, %d ready, counting down %u, can start %u; flags %08x %08x %08x %08x %08x %08x\n",
                        autotest_frame(), n, ready, now[1], now[2], now[4], now[5], now[6], now[7], now[8], now[9]);
            }
        }
        int all = n >= (uint32_t)M.r.players && ready == (int)n - 1 && n >= 2;
        int late = f - M.step_at > ROOM_FRAMES && ready >= 1;
        if ((all || late) && !M.started && !MR8(ctx + 0x1178u) && MR8(ctx + 0x1180u)){
            uint32_t one = 1; call(c, FN_READY, G_LOBBY, 1, &one); MR8(G_START_CLR) = 0;
            call(c, FN_START, ctx, 0, 0);
            M.started = 1;
            fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld start the race: %u in the game, %d ready%s\n", autotest_frame(), n, ready, all ? "" : " (the rest: the game's countdown)");
        }
        if (f - M.step_at > ROOM_FRAMES + 60 * 30 && !M.started) fail("nobody came into the game");
        return;
    }
}

/* ---- the race and its results ----------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* The host's Restart on a LAN race's results (its help bar's, the C key: PAD_BUTTON1 to the results' handler,
 * 0x4E9ACB -> 0x601D00, the glue's +0x11A; offered by 0x4E97A5 while 0x5FE500 says so: the host, other players in
 * the race, not mode 8) takes the host's game from its results back into the race's world at once, and each other
 * game whose player says OK to the game's question (restart_asked): the same race, without the menus (flow 7, 5,
 * then 6 again with the start screen; no flow 3).  That race is a race of its own, as often as the host restarts:
 * its own results and place (the prize goes by the last one raced), its cars evened out again, its racers' Quits
 * its own, and its results read for as long as the first's before the trip's Continue (by the first's clock the
 * trip would take the second results' Continue at once).  In a URL race's heats the heat is raced again (its
 * points are counted only when its results are left: series_next).  1: the race came again just now */
/* the host asked to restart the race (above: G_SRV_GLUE's): the question is the player's, as in the original game,
 * so the trip takes no Continue on our results meanwhile (its Enter would answer Cancel); at most 10 s past the
 * game's 15 s (a question that did not go) */
static int restart_asked(void){
    return MR8(G_SRV_GLUE + GLUE_REDO_ASKED) && (int32_t)(guest_rd32(G_REALTIMER) - guest_rd32(G_SRV_GLUE + GLUE_REDO_AT)) < 4000 * 10;
}
/* the race before the host's Restart: its result stands until the race again is under way (its countdown), and
 * comes back when that never comes (the others said no: the host's start screen, UI_OLPreRaceStart, says "The race
 * can not be started because you have lost your network connection, or the other players ...", about 15 s after
 * the Restart, and its OK goes to the lobby) */
static struct { int on, place, prize, nres, credit, nhall, nhres, hplace; float lead; char winner[16]; MpResult res[MPRACE_RESULTS_MAX]; } R;
static void race_again_init(void){ memset(&R, 0, sizeof R); }
static int race_again(void){
    uint32_t flow = guest_rd32(G_FLOW);
    if (!M.results_at) return 0;
    if (flow != 6u && flow != 3u){ M.unloaded = 1; return 0; }           /* (the results' world going; a Continue then
                                                                          * goes on to the menus, flow 3) */
    if (!M.unloaded || flow != 6u || !(guest_rd32(G_GAMEMODE) & 0x200u)) return 0;
    M.again++;
    fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld the host restarted the race: the race again (%d time%s); the last one's place %d, prize $%d until it is under way\n",
            autotest_frame(), M.again, M.again == 1 ? "" : "s", M.place, M.prize);
    int k = S.heat >= 0 && S.heat < SER_HEATS ? S.heat : 0;
    R.on = 1; R.place = M.place; R.prize = M.prize; R.nres = M.nres; R.credit = M.credit; R.lead = M.lead;
    memcpy(R.winner, M.winner, sizeof R.winner); memcpy(R.res, M.res, sizeof R.res);
    R.nhall = S.nhall[k]; R.nhres = S.nhres; R.hplace = S.hplace;
    M.unloaded = 0; M.redo_asked = 0; M.results_at = 0; M.place = M.prize = 0; M.logged_place = 0; M.nres = 0;
    M.credit = MPC_NONE; M.lead = 0.f; M.winner[0] = 0; M.logged_credit = 0;
    M.perf_logged = 0; memset(&g_bal, 0, sizeof g_bal); quit_reset();
    if (series_on()){ S.alone = 0; S.nhres = 0; S.hplace = 0; S.nhall[k] = 0; }
    M.since = clk(); M.scr = 0;
    return 1;
}
/* ...under way: the last race's result goes; or it did not come (the menus again without results): the last race's
 * result back, as if its results were left (f) */
static void race_again_on(void){
    uint32_t rs = guest_rd32(G_RACE), st = rs ? guest_rd32(rs) : 0;
    if (!R.on || (st != 3u && st != 4u && st != 6u)) return;
    R.on = 0;
    mlog("the race again is under way: the last one's result is gone%s", "");
}
static void race_again_off(long f){
    if (!R.on || M.results_at) return;
    int k = S.heat >= 0 && S.heat < SER_HEATS ? S.heat : 0;
    R.on = 0;
    M.place = R.place; M.prize = R.prize; M.nres = R.nres; M.credit = R.credit; M.lead = R.lead;
    memcpy(M.winner, R.winner, sizeof M.winner); memcpy(M.res, R.res, sizeof M.res);
    if (series_on()){ S.nhall[k] = R.nhall; S.nhres = R.nhres; S.hplace = R.hplace; }
    M.results_at = f;
    fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld the race again did not come: the last one's result stands, place %d, prize $%d\n", autotest_frame(), M.place, M.prize);
}
static int step_racing(long f){
    if (guest_rd32(G_FLOW) == 6u && (guest_rd32(G_GAMEMODE) & 0x200u) && M.phase == MPR_LAN && !S.between){ to_phase(MPR_RACE); M.raced = 1; mlog("the race is on%s", ""); }
    if (M.phase == MPR_LAN && M.lan && guest_rd32(G_FLOW) != 3u && !S.between){                     /* (the room's start: the race's world loads) */
        M.step = "Loading the race";
        if (!M.load_at) M.load_at = f;
    }
    /* (the host's Restart came as the trip's Continue went: into the race again, not the way back, whose input is
     * the trip's) */
    if (M.phase == MPR_BACK && M.raced && !M.left && !M.why[0] && race_again()){ M.goal = G_RACE_GOAL; M.step = "Loading the race"; to_phase(MPR_RACE); }
    if (M.phase != MPR_RACE) return 0;
    race_again(); race_again_on();
    {   /* the game's dialogs in the race and on its results (the player's to answer), in the log */
        uint32_t d = guest_rd32(G_DLG);
        if (d && d != M.race_dlg){
            char t[96]; dlg_text(t, sizeof t);
            fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld in the race, the game's dialog: \"%s\" (%u buttons: %08x %08x %08x, labels %08x %08x %08x)\n",
                    autotest_frame(), t, guest_rd32(G_DLG_NBUT), guest_rd32(G_DLG_MSG1), guest_rd32(G_DLG_MSG2), guest_rd32(G_DLG_MSG3),
                    guest_rd32(G_DLG_MSG1 - 4u), guest_rd32(G_DLG_MSG2 - 4u), guest_rd32(G_DLG_LABEL3));
        }
        M.race_dlg = d;
    }
    if (!M.perf_logged){
        /* the race's cars, once all are rated (or 20 s on): ours and every racer's in the log (GRaceStatus: +0x24
         * racers, +0xBD0 theirs, each +0 its car, [[car +0x14] +4] its driver), ours for the race's report, then
         * evened out */
        uint32_t pl = guest_rd32(G_PLAYER1), car = pl ? guest_rd32(pl + 4u) : 0, cars[RACE_CARS_MAX], pis[RACE_CARS_MAX]; int nc;
        if (race_cars(cars, pis, &nc) || f - M.since > 60 * 20){
            mprace_perf_log("our car in the race", car); M.perf_logged = 1;
            float sum = 0.f; int k = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < nc; i++){
                char who[48];
                snprintf(who, sizeof who, "racer %d (driver %d%s)", i, (int)guest_rd32(guest_rd32(cars[i] + 0x14u) + 4u), cars[i] == car ? ", ours" : "");
                mprace_perf_log(who, cars[i]);
                if (pis[i] && MRF32(pis[i] + PI_RATING) > 0.f){ sum += MRF32(pis[i] + PI_RATING); k++; }
            }
            mprace_car_perf(car, &M.rep_car);
            M.rep_cars = nc; M.rep_field = k ? sum / (float)k : 0.f;
            M.rep_mode = (int)guest_rd32(G_NET + N_MODE); M.rep_track = (int)(guest_rd32(G_NET + N_TRACK) & 0xffffu); M.rep_laps = (int)(guest_rd32(G_NET + N_LAPS) & 0xffffu);
            M.rep_factor = balance_race(car, M.rep_mode);
        }
    }
    balance_hold(f);
    if (on("UI_PostRaceResults.fng")){
        /* our place; while the results are up, again until there is one (our
         * row may be filled in after the screen came: finishing just then) */
        int first = !M.results_at;
        if (first) M.results_at = f;
        results_read(0);                                                          /* (the way back's cover shows them) */
        if (series_on()) series_results(first);                                   /* (a URL race's heats: by the standing) */
        else if (first || !M.place){
            M.place = results_place();
            M.prize = prize_at(M.place);
            credit_decide();
        }
        if (!series_on() && (first || (M.place && !M.logged_place))){
            M.logged_place = M.place != 0;
            fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld the results: place %d, prize $%d%s\n", autotest_frame(), M.place, M.prize, first ? "" : " (our row came later)");
            results_read(1);
        }
        /* the player reads them; Continue after 8 s, the host 4 s after the others (its leaving closes the server);
         * none while the host's Restart counts down (race_again) */
        if (restart_asked()){
            if (!M.redo_asked){ M.redo_asked = 1; mlog("the host asked to restart the race: the results wait for the game's countdown%s", ""); }
        } else if (f - M.results_at > 60 * (M.r.host ? 12 : 8)){
            autotest_tap(K_RET, 6);
            act_ok("UI_PostRaceResults.fng", f); acted(f);
            if (series_next(f)) return 1;                                         /* (the next heat) */
            M.goal = G_CAREER_GOAL; M.step = "Back to free roam"; to_phase(MPR_BACK);
            act_ok("UI_PostRaceResults.fng", f); acted(f);
        }
        return 1;
    }
    /* the menus again: the player left the race (its pause menu's Quit to LAN Main Menu: no results), or the
     * results with their own Continue, before ours (the game's room came up, and the trip waited there for
     * good): back */
    if (guest_rd32(G_FLOW) == 3u){
        race_again_off(f);                                                        /* (a race again that did not come) */
        if (M.results_at && series_next(f)) return 1;                             /* (a heat's results left: the next heat) */
        if (!M.results_at && quit_alone()){ quit_win(f); M.goal = G_CAREER_GOAL; M.step = "Back to free roam"; to_phase(MPR_BACK); return 1; }
        if (M.results_at && !M.place){ M.place = results_place(); M.prize = prize_at(M.place); credit_decide(); }
        if (M.results_at) fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld the results left by the player: place %d, prize $%d\n", autotest_frame(), M.place, M.prize);
        else mlog("the race was left: not finished%s", M.quit_race ? " (the player's own Quit: the fee)" : "");
        M.goal = G_CAREER_GOAL; M.step = "Back to free roam"; to_phase(MPR_BACK);
    }
    return 1;
}

/* ---- back to the career --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* The connection to the LAN game lost (the host's game closed under a player in its room, or its server gone):
 * the game's own screen UI_OL_Disconnect (screen 0x4B9430, class 0x78FCE8; set up by 0x49DB00), not a dialog, and
 * while it is up the game shows no dialog at all ([0x8383B4], ShowDialog 0x558020).  Its options' kinds are at
 * +0x4C + 4 i (i 0 .. 2, its buttons 0xB8A7C6CC .. CE: 0x4D0470); kind 3 is back to the main menu (0x4B93A0: the
 * flag cleared, LAN left 0x4A0140, UI_Main), kind 2 back to the LAN's own main screen (0x49D950), kinds 0 and 1 are
 * the game's way out of the program (0x5B7C40, [0x864F4C] = 1): never those.  The answer as its button gives it,
 * 0x4B95C0(i) on the screen.  1: answered */
#define VT_OL_DISCONNECT 0x0078fce8u
#define FN_DISCONNECT_PICK 0x004b95c0u
static int disconnect_answer(CPU *c){
    uint32_t s = screen_of(VT_OL_DISCONNECT);
    if (!s) return 0;
    int pick = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3 && pick < 0; i++) if (guest_rd32(s + 0x4cu + 4u * (uint32_t)i) == 3u) pick = i;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3 && pick < 0; i++) if (guest_rd32(s + 0x4cu + 4u * (uint32_t)i) == 2u) pick = i;
    fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld the game's \"connection lost\" screen: options %u %u %u, %s%d\n", autotest_frame(), guest_rd32(s + 0x4cu), guest_rd32(s + 0x50u),
            guest_rd32(s + 0x54u), pick < 0 ? "none to take" : "take ", pick);
    if (pick < 0) return 0;
    uint32_t a = (uint32_t)pick; call(c, FN_DISCONNECT_PICK, s, 1, &a);
    return 1;
}
/* The race's parameters (GRaceParameters 0x89E7A0: +0 the track, +0x10 the race type, +0x40 .. +0x47 the network
 * race's flags, +0x74 its racers) are the world the game builds next.  A race that ends goes through the game's
 * front end load (flow 1, 0x57FF10), whose first step puts them back as the menus have them (0x5ED5F0: track 2000,
 * race type 0, no racers); Return to Explore Mode then makes free roam of that (0x5404A0 sets the track, the race
 * type and the player's car, nothing else).  A LAN race whose start broke off (the host's Start, then "the other
 * players were unable to connect", or the host's game gone) never loaded its world, so the game never went that
 * way: its parameters stayed the LAN race's (the host's game had built them, a joiner's too once the start reached
 * it), and Return to Explore built free roam as that race: race type 1, the network race's flags, one racer, no
 * traffic, the race's HUD (HUD_Drift after a drift race), and the game hung at the player's first change of control
 * (its input setup 0x605C70 walking the actions' subscriptions, 0x579410, for good: tests with the game's autopilot,
 * 2026-11-02).  On the way back, in the main menu, they get the same reset when they are not the menus' already. */
#define FN_RPARAMS_RESET 0x005ed5f0u   /* thiscall GRaceParameters: as the front end has them */
#define RP_TRACK_MENUS   0x7d0u
static void params_reset(CPU *c){
    uint32_t tr = guest_rd32(G_RACEPARAMS), ty = guest_rd32(G_RACEPARAMS + 0x10u), n = guest_rd32(G_RACEPARAMS + 0x74u), nf = guest_rd32(G_RACEPARAMS + 0x40u), nf2 = guest_rd32(G_RACEPARAMS + 0x44u);
    if (tr == RP_TRACK_MENUS && !ty && !n) return;
    call(c, FN_RPARAMS_RESET, G_RACEPARAMS, 0, 0);
    fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld the race's parameters were the LAN race's (track %u, race type %u, %u racers, flags %08x %08x): put back "
            "as the menus have them (track %u, race type %u, %u racers)\n", autotest_frame(), tr, ty, n, nf, nf2, guest_rd32(G_RACEPARAMS), guest_rd32(G_RACEPARAMS + 0x10u),
            guest_rd32(G_RACEPARAMS + 0x74u));
}
static void step_back(CPU *c, long f){
    uint32_t cb = guest_rd32(G_LOBBY + 0xcu), flow = guest_rd32(G_FLOW);
    /* in the crib after the race's win: the player picks a sponsor, or the race's movie plays (mpcredit.c): theirs,
     * the dialog too */
    if (mpcredit_busy()){ M.next = f + 4; return; }
    if (on("UI_OL_Disconnect.fng")){ if (act_ok("UI_OL_Disconnect.fng", f)){ disconnect_answer(c); acted(f); } return; }
    /* (the host's Restart counting down on our results: the game's own, into the race again) */
    if (restart_asked() && on("UI_PostRaceResults.fng")){ M.next = f + 4; return; }
    if (guest_rd32(G_DLG)){
        /* a dialog on the way back: Yes / OK (the left button, or the only
         * one); a "please wait" goes by itself, or with its Cancel after 5 s
         * (on the way out of the LAN menus there is nothing to wait for: a
         * host gone left one "connecting" for a minute) */
        uint32_t nb = guest_rd32(G_DLG_NBUT);
        char t[96]; dlg_text(t, sizeof t);
        int cancel = nb == 1 && (guest_rd32(G_DLG_MSG3) == MSG_LOOK_CANCEL || guest_rd32(G_DLG_LABEL3) == LBL_CANCEL);
        if (nb == 0 || cancel){
            if (!M.wait_at){ M.wait_at = f; mlog("a \"please wait\" on the way back: \"%s\"", t); }
            if (cancel && f - M.wait_at > 60 * 5){ mlog("... called off%s", ""); dlg_answer(guest_rd32(G_DLG_MSG3)); M.wait_at = 0; M.next = f + 30; }
            return;
        }
        M.wait_at = 0;
        mlog("a dialog on the way back: \"%s\": yes / OK", t);
        dlg_answer(nb == 1 ? guest_rd32(G_DLG_MSG3) : guest_rd32(G_DLG_MSG1));
        M.next = f + 30;
        return;
    }
    M.wait_at = 0;
    /* (Continue missed: again after 4 s, not sooner; a second Enter on the room that comes next would do its own) */
    if (on("UI_PostRaceResults.fng")){ if (f - M.scr_tap >= 60 * 4 && !restart_asked()){ autotest_tap(K_RET, 6); acted(f); } return; }
    if (flow == 6u){
        /* free roam again: done (the career's own free roam, not a LAN race's world); a test's
         * NFSU2_MPRACE_TEST_NODONE=1 misses it, as a trip that lost its way would (roam_game.c's MP_STALE_US) */
        static int nodone = -1;
        if (nodone < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_MPRACE_TEST_NODONE"), *p = getenv("NFSU2_MPRACE_TEST_NOCRIBPAY");
                         nodone = (e && *e == '1') || (p && *p == '1'); }
        if ((guest_rd32(G_GAMEMODE) & 1u) && guest_rd32(G_RACETYPE) == 0 && guest_rd32(guest_rd32(G_RACECO)) == 4u && on("HUD_SingleRace.fng") && !nodone){
            state_log("back in free roam"); to_phase(M.why[0] ? MPR_FAILED : MPR_DONE);
            M.owns = 0;
            return;
        }
        /* still in the LAN race's world (the results went): its pause menu would leave it; wait for the game */
        return;
    }
    if (cb == CB_ROOM){ if (act_ok("PC_OL_GameRoom.fng", f)){ autotest_tap(K_ESC, 6); acted(f); } return; }   /* "exit this game session?" next */
    if (cb == CB_LOBBY){ if (act_ok("PC_OL_Lobby.fng", f)){ autotest_tap(K_ESC, 6); acted(f); } return; }      /* LAN Main */
    if (on("UI_OLMAIN.fng")){
        if (act_ok("UI_OLMAIN.fng", f)){ send_to(c, MSG_LAN_EXIT, gstr_tmp(c, "UI_OLMAIN.fng")); M.left = 1; acted(f); mlog("leave LAN%s", ""); }
        return;
    }
    static const char *const lan_screens[] = { "UI_PC_LAN.fng", "UI_PC_LAN_ServerSelect.fng", "UI_QRModeSelect.fng", "UI_QRTrackSelect.fng", "UI_QRModeOptions.fng" };
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) if (on(lan_screens[i])){ if (act_ok(lan_screens[i], f)){ autotest_tap(K_ESC, 6); acted(f); } return; }
    { const char *d = ol_detour(); if (d){ if (act_ok(d, f)){ autotest_tap(K_ESC, 6); acted(f); } return; } }   /* (a detour of the way out) */
    if (on("UI_Main.fng")){
        if (!act_ok("UI_Main.fng", f)) return;
        /* the main menu again after the crib's Return to Explore (its save went there instead, unsaved: a 2026-10-27
         * report, the host's server gone on the way back): the career once more, until the way back's time is up */
        if (M.crib_go){ M.resumed = M.crib_go = 0; mlog("the main menu after the crib: the career again%s", ""); }
        state_log("in the main menu");
        params_reset(c);                                                          /* (a start that broke off) */
        uint32_t a[3] = { S_MAIN, gstr_tmp(c, "UI_StartCareer.fng"), 0 };
        call(c, FN_FE_SWITCH, 0, 3, a);
        M.career = 1; acted(f);
        mlog("the career%s", "");
        return;
    }
    if (on("UI_StartCareer.fng")){
        if (!M.resumed){ uint32_t one = 1; call(c, FN_RESUME, 0, 1, &one); M.resumed = 1; mlog("resume the career%s", ""); }
        M.next = f + SETTLE;
        return;
    }
    if (on("UI_CareerCrib.fng") && !on("MC_Main.fng")){
        /* the prize (or the fee), once the crib took its snapshot (the autosave on), so that its autosave sees it.  A
         * test's NFSU2_MPRACE_TEST_NOCRIBPAY=1 misses it, and free roam's end too (as NODONE): a trip that lost its
         * way, paid in free roam (mprace_end_in_roam; a career win waits beside the profile for the next crib) */
        static int nocribpay = -1;
        if (nocribpay < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_MPRACE_TEST_NOCRIBPAY"); nocribpay = e && *e == '1'; }
        if (!M.paid && nocribpay && !M.crib_go) mlog("the crib: no pay here (NFSU2_MPRACE_TEST_NOCRIBPAY)%s", "");
        if (!M.paid && !nocribpay){
            if (guest_rd32(G_SNAPSHOT) == 0 && f - M.since < 60 * 3) return;               /* (its INIT_COMPLETE) */
            pay(c, 0, guest_rd32(G_SNAPSHOT) ? "" : "; the game's autosave is off: saved at the next save");
        }
        if (mpcredit_busy()){ M.next = f + 4; return; }                          /* (the sponsor pick, the movie) */
        if (!M.crib_go){
            state_log("at the crib");
            send_to(c, MSG_CRIB_GO, gstr_tmp(c, "UI_CareerCrib.fng")); M.crib_go = 1; mlog("return to explore mode%s", "");
        }
        M.next = f + SETTLE;
        return;
    }
    if (on("MC_Main.fng")){                                                      /* the autosave's prompts: yes / OK */
        uint32_t mode = guest_rd32(G_MC_MODE), next = guest_rd32(G_MC_NEXT);
        char nm[40] = "";
        if ((mode & 0xfu) == 2u && guest_ok(next, sizeof nm)) for (unsigned i = 0; i + 1 < sizeof nm && MR8(next + i); i++){ nm[i] = (char)MR8(next + i); nm[i + 1] = 0; }
        fprintf(stderr, "[mprace] f=%ld the save: mode 0x%x, from 0x%x, next 0x%x%s%s; dialog %u, top %s\n", autotest_frame(), mode,
                guest_rd32(G_MC_FROM), next, nm[0] ? " " : "", nm, guest_rd32(G_DLG), autotest_top_fng() ? autotest_top_fng() : "?");
        keys("LR"); M.next = f + 90; return;
    }
}

/* a guest string (scratch, up to 8 of them alive) */
static uint32_t g_tmp; static int g_tmp_i;
static uint32_t gstr_tmp(CPU *c, const char *s){
    if (!g_tmp){ uint32_t sz = 0x200; g_tmp = call(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &sz); if (!g_tmp) return 0; }
    uint32_t a = g_tmp + 0x40u * (uint32_t)(g_tmp_i++ & 7);
    gs(a, s, 0x40);
    return a;
}

void mprace_frame(CPU *c){
    clk_step();
    note_net_car();
    if (M.phase == MPR_IDLE || M.phase == MPR_DONE || M.phase == MPR_FAILED){ M.owns = 0; return; }
    long f = clk();
    /* the player's input is ours out of free roam and back, not in the race, not on its results, not while the
     * pause menu's Save saves */
    M.owns = (M.phase == MPR_OUT && !savegame_busy()) || M.phase == MPR_LAN || (M.phase == MPR_BACK && !on("UI_PostRaceResults.fng"));
    /* ...nor while the player picks a sponsor in the crib or watches the race's movie (mpcredit_busy: the page's
     * cover goes too, mprace_covered), and the way back's time stands meanwhile; keys of ours still to press (the
     * save's "LR": the movie comes as the save ends) would answer the question or skip the movie: dropped */
    if (mpcredit_busy()){ M.owns = 0; M.nkeys = 0; }
    if (M.goal == G_CAREER_GOAL){ if (mpcredit_busy()) M.since = f - M.held; else M.held = f - M.since; }
    if (step_racing(f)) return;
    if (keys_run(f) || f < M.next) return;
    if (M.goal == G_RACE_GOAL){
        /* in the game's room the wait counts from there (each game's own: the host's for the others, then the
         * game's 10 s countdown), and the race's loading from its start: a joiner's wait counted from the server
         * list ran out while a late start loaded, and it sat out the race under the cover */
        long lim = M.phase != MPR_LAN ? STEP_FRAMES : M.load_at ? M.load_at - M.since + STEP_FRAMES
                 : M.step_at ? M.step_at - M.since + ROOM_FRAMES + 60 * 40 : STEP_FRAMES;
        if (f - M.since > lim){
            fail(M.phase == MPR_OUT ? "the game did not leave free roam" : M.load_at ? "the race did not load" : "the LAN race did not come together");
            return;
        }
        step_race(c, f);
    } else {
        if (f - M.since > BACK_FRAMES){
            /* stuck on the way back: say so, and leave the rest to the player */
            if (!M.why[0]) snprintf(M.why, sizeof M.why, "the way back stopped on %s", autotest_top_fng() ? autotest_top_fng() : "?");
            mlog("FAILED: %s", M.why);
            to_phase(MPR_FAILED); M.owns = 0;
            return;
        }
        step_back(c, f);
    }
}

/* names.h -- a player's name that reads as a slur.  The game shows another
 * name for one: "Player" over a car in free roam (roam_core.c: every name
 * heard, and our own), and the Mac's settings refuse one as roam_name
 * (bundle.m).  web/src/app/names.mjs is the same lists and the same matching
 * for the server (Online names, the switch's peer list) and the page's
 * settings; web/test/names.test.mjs checks that the two agree.
 *
 * A name is read as letters only: a to z in lower case, the digits and signs
 * that stand for letters as those (0 o, 1 ! | l i, 3 e, 4 @ a, 5 $ s, 7 + t,
 * 6 9 g, 8 b), anything else left out: "N1-g g@" reads "nigga".  Digits
 * that make a number are left out too: three or more in a row, or two that
 * end a part ("Hakan1995", "Dani99", "Dani99GS" are no slur; "ni99a" is
 * one); but not right after a part that is a lone n (or ni) so far, with a
 * letter after them ("N1663r", "BigN199a"; "N1995" stays a letter and a
 * year).  A word matches where each of its letters comes at least as many
 * times in a row as in the word ("niiiggga"; one g is not the two of
 * "nigger").
 *  - anywhere: a word long enough that no other word has it inside it;
 *    "niger" not where "nigeri" is (Nigeria)
 *  - whole: a short one that other words have inside them ("Mustafa GS",
 *    "raccoon", "spicy", "Pakize"), only as a part of the name on its own,
 *    and plural: the parts are split where a character is no letter and
 *    where a capital follows a small letter, digits and signs read as
 *    letters between them or not ("f4g_42", "XxCoonXx", "Big1Fag"); the
 *    name's letters together count as one too ("F A G").  "Dyke" after
 *    "Van" is the surname; a name of whole_ok is none ("Nazli").
 *  - edge: a word that starts or ends a part (or the name's letters
 *    together), plural too ("nigabro", "biggniga"), but not where a part
 *    starts or ends with a word of edge_ok_start/edge_ok_end ("Nigar",
 *    "Zuniga", "Hooniga")
 * The other offensive names go the same way (picked from the live server's
 * names, 2026-10-26, 11-02, 11-05 and 11-07): Nazi ones and their
 * nicknames, hate aimed at a group, terror, sexual violence; and a name with
 * 1488 in it (the neo-Nazi code), spaces, _ or - between its digits or not
 * ("14_88"); and hate aimed at a group as a phrase (name_hate: a verb, a word
 * between or none, the group).  A swear word is no such name.  A "pid" word
 * (pidor, pidar, pidr) right after the start of an English word that ends in "pid"
 * (rapid, cupid, stupid), or after a vowel when it runs into the next part
 * ("TopiDrift"), is no slur ("RapidRacer"; "dapidor", "YaPidor" are).
 * Header only: no state.
 */
#ifndef NAMES_H
#define NAMES_H

#include <string.h>

/* ch as a letter (above), else 0 */
static inline char name_letter(char ch){
    static const char from[] = "01!|l34@5$7+698", to[] = "oiiiieaassttggb";
    if (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') ch = (char)(ch - 'A' + 'a');
    for (int i = 0; from[i]; i++) if (ch == from[i]) return to[i];
    return ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z' ? ch : 0;
}
/* the run of n digits at p is a number, not letters: three or more, or two
 * with no letter after them or a capital after a small letter before them */
static inline int name_number(const char *p, int n, char before){
    if (n != 2) return n > 2;
    char a = p[2];
    return !name_letter(a) || (a >= 'A' && a <= 'Z' && before >= 'a' && before <= 'z');
}
/* the end of word w (its letters) at s + i, each letter at least as many
 * times in a row as in w; -1 if it is not there */
static inline int name_at(const char *s, int i, const char *w){
    while (*w){
        char c = *w; int m = 0, k = 0;
        for (; *w == c; w++) m++;
        while (s[i + k] == c) k++;
        if (k < m) return -1;
        i += k;
    }
    return i;
}
/* word as its letters into w[64] */
static inline void name_word(const char *word, char *w){
    int n = 0;
    for (; *word && n < 63; word++) if (name_letter(*word)) w[n++] = name_letter(*word);
    w[n] = 0;
}
/* t is all one of words, or its plural */
static inline int name_whole(const char *t, const char *const *words){
    char w[64];
    for (int j = 0; words[j]; j++){
        name_word(words[j], w);
        int e = name_at(t, 0, w);
        if (e < 0) continue;
        while (t[e] == 's') e++;
        if (!t[e]) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
/* t is all one of words (or its plural), and none of the names of ok, as
 * they are */
static inline int name_whole_word(const char *t, const char *const *words, const char *const *ok){
    char x[64];
    for (int k = 0; ok[k]; k++){ name_word(ok[k], x); if (!strcmp(t, x)) return 0; }
    return name_whole(t, words);
}
/* t starts with word w (its letters) */
static inline int name_starts(const char *t, const char *w){ return name_at(t, 0, w) >= 0; }
/* t ends with word w (its letters), or its plural */
static inline int name_ends(const char *t, const char *w){
    for (int i = 0; t[i]; i++){
        int e = name_at(t, i, w);
        if (e < 0) continue;
        while (t[e] == 's') e++;
        if (!t[e]) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
/* t starts or ends with a word of edge, and not with a word of the ok
 * lists there */
static inline int name_edge(const char *t, const char *const *edge, const char *const *ok_start, const char *const *ok_end){
    char w[64], x[64];
    for (int j = 0; edge[j]; j++){
        name_word(edge[j], w);
        int start = name_starts(t, w), end = name_ends(t, w);
        for (int k = 0; start && ok_start[k]; k++){ name_word(ok_start[k], x); if (name_starts(t, x)) start = 0; }
        for (int k = 0; end && ok_end[k]; k++){ name_word(ok_end[k], x); if (name_ends(t, x)) end = 0; }
        if (start || end) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
/* a "pid" word w (its letters) at s + i is the end of an English word: not
 * at the start of a part (st[j]: a part starts at s[j]), and right after
 * the start of one of those words (rapid, cupid, stupid, tepid, vapid,
 * insipid, lipid, limpid, sapid, intrepid, hispid), or after a vowel and
 * into the next part */
static inline int name_english_pid(const char *s, int i, const char *w, const char *st){
    static const char *const stems[] = { "ra", "cu", "stu", "te", "va", "insi", "li", "lim", "sa", "intre", "his", 0 };
    char x[64];
    if (strncmp(w, "pid", 3) || st[i]) return 0;
    for (int k = 0; stems[k]; k++){
        name_word(stems[k], x);
        int n = (int)strlen(x);
        if (n <= i && !strncmp(s + i - n, x, (size_t)n)) return 1;
    }
    if (!strchr("aeiouy", s[i - 1])) return 0;
    for (int j = i + 1, e = name_at(s, i, w); j < e; j++) if (st[j]) return 1;
    return 0;
}
/* a phrase of hate aimed at a group (a verb, one of the words that may come
 * between or none, a group: "GasJews", "Kill_All_Jews") anywhere in s, the
 * name's n letters; as the anywhere list's words are matched */
static inline int name_hate(const char *s, int n){
    static const char *const hate_verbs[] = { "gas", "kill", "hate", "hunt", "slay", "burn", "shoot", "nuke", "bomb", "dead", "death", "fck",
        "fuck", "fuk", "destroy", "exterminate", 0 };
    static const char *const hate_between[] = { "s", "the", "all", "allthe", "da", "dem", "them", "those", "every", "dirty", "to", 0 };
    static const char *const hate_groups[] = { "jew", "kike", "colored", "coloured", "zyd", 0 };
    char v[64], w[192], x[64];
    for (int a = 0; hate_verbs[a]; a++){
        name_word(hate_verbs[a], v);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++){
            if (name_at(s, i, v) < 0) continue;
            /* b = -1: no word between */
            for (int b = -1; b < 0 || hate_between[b]; b++)
                for (int g = 0; hate_groups[g]; g++){
                    strcpy(w, v);
                    if (b >= 0){ name_word(hate_between[b], x); strcat(w, x); }
                    name_word(hate_groups[g], x); strcat(w, x);
                    if (name_at(s, i, w) >= 0) return 1;
                }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

        "whitepower", "kukluxklan", "klansman", "jewhate", "nojews", "jewsdid", "4threich", "fourthreich", "holocaust",
        "adolfwasright", "adolfpaint", "adolfthepaint", "whitepride", "jewskil", "yahudisik", "natsist", "nacist", "nigaman",

    static const char *const whole[] = { "fag", "dyke", "coon", "spic", "paki", "kike", "gook", "chink",
        "niga", "nyga", "ngga", "neger", "xach", "xoxol", "hohol", "ukrop", "pider", "pedik", "nazi", "taliban", "rape",

        "nazir", "nazim", "nazif", "nazik", "nazih", "nazib", "nazia", "nazio", "nazli", 0 };
    static const char *const edge_ok_end[] = { "zuniga", "kniga", "kuniga", "miniga", "hooniga", "shiniga", "bronyga", "manyga",

    static const char *const whole_ok[] = { "nazli", "nazilli", 0 };

    char s[256], t[256], prev[256] = "", w[64];  /* the name's letters; the part it is in; the part before */

    int n = 0, k = 0, low = 0;

/* the n characters at p are one of list, as they are */
static inline int name_part_is(const char *p, int n, const char *const *list){
    for (int k = 0; list[k]; k++) if ((int)strlen(list[k]) == n && !strncmp(p, list[k], (size_t)n)) return 1;
    return 0;
}
/* plate (a license plate: capitals and digits, at most 8; anything else is
 * read as a name only) reads as a slur, as a name or as a plate.  A plate
 * has no small letters to split its parts by ("BIGFAG" is "BigFag") and
 * its words run into each other, so:
 *  - plate_edge: a word that ends the plate's letters, plural too
 *    ("BIGFAG", "KILLFAGS"), unless they end with a word of plate_end_ok
 *    (a word or name: "RACCOON", "ASPIC", "TORPEDO", König, Sehnig; one cut
 *    to 8 or misspelled: "MIDNIG(HT)", "LIGHTNIG", "RAFAG(A)"), or that
 *    starts them with a word of plate_rests after it, plural or not
 *    ("FAGBOY", "NIGSKING")
 *  - plate_anywhere: a word anywhere in its letters, unless a word of
 *    plate_anywhere_ok holds it ("HUNGGRY", Anggraini)
 *  - its letters as a name's, but a lone digit at its end is a number
 *    ("MUSTAFA6", "HUZAIFA9")
 *  - codes: a part (letters or digits in a row) that is one of plate_alone
 *    ("KKK", "KKK77"; not "KKKK": laughter), or one of plate_marks next to
 *    one of plate_numbers ("HH88", "88SS", "HEIL88"; not 14: "SS14" is a
 *    car's)
 * Picked from the live server's names read as plates (capitals and digits,
 * the first 8), 2026-11-08; web/src/app/names.mjs PLATE is the same. */
static inline int name_plate_blocked(const char *plate){
    static const char *const plate_edge[] = { "fag", "coon", "spic", "paki", "kike", "kyke", "gook", "chink", "dyke", "nig", "nigr", "neger",
        "pedo", "rtard", 0 };
    static const char *const plate_end_ok[] = { "rafag", "tafag", "racoon", "cocoon", "tycoon", "aspic", "ospic", "uspic", "papaki", "ipaki",
        "eepaki", "klike", "akike", "ekike", "ikike", "okyke", "ergook", "achink", "uchink", "vandyke", "oldyke", "odyke",
        "knig", "midnig", "ghtnig", "sehnig", "anig", "enig", "inig", "onig", "unig", "reneger", "torpedo", "speedo", "ipedo",
        "ppedo", 0 };
    static const char *const plate_rests[] = { "boy", "boi", "lord", "king", "kid", "kill", "killer", "slayer", "hunter", "lover", "life", 0 };
    static const char *const plate_anywhere[] = { "nggr", "jewgas", "jewsgas", "h8jew", 0 };
    static const char *const plate_anywhere_ok[] = { "anggr", "unggr", 0 };
    static const char *const plate_alone[] = { "KKK", 0 };
    static const char *const plate_marks[] = { "HH", "SS", "WP", "HEIL", "SIEG", 0 };
    static const char *const plate_numbers[] = { "88", 0 };
    const char *p = plate ? plate : "";
    if (name_blocked(p)) return 1;
    int len = (int)strlen(p);
    if (len > 8) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) if (!((p[i] >= 'A' && p[i] <= 'Z') || (p[i] >= '0' && p[i] <= '9'))) return 0;
    /* the parts: letters or digits in a row */
    int pa[8], pl[8], np = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; ){
        int d = p[i] <= '9', j = i;
        while (j < len && (p[j] <= '9') == d) j++;
        pa[np] = i; pl[np++] = j - i; i = j;
    }
    for (int k = 0; k < np; k++){
        if (name_part_is(p + pa[k], pl[k], plate_alone)) return 1;
        if (name_part_is(p + pa[k], pl[k], plate_numbers)
            && ((k > 0 && name_part_is(p + pa[k - 1], pl[k - 1], plate_marks))
                || (k + 1 < np && name_part_is(p + pa[k + 1], pl[k + 1], plate_marks)))) return 1;
    }
    /* its letters as a name's, a lone digit at its end left out */
    char q[9], s[9], w[64], x[64];
    memcpy(q, p, (size_t)len + 1);
    if (len >= 2 && q[len - 1] <= '9' && q[len - 2] >= 'A') q[len - 1] = 0;
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; q[i]; i++){
        int r = 0;
        while (q[i + r] >= '0' && q[i + r] <= '9') r++;
        if (r && name_number(q + i, r, i ? q[i - 1] : 0)){ i += r - 1; continue; }
        if (name_letter(q[i])) s[n++] = name_letter(q[i]);
    }
    s[n] = 0;
    for (int j = 0; plate_edge[j]; j++){
        name_word(plate_edge[j], w);
        int end = name_ends(s, w);
        for (int k = 0; end && plate_end_ok[k]; k++){ name_word(plate_end_ok[k], x); if (name_ends(s, x)) end = 0; }
        if (end) return 1;
        int e = name_at(s, 0, w);
        if (e < 0) continue;
        const char *rest = s + e, *bare = rest;
        while (*bare == 's') bare++;
        for (int k = 0; plate_rests[k]; k++){
            const char *const one[] = { plate_rests[k], 0 };
            if (name_whole(rest, one) || name_whole(bare, one)) return 1;
        }
    }
    for (int j = 0; plate_anywhere[j]; j++){
        name_word(plate_anywhere[j], w);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++){
            int e = name_at(s, i, w), ok = 0;
            if (e < 0) continue;
            /* a word of plate_anywhere_ok there from s[a], a <= i, to e or past it */
            for (int k = 0; !ok && plate_anywhere_ok[k]; k++){
                name_word(plate_anywhere_ok[k], x);
                int m = (int)strlen(x);
                for (int a = i > m ? i - m : 0; a <= i && !ok; a++) ok = name_at(s, a, x) >= e;
            }
            if (!ok) return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* net_vlan.c -- the "vlan" network backend: a client of tools/vlanhub.py.
 *
 * The hub emulates one IPv4 /24 broadcast domain (10.77.0.0/24 by default)
 * for several game instances on one Mac.  Nothing here touches an AF_INET
 * socket: every virtual socket is a real AF_UNIX fd, so poll/select, EOF,
 * back-pressure and non-blocking behaviour stay kernel-real, and the Winsock
 * front end (winsock.c) treats it like any other fd.
 *
 *   control   one AF_UNIX stream to the hub: framed requests and replies
 *             (HELLO, OPEN, BIND, CONNECT, LISTEN, CLOSE, STATUS, NOTE), the
 *             hub's end of a new socket travels with the request (SCM_RIGHTS)
 *   UDP/ICMP  an AF_UNIX datagram pair per socket; each datagram carries an
 *             8-byte header {ip[4] (network order), port (LE), flags (LE)}:
 *             the destination on the way out, the source on the way in
 *   TCP       an AF_UNIX stream pair per connection; the hub relays the bytes
 *             to the peer's stream (so it can delay them and write a pcap).
 *             A listener gets an AF_UNIX datagram channel on which the hub
 *             delivers each accepted connection's fd with its addresses.
 * All integers in the control protocol are little endian; addresses are the
 * 4 bytes in network order.  The protocol is documented in tools/vlanhub.py.
 *
 * Requests are made with the guest lock held (they take well under a
 * millisecond); a hub that does not answer within 5 s is declared dead and
 * every later call fails with WSAENETDOWN. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "winsock.h"
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/uio.h>
#include <sys/un.h>
#include <unistd.h>

enum { M_HELLO = 1, M_OPEN, M_BIND, M_CONNECT, M_LISTEN, M_CLOSE, M_STATUS, M_NOTE };
static int g_ctl = -1, g_dead;
static uint16_t g_seq;
static uint32_t g_next_sid = 1;
static pthread_mutex_t g_mx = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

static int vdbg(void){ static int v = -1; if (v < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_VLAN_DEBUG"); v = e && *e && *e != '0'; } return v; }
static void put32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v){ p[0] = (uint8_t)v; p[1] = (uint8_t)(v >> 8); p[2] = (uint8_t)(v >> 16); p[3] = (uint8_t)(v >> 24); }
static void put16(uint8_t *p, uint16_t v){ p[0] = (uint8_t)v; p[1] = (uint8_t)(v >> 8); }
static uint32_t get32(const uint8_t *p){ return (uint32_t)p[0] | (uint32_t)p[1] << 8 | (uint32_t)p[2] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[3] << 24; }
static uint16_t get16(const uint8_t *p){ return (uint16_t)(p[0] | p[1] << 8); }

/* send a whole buffer (with an fd on the first piece) before the deadline */
static int xsend(int fd, const uint8_t *b, size_t n, int pass_fd, uint64_t dl){
    size_t off = 0; int first = 1;
    while (off < n){
        struct iovec io = { (void *)(b + off), n - off };
        struct msghdr m; memset(&m, 0, sizeof m); m.msg_iov = &io; m.msg_iovlen = 1;
        char cb[CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(int))];
        if (first && pass_fd >= 0){
            memset(cb, 0, sizeof cb);
            m.msg_control = cb; m.msg_controllen = sizeof cb;
            struct cmsghdr *cm = CMSG_FIRSTHDR(&m);
            cm->cmsg_level = SOL_SOCKET; cm->cmsg_type = SCM_RIGHTS; cm->cmsg_len = CMSG_LEN(sizeof(int));
            memcpy(CMSG_DATA(cm), &pass_fd, sizeof(int));
        }
        ssize_t k = sendmsg(fd, &m, MSG_NOSIGNAL);
        if (k > 0){ off += (size_t)k; first = 0; continue; }
        if (k < 0 && errno != EAGAIN && errno != EINTR) return -1;
        uint64_t now = ws_now_us(); if (now >= dl) return -1;
        struct pollfd p = { fd, POLLOUT, 0 }; poll(&p, 1, (int)((dl - now) / 1000 + 1));
    }
    return 0;
}
static int xrecv(int fd, uint8_t *b, size_t n, uint64_t dl){
    size_t off = 0;
    while (off < n){
        ssize_t k = recv(fd, b + off, n - off, 0);
        if (k > 0){ off += (size_t)k; continue; }
        if (k == 0) return -1;
        if (errno != EAGAIN && errno != EINTR) return -1;
        uint64_t now = ws_now_us(); if (now >= dl) return -1;
        struct pollfd p = { fd, POLLIN, 0 }; poll(&p, 1, (int)((dl - now) / 1000 + 1));
    }
    return 0;
}
/* One request/reply.  Returns the reply's WSA error (0 = success) and the
 * reply payload after the error field in rep (rcap bytes at most). */
static int ctl_call(uint16_t type, const uint8_t *pl, uint32_t n, int pass_fd, uint8_t *rep, uint32_t rcap, uint32_t *rlen){
    if (g_ctl < 0 || g_dead) return WSAENETDOWN;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mx);
    uint8_t hdr[8 + 256]; uint16_t seq = ++g_seq;
    if (n > 256){ pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mx); return WSAEINVAL; }
    put32(hdr, 4 + n); put16(hdr + 4, type); put16(hdr + 6, seq); memcpy(hdr + 8, pl, n);
    uint64_t dl = ws_now_us() + 5000000ull;
    int err = WSAENETDOWN;
    if (xsend(g_ctl, hdr, 8 + n, pass_fd, dl) == 0){
        uint8_t rh[8];
        for (;;){
            if (xrecv(g_ctl, rh, 8, dl) != 0) break;
            uint32_t len = get32(rh); uint16_t rt = get16(rh + 4), rs = get16(rh + 6);
            if (len < 8 || len > 4096) break;
            uint8_t body[4096];
            if (xrecv(g_ctl, body, len - 4, dl) != 0) break;
            if (rt != (type | 0x8000) || rs != seq) continue;          /* stale reply */
            err = (int)get32(body);
            uint32_t pn = len - 8; if (pn > rcap) pn = rcap;
            if (rep && pn) memcpy(rep, body + 4, pn);
            if (rlen) *rlen = pn;
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mx);
            return err;
        }
    }
    g_dead = 1;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mx);
    ws_log("vlan: lost the hub (request %u): every socket call now fails with WSAENETDOWN", type);
    return WSAENETDOWN;
}

int vlan_alive(void){ return g_ctl >= 0 && !g_dead; }
void vlan_session_end(void){}                           /* the hub link stays: it holds no server's place */

int vlan_hello(const char *path, NetIdent *id){
    if (g_ctl >= 0 && !g_dead) return 0;
    int fd = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
    if (fd < 0) return WSAENETDOWN;
    struct sockaddr_un a; memset(&a, 0, sizeof a); a.sun_family = AF_UNIX;
    if (strlen(path) >= sizeof a.sun_path){ close(fd); ws_log("vlan: hub path too long: %s", path); return WSAENETDOWN; }
    strcpy(a.sun_path, path);
    if (connect(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&a, sizeof a) != 0){ close(fd); return WSAENETDOWN; }
    ws_fd_setup(fd);
    g_ctl = fd; g_dead = 0;
    uint8_t pl[40]; memset(pl, 0, sizeof pl);
    const char *wa = getenv("NFSU2_NET_ADDR"), *wn = getenv("NFSU2_NET_NAME");
    if (wa && *wa){ unsigned b[4]; if (sscanf(wa, "%u.%u.%u.%u", &b[0], &b[1], &b[2], &b[3]) == 4)
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) pl[i] = (uint8_t)b[i]; }
    if (wn && *wn) snprintf((char *)pl + 4, 32, "%s", wn);
    put32(pl + 36, (uint32_t)getpid());
    uint8_t r[48]; uint32_t rl = 0;
    int e = ctl_call(M_HELLO, pl, 40, -1, r, sizeof r, &rl);
    if (e || rl < 48){ close(fd); g_ctl = -1; return e ? e : WSAENETDOWN; }
    memcpy(&id->ip, r, 4); memcpy(&id->mask, r + 4, 4); memcpy(id->mac, r + 8, 6);
    memcpy(id->name, r + 16, 32); id->name[31] = 0;
    snprintf(id->ifname, sizeof id->ifname, "vlan0");
    { const char *em = getenv("NFSU2_NET_MAC"); unsigned v[6];
      if (em && sscanf(em, "%x:%x:%x:%x:%x:%x", &v[0], &v[1], &v[2], &v[3], &v[4], &v[5]) == 6)
          for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) id->mac[i] = (uint8_t)v[i]; }
    return 0;
}

static void bufsizes(int fd){
    int sz = 262144;
    if (setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, &sz, sizeof sz) != 0){ sz = 131072; setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, &sz, sizeof sz); }
    sz = 262144;
    if (setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVBUF, &sz, sizeof sz) != 0){ sz = 131072; setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVBUF, &sz, sizeof sz); }
}

int vlan_open(WsSock *s){
    s->vid = g_next_sid++;
    uint8_t pl[8]; put32(pl, s->vid); put16(pl + 4, (uint16_t)s->type); put16(pl + 6, 0);
    if (s->type == 1){
        int e = ctl_call(M_OPEN, pl, 8, -1, 0, 0, 0);
        s->fd = -1;
        return e;
    }
    int sv[2];
    if (socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_DGRAM, 0, sv) != 0) return ws_errno_to_wsa(errno);
    bufsizes(sv[0]); bufsizes(sv[1]);
    ws_fd_setup(sv[0]); ws_fd_setup(sv[1]);
    int e = ctl_call(M_OPEN, pl, 8, sv[1], 0, 0, 0);
    close(sv[1]);
    if (e){ close(sv[0]); return e; }
    s->fd = sv[0];
    return 0;
}

int vlan_bind(WsSock *s, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port){
    uint8_t pl[12]; put32(pl, s->vid); memcpy(pl + 4, &ip, 4); put16(pl + 8, port); put16(pl + 10, (uint16_t)(s->so_reuse ? 1 : 0));
    uint8_t r[8]; uint32_t rl = 0;
    int e = ctl_call(M_BIND, pl, 12, -1, r, sizeof r, &rl);
    if (e) return e;
    if (rl >= 6){ memcpy(&s->laddr, r, 4); s->lport = get16(r + 4); }
    return 0;
}

int vlan_connect(WsSock *s, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port){
    int sv[2];
    if (socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0, sv) != 0) return ws_errno_to_wsa(errno);
    ws_fd_setup(sv[0]); ws_fd_setup(sv[1]);
    uint8_t pl[12]; put32(pl, s->vid); memcpy(pl + 4, &ip, 4); put16(pl + 8, port); put16(pl + 10, 0);
    uint8_t r[16]; uint32_t rl = 0;
    int e = ctl_call(M_CONNECT, pl, 12, sv[1], r, sizeof r, &rl);
    close(sv[1]);
    uint32_t delay = rl >= 16 ? get32(r + 12) : 0;
    s->conn_ready_us = ws_now_us() + delay;
    if (rl >= 6){ memcpy(&s->laddr, r, 4); s->lport = get16(r + 4); }
    if (e){ close(sv[0]); if (s->fd >= 0 && s->fd != sv[0]) {} return e; }
    s->conn_id = rl >= 12 ? get32(r + 8) : 0;
    if (s->fd >= 0) close(s->fd);
    s->fd = sv[0];
    if (vdbg()) ws_log("vlan: connect -> fd %d, conn #%u", s->fd, s->conn_id);
    return 0;
}

int vlan_listen(WsSock *s, int backlog){
    int sv[2];
    if (socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_DGRAM, 0, sv) != 0) return ws_errno_to_wsa(errno);
    ws_fd_setup(sv[0]); ws_fd_setup(sv[1]);
    uint8_t pl[8]; put32(pl, s->vid); put32(pl + 4, (uint32_t)backlog);
    int e = ctl_call(M_LISTEN, pl, 8, sv[1], 0, 0, 0);
    close(sv[1]);
    if (e){ close(sv[0]); return e; }
    if (s->fd >= 0) close(s->fd);
    s->fd = sv[0];
    return 0;
}

int vlan_accept(WsSock *ls, WsSock *ns){
    uint8_t h[20];
    struct iovec io = { h, sizeof h };
    char cb[CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(int))];
    struct msghdr m; memset(&m, 0, sizeof m);
    m.msg_iov = &io; m.msg_iovlen = 1; m.msg_control = cb; m.msg_controllen = sizeof cb;
    ssize_t k = recvmsg(ls->fd, &m, 0);
    if (k < 0) return ws_errno_to_wsa(errno);
    int nfd = -1;
    for (struct cmsghdr *cm = CMSG_FIRSTHDR(&m); cm; cm = CMSG_NXTHDR(&m, cm))
        if (cm->cmsg_level == SOL_SOCKET && cm->cmsg_type == SCM_RIGHTS) memcpy(&nfd, CMSG_DATA(cm), sizeof(int));
    if (k < 20 || nfd < 0){ if (nfd >= 0) close(nfd); return WSAEWOULDBLOCK; }
    ws_fd_setup(nfd);
    ns->fd = nfd;
    memcpy(&ns->raddr, h, 4); ns->rport = get16(h + 4);
    memcpy(&ns->laddr, h + 8, 4); ns->lport = get16(h + 12);
    ns->conn_id = get32(h + 16);
    ns->vid = g_next_sid++;
    if (vdbg()){ int av = -1; ioctl(nfd, FIONREAD, &av);
                 struct pollfd q = { nfd, POLLIN, 0 }; poll(&q, 1, 0);
                 ws_log("vlan: accept on listener fd %d -> fd %d, conn #%u, %d bytes pending, revents 0x%x", ls->fd, nfd, ns->conn_id, av, q.revents); }
    return 0;
}

int vlan_sendto(WsSock *s, const uint8_t *buf, int len, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, int *sent){
    uint8_t h[8]; memcpy(h, &ip, 4); put16(h + 4, port); put16(h + 6, 0);
    struct iovec io[2] = { { h, 8 }, { (void *)buf, (size_t)len } };
    struct msghdr m; memset(&m, 0, sizeof m); m.msg_iov = io; m.msg_iovlen = 2;
    ssize_t k = sendmsg(s->fd, &m, MSG_NOSIGNAL);
    if (k < 0){
        int e = errno;
        if (e == ENOBUFS){ *sent = len; return 0; }      /* the hub is behind: dropped, as UDP may be */
        return ws_errno_to_wsa(e);
    }
    *sent = len;
    return 0;
}

int vlan_recvfrom(WsSock *s, uint8_t *buf, int len, int peek, uint32_t *ip, uint16_t *port, int *got){
    for (;;){
        uint8_t h[8];
        uint8_t tmp[65536 + 64];
        int icmp = s->type == 3;
        struct iovec io[2] = { { h, 8 }, { icmp ? tmp : buf, icmp ? sizeof tmp : (size_t)len } };
        struct msghdr m; memset(&m, 0, sizeof m); m.msg_iov = io; m.msg_iovlen = 2;
        ssize_t k = recvmsg(s->fd, &m, peek ? MSG_PEEK : 0);
        if (k < 0) return ws_errno_to_wsa(errno);
        if (k < 8){ if (peek) recv(s->fd, h, 1, 0); continue; }   /* malformed: drop */
        uint16_t fl = get16(h + 6);
        if (fl & 1){                                      /* ICMP port unreachable for this socket */
            if (peek) recv(s->fd, h, 8, 0);
            if (s->has_peer) return WSAECONNRESET;
            continue;
        }
        memcpy(ip, h, 4); *port = get16(h + 4);
        int n = (int)k - 8;
        if (icmp){
            /* Windows raw sockets deliver the IPv4 header in front of the ICMP message */
            uint8_t ih[20]; memset(ih, 0, sizeof ih);
            int tot = n + 20;
            ih[0] = 0x45; ih[2] = (uint8_t)(tot >> 8); ih[3] = (uint8_t)tot; ih[8] = 64; ih[9] = 1;
            memcpy(ih + 12, ip, 4); memcpy(ih + 16, &g_ws_id.ip, 4);
            uint32_t sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 20; i += 2) sum += (uint32_t)(ih[i] << 8 | ih[i + 1]);
            while (sum >> 16) sum = (sum & 0xFFFF) + (sum >> 16);
            sum = ~sum & 0xFFFF; ih[10] = (uint8_t)(sum >> 8); ih[11] = (uint8_t)sum;
            int c1 = len < 20 ? len : 20; memcpy(buf, ih, (size_t)c1);
            int c2 = len - c1 < n ? len - c1 : n; if (c2 > 0) memcpy(buf + c1, tmp, (size_t)c2);
            if (tot > len){ *got = len; return WSAEMSGSIZE; }
            *got = tot; return 0;
        }
        if (m.msg_flags & MSG_TRUNC){ *got = len; return WSAEMSGSIZE; }
        *got = n;
        return 0;
    }
}

void vlan_close(WsSock *s, int abortive){
    if (vdbg()) ws_log("vlan: close fd %d conn #%u%s", s->fd, s->conn_id, abortive ? " (abortive)" : "");
    if (g_ctl < 0 || g_dead) return;
    uint8_t pl[12]; put32(pl, s->vid); put32(pl + 4, abortive ? 1u : 0u); put32(pl + 8, s->conn_id);
    ctl_call(M_CLOSE, pl, 12, -1, 0, 0, 0);
}

/* After EOF on a stream: did the peer reset the connection (linger 0) or
 * close it normally?  Asked only when the fd reports a hang-up. */
int vlan_conn_was_reset(WsSock *s){
    if (!s->conn_id || s->fd < 0) return 0;
    struct pollfd p = { s->fd, POLLIN, 0 };
    poll(&p, 1, 0);
    if (!(p.revents & (POLLHUP | POLLIN))) return 0;
    if ((p.revents & POLLIN) && !(p.revents & POLLHUP)){
        char ch; ssize_t k = recv(s->fd, &ch, 1, MSG_PEEK);
        if (k != 0) return 0;                            /* data pending, not EOF */
    }
    uint8_t pl[4]; put32(pl, s->conn_id);
    uint8_t r[4]; uint32_t rl = 0;
    if (ctl_call(M_STATUS, pl, 4, -1, r, sizeof r, &rl) || rl < 4) return 0;
    return get32(r) == 2;
}

void vlan_note(const char *text){
    uint8_t pl[200]; size_t n = strlen(text); if (n > 199) n = 199;
    memcpy(pl, text, n);
    ctl_call(M_NOTE, pl, (uint32_t)n, -1, 0, 0, 0);
}

/* netrace.c -- network races (Online and LAN): every track open, 2 laps, 6
 * players, drift from 2 laps.
 *
 * In a race between players the career's unlocks only get in the way, so a
 * network game can be created on any track, either direction, whatever the
 * profile has unlocked; and a new game starts at 2 laps instead of 3.  Career,
 * Quick Race, cars and parts keep the game's own unlocks.  A game takes up to
 * 6 players in every mode but drag, as the game's own URL races do; drag
 * keeps one car per lane.  A drift game takes 2 laps or more, as a circuit,
 * ranked or not (the game's least was 4, longer than any of the career's
 * stadium and parkade drifts: 2 or 3 laps).
 *
 * The game (SPEED2.EXE v1.2 NA, static reading):
 *  - The track lock is 0x5156f0, cdecl (mask, track, reverse, 0) -> al: 1
 *    with the "unlock all things" debug byte [0x838464], else the career's
 *    unlock table (0x5143c0 on 0x85ad40, its only caller) for the mask bits
 *    1 and 0x1f8; bits 6 are always open.  Mask 0x1f8 is the network race's
 *    (online [0x850078] = 8, LAN 0x200): the track list of Create Game
 *    (0x4cded0 -> 0x4b4c10, the item's lock +8) and the options' Direction
 *    Reverse (0x4b41c0).  Quick Race passes 1.
 *  - The network race's laps are the word [0x8500ba] (NUMLAPS, the gcre
 *    PARAMS LAPS, 0x584860), in the online/LAN object 0x850080 (+0x3a).  Only
 *    the game state's constructor 0x53ed20 (static init, 0x77d390) gives it a
 *    default, 3 (0x53ed6b); the save keeps none of it but the login (0x515bf0).
 *    The options' Laps (0x4b3e40, the arrows 0x4b3f10) keep it between the
 *    mode's least (the option's word +0x54: 2 for circuit (0) and URL (4), 4
 *    for drift (3), Street X (0xA) and mode 5, else 1) and 10, the arrows
 *    wrapping round; a joiner takes the host's (0x601d20).  The constructor
 *    sets the least and raises the laps to it; in a ranked online game
 *    ([0x850098]) the options screen (0x4ef620) raises them again on its
 *    updates, with the least's getter 0x498400 (the same table).  Quick
 *    Race's Laps (0x4b3d60) is 1 to 10 in every mode.  The race's setup takes
 *    the laps as they are (drift 0x53f830), 1 on a point-to-point track (its
 *    info +0x80 = 1: downhill drift; +0x85, 0x53fdea).
 *  - Max Players is the byte [0x850080] (MAXPLYS, the gcre MAXSIZE), its
 *    least [0x850081] = 2, 3 for a ranked game ([0x850098]).  The option's
 *    constructor 0x4b3110 sets it to the mode's most: 6 for URL (mode
 *    [0x850088] = 4; Street X is 0xA), 3 for drag (2) on track 4402, which
 *    has three lanes, else 4.  Its arrows 0x4b3190 step it between the two, wrapping round,
 *    and its vtable +0xc (0x4b3220) shows it.  The race coordinator
 *    ([0x890118]) has 6 racer entries, and the start grid (0x5eb5d0) lines up
 *    any number of cars in two columns where a track has fewer start markers.
 */
#include "cpu.h"

#define G_NET_LAPS  0x008500bau    /* word: the network race's laps */
#define MASK_NET    0x1f8u         /* 0x5156f0's mask bits of a network race */
#define G_NET_MAX   0x00850080u    /* byte: Max Players */
#define G_NET_MIN   0x00850081u    /* byte: its least */
#define G_NET_MODE  0x00850088u    /* int: 0 circuit, 1 sprint, 2 drag, 3 drift, 4 URL, 0xA Street X */
#define MODE_DRAG   2u
#define MODE_DRIFT  3u
#define LAPS_LEAST  0x54u          /* word: the Laps option's least */
#define DRIFT_LEAST 2u             /* a circuit's */
#define NET_MOST    6u             /* the race coordinator's racer entries */

#define MSG_RIGHT   0xb5971bf1u
#define RET_ARROWS  0x004b3218u    /* the return address of the arrows' own call of +0xc */

/* the track lock: open for a network race, else the game's */

void sub_005156f0(CPU *c){
    if (!(MR32(c->esp + 4u) & MASK_NET)){ sub_005156f0_orig(c); return; }
    c->eax = (c->eax & 0xffffff00u) | 1u;
    POP32(c->eip);
}

/* the game state's constructor (thiscall, returns this): laps 2, not 3 */
void sub_0053ed20_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_0053ed20(CPU *c){
    sub_0053ed20_orig(c);
    MR16(G_NET_LAPS) = 2;
}

/* the Laps option's constructor (thiscall, 5 arguments, returns this): drift
 * from 2 laps, and the laps kept that its least of 4 raised */
void sub_004b3e40_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_004b3e40(CPU *c){
    uint32_t self = c->ecx, laps = MR16(G_NET_LAPS);
    sub_004b3e40_orig(c);
    if (MR32(G_NET_MODE) != MODE_DRIFT) return;
    MR16(self + LAPS_LEAST) = DRIFT_LEAST;
    MR16(G_NET_LAPS) = (uint16_t)(laps < DRIFT_LEAST ? DRIFT_LEAST : laps > 10u ? 10u : laps);
}

/* its least's getter (thiscall, -> ax, also into the option's +0x54), a
 * ranked game's: drift 2 */
void sub_00498400_orig(CPU *c);

/* Max Players' constructor (thiscall, 5 arguments, returns this): 6, drag as
 * the game has it */
void sub_004b3110_orig(CPU *c);

/* its arrows (thiscall (arg, msg), ret 8): up to 6, drag as the game has it */
void sub_004b3190_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_004b3190(CPU *c){

    if (msg == MSG_LEFT) n = n > lo ? n - 1u : NET_MOST;
    else if (msg == MSG_RIGHT) n = n < NET_MOST ? n + 1u : lo;
    sub_004b3190_orig(c);
    if (MR32(G_NET_MODE) == MODE_DRAG || MR8(G_NET_MAX) == n) return;

    c->ecx = self;
    PUSH32(RET_ARROWS);
    dispatch_indirect(c, MR32(MR32(self) + 0xcu));

}

/* nettest.h -- one rule for "a test or debug run, not someone playing", for

/* olfilter.c -- the Online lobby's Filter narrows its game list once the
 * player has set it.
 *
 * The online host lists every open game, those the Filter asks for first
 * (web/server-rs/crates/online lobby.rs game_search, since 0b92d3f): nobody
 * changed the game's default Filter, so a game of other settings was seen by
 * no one.  A player who did set it saw the other games all the same ("the
 * filters don't work either", a player's report, 2026-10-23).
 *
 * The game keeps the Filter in the network race's settings (0x850080: race
 * type [0x850088], car restrictions [0x85008c], ranked [0x850098], Race
 * Breaker [0x850099], Collision Detection [0x85009a]): the ones Create Game's
 * screens set, and a join copies those of the game it joined into them
 * (0x58b070).  The lobby's search (0x4bb0f0 -> 0x5904c0, gsea) sends them as
 * CUSTFLAGS and SYSFLAGS under their masks, so the host cannot tell a Filter
 * the player set from the settings of a game they made or joined.
 *
 * Here: leaving the Filter screen (UI_OLFilters.fng, handler 0x4a0c30, only
 * from its vtable 0x796200: Apply Filter 0xc407210 / 0x406415e3, or Back
 * 0x911ab364; both go back to the lobby with the settings as the screen left
 * them) notes those settings.  A gsea to the online host while the settings
 * are still those carries the code "filt" (the header's [4..7], 0 in the
 * game's own requests), and the host lists only the games such a search asks
 * for, unless it asks for the Filter's defaults (Circuit, no restriction,
 * both options on, unranked).  A game made or joined since changes the
 * settings: the list is the whole one again until the next visit to the
 * Filter screen.  Original: EA's server took every search as a Filter. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#define FN_FILTER_MSG   0x004a0c30u   /* thiscall (msg, obj, a3, a4), ret 0x10 */
#define MSG_APPLY       0x0c407210u
#define MSG_ACCEPT      0x406415e3u
#define MSG_BACK        0x911ab364u
#define G_MODE          0x00850088u   /* dword: the race type */
#define G_RESTRICT      0x0085008cu   /* byte: car restrictions (1: none) */
#define G_OPTIONS       0x00850098u   /* bytes: ranked, Race Breaker, Collision Detection */

void sub_004a0c30(CPU *c);
void dispatch_patch(uint32_t a, void (*f)(CPU *));

static int g_set;                     /* the player left the Filter screen with these settings */
static uint8_t g_filter[8];

static void settings(uint8_t s[8]){
    uint32_t m = MR32(G_MODE);
    memcpy(s, &m, 4);
    s[4] = MR8(G_RESTRICT); s[5] = MR8(G_OPTIONS); s[6] = MR8(G_OPTIONS + 1u); s[7] = MR8(G_OPTIONS + 2u);
}
static int filter_on(void){
    uint8_t s[8];
    settings(s);
    return g_set && !memcmp(s, g_filter, sizeof s);
}

static void filter_msg(CPU *c){
    uint32_t m = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
    sub_004a0c30(c);
    if (m != MSG_APPLY && m != MSG_ACCEPT && m != MSG_BACK) return;
    settings(g_filter); g_set = 1;
    fprintf(stderr, "[online] the Filter: race type %u, restrictions %u, ranked %u, Race Breaker %u, collisions %u\n",
            MR32(G_MODE), g_filter[4], g_filter[5], g_filter[6], g_filter[7]);
}

void olfilter_install(void){ dispatch_patch(FN_FILTER_MSG, filter_msg); }

/* The bytes the game sends the online host's lobby (winsock.c), a message
 * after another: [0..3] kind, [4..7] code, [8..11] big-endian length with
 * these 12.  olfilter_lobby_mark() puts a code in the message's header
 * within the bytes about to go (the game's own buffer), olfilter_lobby_sent()
 * moves on by the bytes that went: a send cut short marks the rest when it
 * goes.  The codes: "filt" in a gsea (above), and in a rank (the race's
 * report) "ed" and our car's type when its game data is edited, else "j",
 * a racer's NAMEn and how far its car jumped at once (mprace_rank_code: the
 * host's [cheat] lines; the racer found among the message's own fields). */
typedef struct { uint32_t link, at, len; uint8_t hdr[12]; int mark; char code[4]; } Stream;
static Stream g_out;

int mprace_rank_code(char code[4], const uint8_t *body, int n);   /* mprace.c */
/* (body: the message's fields after its header, as far as these bytes have them) */
static int code_for(Stream *st, const uint8_t *body, int n){
    if (!memcmp(st->hdr, "gsea", 4) && filter_on()){ memcpy(st->code, "filt", 4); return 1; }
    return !memcmp(st->hdr, "rank", 4) && mprace_rank_code(st->code, body, n);
}

static void walk(Stream *st, uint8_t *p, int n, int patch){
    for (int i = 0; i < n;){
        if (st->at < 12u){
            if (st->at == 4u) st->mark = patch && code_for(st, p + i + 8, n - i - 8);
            if (st->at >= 4u && st->at < 8u && st->mark && !p[i]) p[i] = (uint8_t)st->code[st->at - 4u];
            st->hdr[st->at++] = p[i++];
            if (st->at == 12u){
                st->len = (uint32_t)st->hdr[8] << 24 | (uint32_t)st->hdr[9] << 16 | (uint32_t)st->hdr[10] << 8 | st->hdr[11];
                if (st->len <= 12u) st->at = 0;
            }
            continue;
        }
        uint32_t k = st->len - st->at;
        if (k > (uint32_t)(n - i)) k = (uint32_t)(n - i);
        i += (int)k; st->at += k;
        if (st->at >= st->len) st->at = 0;
    }
}
void olfilter_lobby_mark(uint32_t link, uint8_t *p, int n){
    if (link != g_out.link){ memset(&g_out, 0, sizeof g_out); g_out.link = link; }
    Stream st = g_out;
    walk(&st, p, n, 1);
}
void olfilter_lobby_sent(uint32_t link, uint8_t *p, int n){
    if (link != g_out.link){ memset(&g_out, 0, sizeof g_out); g_out.link = link; }
    walk(&g_out, p, n, 0);
}

/* online.c -- the game's Online menu logs in under the player's name.
 *
 * The browser's server is its own stand-in for EA's servers (web/server-rs/crates/online,
 * runtime/winsock.c): any name logs in, there are no accounts.  So the EA Login
 * screens (Create New / Use Existing EA Account, the account name and password,
 * "save the login in a profile?", Select An Online Persona) ask for nothing the
 * server needs.  With online on, main menu -> Online goes straight to the
 * Online Main Menu as the player's name: roam_name (NFSU2_ROAM_NAME, the name
 * friends see in free roam), else the career profile's name.  That screen logs
 * in by itself, as it does for LAN play.  Without a usable name, or with online
 * off (and always on the Mac), the game's own screens come as before.
 *
 * The front end (SPEED2.EXE v1.2 NA, static reading):
 *  - The main menu's Online (0x4f98b0, message 0xd05fc3a3) sets the online mode
 *    [0x850078] = 8 and calls 0x4effd0(fe), which builds the login screens'
 *    flow ([0x836370], 0x4e3960: UI_OLISPConnect -> UI_OLEALogin ->
 *    UI_OLCreateUser | UI_OLUseExisting -> UI_OLSelectPersona -> UI_OLMAIN)
 *    and shows its first screen.
 *  - The login itself is a stage machine on the profile object 0x850080:
 *    stage +0x50, the stage before +0x54, an error flag +0x4c; 0x5031b0(n)
 *    sets the stage and clears the flag.  0x4cfee0(target): 2/3 -> 4, 4
 *    connect (LobbyConnect) -> 5 -> 6, auth (account +0x58, password +0x80,
 *    16 bytes each in online mode) -> 7 -> 8, pers (persona +0x6c) -> 9 -> 10,
 *    EA Messenger -> 11 -> 12, the race report -> 13/14.
 *  - UI_OLISPConnect (0x49df20) starts NetConn (0x585640) at stage 0 and sets
 *    stage 2; UI_OLEALogin's constructor (0x4d0738) closes a session left
 *    over (stage > 2) and sets stage 3.  The other screens fill the three
 *    fields and run the stages to 6, 8 and 12.
 *  - UI_OLMAIN (constructor 0x4e5f80, handler 0x4f19a0) runs the stages to 14
 *    with its own "connecting" dialog: the LAN path goes there straight from
 *    its name screen (0x4a2e20: account = persona = password = the name).
 * The override below does what UI_OLISPConnect and UI_OLEALogin's constructor
 * do, fills the fields as the LAN name screen does, and shows UI_OLMAIN; the
 * flow is never built ([0x836370] stays as it was, 0 after any earlier visit:
 * leaving online, 0x4a0140, clears it, as reaching UI_OLMAIN does).  Logoff
 * and Back on the Online Main Menu are the game's own (0x4a0140: stage 0, the
 * main menu).
 * A login that fails on the way shows the game's own dialog on the Online Main
 * Menu (the callbacks 0x4b9090 connect, 0x4b9110 auth, 0x4b9220 pers; a name
 * the server refuses gets "There was a problem selecting this persona.  You
 * will be returned to the EA Login screen.").  UI_OLMAIN has no answer to
 * their OK (it expects a login the screens before it made), so the second
 * override below gives the one the screens would: the name refused (auth or
 * pers: the stage is back at 6 or 8) -> leave online and the EA Login screens,
 * where another name can be typed (UI_OLEALogin also offers "Use <name>": the
 * game's own saved login, from the account field); no connection (stage 4) ->
 * leave online to the main menu, as UI_OLEALogin's Cancel does.
 * A name another player holds the server gives with four digits instead (it
 * refuses a persona only when it finds no free digits for it, or the persona
 * is not the account's): online_lobby_read() below
 * puts that name in the game's own fields as the server's answer arrives.
 */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "game.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

int winsock_online(void);                    /* winsock.c: online on (browser, NFSU2_ONLINE) */
unsigned roam_plat_name(char out[33]);       /* web/roam_web.c: the name picked on the page while the game runs */

#define G_PROFILE          0x00850080u  /* the online/LAN profile object */
#define G_STAGE            0x008500d0u  /* +0x50: the login stage */
#define G_ACCOUNT          0x008500d8u  /* +0x58: online account name, 16 bytes */
#define G_PERSONA          0x008500ecu  /* +0x6c: online persona, 16 bytes */
#define G_PASSWORD         0x00850100u  /* +0x80: online password, 16 bytes */
#define G_LOGIN_FLOW       0x00836370u  /* the login screens' flow object */
#define G_NETGAME          0x0089cf48u
#define FN_NETCONN_STARTUP 0x00585640u  /* cdecl () */
#define FN_SET_STAGE       0x005031b0u  /* thiscall profile, (stage) */
#define FN_LOBBY_DROP      0x0058fd50u  /* cdecl (0) */
#define FN_NETGAME_END     0x005fe2b0u  /* thiscall 0x89cf48, (0) */
#define FN_FE_SWITCH       0x00537980u  /* cdecl (fe, package name, 0) */
#define FN_LEAVE_ONLINE    0x004a0140u  /* cdecl (fe or 0): Logoff, then UI_Main unless 0 */
#define S_OLMAIN           0x0078f240u  /* "UI_OLMAIN.fng" */
#define RET_IN_FLOW        0x004f001fu  /* a return address inside 0x4effd0 */
/* the OK of a login error dialog (the callbacks above): pers, a known auth
 * code, and the connection's Cancel (or an unknown auth code) */
#define MSG_PERS_OK        0xaa54bf29u
#define MSG_AUTH_OK        0x904aca43u
#define MSG_CANCEL         0x2c0e485au

static int g_auto;                  /* the Online Main Menu was shown by this file */
static char g_name[16];

/* 3 to 15 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -, as the server takes a name (nfsu2-online valid_name):
 * any other run of characters becomes one '_' (none at either end), then cut
 * to 15; one or two characters are padded with '_'.  0 if nothing is left. */
static int clean(char out[16], const char *src){
    int n = 0, gap = 0;
    for (; *src && n < 15; src++){
        char ch = *src;
        int ok = (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') || ch == '_' || ch == '-';
        if (!ok){ gap = 1; continue; }
        if (gap && n && n < 14) out[n++] = '_';
        gap = 0;
        out[n++] = ch;
    }
    if (!n){ out[0] = 0; return 0; }
    while (n < 3) out[n++] = '_';
    out[n] = 0;
    return 1;
}

/* the player's name: the one it picked on the page while the game runs (the
 * operator took the old one away: roam_plat_name), else roam_name without a
 * comment after it (roam_game.c's opt(): a ';' or '#' at the start or after a
 * blank), else the profile's */
static int player_name(char out[16], const char **from){
    char picked[33];
    if (roam_plat_name(picked) && clean(out, picked)){ *from = "the name picked on the page"; return 1; }
    const char *v = getenv("NFSU2_ROAM_NAME");
    char buf[64]; int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; v && v[i] && n < (int)sizeof buf - 1; i++){
        if ((v[i] == ';' || v[i] == '#') && (i == 0 || v[i - 1] == ' ' || v[i - 1] == '\t')) break;
        buf[n++] = v[i];
    }
    buf[n] = 0;
    *from = "roam_name";
    if (clean(out, buf)) return 1;
    if (n) fprintf(stderr, "[online] roam_name \"%s\" has no letters, digits, - or _ for an online name\n", buf);
    if (!mem_is_committed(G_PROFILE_NAME) || !mem_is_committed(G_PROFILE_NAME + 15u)) return 0;
    char pn[17];
    for (n = 0; n < 16 && MR8(G_PROFILE_NAME + (uint32_t)n); n++) pn[n] = (char)MR8(G_PROFILE_NAME + (uint32_t)n);
    pn[n] = 0;
    *from = "the profile's name";
    int language_no_profile(const char *name);           /* runtime/language.c: in the game's language */
    return !language_no_profile(pn) && clean(out, pn);
}

/* a guest call with every register restored afterwards (any convention):
 * by address, or (direct) a lifted function this file overrides */
static void call_to(CPU *c, uint32_t fn, void (*direct)(CPU *), uint32_t ecx, int n, const uint32_t *arg){
    CPU save = *c;
    c->esp = (c->esp - 256u) & ~15u;
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) PUSH32(arg[i]);
    c->ecx = ecx;
    PUSH32(RET_IN_FLOW);
    if (direct) direct(c); else dispatch_indirect(c, fn);
    *c = save;
}
static void call(CPU *c, uint32_t fn, uint32_t ecx, int n, const uint32_t *arg){ call_to(c, fn, 0, ecx, n, arg); }

static void field(uint32_t at, const char *s){
    memset(g_mem + at, 0, 16);
    memcpy(g_mem + at, s, strlen(s));
}

/* 0x4effd0(fe), cdecl, from the main menu's Online (above) */
void sub_004effd0_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_004effd0(CPU *c){
    char name[16]; const char *from = "";
    uint32_t fe = MR32(c->esp + 4u), stage = MR32(G_STAGE);
    g_auto = 0;
    if (!winsock_online() || MR32(G_GAMEMODE) != 8u || stage == 1u){ sub_004effd0_orig(c); return; }
    if (!player_name(name, &from)){
        fprintf(stderr, "[online] no name for the Online menu (set roam_name, or load a profile): the EA Login screens\n");
        sub_004effd0_orig(c); return;
    }
    uint32_t a[3];
    if (stage == 0u){                                      /* UI_OLISPConnect */
        call(c, FN_NETCONN_STARTUP, 0, 0, 0);
        a[0] = 2; call(c, FN_SET_STAGE, G_PROFILE, 1, a);
    } else if (stage > 2u){                                /* UI_OLEALogin's constructor */
        a[0] = 0; call(c, FN_LOBBY_DROP, 0, 1, a);
        a[0] = 0; call(c, FN_NETGAME_END, G_NETGAME, 1, a);
        a[0] = 3; call(c, FN_SET_STAGE, G_PROFILE, 1, a);
    }
    field(G_ACCOUNT, name); field(G_PERSONA, name); field(G_PASSWORD, name);
    fprintf(stderr, "[online] Online menu as %s (%s): no EA Login screens\n", name, from);
    memcpy(g_name, name, sizeof g_name); g_auto = 1;
    a[0] = fe; a[1] = S_OLMAIN; a[2] = 0; call(c, FN_FE_SWITCH, 0, 3, a);
    c->eax = MR32(G_LOGIN_FLOW);
    POP32(c->eip);
}

/* UI_OLMAIN's handler (0x4f19a0, thiscall (msg, 3 more), ret 0x10): its login
 * state is at +0x150 (+4: stopped after an error, 0x4e37d0), its package at +4 */
void sub_004f19a0_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_004f19a0(CPU *c){
    uint32_t self = c->ecx, msg = MR32(c->esp + 4u), stage = MR32(G_STAGE);
    int failed = g_auto && MR32(G_GAMEMODE) == 8u && stage < 12u && MR8(self + 0x154u) == 1u
                 && (msg == MSG_PERS_OK || msg == MSG_AUTH_OK || msg == MSG_CANCEL);
    sub_004f19a0_orig(c);
    if (!failed) return;
    g_auto = 0;
    uint32_t fe = MR32(self + 4u), a[1];
    if (stage < 6u){
        fprintf(stderr, "[online] the Online menu could not connect: back to the main menu\n");
        a[0] = fe; call(c, FN_LEAVE_ONLINE, 0, 1, a);
        return;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[online] the server did not take %s (no free digits for it?): the EA Login screens\n", g_name);
    a[0] = 0; call(c, FN_LEAVE_ONLINE, 0, 1, a);
    a[0] = fe; call_to(c, 0, sub_004effd0_orig, 0, 1, a);
}

/* The persona the server gave: its answer to pers (code 0) names it, the name
 * the game asked for or, when another player is online or racing under that,
 * the name with four digits in place of its end (nfsu2-online free_variant).  The game finds
 * itself among a race's players by its own persona and account fields, so they
 * take the server's name: a game that kept the name it asked for took the
 * other player's place for its own and sent its race traffic to itself.
 * winsock.c hands over the lobby link's bytes as the game reads them; a frame
 * is 12 bytes of header (kind, code, u32 big-endian length, the header
 * included) and TagField text (nfsu2-online aries.rs). */
static int name_char(int ch){ return (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') || ch == '_' || ch == '-'; }
static void persona_given(const char *body){
    const char *v = 0;
    for (const char *p = body; *p; p++)
        if ((p == body || (unsigned char)p[-1] <= 0x20) && !strncasecmp(p, "PERS=", 5)){ v = p + 5; break; }
    if (!v) return;
    if (*v == '"') v++;
    char given[16]; int n = 0;
    while (n < 15 && name_char((unsigned char)v[n])){ given[n] = v[n]; n++; }
    given[n] = 0;
    if (n < 3 || name_char((unsigned char)v[n])) return;
    char asked[17] = "", account[17] = "";
    memcpy(asked, g_mem + G_PERSONA, 16); memcpy(account, g_mem + G_ACCOUNT, 16);
    if (!strcmp(asked, given)) return;
    /* the account too when it is the persona (this file's login, and LAN's): the
     * next login (after a race) asks for the account's own persona */
    if (!strcmp(account, asked)) field(G_ACCOUNT, given);
    field(G_PERSONA, given);
    if (!strcmp(g_name, asked)) memcpy(g_name, given, sizeof g_name);
    fprintf(stderr, "[online] the server gave the name %s (another player is online under %s)\n", given, asked);
}
static uint32_t g_link;              /* the lobby link being read (its connection id) */
static uint8_t g_hdr[12];
static int g_hdr_n, g_keep;          /* header bytes so far; this frame is a pers answer */
static uint32_t g_left;              /* body bytes of this frame still to come */
static char g_body[256];
static int g_body_n;
void online_lobby_read(uint32_t link, const uint8_t *p, int n){
    if (link != g_link){ g_link = link; g_hdr_n = 0; g_left = 0; g_keep = 0; }
    while (n > 0){
        if (!g_left){
            int k = 12 - g_hdr_n < n ? 12 - g_hdr_n : n;
            memcpy(g_hdr + g_hdr_n, p, (size_t)k); g_hdr_n += k; p += k; n -= k;
            if (g_hdr_n < 12) return;
            g_hdr_n = 0;
            uint32_t len = (uint32_t)g_hdr[8] << 24 | (uint32_t)g_hdr[9] << 16 | (uint32_t)g_hdr[10] << 8 | g_hdr[11];
            if (len <= 12) continue;
            g_left = len - 12; g_body_n = 0;
            g_keep = !memcmp(g_hdr, "pers", 4) && !memcmp(g_hdr + 4, "\0\0\0\0", 4) && g_left < sizeof g_body;
            continue;
        }
        int k = (uint32_t)n < g_left ? n : (int)g_left;
        if (g_keep){ memcpy(g_body + g_body_n, p, (size_t)k); g_body_n += k; }
        p += k; n -= k; g_left -= (uint32_t)k;
        if (!g_left && g_keep){ g_body[g_body_n] = 0; g_keep = 0; persona_given(g_body); }
    }
}
