/* optslider.c -- sliders of our own on the game's option screens (Horn
 * Volume, hornmenu.c; Exposure and White Level, tonemenu.c; Stance's page, stance.c).
 *
 * The game's sliders are a class each over one widget (0x98 bytes, made by
 * 0x51E840 from the screen's layout).  Three methods are their own, the rest
 * shared by every slider (Audio's volumes, Video's World Detail ...); Engine
 * Volume's (vtable 0x7919E8):
 *    1  0x49A900  (?, message): its slider (+0x54) takes a left or right
 *                 (0x9120409E, 0xB5971BF1), the arrow blinks (16), the
 *                 value (18: +0x84) goes to the audio settings (0x83AA28
 *                 +0x14) and the sound (0x469050), the label again (3)
 *    3  0x49A950  the label: its text by hash ("Engine Volume")
 *   17  0x49A970  the range and step (+0x7C, +0x78, +0x8C: 0 .. 1, 0.05),
 *                 then the value from the audio settings
 * Each of ours is a copy of that vtable in guest memory with those three
 * here, at guest addresses nothing runs (the nops after Engine Volume's own
 * three), which the dispatch table sends to this file; the vtable tells
 * which slider an entry is.  The screen's list (0x54F410; the pause menu's
 * 0x54F800 in front of it) finds an entry's parts in the screen's package by
 * name and number (OPTION_NAME_8, SLIDER_KNOB_8, ...), and places them in its
 * row itself: a package without them for our entry gets copies of the entry
 * before's (parts_ready; the pause menu's UI_PauseOptions.fng has the bar's
 * only for its seven). */
#include "optslider.h"
#include "guest.h"
#include "game.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

void dispatch_patch(uint32_t a, void (*f)(CPU *));

#define FN_WIDGET     0x0051e840u   /* thiscall (screen +0xFC, +0x10C, +0x114, +0x11C, 1): a slider entry */
#define FN_SET        0x004ff550u   /* thiscall slider (float): its value, within its range */
#define VT_ENGINE     0x007919e8u   /* Engine Volume's class */
#define VT_N          19
#define M_ACT         0x0049a947u   /* our methods 1, 3 and 17 */
#define M_LABEL       0x0049a962u
#define M_INIT        0x0049a99fu
#define S_COUNT       0x12cu        /* the screen: its entries so far (the next one's number) */
#define S_PACKAGE     4u            /* its package's name */
#define W_SLIDER      0x54u         /* the entry: its slider (its own vtable) */
#define W_LABEL       0x2cu         /* its OPTION_NAME_n */
#define W_MAX         0x78u
#define W_MIN         0x7cu
#define W_VALUE       0x84u
#define W_STEP        0x8cu

#define SLIDERS 8
static OptSlider *g_sl[SLIDERS];
static int g_nsl;
static uint32_t g_scr;                           /* guest memory: scratch for strings */

static uint32_t fbits(float f){ uint32_t u; memcpy(&u, &f, 4); return u; }
/* the slider an entry is, by its class; 0: none of ours */
static OptSlider *slider_of(uint32_t self){
    uint32_t vt = MR32(self);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nsl; i++) if (g_sl[i]->vt == vt) return g_sl[i];
    return 0;
}

/* 1: a left or right moved the slider; its value, on a step of its range, to the slider's owner */
static void os_act(CPU *c){
    uint32_t self = c->ecx, msg = MR32(c->esp + 8u), sl = self + W_SLIDER;
    float was = MRF32(self + W_VALUE);
    if (gcall(c, MR32(MR32(sl) + 4u), sl, 1, &msg) & 0xffu) gcall(c, MR32(MR32(self) + 0x40u), self, 1, &msg);
    float v = MRF32(self + W_VALUE);
    OptSlider *s = slider_of(self);
    if (s && v != was){
        v = s->min + roundf((v - s->min) / s->step) * s->step;
        if (v < s->min) v = s->min;
        if (v > s->max) v = s->max;
        s->moved(v);
    }
    gcall(c, MR32(MR32(self) + 0x0cu), self, 0, 0);
    POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 8u;
}
/* 3: the label */
static void os_label(CPU *c){
    uint32_t obj = MR32(c->ecx + W_LABEL);
    OptSlider *s = slider_of(c->ecx);
    if (obj && g_scr && s){
        guest_write_str(g_scr, s->label(), 64);
        gcall(c, FN_FE_SETSTR, obj, 1, &g_scr);
        MR32(obj + 0x1cu) |= 2u;                 /* a text of its own, as FEPrintf leaves it (0x537B30) */
    }
    POP32(c->eip);
}
/* 17: the range and step, at the slider's value */
static void os_init(CPU *c){
    uint32_t self = c->ecx;
    OptSlider *s = slider_of(self);
    if (s){
        uint32_t v = fbits(s->value());
        MRF32(self + W_MAX) = s->max; MRF32(self + W_MIN) = s->min; MRF32(self + W_STEP) = s->step;
        gcall(c, FN_SET, self + W_SLIDER, 1, &v);
    }
    POP32(c->eip);
}

/* ---- the entry's parts ------------------------------------------------------ */
/* the address of the object list's "first" (a package's +0x4C, a group's
 * +0x64) that holds o */
static uint32_t fe_list_of(uint32_t first, uint32_t o, int depth){
    int n = 0;
    for (uint32_t it = MR32(first); it && n < 4096; it = MR32(it + 4u), n++){
        if (it == o) return first;
        if (depth < 8 && MR32(it + 0x18u) == 5u){ uint32_t l = fe_list_of(it + 0x64u, o, depth + 1); if (l) return l; }
    }
    return 0;
}
/* a copy of the package's object o under another name's hash, after it in
 * its list: as roam_game.c's fe_clone makes them (Clone, vtable slot 1, then
 * the drawing data an image or a string needs to be drawn at all); intro.c's
 * title line too */
uint32_t fe_copy(CPU *c, uint32_t pk, uint32_t o, uint32_t hash){
    uint32_t l = guest_ok(pk, 0x54) && guest_ok(o, 0x5c) && guest_ok(MR32(o), 8) ? fe_list_of(pk + 0x4cu, o, 0) : 0;
    if (!l) return 0;
    uint32_t n = 0, last = 0;
    for (uint32_t it = MR32(l); it && n < 4096; it = MR32(it + 4u)){ last = it; n++; }
    if (n != MR32(l - 4u) || last != MR32(l + 4u)) return 0;          /* not the count and last we take it for */
    uint32_t one = 1, cl = gcall(c, MR32(MR32(o) + 4u), o, 1, &one);
    if (!guest_ok(cl, 0x5c)) return 0;
    MR32(cl + 0x58u) = 0;
    uint32_t dn = MR32(o + 0x30u), d0 = MR32(o + 0x2cu), d1 = MR32(cl + 0x2cu), ty = MR32(o + 0x18u);
    if ((ty == 1u || ty == 2u) && MR32(cl + 0x30u) == dn && dn && dn <= 0x100u && guest_ok(d0, dn) && guest_ok(d1, dn) && d0 != d1)
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < dn; i++) MR8(d1 + i) = MR8(d0 + i);
    MR32(cl + 0x10u) = hash;
    uint32_t nx = MR32(o + 4u);
    MR32(cl + 4u) = nx; MR32(cl + 8u) = o; MR32(o + 4u) = cl;
    if (nx) MR32(nx + 8u) = cl; else MR32(l + 4u) = cl;
    MR32(l - 4u) += 1;
    return cl;
}
/* The copies and their originals, while the package holds them: the copies
 * take the originals' colour every frame (optslider_frame).  They are made as
 * the screen is set up, before the package's scripts have given its objects
 * their colours (a copy then: alpha 0, never drawn, 0x51A970), and their
 * own scripts, copied as they are, never do. */
#define NAMES  10                                /* the parts the list reads for an entry */
#define COPIES (NAMES * 2)                       /* a screen's: two sliders' */
static struct { uint32_t pk, pkname, n, o[COPIES], cl[COPIES], ho[COPIES], hc[COPIES]; } g_cp;
void optslider_frame(CPU *c){
    if (!g_cp.n) return;
    uint32_t pk = gcall(c, FN_FE_PACKAGE, 0, 1, &g_cp.pkname);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_cp.n && pk == g_cp.pk; i++)              /* each still the package's, by its name too */
        if (!guest_ok(g_cp.o[i], 0x5c) || !guest_ok(g_cp.cl[i], 0x5c) || MR32(g_cp.o[i] + 0x10u) != g_cp.ho[i] || MR32(g_cp.cl[i] + 0x10u) != g_cp.hc[i]
            || !fe_list_of(pk + 0x4cu, g_cp.o[i], 0) || !fe_list_of(pk + 0x4cu, g_cp.cl[i], 0)) pk = 0;
    if (pk != g_cp.pk){ g_cp.n = 0; return; }                         /* the screen is gone, and its objects */
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_cp.n; i++){
        uint32_t d0 = MR32(g_cp.o[i] + 0x2cu), d1 = MR32(g_cp.cl[i] + 0x2cu), ch = 0;
        if (!guest_ok(d0, 16) || !guest_ok(d1, 16)) continue;
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 16u; k += 4u) if (MR32(d1 + k) != MR32(d0 + k)){ MR32(d1 + k) = MR32(d0 + k); ch = 1; }
        if (ch) MR32(g_cp.cl[i] + 0x1cu) |= 0x400000u;                 /* changed, as the FE's setters mark it */
    }
}
/* a part's object in the package by name and number, 0: none; *hash: that name's */
static uint32_t part(CPU *c, uint32_t pk, uint32_t base, uint32_t n, uint32_t *hash, char *nm, size_t cap){
    int k = 0;
    for (; base && k < 32 && MR8(base + (uint32_t)k); k++) nm[k] = (char)MR8(base + (uint32_t)k);
    snprintf(nm + k, cap - (size_t)k, "%u", n);
    guest_write_str(g_scr, nm, 48);
    *hash = gcall(c, FN_FE_HASH, 0, 1, &g_scr);
    return gcall(c, FN_PKG_FIND, pk, 1, hash);
}
/* The parts the list reads for entry n (the screen's names, +0xC4
 * OPTION_NAME_ .. +0xF0 SLIDER_END_), in the screen's package: each one the
 * package has for entry n - 1 but not for n is a copy of n - 1's (the pause
 * menu's has the slider's bar, knob and ends only for its seven), one it has
 * for neither stays out, as from the entries before (OPTION_BACKING_ in the
 * pause menu: none; SLIDER_VALUE_, a number the slider prints only where
 * there is one).  0: the package is not there. */
static int parts_ready(CPU *c, uint32_t scr, uint32_t n, const char *name){
    static const uint32_t OFS[NAMES] = { 0xc4u, 0xd0u, 0xd4u, 0xd8u, 0xdcu, 0xe0u, 0xe4u, 0xe8u, 0xecu, 0xf0u };
    uint32_t pn = MR32(scr + S_PACKAGE), pk = pn ? gcall(c, FN_FE_PACKAGE, 0, 1, &pn) : 0;
    if (!pk || n < 1u) return 0;
    char line[200]; int o_n = 0;
    if (pk != g_cp.pk || pn != g_cp.pkname) g_cp.n = 0;                 /* another screen's copies: gone with it */
    g_cp.pk = pk; g_cp.pkname = pn;
    uint32_t n0 = g_cp.n;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < NAMES; i++){
        char nm[48], was[48];
        uint32_t h, h0, b = MR32(scr + OFS[i]);
        if (part(c, pk, b, n, &h, nm, sizeof nm)) continue;
        uint32_t o = n > 1u ? part(c, pk, b, n - 1u, &h0, was, sizeof was) : 0, cl = o && g_cp.n < COPIES ? fe_copy(c, pk, o, h) : 0;
        if (!o) continue;
        if (!cl){ fprintf(stderr, "[menu] no copy of %s for %s: no %s slider\n", was, nm, name); return 0; }
        g_cp.o[g_cp.n] = o; g_cp.cl[g_cp.n] = cl; g_cp.ho[g_cp.n] = h0; g_cp.hc[g_cp.n++] = h;
        if (o_n < (int)sizeof line - 40) o_n += snprintf(line + o_n, sizeof line - (size_t)o_n, " %s", nm);
    }
    if (g_cp.n > n0) fprintf(stderr, "[menu] %s, entry %u: copies of entry %u's parts as%.*s\n", name, n, n - 1u, o_n, line);
    return 1;
}

void optslider_add(CPU *c, uint32_t scr, uint32_t fn_add, OptSlider *s){
    if (!s->vt){
        if (g_nsl == SLIDERS) return;
        uint32_t sz = VT_N * 4u + 4u;
        if (!g_scr){
            uint32_t n = 64u;
            if (!(g_scr = gcall(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &n))) return;
            dispatch_patch(M_ACT, os_act);
            dispatch_patch(M_LABEL, os_label);
            dispatch_patch(M_INIT, os_init);
        }
        uint32_t vt = gcall(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &sz);
        if (!vt) return;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i <= VT_N; i++) MR32(vt + 4u * i) = MR32(VT_ENGINE + 4u * i);
        MR32(vt + 4u * 1u) = M_ACT; MR32(vt + 4u * 3u) = M_LABEL; MR32(vt + 4u * 17u) = M_INIT;
        s->vt = vt; g_sl[g_nsl++] = s;
    }
    if (!parts_ready(c, scr, MR32(scr + S_COUNT), s->name)) return;
    uint32_t sz = 0x98u, w = gcall(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &sz);
    if (!w) return;
    uint32_t a[5] = { scr + 0xfcu, scr + 0x10cu, scr + 0x114u, scr + 0x11cu, 1u };
    gcall(c, FN_WIDGET, w, 5, a);
    MR32(w) = s->vt;
    uint32_t b[2] = { w, 1u };
    gcall(c, fn_add, scr, 2, b);
}

/* oracle.c -- differential oracle: the ORIGINAL x86 code of selected guest
 * functions runs under an x86 emulator (Unicorn) from the same guest state as
 * the lifted C, and the results are compared.
 *
 * Always built: the wrappers at the bottom.  For every listed function the
 * lifted body is generated as sub_X_orig (gen.sh picks the _orig names up from
 * this file) and sub_X here calls it.  Without the oracle that is one load and
 * a predictable branch per call.
 *
 * Built with the emulator only for test binaries:
 *     ORACLE=1 UNICORN_DIR=<unicorn 2.1.x build+source> ./link.sh orig
 * (link.sh adds -DNFSU2_ORACLE and links libunicorn.a; Unicorn is built
 * natively for arm64 from source with cmake, x86 target only.)
 *
 * Run-time options (read once, at the first wrapped call):
 *   NFSU2_ORACLE = cmp | exec
 *     cmp   Unicorn runs the function (and everything it calls) on private
 *           copies of the guest pages it touches, then the lifted C runs on the
 *           real memory as usual.  General registers, the x87 stack top and
 *           ST(0) of a float result, and every page Unicorn touched are
 *           compared; differing dwords are classified as float32 ulps.
 *     exec  Unicorn runs the function on the real guest memory and the lifted
 *           C does not run: the game continues on the original code's
 *           results (a whole-trajectory oracle).  Calls into HLE imports are
 *           bridged to the runtime.
 *   NFSU2_ORACLE_FNS   = hex,hex,...   subset of the wrapped functions (all)
 *   NFSU2_ORACLE_PC    = 24 | 53 | 64  x87 precision control under Unicorn
 *                        (24: the game thread on Windows, whose CreateDevice
 *                        call has no D3DCREATE_FPU_PRESERVE)
 *   NFSU2_ORACLE_EVERY = n             cmp: every n-th call of a function (1)
 *   NFSU2_ORACLE_LOG   = file          cmp: one line per differing dword
 *                                      (first NFSU2_ORACLE_MAXLOG, 2000)
 *   NFSU2_ORACLE_OUT   = file          summary table at exit (also stderr)
 *   NFSU2_ORACLE_WATCH = addr          cmp: log every Unicorn write to the
 *                                      dword at addr (eip, value), to locate
 *                                      the instruction behind a difference;
 *                        stackptr      log stores of stack addresses outside
 *                                      the stack (slow: hooks every write)
 *
 * Unicorn's x87 is QEMU softfloat floatx80 and honours the precision and
 * rounding control fields for FADD/FSUB/FMUL/FDIV/FSQRT, like the hardware.
 * Its FSIN/FCOS/FPTAN/FPATAN/FYL2X/F2XM1 go through host double libm, i.e.
 * the same as the lifter: the oracle cannot check those against silicon.
 */
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <math.h>

typedef void (*guest_fn)(CPU *);
int g_oracle_on = 0;                       /* 1 once NFSU2_ORACLE is active */
static int g_oracle_inited = 0;
void oracle_call(CPU *c, uint32_t va, guest_fn lifted);

/* first call: decide whether the oracle is active */
static inline void oracle_maybe_init(void){
    if (__builtin_expect(g_oracle_inited, 1)) return;
    g_oracle_inited = 1;
#ifdef NFSU2_ORACLE
    const char *m = getenv("NFSU2_ORACLE");
    if (m && *m && strcmp(m, "0")) g_oracle_on = 1;
#else
    if (getenv("NFSU2_ORACLE"))
        fprintf(stderr, "[oracle] NFSU2_ORACLE ignored: this binary was linked without ORACLE=1\n");
#endif
}

#define OW(VA, NAME, ORIG) \
    void ORIG(CPU *); \
    void NAME(CPU *c){ \
        oracle_maybe_init(); \
        if (__builtin_expect(g_oracle_on, 0)) oracle_call(c, VA, ORIG); \
        else ORIG(c); }

#ifndef NFSU2_ORACLE
void oracle_call(CPU *c, uint32_t va, guest_fn lifted){ (void)va; lifted(c); }
#else
/* ======================================================================= */
#include <unicorn/unicorn.h>
#include <pthread.h>

extern void (*g_report_fn)(void);
void dispatch_indirect(CPU *, uint32_t);
#include <stdatomic.h>
extern _Atomic uint64_t g_vclock_freeze;    /* win32.c */
uint64_t host_us(void); uint32_t host_ms(void);
typedef struct { uint32_t iat; const char *dll; const char *name; int nargs; } ImpEnt;
extern const ImpEnt g_imp[]; extern const uint32_t g_imp_count;

#define PG       0x1000u
#define NPOOL    8192u                     /* shadow pages per call (32 MB) */
#define GDT_VA   0xFFFF0000u               /* oracle-private, never guest-committed */
#define MAXFN    16

enum { MODE_CMP = 1, MODE_EXEC = 2 };
static int g_mode = 0, g_pc = 24, g_every = 1, g_maxlog = 2000;
static FILE *g_log = 0;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t va; int enabled;
    uint64_t calls, compared, aborted, identical, differ;
    uint64_t reg_diff, top_diff, st0_diff;
    uint64_t dw_live, dw_stack;            /* differing dwords */
    uint64_t ulp_hist[6];                  /* live: 1, 2-15, 16-255, 256-64K, >64K, non-float */
    uint32_t max_ulp; double max_rel;
    double st0_max_rel;
    uint64_t pages;                        /* pages copied, total */
    uint64_t imports;                      /* exec: HLE calls bridged */
    char why[64];                          /* last abort reason */
} FnStat;
static FnStat g_fs[MAXFN]; static int g_nfs;

static FnStat *fn_stat(uint32_t va){
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nfs; i++) if (g_fs[i].va == va) return &g_fs[i];
    if (g_nfs == MAXFN) return &g_fs[MAXFN - 1];
    FnStat *s = &g_fs[g_nfs++]; memset(s, 0, sizeof *s); s->va = va; s->enabled = 1;
    const char *f = getenv("NFSU2_ORACLE_FNS");
    if (f && *f){
        s->enabled = 0;
        for (const char *p = f; *p; ){
            uint32_t a = (uint32_t)strtoul(p, (char **)&p, 16);
            if (a == va) s->enabled = 1;
            while (*p == ',' || *p == ' ') p++;
            if (*p && !((*p >= '0' && *p <= '9') || (*p >= 'a' && *p <= 'f') || (*p >= 'A' && *p <= 'F') || *p == 'x' || *p == 'X')) p++;
        }
    }
    return s;
}

/* ---- x87 80-bit <-> double ------------------------------------------- */
static void d_to_f80(double v, uint8_t out[10]){ f80_store(out, v); }
/* round-to-nearest-even (f80_load in cpu.h truncates; exact for PC 24/53) */
static double f80_to_d(const uint8_t in[10]){
    uint64_t m; uint16_t se; memcpy(&m, in, 8); memcpy(&se, in + 8, 2);
    int sign = se >> 15; int e = se & 0x7FFF;
    if (e == 0 && m == 0) return sign ? -0.0 : 0.0;
    if (e == 0x7FFF) return (m << 1) ? (sign ? -NAN : NAN) : (sign ? -INFINITY : INFINITY);
    if (!(m >> 63)) {                     /* unnormal/denormal: tiny for us */
        double v = ldexp((double)m, e - 16383 - 63 + (e == 0));
        return sign ? -v : v;
    }
    uint64_t hi = m >> 11, lo = m & 0x7FF;
    if (lo > 0x400 || (lo == 0x400 && (hi & 1))) hi++;
    double v = ldexp((double)hi, e - 16383 - 52);
    return sign ? -v : v;
}

/* ---- memory hooks ----------------------------------------------------- */
static void abort_run(const char *why, uint32_t a){
    if (!g_abort){ g_abort = 1; g_abort_why = why; g_abort_addr = a; }
}
/* cmp: give Unicorn a private copy of the guest page holding a */
static bool shadow_map(uc_engine *uc, uint32_t a){
    if (!mem_is_committed(a)){ abort_run("unmapped guest address", a); return false; }
    if (g_nshadow == NPOOL){ abort_run("shadow pool full", a); return false; }
    uint32_t pg = a & ~(PG - 1);
    uint8_t *buf = g_pool + (size_t)g_nshadow * PG;
    memcpy(buf, g_mem + pg, PG);
    if (uc_mem_map_ptr(uc, pg, PG, UC_PROT_ALL, buf)){ abort_run("map_ptr", a); return false; }
    g_shadow_va[g_nshadow++] = pg;
    return true;
}
static bool on_unmapped(uc_engine *uc, uc_mem_type type, uint64_t addr, int size,
                        int64_t value, void *ud){
    (void)size; (void)value; (void)ud;
    uint32_t a = (uint32_t)addr;
    if (type == UC_MEM_FETCH_UNMAPPED && a >= 0xE0000000u){
        abort_run("import", a); return false;          /* HLE thunk / COM method */
    }
    if (!mem_is_committed(a)){ abort_run("unmapped guest address", a); return false; }
    if (g_mode == MODE_EXEC){
        uint32_t blk = a >> 14;
        if (g_exec_mapped[blk >> 3] & (1u << (blk & 7))){ abort_run("remap", a); return false; }
        if (uc_mem_map_ptr(uc, (uint64_t)blk << 14, 0x4000, UC_PROT_ALL, g_mem + ((uint64_t)blk << 14))){
            abort_run("map_ptr", a); return false; }
        g_exec_mapped[blk >> 3] |= (uint8_t)(1u << (blk & 7));
        return true;
    }
    return shadow_map(uc, a);
}
/* cmp: pure imports reached from the compared functions: the timing calls of
 * the profiling helpers (0x43BD90/0x43BDF0/0x43BE20; the clock is frozen for
 * the comparison, so the lifted run gets the same values from the runtime's
 * HLE) and the pointer checks of the pool code (0x43BD60, HLE: valid).
 * Returns 1 if emulated. */
static int emulate_import(uint32_t idx){
    if (idx >= g_imp_count) return 0;
    const char *n = g_imp[idx].name;
    uint32_t esp, ret, p = 0, eax; uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_ESP, &esp);
    if (uc_mem_read(g_uc, esp, &ret, 4)) return 0;
    int nargs;
    if (!strcmp(n, "QueryPerformanceCounter") || !strcmp(n, "QueryPerformanceFrequency")){
        if (uc_mem_read(g_uc, esp + 4, &p, 4)) return 0;
        uint64_t v = !strcmp(n, "QueryPerformanceFrequency") ? 1000000ull : host_us();
        if (p && uc_mem_write(g_uc, p, &v, 8)){
            /* not mapped yet (uc_mem_* calls do not run the hooks) */
            if (!shadow_map(g_uc, p) || (((p + 7) ^ p) & ~(PG - 1) && !shadow_map(g_uc, p + 7)) ||
                uc_mem_write(g_uc, p, &v, 8)) return 0;
            g_abort = 0;
        }
        eax = 1; nargs = 1;
    } else if (!strcmp(n, "timeGetTime") || !strcmp(n, "GetTickCount")){
        eax = host_ms(); nargs = 0;
    } else if (!strcmp(n, "IsBadReadPtr") || !strcmp(n, "IsBadWritePtr")){
        eax = 0; nargs = 2;                  /* as the runtime's HLE: valid */
    } else if (!strcmp(n, "IsBadCodePtr")){
        eax = 0; nargs = 1;
    } else return 0;
    esp += 4u + 4u * (uint32_t)nargs;
    uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_ESP, &esp); uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EAX, &eax);
    uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EIP, &ret);
    return 1;
}

static bool on_prot(uc_engine *uc, uc_mem_type type, uint64_t addr, int size,
                    int64_t value, void *ud){
    (void)uc; (void)type; (void)size; (void)value; (void)ud;
    abort_run("write to read-only image section", (uint32_t)addr);
    return false;
}

static uint32_t g_esp_entry;
static void on_watch(uc_engine *uc, uc_mem_type type, uint64_t addr, int size,
                     int64_t value, void *ud){
    (void)type; (void)ud;
    if (!g_log) return;
    if (g_watch == 1){   /* "stackptr": stack addresses stored outside the stack */
        uint32_t v = (uint32_t)value;
        if (size != 4 || v > g_esp_entry || v + 0x100000u < g_esp_entry ||
            ((uint32_t)addr <= g_esp_entry && (uint32_t)addr + 0x100000u >= g_esp_entry)) return;
    } else if (addr + (uint64_t)size <= g_watch || addr >= (uint64_t)g_watch + 4) return;
    uint32_t eip, esp; uc_reg_read(uc, UC_X86_REG_EIP, &eip); uc_reg_read(uc, UC_X86_REG_ESP, &esp);
    fprintf(g_log, "  watch: eip=%08x esp=%08x write [%08x]/%d = %08llx\n", eip, esp,
            (uint32_t)addr, size, (unsigned long long)value);
}

/* cmp: guest functions Unicorn should skip, returning eax = 0 (none needed
 * now: the timing imports of the profiling helpers 0x43BD90/0x43BDF0/
 * 0x43BE20 are emulated against the frozen clock, see emulate_import) */
static const uint32_t g_stub_ret0[] = { 0 };   /* none needed since the clock freeze */
static void on_stub(uc_engine *uc, uint64_t addr, uint32_t size, void *ud){
    (void)size; (void)ud;
    if (g_mode != MODE_CMP) return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof g_stub_ret0 / sizeof *g_stub_ret0; i++)
        if (g_stub_ret0[i] && (uint32_t)addr == g_stub_ret0[i]){
            uint32_t esp, ret, z = 0; uc_reg_read(uc, UC_X86_REG_ESP, &esp);
            uc_mem_read(uc, esp, &ret, 4); esp += 4;
            uc_reg_write(uc, UC_X86_REG_ESP, &esp); uc_reg_write(uc, UC_X86_REG_EAX, &z);
            uc_reg_write(uc, UC_X86_REG_EIP, &ret);
            return;
        }
}

/* ---- GDT: flat code/data plus a data segment for fs (TEB) ------------- */
static void gdt_entry(int i, uint32_t base, uint32_t limit, int code, int dpl){
    uint8_t *d = g_gdt + 8 * i;
    limit >>= 12;                          /* 4 KB granularity */
    d[0] = limit & 0xFF; d[1] = (limit >> 8) & 0xFF;
    d[2] = base & 0xFF; d[3] = (base >> 8) & 0xFF; d[4] = (base >> 16) & 0xFF;
    d[5] = (uint8_t)(0x80 | (dpl << 5) | 0x10 | (code ? 0x0A : 0x02));   /* present, S, type */
    d[6] = (uint8_t)(0xC0 | ((limit >> 16) & 0x0F));                     /* G, D/B */
    d[7] = (base >> 24) & 0xFF;
}
static void set_fs(uint32_t base){
    gdt_entry(4, base, 0xFFFFF000u, 0, 3);
    uc_mem_write(g_uc, GDT_VA, g_gdt, 8 * 6);
    uint32_t fs = (4 << 3) | 3; uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_FS, &fs);
}

static bool on_sentinel(uc_engine *uc, uc_mem_type type, uint64_t addr, int size,
                        int64_t value, void *ud);
static void oracle_report(void);
static void (*g_prev_report)(void);
static void chained_report(void){ oracle_report(); if (g_prev_report) g_prev_report(); }

static int oracle_setup(CPU *c){
    const char *m = getenv("NFSU2_ORACLE");
    g_mode = (m && !strcmp(m, "exec")) ? MODE_EXEC : MODE_CMP;
    const char *e;
    if ((e = getenv("NFSU2_ORACLE_PC"))) g_pc = atoi(e);
    if ((e = getenv("NFSU2_ORACLE_EVERY"))) g_every = atoi(e) > 0 ? atoi(e) : 1;
    if ((e = getenv("NFSU2_ORACLE_MAXLOG"))) g_maxlog = atoi(e);
    if ((e = getenv("NFSU2_ORACLE_LOG")) && *e) g_log = fopen(e, "w");
    g_out = getenv("NFSU2_ORACLE_OUT");
    if (uc_open(UC_ARCH_X86, UC_MODE_32, &g_uc)){ fprintf(stderr, "[oracle] uc_open failed\n"); return 0; }
    /* image: .text and .rdata alias the guest memory (read-only + exec in
     * cmp; writable in exec so the game's own state stays in one place) */
    int rw = g_mode == MODE_EXEC ? UC_PROT_WRITE : 0;
    if (uc_mem_map_ptr(g_uc, 0x00401000u, 0x00382000u, UC_PROT_READ | UC_PROT_EXEC | rw, g_mem + 0x00401000u) ||
        uc_mem_map_ptr(g_uc, 0x00783000u, 0x00065000u, UC_PROT_READ | UC_PROT_EXEC | rw, g_mem + 0x00783000u)){
        fprintf(stderr, "[oracle] cannot map the image\n"); return 0; }
    if (g_mode == MODE_EXEC)
        for (uint32_t b = 0x00401000u >> 14; b < (0x00783000u + 0x65000u + 0x3FFFu) >> 14; b++)
            g_exec_mapped[b >> 3] |= (uint8_t)(1u << (b & 7));   /* never remap over the image */
    if (mem_is_committed(GDT_VA)){ fprintf(stderr, "[oracle] GDT address is guest memory\n"); return 0; }
    uc_mem_map_ptr(g_uc, GDT_VA, PG, UC_PROT_READ | UC_PROT_WRITE, g_gdt);
    memset(g_gdt, 0, sizeof g_gdt);
    gdt_entry(1, 0, 0xFFFFF000u, 1, 3);    /* code, ring 3 */
    gdt_entry(2, 0, 0xFFFFF000u, 0, 3);    /* data, ring 3 */
    gdt_entry(3, 0, 0xFFFFF000u, 0, 0);    /* data, ring 0 (ss while cpl = 0) */
    gdt_entry(5, 0, 0xFFFFF000u, 1, 0);    /* code, ring 0 */
    uc_mem_write(g_uc, GDT_VA, g_gdt, 8 * 6);
    uc_x86_mmr gdtr = { 0, GDT_VA, 8 * 6 - 1, 0 };
    uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_GDTR, &gdtr);
    uint32_t sel;
    sel = (3 << 3) | 0; uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_SS, &sel);
    sel = (2 << 3) | 3; uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_DS, &sel); uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_ES, &sel);
    uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_GS, &sel);
    set_fs(c->fs_base);
    if (g_mode == MODE_CMP) g_pool = malloc((size_t)NPOOL * PG);
    uc_hook h;
    uc_hook_add(g_uc, &h, UC_HOOK_MEM_UNMAPPED, (void *)on_sentinel, 0, 1, 0);
    uc_hook_add(g_uc, &h, UC_HOOK_MEM_WRITE_PROT, (void *)on_prot, 0, 1, 0);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof g_stub_ret0 / sizeof *g_stub_ret0; i++)
        if (g_stub_ret0[i]) uc_hook_add(g_uc, &h, UC_HOOK_CODE, (void *)on_stub, 0, g_stub_ret0[i], g_stub_ret0[i]);
    if ((e = getenv("NFSU2_ORACLE_WATCH")) && *e){
        g_watch = !strcmp(e, "stackptr") ? 1u : (uint32_t)strtoul(e, 0, 0);
        if (g_watch == 1) uc_hook_add(g_uc, &h, UC_HOOK_MEM_WRITE, (void *)on_watch, 0, 1, 0);
        else uc_hook_add(g_uc, &h, UC_HOOK_MEM_WRITE, (void *)on_watch, 0, g_watch & ~3u, (g_watch & ~3u) + 3);
    }
    g_owner = c;
    g_prev_report = g_report_fn; g_report_fn = chained_report;
    atexit(oracle_report);
    fprintf(stderr, "[oracle] %s mode, x87 PC=%d, every %d, Unicorn %s\n",
            g_mode == MODE_EXEC ? "exec" : "cmp", g_pc, g_every, uc_version(0, 0) ? "2.x" : "?");
    return 1;
}

static uint16_t uc_fcw(const CPU *c){
    uint16_t pcb = g_pc == 24 ? 0 : g_pc == 53 ? 2 : 3;
    return (uint16_t)((c->fcw & ~0x0300u) | (pcb << 8));
}
static void cpu_to_uc(const CPU *c, uint32_t eip){
    static const int R[8] = { UC_X86_REG_EAX, UC_X86_REG_ECX, UC_X86_REG_EDX, UC_X86_REG_EBX,
                              UC_X86_REG_ESP, UC_X86_REG_EBP, UC_X86_REG_ESI, UC_X86_REG_EDI };
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) uc_reg_write(g_uc, R[i], &c->r[i]);
    uint32_t fl = eflags_get(c) & ~0x00240000u;          /* no ID/AC games here */
    uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EFLAGS, &fl);
    uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EIP, &eip);
    uint16_t cw = uc_fcw(c); uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_FPCW, &cw);
    uint16_t sw = (uint16_t)((c->fsw & ~0x3800u) | ((c->top & 7) << 11));
    uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_FPSW, &sw);
    uint16_t tag = 0;                                     /* all valid: no stack faults */
    uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_FPTAG, &tag);
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++){ uint8_t f[10]; d_to_f80(c->st[i], f); uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_FP0 + i, f); }
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_XMM0 + i, c->xmm[i].b);
    uint32_t mx = 0x1F80; uc_reg_write(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_MXCSR, &mx);
    set_fs(c->fs_base);
}
static void uc_to_cpu(CPU *c){
    static const int R[8] = { UC_X86_REG_EAX, UC_X86_REG_ECX, UC_X86_REG_EDX, UC_X86_REG_EBX,
                              UC_X86_REG_ESP, UC_X86_REG_EBP, UC_X86_REG_ESI, UC_X86_REG_EDI };
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) uc_reg_read(g_uc, R[i], &c->r[i]);
    uint32_t fl; uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EFLAGS, &fl);
    eflags_set(c, (fl & ~0x00240000u) | (c->sysfl & 0x00240000u));
    uint16_t sw; uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_FPSW, &sw);
    c->top = (sw >> 11) & 7; c->fsw = (uint16_t)(sw & ~0x3800u);
    uint16_t cw; uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_FPCW, &cw);
    c->fcw = (uint16_t)((cw & ~0x0300u) | (c->fcw & 0x0300u));   /* PC stays the lifted thread's */
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++){ uint8_t f[10]; uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_FP0 + i, f); c->st[i] = f80_to_d(f); }
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_XMM0 + i, c->xmm[i].b);
}

static void unmap_shadow(void){
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_nshadow; i++) uc_mem_unmap(g_uc, g_shadow_va[i], PG);
    g_nshadow = 0;
}

/* The function returns into SENTINEL: its return address on the emulated
 * stack is replaced, so the return is caught as a fetch from an unmapped
 * page (uc_emu_start's "until" is not reliable once that address sits in
 * the middle of a cached translation block, which let runs continue into
 * the caller).  Recursion through the caller cannot fake it either. */
#define SENTINEL 0xFFFE0000u
static int g_returned;
static bool on_sentinel(uc_engine *uc, uc_mem_type type, uint64_t addr, int size,
                        int64_t value, void *ud){
    (void)uc; (void)type; (void)size; (void)value; (void)ud;
    if ((uint32_t)addr == SENTINEL){ g_returned = 1; return false; }
    return on_unmapped(uc, type, addr, size, value, ud);
}
static int exec_map(uint32_t a){
    uint32_t blk = a >> 14;
    if (g_exec_mapped[blk >> 3] & (1u << (blk & 7))) return 1;
    if (!mem_is_committed(a)) return 0;
    if (uc_mem_map_ptr(g_uc, (uint64_t)blk << 14, 0x4000, UC_PROT_ALL, g_mem + ((uint64_t)blk << 14))) return 0;
    g_exec_mapped[blk >> 3] |= (uint8_t)(1u << (blk & 7));
    return 1;
}

/* run the function at va until it returns; exec mode bridges import calls */
static int emulate(CPU *c, uint32_t va, FnStat *s){
    uint32_t esp0 = c->esp, eip = va, sent = SENTINEL;
    /* plant the sentinel (cmp: in the private copy of the stack page) */
    if (g_mode == MODE_CMP){
        if (uc_mem_write(g_uc, esp0, &sent, 4) &&
            (!shadow_map(g_uc, esp0) || uc_mem_write(g_uc, esp0, &sent, 4))){
            abort_run("cannot plant the return sentinel", esp0); return 0; }
    } else {
        if (!exec_map(esp0) || uc_mem_write(g_uc, esp0, &sent, 4)){
            abort_run("cannot plant the return sentinel", esp0); return 0; }
    }
    g_returned = 0;
    int rc = 0;
    for (int guard = 0; guard < 1000000; guard++){
        g_abort = 0;
        uc_err err = uc_emu_start(g_uc, eip, 0, 0, 0);
        uint32_t pc, esp; uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EIP, &pc); uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_ESP, &esp);
        if (g_returned){
            if (esp > esp0){ rc = 1; break; }
            abort_run("sentinel reached with the stack below the entry", pc); break;
        }
        if (g_mode == MODE_CMP && g_abort && !strcmp(g_abort_why, "import") &&
            g_abort_addr >= 0xF0000000u && emulate_import(g_abort_addr - 0xF0000000u)){
            s->imports++;
            uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_EIP, &eip);
            continue;
        }
        if (g_mode == MODE_EXEC && g_abort && !strcmp(g_abort_why, "import")){
            /* the call pushed its return address; let the runtime's HLE run it */
            uc_to_cpu(c);
            dispatch_indirect(c, g_abort_addr);
            s->imports++;
            eip = c->eip;
            cpu_to_uc(c, eip);
            continue;
        }
        if (!g_abort) abort_run(err ? uc_strerror(err) : "stopped", pc);
        break;
    }
    if (g_mode == MODE_EXEC) MR32(esp0) = g_ret_addr;   /* the real stack keeps the real one */
    if (!rc && !g_abort) abort_run("too many import bridges", eip);
    return rc;
}

static int g_nlog; static uint32_t g_esp0;
static void log_diff(FnStat *s, uint64_t callno, const char *what, uint32_t a, uint32_t ov, uint32_t lv){
    if (!g_log || g_nlog >= g_maxlog) return;
    g_nlog++;
    float of, lf; memcpy(&of, &ov, 4); memcpy(&lf, &lv, 4);
    fprintf(g_log, "%06x #%llu %s %08x oracle=%08x (%.9g) lifted=%08x (%.9g)  [esp0=%08x ret=%08x]\n",
            s->va, (unsigned long long)callno, what, a, ov, (double)of, lv, (double)lf, g_esp0, g_ret_addr);
}
static int is_floaty(uint32_t v){ uint32_t e = (v >> 23) & 0xFF; return v == 0 || v == 0x80000000u || (e > 0x40 && e < 0xBF); }

void oracle_call(CPU *c, uint32_t va, guest_fn lifted){
    static int setup_ok = -1;
    if (setup_ok < 0) setup_ok = oracle_setup(c);
    if (!setup_ok || c != g_owner || g_busy){ lifted(c); return; }
    FnStat *s = fn_stat(va);
    s->calls++;
    if (!s->enabled || (g_mode == MODE_CMP && (s->calls - 1) % (uint64_t)g_every)){ lifted(c); return; }
    g_ret_addr = MR32(c->esp);

    if (g_mode == MODE_EXEC){
        cpu_to_uc(c, va);
        if (!emulate(c, va, s)){
            /* the state is partly updated: nothing sane to fall back to */
            fprintf(stderr, "[oracle] exec %06x aborted (%s at %08x) -- the run is invalid from here\n",
                    va, g_abort_why, g_abort_addr);
            s->aborted++; snprintf(s->why, sizeof s->why, "%s@%08x", g_abort_why, g_abort_addr);
            uc_to_cpu(c); c->eip = g_ret_addr; return;
        }
        uc_to_cpu(c); c->eip = g_ret_addr; s->compared++;
        return;
    }

    /* ---- cmp ---- */
    CPU pre = *c;
    atomic_store(&g_vclock_freeze, host_us());
    g_busy = 1; g_esp0 = c->esp; g_esp_entry = c->esp;
    if (g_watch && g_log) fprintf(g_log, "%06x #%llu begin esp=%08x ret=%08x\n", va,
                                  (unsigned long long)s->calls, c->esp, g_ret_addr);
    cpu_to_uc(c, va);
    int ok = emulate(c, va, s);
    CPU orc = *c; uc_to_cpu(&orc);
    uc_mem_write(g_uc, c->esp, &g_ret_addr, 4);   /* undo the sentinel before comparing */
    lifted(c);                              /* the real run, on the real memory */
    g_busy = 0;
    atomic_store(&g_vclock_freeze, 0);
    if (!ok){
        s->aborted++; snprintf(s->why, sizeof s->why, "%s@%08x", g_abort_why, g_abort_addr);
        if (g_abort_addr >= 0xF0000000u && g_abort_addr - 0xF0000000u < g_imp_count)
            snprintf(s->why, sizeof s->why, "import %s", g_imp[g_abort_addr - 0xF0000000u].name);
        if (g_log && g_nlog < g_maxlog){
            /* where: .text return addresses on the emulated stack */
            uint32_t esp; uc_reg_read(g_uc, UC_X86_REG_ESP, &esp);
            g_nlog++;
            fprintf(g_log, "%06x #%llu abort: %s at %08x; stack:", va, (unsigned long long)s->calls,
                    g_abort_why, g_abort_addr);
            int n = 0;
            for (uint32_t a = esp; a < g_esp0 + 4 && n < 16; a += 4){
                uint32_t v; if (uc_mem_read(g_uc, a, &v, 4)) break;
                if (v >= 0x00401000u && v < 0x00783000u){ fprintf(g_log, " %08x", v); n++; }
            }
            fprintf(g_log, "\n");
        }
        unmap_shadow(); return;
    }
    s->compared++; s->pages += g_nshadow;
    int differ = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (orc.r[i] != c->r[i]){
        differ = 1; s->reg_diff++;
        log_diff(s, s->calls, "reg", (uint32_t)i, orc.r[i], c->r[i]);
    }
    if ((orc.top & 7) != (c->top & 7)){ differ = 1; s->top_diff++; log_diff(s, s->calls, "x87top", 0, (uint32_t)orc.top, (uint32_t)c->top); }
    else if (((pre.top - 1) & 7) == (c->top & 7)){          /* float result in ST(0) */
        double o = orc.st[c->top & 7], l = c->st[c->top & 7];
        if (memcmp(&o, &l, 8) && !(o != o && l != l)){
            differ = 1; s->st0_diff++;
            double rel = fabs(o - l) / (fabs(o) > 1e-30 ? fabs(o) : 1e-30);
            if (rel > s->st0_max_rel) s->st0_max_rel = rel;
            if (g_log && g_nlog < g_maxlog){ g_nlog++;
                fprintf(g_log, "%06x #%llu st0 oracle=%.17g lifted=%.17g\n", va, (unsigned long long)s->calls, o, l); }
        }
    }
    uint32_t esp_after = c->esp;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < g_nshadow; k++){
        uint32_t pg = g_shadow_va[k];
        const uint32_t *o = (const uint32_t *)(g_pool + (size_t)k * PG);
        const uint32_t *l = (const uint32_t *)(g_mem + pg);
        if (!memcmp(o, l, PG)) continue;
        for (uint32_t w = 0; w < PG / 4; w++){
            if (o[w] == l[w]) continue;
            uint32_t a = pg + 4 * w;
            /* below the final stack pointer = the callee's dead locals */
            if (a < esp_after && a + 0x20000u >= esp_after){
                s->dw_stack++;
                if (getenv("NFSU2_ORACLE_LOGSTACK")) log_diff(s, s->calls, "deadstack", a, o[w], l[w]);
                continue; }
            s->dw_live++; differ = 1;
            uint32_t ov = o[w], lv = l[w];
            int b;
            if (is_floaty(ov) && is_floaty(lv) && ((ov ^ lv) >> 31) == 0){
                uint32_t ulp = ov > lv ? ov - lv : lv - ov;
                if (ulp > s->max_ulp) s->max_ulp = ulp;
                float of, lf; memcpy(&of, &ov, 4); memcpy(&lf, &lv, 4);
                double rel = fabs((double)of - (double)lf) / (fabs((double)of) > 1e-30 ? fabs((double)of) : 1e-30);
                if (rel > s->max_rel) s->max_rel = rel;
                b = ulp <= 1 ? 0 : ulp < 16 ? 1 : ulp < 256 ? 2 : ulp < 65536 ? 3 : 4;
            } else b = 5;
            s->ulp_hist[b]++;
            log_diff(s, s->calls, b == 5 ? "mem(int)" : "mem", a, ov, lv);
        }
    }
    if (differ) s->differ++; else s->identical++;
    unmap_shadow();
}

/* Runtime wrappers for lifted functions.
 *
 * The D3DX effect parameter tree was being parsed CYCLICALLY (node 0 -> 6 -> 4..8 -> 6)
 * and one past the node array's capacity (8) was requested (index 8).
 * The root cause is still open. There are two guards here:
 *   1) array bounds: return safely on an index past the capacity
 *   2) visited set: each node at most once per top-level walk
 * That way the walk terminates and the game can make progress.            */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "game.h"
#include "guest.h"
#include "guest_span.h"
#include <stdio.h>

void guest_backtrace(CPU*,int);

uint64_t g_cycle_break = 0, g_oob_node = 0, g_depth_guard = 0;
static uint64_t guard_total = 0, guard_cap = 0;
static CPU *g_guard_cpu = 0;

#ifdef __wasm__
#define HEAP_LO 0x08000000u
#define HEAP_HI 0x28000000u
#else
#define HEAP_LO 0x10000000u
#define HEAP_HI 0x2F000000u
#endif

/* Find the heap block that contains a guest address (header: +0 size, +4 signature); on wasm also in the guest
 * heap's window above the runtime (guest_span.h), whose blocks start in it */
static int block_of(uint32_t addr, uint32_t *ubeg, uint32_t *uend){
    uint32_t lo = HEAP_LO;
#ifdef __wasm__
    if (g_gwin_hi && addr >= g_gwin_lo && addr < g_gwin_hi) lo = g_gwin_lo;
    else
#endif
    if (addr < HEAP_LO || addr >= HEAP_HI) return 0;
    for (uint32_t p = (addr & ~15u); p >= lo; p -= 16u){
        if (!mem_is_committed(p+4)) return 0;
        if (MR32(p+4) == 0xA110C8EDu){
            uint32_t sz = MR32(p), beg = p + 16u, end = beg + sz;
            if (addr >= beg && addr < end){ *ubeg = beg; *uend = end; return 1; }
            return 0;
        }
        if (p < 16u) break;
    }
    return 0;
}

static void guard_hit(void){
    if (!guard_cap){ const char *e = getenv("GUARD_CAP");
                     guard_cap = e ? (uint64_t)atoll(e) : 2000000ull; }
    if (guard_total == 5000 && g_guard_cpu && getenv("GUARD_BT")){
        fprintf(stderr,"\n=== call chain at the 5000th guard hit ===\n");
        guest_backtrace(g_guard_cpu, 14);
    }
    if (++guard_total > guard_cap){
        fprintf(stderr,"\n*** GUARD CEILING (%llu) - the effect system cannot make progress.\n",
                (unsigned long long)guard_cap);
        { extern uint32_t g_watch_addr; extern void watch_dump(const char*,int);
          if (g_watch_addr) watch_dump("guard ceiling", 20); }
        { extern void (*g_report_fn)(void); if (g_report_fn) g_report_fn(); }
        _exit(6);
    }
}

/* --- shared: node array bounds + visit check ------------------------- */
typedef struct { uint64_t bits[8]; uint32_t tab; } VisSet;   /* 512 nodes */

/* The tree guard is NOW OFF BY DEFAULT.
 * The cyclic parse actually came from CPU emulation bugs (x87 rounding,
 * SSE width, adc/sbb carry...).  With those fixed the walk terminates on
 * its own; the guard is only turned on with GUARD_ON=1, and then it also
 * cuts valid nodes and breaks the tree.                                  */
static int g_guard_off = -1;
static int guard_off(void){
    if (g_guard_off < 0) g_guard_off = getenv("GUARD_ON") ? 0 : 1;
    return g_guard_off;
}

static int node_guard(CPU *c, uint32_t a1, int depth, VisSet *vs){
    if (guard_off()) return 0;
    uint32_t tab = c->ecx + 0x2cu;
    if (!mem_is_committed(tab)) return 0;
    uint32_t arr = MR32(tab), beg, end;
    if (block_of(arr, &beg, &end)){
        uint32_t cap = (end - arr) / 0x64u;
        if (a1 >= cap){ g_oob_node++; guard_hit(); return 1; }
    }
    if (depth == 0){                       /* top level: reset the set */
        for (int i=0;i<8;i++) vs->bits[i]=0;
        vs->tab = arr;
    }
    if (arr == vs->tab && a1 < 512u){
        uint64_t *w = &vs->bits[a1 >> 6]; uint64_t b = 1ull << (a1 & 63);
        if (*w & b){ g_cycle_break++; guard_hit(); return 1; }
        *w |= b;
    }
    return 0;
}

 * Node: 0x64 bytes.  +0x04 array base, +0x18/+0x1a child node indices
 * (0xFFFF = none), +0x58 type tag.                                       */
static void dump_nodes(CPU *c){

    uint32_t arr = MR32(tab), beg, end;

    uint32_t cap = (end - arr) / 0x64u;

            }

        for (int f = 0; f <= 4; f += 4){

            if (ptr && mem_is_committed(ptr+31)){

                    fputc((ch>=32&&ch<127)?ch:'.', stderr); }
                fprintf(stderr,"\n");
            }
        }
    }

        uint32_t n = arr + i*0x64u;
        if (!mem_is_committed(n+0x5C)) break;

    }

                    uint32_t sp = mem_is_committed(ap+3) ? MR32(ap) : 0; ap += 4;
                    snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s", gstr(sp));
                } else if (cv == 'c'){
                    uint32_t v = mem_is_committed(ap+3) ? MR32(ap) : 0; ap += 4;
                    snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%c", (int)(v & 0xFFu));
                } else if (cv == 'f' || cv == 'g' || cv == 'e'){
                    uint64_t lo = mem_is_committed(ap+7) ? ((uint64_t)MR32(ap) |
                                  ((uint64_t)MR32(ap+4) << 32)) : 0; ap += 8;
                    double dv; memcpy(&dv, &lo, 8);
                    snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%g", dv);
                } else {
                    uint32_t v = mem_is_committed(ap+3) ? MR32(ap) : 0; ap += 4;
                    if (cv == 'x') snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%x", v);
                    else if (cv == 'X') snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%X", v);
                    else if (cv == 'u') snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%u", v);
                    else if (cv == 'p') snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%08x", v);
                    else snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%d", (int)v);
                }
                for (const char *t2 = tmp; *t2 && o < sizeof out - 2; t2++) out[o++] = *t2;
            }
            out[o] = 0;
            fprintf(stderr, "  [game] %s%s", out,
                    (o && out[o-1] == '\n') ? "" : "\n");
            /* Inside SwitchFEngPackages ebx = the front-end package manager
             * ("this").  printf is called right at that point, so we catch the
             * pointer here for free; it is needed to force a switch. */
            if (!strncmp(out, "SwitchFEngPackages", 18)) g_fe_mgr = c->ebx;
            /* WHO triggers the screen switch?  The call chain of a successful
             * switch shows what is missing at the splash screen. */
            { const char *bt = getenv("GAMELOG_BT");
              static int nbt = 0;
              if (bt && *bt && nbt < 4 && !strncmp(out, bt, strlen(bt))){
                  nbt++; guest_backtrace(c, 16); } }
        }
    }
    sub_0050d510_orig(c);
}


/* --- Force rain (FORCERAIN) -----------------------------------------------
 * The game picks the weather at random at race start (measured: rain in ~1
 * of 8 runs); debugging a rain-specific problem needs reproducible rain.
 * Rain::Update = sub_0061f120 (__thiscall, ecx = the Rain* at eView+0x64):
 *   Rain+0x5094 target precipitation (0..1), +0x1f0 current intensity (moves
 *   toward the target), +0x509c cloud intensity.  The target is computed every
 *   frame by sub_0061e380 (if the "Rain" zone object 0x8a1f28 is active);
 *   otherwise the old target stays.
 * FORCERAIN=1 sets the target to 1.0, FORCERAIN=2 sets it to 0 (always dry).
 * FORCERAIN=3 OVERCAST sky without rain (+0x509c and its target +0x5098 = 0;
 * 1.0 = clear sky), FORCERAIN=4 overcast sky + rain.
 * Without the variable the behaviour is EXACTLY the game's.  In both builds.
 * The update itself goes through framerate.c (F6: it runs every frame above
 * 60 fps). */
static int force_rain(void){
    static int fr = -1;
    if (fr < 0){ const char *e = getenv("FORCERAIN"); fr = e ? atoi(e) : 0; }
    return fr;
}
/* --- One weather for everyone in free roam --------------------------------
 * sub_0061e380(x, y) is the rain at a place: the "Rain" zone's rain there
 * (its param 0) when v = |0.5 cos(t + x/50) + 0.5| <= the zone's threshold
 * (param 1), else 0 (sub_006134e0: t the world timer 0x7fb718 in s, the
 * angle in degrees), so the rain comes and goes in a 6-minute cycle, shifted
 * by 1 s for every 50 m along x (measured at the prologue's spot: rain 0.75
 * below v ~0.05, about 52 s of every 6 minutes, from 2:00 after a load on
 * the game's clock).  Rain::Update takes it at the camera (the drops, the
 * fog, the sound), and the car physics at each car (sub_005a4d80 and
 * sub_005aad90 through 0x5ed5d0): a grip x (1 - 0.025 x rain), as the game's
 * weather tip says.  The world timer starts at 1 s with each World
 * (0x5ff490 -> 0x576cf0), so in free roam each player had their own weather,
 * and their own grip at the same place.  Network races need nothing: every
 * client's world timer follows the race host's (0x601a60).
 * In free roam's world with free-roam multiplayer on, t is the device's UTC
 * time mod 360 s instead, the same for everyone whose clock is right (a
 * clock some seconds off only moves the rain's start and end as much).  The
 * formula and the zones stay the game's, so it rains as often and as long
 * as before; only where in the cycle a world starts changes (the game's own
 * clock started each load at the same point).  Solo, races, the Dyno Shop
 * and LAN keep the game's clock. */
int roam_game_shared_weather(void);       /* roam_game.c: free roam's world with free-roam multiplayer on */
#define A_WORLD_T   0x007fb718u           /* WorldTimer in seconds (float) */
static float shared_weather_t(void){
    static uint32_t at = ~0u; static float t;
    uint32_t tick = MR32(G_WORLDTIMER);
    if (tick != at){                      /* the clock once a step: the car physics asks once per car */
        struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
        t = (float)((double)(ts.tv_sec % 360) + (double)ts.tv_nsec * 1e-9);
        at = tick;
    }
    return t;
}
void sub_0061e380_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_0061e380(CPU *c){
    if (roam_game_shared_weather()){
        float own = MRF32(A_WORLD_T);
        MRF32(A_WORLD_T) = shared_weather_t();
        sub_0061e380_orig(c);
        MRF32(A_WORLD_T) = own;
    } else sub_0061e380_orig(c);
    int fr = force_rain();
    if (fr == 1 || fr == 4) ST(0) = 1.0; else if (fr == 2 || fr == 3) ST(0) = 0.0;
}
void hfr_rain_update(CPU *c);          /* framerate.c: sub_0061f120_orig at any frame rate */
/* photo mode's Weather (photo.c): -1 as the game has it, 0 dry, 1 rain; and whether its world stands.  Forced, the rain
 * is what the photo asks at once (its strength +0x1F0 too, which only eases while the world runs).  In a world that
 * stands the update would do nothing (a world step of 0 is under its gate), so it runs on a step so short that the
 * drops hang where they are (framerate.c scales their moves by it) but the rain's look is made; and the first frames
 * after rain is asked, on a 60 fps step each, so that there are drops to hang. */
void sub_0061f120_orig(CPU *c);
int photo_weather(void);
int photo_stands(void);
#define RAIN_PRIME  40
static void photo_rain(CPU *c, uint32_t rain){
    static int was = -1, prime;
    int pw = photo_weather();
    if (pw != was){ prime = pw == 1 ? RAIN_PRIME : 0; was = pw; }
    MRF32(rain + 0x5094u) = (float)pw; MRF32(rain + 0x1f0u) = (float)pw;
    if (pw == 1){ MRF32(rain + 0x5098u) = 0.0f; MRF32(rain + 0x509cu) = 0.0f; }   /* an overcast sky with it */
    if (!photo_stands()){ hfr_rain_update(c); return; }
    float dt = MRF32(G_WORLDDT);
    uint32_t ret = MR32(c->esp);
    for (; prime > 0; prime--){                 /* (the call pops its return: pushed again for the next) */
        MRF32(G_WORLDDT) = 1.f / 60.f; c->ecx = rain;
        sub_0061f120_orig(c);
        c->esp -= 4u; MR32(c->esp) = ret;
        MRF32(rain + 0x1f0u) = (float)pw;
    }
    MRF32(G_WORLDDT) = 1e-4f; c->ecx = rain;
    hfr_rain_update(c);
    MRF32(G_WORLDDT) = dt;
}
void sub_0061f120(CPU *c){
    void split_rain_begin(CPU *); void split_rain_end(void);
    split_rain_begin(c);
    uint32_t rain = c->ecx;
    int fr = force_rain();
    if (rain && mem_is_committed(rain + 0x50a3u) && photo_weather() >= 0){ photo_rain(c, rain); split_rain_end(); return; }
    if (fr && rain && mem_is_committed(rain + 0x50a3u))
        MRF32(rain + 0x5094u) = (fr == 1 || fr == 4) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
    hfr_rain_update(c);
    if (fr >= 3 && rain && mem_is_committed(rain + 0x50a3u)){
        MRF32(rain + 0x5098u) = 0.0f; MRF32(rain + 0x509cu) = 0.0f; }
    split_rain_end();
}

/* --- Force the sky transition (FORCETOD) ----------------------------------
 * sub_0060faa0 = time-of-day / sky state machine (every frame while the game
 * state is 6).  A 300 s cycle on the world timer 0x7fb718 (s):
 * if (int)timer % 300 == 60 and state 0x8a1c8c == 0 it moves to state 2 and
 * the sky transition (skymorph.efx: sunset -> night) starts.  Test runs last
 * ~60 s, so they only hit this transition now and then (measured: ~1 in 8
 * runs), and the HD build got very slow when they did.
 * FORCETOD=1 triggers the transition at the first chance; FORCETOD=<frame count>
 * after that many calls.  Unset, the behaviour is EXACTLY the game's.  In both builds. */
void sub_0060faa0_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_0060faa0(CPU *c){
    static int ft = -1, done = 0; static long calls = 0;
    if (ft < 0){ const char *e = getenv("FORCETOD"); ft = e ? atoi(e) : 0; }
    if (ft > 0 && !done && MR32(G_FLOW) == 6u && MR32(0x8a1c78u) != 0u && ++calls >= ft &&
        MR32(0x8a1c8cu) == 0u){
        static int st = -1;
        if (st < 0){ const char *e = getenv("FORCETOD_STATE"); st = e ? atoi(e) : 2; if (st < 1 || st > 4) st = 2; }
        MR32(0x8a1c8cu) = (uint32_t)st; done = 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[FORCETOD] sky state forced to %d (call %ld)\n", st, calls);
    }
    sub_0060faa0_orig(c);
}

/* --- sub_005c7ec0: per-view camera/projection setup ---------------------
 * __thiscall(ecx = matrix struct, [esp+4] = eView*), ret 0x10.
 *   eView+0x04 = view id (1 main, 3 rear-view mirror, 4 road reflection)
 *   eView+0x40 = Camera*  (CameraParams: +0xbc NearZ, +0xc0 FarZ, +0xc4 FOV)
 *   ecx+0x00 view matrix, +0x40 projection, +0x80 their product
 * The game only passes identity matrices to SetTransform; the camera can only
 * be read here.  The address is captured and (in the HD build) the main
 * view's matrices are recorded into the frame.  In the original build
 * enh_view_setup is an empty inline function.  The web build keeps the
 * headlight view's (9) for the other cars' lights (headlights.c), and turns
 * the view against a phone's tilt (below). */
#ifdef __wasm__
/* The touch controls' level horizon (web/src/app/touch.ts): while tilt
 * steers, the main view (1) and its road reflection (4, laid over it in
 * screen space) turn against the phone's tilt, about the camera's forward
 * axis, so the road's horizon stays level with the real one; the HUD stays
 * on the phone.  The camera's matrix is turned for the length of the call:
 * the view matrix copied from it (0x4012b0), the product and the culling
 * planes made of that agree, and whatever reads the camera itself keeps the
 * game's.  The game's view space has y down (the projection's P11 is
 * negative), so this turns the picture anticlockwise for a + roll.  Photo
 * mode's tilt turns it the same way, and its field of view (camera +0xC4, a
 * binary angle) stands in for the camera's for the call (photo.c).  So does
 * its frame's shift for a still picture: the eye moved along the view's x
 * and y (the camera's matrix, its translation row, for the call), then the
 * projection sheared after (its third row: x and y go by that much times the
 * depth) so that the picture moves within a pixel and what is at the focus
 * distance F stays where it was (the eye's move a goes back by a * P00 / F),
 * and the product made again (the view times the projection).  photo.c
 * gives the lens's point as where far away lands (a part of the view's half
 * width): the eye's move a is that times F / P00, the same scale for y, so
 * the blur is round on the screen.  Photo mode's lens shift moves the
 * picture's middle (the projection's third row again, before the frame's
 * shift), the game drawing wider for it (photo.c gives a wider field of view
 * and how much: the projection is made that much bigger again, so what the
 * shift brings in was not culled); a picture in tiles makes the projection N
 * times as big and moves it so that one tile fills the screen (its x and y
 * columns times N, then a move of the third row).  P00 for the lens's eye move
 * is the picture's (pic_p00: the projection without the tiles'). */
float input_view_roll(void);
int photo_view(uint16_t *fov, float *roll, float *jit);
void look_view(uint32_t id, uint32_t cam);  /* look.c: the right stick's look round the car turns the camera */
static float pic_p00;                       /* the picture's P00 (without the tiles'), for the next frame's lens */
static void photo_shear(uint32_t plat, const float *j){
    float *V = (float *)(g_mem + plat), *Pr = V + 16, *M = V + 32;
    float p00 = Pr[0], p11 = Pr[5], p23 = Pr[11];
    static int said;
    if (!said){                     /* once: the product is the view times the projection, as made here */
        float e = 0.f;
        for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
            e = fmaxf(e, fabsf(M[r * 4 + k] - (V[r * 4] * Pr[k] + V[r * 4 + 1] * Pr[4 + k] + V[r * 4 + 2] * Pr[8 + k] + V[r * 4 + 3] * Pr[12 + k])));
        said = 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[photo] the view's product made again: %s (off by %g); P00 %.3f P11 %.3f P23 %.3f\n",
                e < 1e-3f ? "as the game's" : "NOT as the game's", (double)e, (double)p00, (double)p11, (double)p23);
    }
    /* the lens shift: the game drew j[7] times wider; the picture's middle to (j[5], j[6]) (x right, y up) */
    float k = j[7] >= 1.f ? j[7] : 1.f, n = j[8] >= 1.f ? j[8] : 1.f;
    float ox = -j[5], oy = -j[6];
    /* a tile: column j[9] of n from the left, row j[10] from the top; the whole picture's x and y n times as big, moved
     * so that the tile's middle is the screen's */
    float tx = n > 1.f ? 2.f * j[9] + 1.f - n : 0.f, ty = n > 1.f ? n - 2.f * j[10] - 1.f : 0.f;
    for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++){ Pr[r * 4] *= k * n; Pr[r * 4 + 1] *= k * n; }
    Pr[8] += (n * ox - tx) * p23; Pr[12] += (n * ox - tx) * Pr[15];
    Pr[9] += (n * oy - ty) * p23; Pr[13] += (n * oy - ty) * Pr[15];
    pic_p00 = p00 * k;
    p00 = Pr[0]; p11 = Pr[5];
    Pr[8] += j[0] * p23 + (j[4] > 0.f ? j[2] * p00 / j[4] : 0.f);
    Pr[9] += j[1] * p23 + (j[4] > 0.f ? j[3] * p11 / j[4] : 0.f);
    for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
        M[r * 4 + k] = V[r * 4] * Pr[k] + V[r * 4 + 1] * Pr[4 + k] + V[r * 4 + 2] * Pr[8 + k] + V[r * 4 + 3] * Pr[12 + k];
}
static void view_roll(uint32_t m, float a){
    float c = cosf(a), s = sinf(a);
    for (uint32_t r = m; r < m + 0x40u; r += 0x10u){
        float x = MRF32(r), y = MRF32(r + 4u);
        MRF32(r) = x * c + y * s;
        MRF32(r + 4u) = y * c - x * s;
    }
}
#endif
void sub_005c7ec0_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_005c7ec0(CPU *c){
    uint32_t plat = c->ecx, view = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
#ifdef __wasm__
    uint32_t cam = 0, fcam = 0; uint8_t keep[0x40]; uint16_t fov = 0, fkeep = 0;
    float pj[11] = { 0 };
    int shift = 0;
    if (view && mem_is_committed(view + 0x43u) && (MR32(view + 4u) == 1u || MR32(view + 4u) == 4u)){
        look_view(MR32(view + 4u), MR32(view + 0x40u));     /* till after Present, for everything drawn */
        float a = input_view_roll(), pr = 0.f;
        if (photo_view(&fov, &pr, pj)){
            a += pr;
            fcam = MR32(view + 0x40u);
            if (fcam && mem_is_committed(fcam + 0xc5u)){ fkeep = MR16(fcam + 0xc4u); MR16(fcam + 0xc4u) = fov; }
            else fcam = 0;
            shift = (pj[0] != 0.f || pj[1] != 0.f || pj[2] != 0.f || pj[3] != 0.f || pj[5] != 0.f || pj[6] != 0.f || pj[8] > 1.f)
                    && plat && mem_is_committed(plat + 0xbfu);
        }
        cam = a != 0.f || shift ? MR32(view + 0x40u) : 0u;
        if (cam && mem_is_committed(cam + 0x3fu)){
            memcpy(keep, g_mem + cam, sizeof keep);
            if (a != 0.f) view_roll(cam, a);
            if (shift){
                /* the lens's point (far away's move, in half widths) as the eye's move in metres, round in the view:
                 * times the focus distance over the projection's x scale (the view's own, as the last frame made it) */
                float p00 = pic_p00 > 0.f ? pic_p00 : MRF32(plat + 0x40u), s = p00 > 0.05f && p00 < 50.f && pj[4] > 0.f ? pj[4] / p00 : 0.f;
                pj[2] *= s; pj[3] *= s;
                MRF32(cam + 0x30u) -= pj[2]; MRF32(cam + 0x34u) -= pj[3];
            }
        }
        else { cam = 0; shift = 0; }
    }
    sub_005c7ec0_orig(c);
    if (shift) photo_shear(plat, pj);
    if (cam) memcpy(g_mem + cam, keep, sizeof keep);
    if (fcam) MR16(fcam + 0xc4u) = fkeep;
#else
    sub_005c7ec0_orig(c);
#endif
    if (view && plat && mem_is_committed(view + 0x43u) && mem_is_committed(plat + 0xbfu)){
        enh_view_setup(MR32(view + 4u), (const float *)(g_mem + plat),
                       MR32(view + 0x40u));
#ifdef __wasm__
        void headlights_view(uint32_t id, const float *plat);
        headlights_view(MR32(view + 4u), (const float *)(g_mem + plat));
#endif
    }
}


/* --- sub_0075bed4: the CRT's _ftol2 ---------------------------------------
 * ST(0) -> int64 in edx:eax, truncated toward zero; pops ST(0).  The hottest
 * lifted function on both ports (3.4 % of the Mac's race frame; 2.3 % in
 * Chrome).  It
 * rounds with fistp in the control word's RC, takes the difference (rounded
 * through X87R at PC=24), stores it as a float and adds or subtracts its sign
 * bit as a carry.  The wasm build runs this equivalent of the lifted body:
 * the same edx:eax, ecx, flags, x87 slots and top, esp and eip; only the
 * scratch stores below the caller's esp (its own frame) are not made.
 * tests/main_all.c section 6 checks it against the lifted body.  The Mac
 * keeps the lifted body (one forwarding call). */
void sub_0075bed4_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_0075bed4(CPU *restrict c){
#ifdef __wasm__
    FTOL2_BODY(c);                                          /* cpu.h */
    POP32(c->eip);
#else
    sub_0075bed4_orig(c);
#endif
}

/* --- the view-frustum box test ---------------------------------------------
 * sub_005bc210(M, lo, hi), cdecl: the box lo..hi (3 floats each, in and out)
 * through the matrix M (rows 0-2, translation in row 3), min and max per
 * axis summed term by term.  sub_005bc300(lo, hi, M), thiscall, ret 0xC: the
 * box (through M when M is not 0) against the six planes (n.x n.y n.z d) at
 * [ecx] + 0xC0: 0 outside one of them, 1 crossing one, 2 inside all.
 * sub_0048ac60 is a jmp to it that the lift copies whole.  The three were
 * ~6 % of a race frame in Chrome: run per object, with the x87 stack in
 * memory and every result tested.
 * On wasm they run in f32 here: at PC=24 and RC=nearest the x87 rounds each
 * result to 24 bits once, as f32 arithmetic does, while the result is a
 * normal float or zero (the lifted X87R gives the same: for float operands
 * the double result rounded to float is the correctly rounded one).  Every
 * result is checked for that; anything else (a NaN, an infinity, a float
 * subnormal, another control word) runs the lifted body from the untouched
 * state.  Same registers, flags, x87 top and condition bits, outputs and
 * stores at or above the caller's esp as the lifted bodies; not the scratch
 * stores below it, nor the x87 slots they leave empty.  tests/main_all.c
 * section 7 checks them against the lifted bodies.  The Mac keeps those. */
void sub_005bc210_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_005bc300_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_0048ac60_orig(CPU *c);
uint64_t g_cull_lifted;            /* calls that ran the lifted body (tests) */
#ifdef __wasm__
/* the x87 at PC=24 has this result too: a normal float or zero */
static inline uint32_t cull_ok(float x){
    float a = __builtin_fabsf(x);
    return (uint32_t)(x == 0.0f) | ((uint32_t)(a >= 0x1p-126f) & (uint32_t)(a <= 0x1.fffffep127f));
}
/* sub_005bc210's arithmetic on lo/hi (in place); 0 if the lifted body must
 * run.  *cmp: its last fcom (row 2, column 2: lo product vs hi product),
 * *pb: the hi product it stored in its first argument's slot then. */
static int cull_xform(uint32_t M, float lo[3], float hi[3], int *cmp, float *pb_last){
    float mn[3], mx[3], pa = 0, pb = 0;
    uint32_t ok = 1;
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) mn[j] = mx[j] = MRF32(M + 0x30u + 4u * (uint32_t)j);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++){
            float m = MRF32(M + 16u * (uint32_t)i + 4u * (uint32_t)j);
            pa = lo[i] * m; pb = hi[i] * m;
            if (pa < pb){ mn[j] += pa; mx[j] += pb; } else { mn[j] += pb; mx[j] += pa; }
            ok &= cull_ok(pa) & cull_ok(pb) & cull_ok(mn[j]) & cull_ok(mx[j]);
        }
    if (!ok) return 0;
    *cmp = pa < pb ? -1 : pa > pb ? 1 : 0; *pb_last = pb;
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++){ lo[j] = mn[j]; hi[j] = mx[j]; }
    return 1;
}
static void cull_fsw(CPU *restrict c, int cmp){
    c->fsw &= (uint16_t)~(FSW_C0 | FSW_C2 | FSW_C3);
    if (cmp < 0) c->fsw |= FSW_C0; else if (cmp == 0) c->fsw |= FSW_C3;
}
static int xform_native(CPU *restrict c){
    if (c->fcw & 0x0F00u) return 0;
    uint32_t e = c->esp, M = MR32(e + 4u), A = MR32(e + 8u), B = MR32(e + 12u);
    float lo[3], hi[3]; int cmp; float pb;
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++){ lo[j] = MRF32(A + 4u * (uint32_t)j); hi[j] = MRF32(B + 4u * (uint32_t)j); }
    if (!cull_xform(M, lo, hi, &cmp, &pb)) return 0;
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++){ MRF32(A + 4u * (uint32_t)j) = lo[j]; MRF32(B + 4u * (uint32_t)j) = hi[j]; }
    MRF32(e + 4u) = pb;                                   /* its fstp [esp+0x20] scratch */
    cull_fsw(c, cmp);
    c->eax = (M & 0xffff0000u) | fsw_get_top(c, ((uint32_t)c->top - 7u) & 7u);   /* fnstsw ax */
    c->ecx = A + 12u; c->edx = M + 0x38u;
    { uint32_t a = e - 12u, r = e; FLAGS_ADD_M(a, 0xcu, r, 32, F_ALL); }         /* add esp, 0xc */
    POP32(c->eip);
    return 1;
}
static int frustum_native(CPU *restrict c){
    if (c->fcw & 0x0F00u) return 0;
    uint32_t e = c->esp, P1 = MR32(e + 4u), P2 = MR32(e + 8u), M = MR32(e + 12u);
    float lo[3], hi[3], C[3], H[3]; int cmp; float pb;
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++){ lo[j] = MRF32(P1 + 4u * (uint32_t)j); hi[j] = MRF32(P2 + 4u * (uint32_t)j); }
    if (M && !cull_xform(M, lo, hi, &cmp, &pb)) return 0;
    float half = MRF32(0x00784260u), K = MRF32(0x007d7d3cu);
    uint32_t ok = 1;
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++){
        float s = hi[j] + lo[j]; C[j] = s * half; H[j] = hi[j] - C[j];
        ok &= cull_ok(s) & cull_ok(C[j]) & cull_ok(H[j]);
    }
    if (!ok) return 0;
    uint32_t base = MR32(c->ecx), p = base + 0xc0u, inter = 0;
    int k, last = 0;
    for (k = 0; k < 6; k++, p += 16u){
        float nx = MRF32(p), ny = MRF32(p + 4u), nz = MRF32(p + 8u), d = MRF32(p + 12u);
        float r1 = __builtin_fabsf(nz) * H[2], r2 = __builtin_fabsf(nx) * H[0], r3 = __builtin_fabsf(ny) * H[1];
        float r12 = r1 + r2, r = r12 + r3;
        float s1 = C[2] * nz, s2 = C[0] * nx, s3 = C[1] * ny;
        float s12 = s1 + s2, s123 = s12 + s3, s = s123 + d, sp = s + r;
        if (!(cull_ok(r1) & cull_ok(r2) & cull_ok(r3) & cull_ok(r12) & cull_ok(r) & cull_ok(s1) & cull_ok(s2)
              & cull_ok(s3) & cull_ok(s12) & cull_ok(s123) & cull_ok(s) & cull_ok(sp))) return 0;
        if (sp < K) break;                                /* outside this plane */
        float sm = s - r;
        if (!cull_ok(sm)) return 0;
        if (sm < K) inter = 1;
        last = sm < K ? -1 : sm > K ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (k < 6){                                           /* fcomp; ...; fstp st0; xor eax, eax */
        cull_fsw(c, -1);
        c->eax = 0; c->ecx = base + 0xc4u + 16u * (uint32_t)k; c->edx = (uint32_t)k + 1u;
        FLAGS_LOG_M(0u, 32, F_ALL);
    } else {                                              /* test esi, esi; sete al; inc eax */
        cull_fsw(c, last);
        uint32_t a = inter ? 0u : 1u, r = a + 1u;
        c->eax = r; c->ecx = base + 0xc4u + 0x60u; c->edx = 7u;
        FLAGS_LOG_M(inter, 32, F_ALL);
        { uint32_t cf = c->cf; FLAGS_ADD_M(a, 1u, r, 32, F_ALL); c->cf = cf; }
    }
    POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 12u;
    return 1;
}
#endif
void sub_005bc210(CPU *restrict c){
#ifdef __wasm__
    if (xform_native(c)) return;
#endif
    g_cull_lifted++;
    sub_005bc210_orig(c);
}
static int g_pc_watch;             /* sub_005c5930's PARTCULL=2 check: count the parts found outside */
static uint32_t g_pc_out;
void sub_005bc300(CPU *restrict c){
#ifdef __wasm__
    if (frustum_native(c)){ if (g_pc_watch && !c->eax) g_pc_out++; return; }
#endif
    g_cull_lifted++;
    sub_005bc300_orig(c);
    if (g_pc_watch && !c->eax) g_pc_out++;
}
void sub_0048ac60(CPU *restrict c){
#ifdef __wasm__
    if (frustum_native(c)) return;
#endif
    g_cull_lifted++;
    sub_0048ac60_orig(c);
}
/* --- sub_005c5930: a model's parts into the render lists --------------------
 * (item, M, a3, flags, a5), thiscall (the view), ret 0x14.  The model
 * [[item+0xC]] has [+0x10] parts of 0x3C bytes at [+0x14] (a box: lo at +0,
 * hi at +0x10; +0x38 bit 0: never tested), and each is tested against the
 * view (sub_005bc300(lo, hi, M) above: 0 outside, then left out) unless
 * flags has bit 2.  ~30 models a car, tested part by part.  When the box
 * round all of a model's tested parts is inside every plane of the view by
 * a margin, so is each part's box (the same M), and the game's test of each
 * would pass it: the model goes in with bit 2, its parts untested (7 models
 * in 10 among 48 friends' cars, 4 parts each: ~0.2 ms a frame less).
 * Anything else is tested as before.
 * PARTCULL=0 off; PARTCULL=2 checks: such a model is tested as before, and
 * a part found outside is counted ([partcull] lines). */
void sub_005c5930_orig(CPU *c);
static int g_pc_on = -1;
static uint64_t g_pc_models, g_pc_fast, g_pc_parts, g_pc_bad;
/* the box lo..hi, through M when M is not 0, inside the six planes at [th]+0xC0
 * (n.x n.y n.z d; inside: n.p + d >= [0x7D7D3C] over the whole box) by a margin */
static int pc_inside(uint32_t th, uint32_t M, const float lo[3], const float hi[3]){
    float C[3], H[3], c0[3], h0[3];
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++){ c0[j] = (hi[j] + lo[j]) * 0.5f; h0[j] = (hi[j] - lo[j]) * 0.5f; }
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++){
        if (!M){ C[j] = c0[j]; H[j] = h0[j]; continue; }
        float cc = MRF32(M + 0x30u + 4u * (uint32_t)j), hh = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++){
            float m = MRF32(M + 16u * (uint32_t)i + 4u * (uint32_t)j);
            cc += c0[i] * m; hh += h0[i] * __builtin_fabsf(m);
        }
        C[j] = cc; H[j] = hh;
    }
    float K = MRF32(0x007d7d3cu);
    uint32_t p = MR32(th) + 0xc0u;
    for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++, p += 16u){
        float nx = MRF32(p), ny = MRF32(p + 4u), nz = MRF32(p + 8u), d = MRF32(p + 12u);
        float s = C[0] * nx + C[1] * ny + C[2] * nz + d;
        float r = __builtin_fabsf(nx) * H[0] + __builtin_fabsf(ny) * H[1] + __builtin_fabsf(nz) * H[2];
        float tol = 0.01f + 1e-5f * (__builtin_fabsf(s) + r + __builtin_fabsf(d));   /* the game's float rounding, with room */
        if (!(s - r > K + tol)) return 0;                                            /* (a NaN too) */
    }
    return 1;
}
int g_carpaint_watch;                            /* carpaint.c's test aid ("roam mp paint on"): each model drawn checked */
__attribute__((weak)) void carpaint_model(uint32_t mdl);
static void partcull_draw(CPU *c){
    if (g_pc_on < 0){ const char *e = getenv("PARTCULL"); g_pc_on = e ? atoi(e) : 1; }
    uint32_t e = c->esp, item = MR32(e + 4u), fl = MR32(e + 16u);
    uint32_t W = g_pc_on && item && !(fl & 4u) ? MR32(item + 0xcu) : 0;
    uint32_t mdl = W ? MR32(W) : 0, n = mdl ? MR32(mdl + 0x10u) : 0, parts = n ? MR32(mdl + 0x14u) : 0;
    if (!parts || n < 2u || n > 4096u){ sub_005c5930_orig(c); return; }
    float lo[3] = { 1e30f, 1e30f, 1e30f }, hi[3] = { -1e30f, -1e30f, -1e30f };
    uint32_t tested = 0, fin = 1;
    for (uint32_t i = 0, p = parts; i < n; i++, p += 0x3cu){
        if (MR8(p + 0x38u) & 1u) continue;
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++){
            float a = MRF32(p + 4u * (uint32_t)j), b = MRF32(p + 0x10u + 4u * (uint32_t)j);
            fin &= (uint32_t)(__builtin_fabsf(a) < 1e30f) & (uint32_t)(__builtin_fabsf(b) < 1e30f);
            if (a < lo[j]) lo[j] = a;
            if (b > hi[j]) hi[j] = b;
        }
        tested++;
    }
    g_pc_models++;
    if (tested < 2u || !fin || !pc_inside(c->ecx, MR32(e + 8u), lo, hi)){ sub_005c5930_orig(c); return; }
    g_pc_fast++; g_pc_parts += tested;
    if (g_pc_on == 2){
        uint32_t out0 = g_pc_out;
        g_pc_watch = 1; sub_005c5930_orig(c); g_pc_watch = 0;
        if (g_pc_out != out0){
            g_pc_bad += g_pc_out - out0;
            fprintf(stderr, "[partcull] model %08x: %u of %u part(s) outside, taken as inside\n", mdl, g_pc_out - out0, tested);
        }
        if ((g_pc_fast & 0x3ffffu) == 0)
            fprintf(stderr, "[partcull] %llu models, %llu inside (%llu parts not tested), %llu wrong\n", (unsigned long long)g_pc_models,
                    (unsigned long long)g_pc_fast, (unsigned long long)g_pc_parts, (unsigned long long)g_pc_bad);
        return;
    }
    MR32(e + 16u) = fl | 4u;
    sub_005c5930_orig(c);
}
/* A car with a license plate of its own (plates.c) puts that plate's texture in the model's texture table for as long
 * as the model goes into the render lists, which keep it; the table has the game's back after, for the next car */
void plates_model(uint32_t item, uint32_t keep[2]);
void sub_005c5930(CPU *c){
    uint32_t keep[2];
    if (g_carpaint_watch && carpaint_model) carpaint_model(MR32(c->esp + 4u));
    plates_model(MR32(c->esp + 4u), keep);
    partcull_draw(c);
    if (keep[0]) MR32(keep[0]) = keep[1];
}

/* --- sub_0068ce7c: D3DXMatrixMultiply, the SSE version ---------------------
 * (out, a, b), stdcall: out = a * b, 4x4 floats, returns out.  D3DX calls it
 * through its CPU table for every matrix product: 2.7 % of a race frame in
 * Chrome, where the lift does each packed operation lane by lane through the
 * SSE NaN rule.  On wasm it runs here as f32x4 operations in the same order
 * (row 0 (a0 b0 + a1 b1) + (a2 b2 + a3 b3), rows 1 and 2 summed left to
 * right, row 3 as row 0): IEEE results like SSE's, denormals included (the
 * game leaves MXCSR at its default).  A NaN anywhere runs the lifted body
 * (wasm does not keep SSE's NaN operand order).  The same memory, eax, ecx,
 * edx and xmm0-7 as the lifted body; tests/main_all.c section 8 checks it.
 * The Mac keeps the lifted body. */
void sub_0068ce7c_orig(CPU *c);
uint64_t g_mmul_lifted;            /* calls that ran the lifted body (tests) */
void sub_0068ce7c(CPU *restrict c){
#ifdef __wasm__
#pragma clang fp contract(off)
    typedef float v4 __attribute__((vector_size(16), aligned(4)));
    uint32_t e = c->esp, out = MR32(e + 4u), A = MR32(e + 8u), B = MR32(e + 12u);
    v4 r0, r1, r2, r3; float a[16];
    memcpy(&r0, g_mem + B, 16); memcpy(&r1, g_mem + B + 16u, 16);
    memcpy(&r2, g_mem + B + 32u, 16); memcpy(&r3, g_mem + B + 48u, 16);
    memcpy(a, g_mem + A, 64);
#define BC(x_) ((v4){ (x_), (x_), (x_), (x_) })
    v4 o0 = (BC(a[0]) * r0 + BC(a[1]) * r1) + (BC(a[2]) * r2 + BC(a[3]) * r3);
    v4 o1 = ((BC(a[4]) * r0 + BC(a[5]) * r1) + BC(a[6]) * r2) + BC(a[7]) * r3;
    v4 o2 = ((BC(a[8]) * r0 + BC(a[9]) * r1) + BC(a[10]) * r2) + BC(a[11]) * r3;
    v4 p0 = r0 * BC(a[12]), p1 = r1 * BC(a[13]), p3 = r3 * BC(a[15]), q = r2 * BC(a[14]) + p3;
    v4 o3 = (p0 + p1) + q;
    __typeof__(o0 != o0) nan = (o0 != o0) | (o1 != o1) | (o2 != o2) | (o3 != o3);
    if (!(nan[0] | nan[1] | nan[2] | nan[3])){
        memcpy(g_mem + out, &o0, 16); memcpy(g_mem + out + 16u, &o1, 16);
        memcpy(g_mem + out + 32u, &o2, 16); memcpy(g_mem + out + 48u, &o3, 16);
        v4 x7 = BC(a[15]);
        memcpy(&c->xmm[0], &o3, 16); memcpy(&c->xmm[1], &p1, 16); memcpy(&c->xmm[2], &q, 16); memcpy(&c->xmm[3], &p3, 16);
        memcpy(&c->xmm[4], &o0, 16); memcpy(&c->xmm[5], &o1, 16); memcpy(&c->xmm[6], &o2, 16); memcpy(&c->xmm[7], &x7, 16);
        c->eax = out; c->ecx = B; c->edx = out;
        POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 12u;
        return;
    }
#undef BC
    g_mmul_lifted++;
#endif
    sub_0068ce7c_orig(c);
}

/* --- UI_ChoosePerformancePackage: a field the game never initialises ------
 * The Performance Shop's package screen (vtable 0x79D2D0, 0x250 bytes from
 * operator new, constructor sub_00559c90) never writes its field +0xC0, but
 * its refresh method sub_005620d0 -- first called from inside the
 * constructor (0x556E60 -> 0x557119) -- reads it: -10 or 1 there means
 * "close the parts list and open it again".  The field holds whatever the
 * heap block held before (0xEEEEEEEE in a fresh block; 1 after some heap
 * histories: movies played, 60 fps or a slow frame rate).  With 1, entering
 * a category whose carousel starts at "Choose Individual Parts" (Nitrous
 * Oxide) opens UI_BuyPerformanceParts twice; the first one is popped at once,
 * the package screen stays hidden with control mask 0 under the second, and
 * after ESC no screen takes input: the shop is dead until Cmd-Q
 * (+0xC0 = 1 at sub_005620d0's first call, 0xC3ED0000 in the good run;
 * the mouse position plays no part).  Nothing else in the game reads or writes the
 * field (all accesses in 0x540000..0x575000), so the screen is given the
 * value of a fresh block before its constructor runs: the parts list opens
 * once, both screens keep input, and ESC goes back to the categories, as in
 * every run where the stale value was not -10 or 1. */
void sub_00559c90_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_00559c90(CPU *c){
    uint32_t self = c->ecx;
    if (self && mem_is_committed(self) && mem_is_committed(self + 0xc3u))
        MR32(self + 0xc0u) = 0xEEEEEEEEu;
    sub_00559c90_orig(c);
}

/* --- sub_004e8b70: the memory card screen's profile name, never initialised ---
 * The memory card screen (MC_Main.fng: constructor 0x4F3320, 0x9C bytes from
 * operator new, then this base constructor, thiscall, ret 4) keeps a
 * profile's name at +0x6C, 32 bytes.  The Save question shows it ("Are you
 * sure you want to save the profile named %s?", 0x4A3C10), and the save
 * makes it the profile's name (states 6 and 7 of 0x4E8D30: 0x4E8ED4 and
 * 0x4E8F17 copy it into 0x83A9E0 with 0x502F40) before the file is written
 * under it.  Most ways into the save copy the profile's name there first
 * (0x4F3462, 0x4F35FC, 0x4FD694); those through state 2 do not (0x4FD658:
 * message 0xDC12AF2E, which 0x4C6457 sends when a memory card operation
 * fails; 0x4FBA5F), and the field holds what the heap block held before.
 * The PC game's heap mostly gives the screen the block the last one left,
 * name and all; ours does not.  A cover shoot (DVD or magazine) whose save
 * failed, its new 1 MB file not written in a browser whose storage was full,
 * went on to the profile's save that way: the question showed the heap's
 * bytes as the name (eight heap addresses, 2026-10-27 report; 32 0xEF bytes,
 * a later one) and Yes renamed the profile to them and saved it in a folder
 * of that name (tests/scripts/career_cover_name.txt).  The field now starts
 * as the profile's name (zeros with none loaded), as the old block held it;
 * the ways that put another name there still do.  NFSU2_TEST_MC_STALE=1
 * (test aid): the game's way, the field holding 0xEF bytes. */
#define MC_NAME         0x6cu         /* the screen's profile name, 32 bytes */
void sub_004e8b70_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_004e8b70(CPU *c){
    static int stale = -1;
    if (stale < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_TEST_MC_STALE"); stale = e && *e == '1'; }
    uint32_t self = c->ecx;
    sub_004e8b70_orig(c);
    if (!self || !mem_is_committed(self + MC_NAME) || !mem_is_committed(self + MC_NAME + 31u)) return;
    int named = MR8(G_PROFILE_NAME + 0x20u) != 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 32u; i++)
        MR8(self + MC_NAME + i) = stale ? 0xefu : named ? MR8(G_PROFILE_NAME + i) : 0u;
}

/* --- sub_004ff3b0: a first profile's name box starts with Your name ---
 * The game's one text entry (0x83A7B0, input_web.c) is set up here (thiscall,
 * ret 0x10: record, kind, text, most): the text goes to +0x100 (what is
 * typed, and shown) and +0 (what it started with), its length to +0x200.  A
 * new profile's name (0x556490: kind 6, letters and digits, 7 at most) starts
 * with the game's text 0x818F0385, NAME in English (empty in some
 * languages), and typing goes after it: hundreds of players kept NAME.  When
 * the page finds no profile in the save folder it passes the name the player
 * typed under Your name as NFSU2_NEW_PROFILE_NAME (shell.ts; never the digits
