/* ---- our text ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* text if it is a plate's (n capitals and digits) and reads as no slur, else none */
static void take(char *dst, const char *text, const char *from){
    size_t n = text ? strlen(text) : 0;
    if (n > RC_PLATE_MAX || !rc_plate_ok(text, (uint32_t)n)){ fprintf(stderr, "[plates] %s: not a plate (capitals and digits, at most %d): none\n", from, RC_PLATE_MAX); n = 0; }
    else if (n && name_plate_blocked(text)){ fprintf(stderr, "[plates] %s reads as a slur: none\n", from); n = 0; }
    if (n) memcpy(dst, text, n);
    dst[n] = 0;
}
/* our plate's text, "" the game's own: NFSU2_LICENSE_PLATE, as the game started */
const char *plates_mine(void){
    if (!g_mine_read){
        g_mine_read = 1;
        take(g_mine, getenv("NFSU2_LICENSE_PLATE"), "NFSU2_LICENSE_PLATE");
        if (g_mine[0]) fprintf(stderr, "[plates] ours: %s\n", g_mine);
    }
    return g_mine;
}

/* roam_game.c, each frame: friend k's car (0: none shown) and its player's plate ("" the game's own) */
void plates_friend(int k, uint32_t car, const char *text){
    if (k < 0 || k >= FRIENDS) return;
    g_friend[k].car = car && text && text[0] ? car : 0;
    snprintf(g_friend[k].text, sizeof g_friend[k].text, "%s", g_friend[k].car ? text : "");
}
/* roam_game.c: the world went, every friend's car with it */
void plates_forget(void){
    for (int k = 0; k < FRIENDS; k++){ g_friend[k].car = 0; g_friend[k].text[0] = 0; g_friend[k].slot = -1; }
}

/* ---- which car wears which ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static int network_race(void){
    return MR8(G_NET_ONLINE) || (int32_t)MR32(G_NET_CLIENT) > 0 || (int32_t)MR32(G_NET_HOST) > 0;
}
/* one of our cars: player 1's, a split race's other players', co-op's player 2's */
static int ours(uint32_t car){
    uint32_t p1 = guest_rd32(SPLIT_PLAYERS_INDEX);
    if (car == guest_rd32(p1 + PL_CAR)) return 1;
    if (car == coop_p2_car()) return 1;
    if (MR32(G_GAMEMODE) == 4u || coop_racing_together()){
        uint32_t n = MR32(SPLIT_PLAYERS_COUNT);
        for (uint32_t i = 1; i < n && i < SPLIT_PORT_CAPACITY; i++) if (car == guest_rd32(guest_rd32(SPLIT_PLAYERS_INDEX + 4u * i) + PL_CAR)) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
/* The front end draws one car, the one its screen is about: ours in the garage and the shops, the car lot's, a car
 * select's or another player's (Online) elsewhere.  It wears our plate from a screen of ours on, until a screen of
 * others' (any other screen: a dialog, the help bar, changes nothing) */
static char g_fe_screen[64];                    /* the newest screen of either list (fe_follow) */
static int screen_in(const char *s, const char *const *list){
    for (int i = 0; list[i]; i++) if (!strncasecmp(s, list[i], strlen(list[i]))) return 1;
    return 0;
}
static void fe_follow(void){
    static const char *const our_screens[] = { "UI_CareerCrib", "UI_CareerCarSelect", "UI_Choose", "UI_CHoose",
        "UI_PC_Customize", "UI_Paint", "UI_Decal", "UI_Custom", "UI_Rims", "UI_GenericParts", "UI_ICE",
        "UI_Performance", "UI_BuyPerformance", "UI_ShowCase", "UI_Showcase", "UI_Magazine", 0 };
    static const char *const other_screens[] = { "UI_CareerCarLot", "CarLot", "UI_OLCarLot", "UI_QR", "UI_OL",
        "UI_StartCareer", "UI_Main", "MC_", "UI_Options", "UI_PC_LAN", "PC_OL", 0 };
    static uint32_t flow;
    static char told[64];
    if (MR32(G_FLOW) != flow){ flow = MR32(G_FLOW); g_fe_ours = 0; told[0] = 0; g_fe_screen[0] = 0; }
    if (flow != 3u) return;
    /* the newest screen of either list (the game starts a screen with the garage's backdrop and its help line in
     * the same frame: autotest_screen_batch has them all, the screen first) */
    const char *s = 0, *b;
    for (int i = 0; (b = autotest_screen_batch(i)); i++) if (screen_in(b, other_screens) || screen_in(b, our_screens)) s = b;
    if (!s) return;
    g_fe_ours = screen_in(s, our_screens) && !screen_in(s, other_screens);
    snprintf(g_fe_screen, sizeof g_fe_screen, "%s", s);
    if (g_mine[0] && strcmp(told, s)){
        snprintf(told, sizeof told, "%s", s);
        fprintf(stderr, "[plates] f=%ld %s: %s\n", autotest_frame(), s, g_fe_ours ? "our car, our plate" : "not our car, the game's plate");
    }
}

/* ---- the textures --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static int find(const char *text){
    for (int i = 0; i < PLATE_SLOTS; i++) if (g_slot[i].ti && g_slot[i].text[0] && !strcmp(g_slot[i].text, text)) return i;
    return -1;
}
/* the game's plate decoded (our plates are drawn on it), once its pixels are where we read them last; 0 where they are
 * not as the game's data has them (a plain plate stands in) */
static const uint8_t *stock(uint32_t src){
    uint32_t px = guest_rd32(src + TI_PIXELS), plat = guest_rd32(src);
    if (!px || !guest_ok(px, PLATE_W * PLATE_H / 2u - 1u) || MR16(src + TI_W) != PLATE_W || MR16(src + TI_H) != PLATE_H
        || !guest_ok(plat, PLAT_SZ) || MR32(plat + PLAT_FORMAT) != FMT_DXT1) return 0;
    if (px != g_stock_px){ plate_dxt1(GPTR(px), PLATE_W, PLATE_H, g_stock); g_stock_px = px; }
    return g_stock;
}
/* slot i's texture made, or remade, for text: 1 done */
static int make(CPU *c, int i, const char *text){
    Slot *s = &g_slot[i];
    uint32_t a[3] = { PLATE_HASH, 0, 0 }, src = gcall_main(c, FN_TEXINFO, 0, 3, a);
    if (!guest_ok(src, TI_SZ) || !guest_ok(guest_rd32(src), PLAT_SZ)) return 0;           /* not loaded (yet) */
    if (!plate_image(text, strlen(text), stock(src), g_px)) return 0;
    uint32_t ti = s->ti;
    if (!ti){
        /* our TextureInfo, its platform record and its pixels in one block of the game's */
        uint32_t size = TI_SZ + PLAT_SZ + 64u + PLATE_BYTES;
        if (!(ti = gcall_main(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &size)) || !guest_ok(ti, size)) return 0;
        uint32_t pl = ti + TI_SZ, pix = (pl + PLAT_SZ + 63u) & ~63u;
        memcpy(GPTR(ti), GPTR(src), TI_SZ); memcpy(GPTR(pl), GPTR(guest_rd32(src)), PLAT_SZ);
        MR32(pl) = MR32(pl + 4u) = 0;                                   /* on no list of the game's */
        MR32(pl + PLAT_TEX) = MR32(pl + PLAT_LIST) = 0;
        MR32(pl + PLAT_FORMAT) = FMT_ARGB;
        char nm[24]; snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "PLATE_%02d", i);
        for (uint32_t q = 0; q < 24u; q++) MR8(ti + TI_NAME + q) = q < strlen(nm) ? (uint8_t)nm[q] : 0;
        MR32(ti) = pl; MR32(ti + TI_SELF) = ti; MR32(ti + TI_PIXELS) = pix; MR32(ti + TI_PALETTE) = 0;
        MR32(ti + TI_HASH) = 0x504c0000u + (uint32_t)i;                 /* "PL" and the slot: no name the game has */
        MR32(ti + TI_BYTES) = PLATE_BYTES; MR32(ti + TI_PAL) = 0; MR32(ti + TI_LEVEL0) = PLATE_W * PLATE_H * 4;
        MR16(ti + TI_W) = PLATE_W; MR16(ti + TI_H) = PLATE_H;               /* the game's own size: log2 7 and 6 */
        MR8(ti + TI_LOG_W) = 7; MR8(ti + TI_LOG_H) = 6;
        MR8(ti + TI_KIND) = KIND_ARGB; MR8(ti + TI_LEVELS) = PLATE_MIPS;
        s->ti = ti;
    }
    uint32_t pl = MR32(ti), pix = MR32(ti + TI_PIXELS), tex = MR32(pl + PLAT_TEX);
    memcpy(GPTR(pix), g_px, PLATE_BYTES);
    if (!tex) gcall_main(c, FN_TEX_CREATE, ti, 0, 0);
    else {
        /* the texture is there: the new pixels into it, level by level (the port's texture, com.c) */
        uint32_t off = 0, w = PLATE_W, h = PLATE_H;
        for (int m = 0; m < PLATE_MIPS; m++, w /= 2, h /= 2){
            metal_upload_texture(MR32(tex + COM_TID), (unsigned)m, g_px + off, w * 4u, PLATE_W, PLATE_H, FMT_ARGB);
            off += w * h * 4u;
        }
    }
    if (!MR32(pl + PLAT_TEX)) return 0;
    snprintf(s->text, sizeof s->text, "%s", text);
    s->ready = 1; g_made++;
    return 1;
}
/* slot i gone: its platform record off the game's list of textures (0x5CE170 put it there: +0 the next, +4 the one
 * before, the list's head at 0x872B4C), its texture released (the D3D object's Release until none holds it), and its
 * block freed */
static void drop(CPU *c, int i){
    Slot *s = &g_slot[i];
    uint32_t pl = guest_rd32(s->ti), tex = pl ? guest_rd32(pl + PLAT_TEX) : 0;
    if (pl && guest_ok(guest_rd32(pl), 7) && guest_ok(guest_rd32(pl + 4u), 7)){
        uint32_t next = MR32(pl), before = MR32(pl + 4u);
        MR32(before) = next; MR32(next + 4u) = before;
        MR32(pl) = MR32(pl + 4u) = 0;
    }
    for (int n = 0; tex && n < 8; n++){
        uint32_t release = guest_rd32(guest_rd32(tex) + 8u);
        if (!release || !gcall_main(c, release, 0, 1, &tex)) break;
    }
    if (pl) MR32(pl + PLAT_TEX) = 0;
    fprintf(stderr, "[plates] f=%ld slot %d (%s) freed: no car wanted it for %.0f s\n", autotest_frame(), i, s->text[0] ? s->text : "none", FREE_S);
    if (s->ti) gcall_main(c, FN_FREE, 0, 1, &s->ti);
    memset(s, 0, sizeof *s);
    g_freed++;
}
/* text's slot this frame, made now if there is room for it (-1: not yet) */
static int want(CPU *c, const char *text, int *uploads){
    int i = find(text);
    /* (its D3D texture still there: the game releases every one of its list when its device is lost, 0x5CE400) */
    if (i >= 0 && g_slot[i].ready && guest_rd32(guest_rd32(g_slot[i].ti) + PLAT_TEX)){ g_slot[i].wanted = g_frame; g_slot[i].wanted_s = now_s(); return i; }
    if (*uploads >= UPLOADS_PER_FRAME) return -1;
    if (i < 0){
        /* a slot: an empty one first, else the one no car wanted for longest (and not for REUSE_FRAMES) */
        for (int k = 0; k < PLATE_SLOTS; k++){
            Slot *s = &g_slot[k];
            if (g_frame < s->retry || (s->ti && g_frame - s->wanted < REUSE_FRAMES)) continue;
            if (i < 0 || (!s->ti && g_slot[i].ti) || (!!s->ti == !!g_slot[i].ti && s->wanted < g_slot[i].wanted)) i = k;
        }
        if (i < 0) return -1;
    }
    (*uploads)++;
    g_slot[i].ready = 0; g_slot[i].text[0] = 0;
    if (!make(c, i, text)){ g_slot[i].retry = g_frame + RETRY_FRAMES; return -1; }
    g_slot[i].wanted = g_frame; g_slot[i].wanted_s = now_s(); g_slot[i].retry = 0;
    fprintf(stderr, "[plates] f=%ld slot %d: %s\n", autotest_frame(), i, text);
    return i;
}

/* each frame, from the main-loop hook: the textures the cars want */
void plates_frame(CPU *c){
    g_frame++;
    fe_follow();
    const char *mine = plates_mine();
    int uploads = 0, flow = (int)MR32(G_FLOW);
    int net = network_race();
    static int net_was;
    if (net != net_was){
        net_was = net;
        fprintf(stderr, "[plates] f=%ld %s\n", autotest_frame(), net ? "a race over the network: every car the game's own plate" : "no race over the network: plates again");
    }
    g_mine_slot = mine[0] && !net && ((flow == 6) || (flow == 3 && g_fe_ours)) ? want(c, mine, &uploads) : -1;
    for (int k = 0; k < FRIENDS; k++)
        g_friend[k].slot = g_friend[k].car && !net && flow == 6 ? want(c, g_friend[k].text, &uploads) : -1;
    double t = now_s();
    for (int i = 0; i < PLATE_SLOTS; i++)
        if (g_slot[i].ti && g_frame - g_slot[i].wanted > REUSE_FRAMES && t - g_slot[i].wanted_s > FREE_S) drop(c, i);
    static unsigned shown;
    if (g_made + g_freed != shown && (g_made + g_freed) % 16u == 0u){
        int used = 0; for (int i = 0; i < PLATE_SLOTS; i++) used += g_slot[i].ti != 0;
        fprintf(stderr, "[plates] f=%ld %u made, %u freed, %d of %d slots hold one\n", autotest_frame(), g_made, g_freed, used, PLATE_SLOTS);
        shown = g_made + g_freed;
    }
}

/* ---- the drawing ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* 0x620AE0 / 0x6162E0 (showoff.c, photo.c): the car of render info ri is drawn now; what was drawing before, back after */
uint32_t plates_begin(uint32_t ri){
    uint32_t before = g_drawing, car = guest_ok(ri, 3) ? MR32(ri + RI_CAR) : 0;
    g_drawing = 0;
    if (!car) return before;
    int slot = -1;
    if (MR32(G_FLOW) == 3u) slot = g_mine_slot;                         /* the front end's one car (plates_frame said whose) */
    else if (ours(car)) slot = g_mine_slot;
    else for (int k = 0; k < FRIENDS; k++) if (g_friend[k].car == car){ slot = g_friend[k].slot; break; }
    if (slot >= 0 && g_slot[slot].ready) g_drawing = g_slot[slot].ti;
    return before;
}
void plates_end(uint32_t before){ g_drawing = before; }
/* stance.c: the front end's car is ours (fe_follow) */
int plates_fe_ours(void){ return g_fe_ours; }
/* ... and the screen that says so ("" none yet) */
const char *plates_fe_screen(void){ return g_fe_screen; }
/* 0x5C5930 (overrides.c): a model of the car being drawn into the render lists (item: its model); keep says what to
 * put back after (keep[0] the place, 0: nothing) */
void plates_model(uint32_t item, uint32_t keep[2]){
    keep[0] = 0;
    if (!g_drawing || !guest_ok(item, 0x10u)) return;
    uint32_t solid = MR32(item + 0xcu);
    if (!guest_ok(solid, SOLID_TABLE + 3u)) return;
    uint32_t n = MR8(solid + SOLID_COUNT), table = MR32(solid + SOLID_TABLE);
    if (!n || !guest_ok(table, n * 8u - 1u)) return;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < n; k++){
        if (MR32(table + 8u * k) != PLATE_HASH) continue;
        keep[0] = table + 8u * k + 4u; keep[1] = MR32(keep[0]);
        MR32(keep[0]) = g_drawing;
        return;
    }
}

/* powerunits.c -- Power Units, a row of the game's own Gameplay options after
 * Speedometer Units: the engine's power in bhp or kW wherever the game shows
 * it, whatever the speedometer shows (Discord: km/h with hp).  The game takes
 * both from Speedometer Units (0x83AA1A: 1 = km/h, Nm, kW; 0 = mph, ft-lbs,
 * bhp), and torque and speeds still do.  The value is the registry's
 * PowerUnits (1 = bhp, 0 = kW); none: as the speedometer, as in the original
 * game, until the row is changed.
 *
 * Power is kept in kW.  Each place that shows it asks 0x5EA8B0 ("km/h?") or
 * 0x5EA8A0 ("mph?") once for the factor (x1.341, 0x79BEF0, for bhp) and once
 * for the label, or reads the byte itself; hooks right after answer for the
 * power instead:
 *    0x53D0A0  the dyno chart: its power axis (600 bhp or 447 kW, 0x79BF00),
 *              the legend's "Power ( bhp )", the curve
 *    0x54A620  the chart's maximum power
 *    0x54A970  the results' power, of each run
 *    0x562530  the performance shop's single parts (UI_BuyPerformanceParts):
 *              a part's gain (the byte in bl, which the torque's has used
 *              by then)
 *
 * The row is a copy of Speedometer Units' class (vtable 0x791C90, a toggle of
 * 0x54 bytes made by 0x51E230) with two methods here, at guest addresses
 * nothing runs (the nops after Speedometer Units' own), which the dispatch
 * table sends to this file:
 *    1  0x49AE80  (?, message): a left or right (0x9120409E, 0xB5971BF1)
 *                 changes the value, the arrow blinks (16), the texts again (3)
 *    3  0x49AEE0  the name (+0x2C) and the value (+0x30), both by hash
 * Its value is the game's own "bhp" and "kW" (0xCBBC6512, 0x5B81D5BA), as
 * each language writes them ("CV", "pk", ...).  The screens' lists (0x54EF30;
 * the pause menu's 0x54F170) find an entry's parts in the screen's package by
 * name and number (OPTION_NAME_4, ...), and place them in its row: the row
 * goes in only where the package has them for the list's last entry too,
 * which ours makes one more. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "guest.h"
#include "game.h"
#include "widescreen.h"           /* HOOK_SITE */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

void dispatch_patch(uint32_t a, void (*f)(CPU *));
int  win32_reg_get_dword(const char *nm, uint32_t *out);
void win32_reg_put_dword(const char *nm, uint32_t v);
const char *language_name(void);

#define REG_NAME      "PowerUnits"
#define A_KMH         0x0083aa1au   /* byte: Speedometer Units, 1 = km/h */
#define FN_TOGGLE     0x0051e230u   /* thiscall (screen +0xFC, +0x10C, +0x114, +0x11C, 1): a toggle entry */
#define FN_ADD        0x0054ef30u   /* thiscall screen (entry, 1): Options > Gameplay's list takes a toggle */
#define FN_ADD_PAUSE  0x0054f170u   /* thiscall screen (entry, 1): the pause menu's */
#define FN_MODE       0x005026f0u   /* thiscall 0x83AAB4: the game mode (2: the pause menu has no Explore Map Mode) */
#define FN_FE_STRING  0x0050c900u   /* cdecl (string object, hash): its text, in the game's language */
#define VT_SPEEDO     0x00791c90u   /* Speedometer Units' class */
#define VT_N          18
#define M_ACT         0x0049aed8u   /* our methods 1 and 3 */
#define M_LABEL       0x0049af13u
#define MSG_LEFT      0x9120409eu
#define MSG_RIGHT     0xb5971bf1u
#define T_BHP         0xcbbc6512u
#define T_KW          0x5b81d5bau
#define S_COUNT       0x12cu        /* the screen: its entries so far (the next one's number) */
#define S_PACKAGE     4u            /* its package's name */
#define S_HEAD        0x4cu         /* its entries' list (an entry's node at +4: next, prev) */
#define W_LABEL       0x2cu         /* the entry: its OPTION_NAME_n */
#define W_VALUE       0x30u         /* its value */

static int g_installed;
static int g_hp = -1;                            /* 1: bhp, 0: kW, -1: as the speedometer */
static uint32_t g_vt, g_scr;                     /* guest memory: our vtable, then scratch for strings */

static int bhp(void){ return g_hp >= 0 ? g_hp : MR8(A_KMH) != 1; }

/* the name in the game's language, after its own Speedometer Units and
 * power ("Unit\xe9s compteur", "Puissance", ...; in Latin-1, as the language
 * files are; Polish with the letters its pack's fonts draw as Polish ones,
 * as hornmenu.c; Turkish's "G\xfc\xe7 Birimi" after its "H\xedz Birimi";
 * Hungarian's after its "M\xe9rt\xe9kegys\xe9g" and "Teljes\xedtm\xe9ny"; Czech's and
 * Slovak's after their "V\xfdkon");
 * English for the others, whose fonts have their own
 * encodings but draw ASCII as it is */
static const char *label(void){
    static const struct { const char *lang, *text; } T[] = {
        { "french", "Unit\xe9s puissance" }, { "german", "Leistungseinheit" }, { "italian", "Unit\xe0 potenza" },
        { "spanish", "Unidades de potencia" }, { "dutch", "Eenheden vermogen" }, { "swedish", "Enhet f\xf6r effekt" },
        { "danish", "Ydelsesenhed" }, { "portuguese", "Unidades de Pot\xeancia" }, { "polish", "Jednostki mocy" },
        { "turkish", "G\xfc\xe7 Birimi" }, { "hungarian", "Teljes\xedtm\xe9nyegys\xe9g" },
        { "czech", "Jednotky v\xfdkonu" }, { "slovak", "Jednotky v\xfdkonu" },
    };
    const char *l = language_name();
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof T / sizeof T[0]; i++) if (!strcmp(l, T[i].lang)) return T[i].text;
    return "Power Units";
}

/* 1: a left or right changes the value, to the registry */
static void pu_act(CPU *c){
    uint32_t self = c->ecx, msg = MR32(c->esp + 8u);
    if (msg == MSG_LEFT || msg == MSG_RIGHT){
        g_hp = !bhp();
        win32_reg_put_dword(REG_NAME, (uint32_t)g_hp);
        fprintf(stderr, "[units] power in %s\n", g_hp ? "bhp" : "kW");
    }
    gcall(c, MR32(MR32(self) + 0x40u), self, 1, &msg);
    gcall(c, MR32(MR32(self) + 0x0cu), self, 0, 0);
    POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 8u;
}
/* 3: the name and the value */
static void pu_label(CPU *c){
    uint32_t self = c->ecx, obj = MR32(self + W_LABEL);
    if (obj && g_scr){
        guest_write_str(g_scr, label(), 64);
        gcall(c, FN_FE_SETSTR, obj, 1, &g_scr);
        MR32(obj + 0x1cu) |= 2u;                 /* a text of its own, as FEPrintf leaves it (0x537B30) */
    }
    uint32_t a[2] = { MR32(self + W_VALUE), bhp() ? T_BHP : T_KW };
    gcall(c, FN_FE_STRING, 0, 2, a);
    POP32(c->eip);
}

/* the registry's value, and our methods to the dispatch table (once) */
void powerunits_install(void){
    if (g_installed) return;
    g_installed = 1;
    uint32_t v;
    if (win32_reg_get_dword(REG_NAME, &v)){
        g_hp = v != 0;
        fprintf(stderr, "[units] power in %s (registry %s)\n", g_hp ? "bhp" : "kW", REG_NAME);
    }
    dispatch_patch(M_ACT, pu_act);
    dispatch_patch(M_LABEL, pu_label);
}

/* ---- the row ------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* a part's object in the package by name and number, 0: none */
static uint32_t part(CPU *c, uint32_t pk, uint32_t base, uint32_t n, char *nm, size_t cap){
    int k = 0;
    for (; k < 32 && MR8(base + (uint32_t)k); k++) nm[k] = (char)MR8(base + (uint32_t)k);
    snprintf(nm + k, cap - (size_t)k, "%u", n);
    guest_write_str(g_scr, nm, 48);
    uint32_t h = gcall(c, FN_FE_HASH, 0, 1, &g_scr);
    return gcall(c, FN_PKG_FIND, pk, 1, &h);
}
/* Has the screen's package every part for entry n that it has for n - 1?
 * The names the toggles' list reads: +0xC4 OPTION_NAME_ .. +0xD8, but for
 * +0xCC in the menus' (0x54EF30). */
static int parts_there(CPU *c, uint32_t scr, uint32_t n, int pause){
    uint32_t pn = MR32(scr + S_PACKAGE), pk = pn ? gcall(c, FN_FE_PACKAGE, 0, 1, &pn) : 0;
    if (!pk || n < 2u) return 0;
    for (uint32_t o = 0xc4u; o <= 0xd8u; o += 4u){
        char nm[48], was[48];
        uint32_t b = o == 0xccu && !pause ? 0 : MR32(scr + o);
        if (b && !part(c, pk, b, n, nm, sizeof nm) && part(c, pk, b, n - 1u, was, sizeof was)){
            fprintf(stderr, "[units] the screen has %s but no %s: no Power Units row\n", was, nm);
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}
/* our row, entry n, before `after` more of the game's */
static void add(CPU *c, uint32_t scr, uint32_t fn_add, uint32_t after){
    powerunits_install();
    if (!g_vt){
        uint32_t sz = VT_N * 4u + 64u;
        if (!(g_vt = gcall(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &sz))) return;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < VT_N; i++) MR32(g_vt + 4u * i) = MR32(VT_SPEEDO + 4u * i);
        MR32(g_vt + 4u * 1u) = M_ACT; MR32(g_vt + 4u * 3u) = M_LABEL;
        g_scr = g_vt + VT_N * 4u;
    }
    uint32_t n = MR32(scr + S_COUNT);
    if (!parts_there(c, scr, n + after, fn_add == FN_ADD_PAUSE)) return;
    uint32_t sz = 0x54u, w = gcall(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &sz);
    if (!w) return;
    uint32_t a[5] = { scr + 0xfcu, scr + 0x10cu, scr + 0x114u, scr + 0x11cu, 1u };
    gcall(c, FN_TOGGLE, w, 5, a);
    MR32(w) = g_vt;
    uint32_t b[2] = { w, 1u };
    gcall(c, fn_add, scr, 2, b);
}
/* Speedometer Units changed: our row, right after it, shows the power's
 * units again while they follow it */
static void speedo_changed(CPU *c, uint32_t self){
    uint32_t nd = MR32(self + 4u), w = nd ? nd - 4u : 0;
    if (g_hp < 0 && g_vt && w && MR32(w) == g_vt) gcall(c, M_LABEL, w, 0, 0);
}

int powerunits_hook(CPU *c, uint32_t ip){
    switch (ip){
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004b7439): add(c, c->esi, FN_ADD, 4u); return 1;   /* Options > Gameplay: after Speedometer Units, before Career Difficulty .. Save */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004c3b3a): {                                        /* the pause menu's: Explore Map Mode (not in mode 2), Race Map Mode and Save follow */
        uint32_t m = gcall(c, FN_MODE, 0x0083aab4u, 0, 0);
        add(c, c->esi, FN_ADD_PAUSE, m == 2u ? 2u : 3u);
        return 1; }
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0049aeb6):                                          /* Speedometer Units' method 1, its texts again */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0049aed4): speedo_changed(c, c->esi); return 1;
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0053d0ea):                                          /* "km/h?" (0x5EA8B0): the chart's power axis */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0053d145):                                          /*   the legend */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0054a735):                                          /*   the chart's maximum, its factor */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0054a74f):                                          /*   and label */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0054ae3c):                                          /*   a run's result, its factor */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0054ae53):                                          /*   and label */
        powerunits_install();
        if (g_hp >= 0) c->eax = (uint32_t)!g_hp;
        return 1;
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0053d496):                                          /* "mph?" (0x5EA8A0): the chart's curve */
        powerunits_install();
        if (g_hp >= 0) c->eax = (uint32_t)g_hp;
        return 1;
    case HOOK_SITE(0x005626a8):                                          /* a part's gain: km/h in bl */
        powerunits_install();
        if (g_hp >= 0) c->ebx = (c->ebx & ~0xffu) | (uint32_t)!g_hp;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* quickrace.c -- more choices in Quick Race, and a one-lap race's progress in
 * percent.
 *
 *  - Laps 1 .. 127 (the game's own 1 .. 10, both ends wrapping round as
 *    there): TONumLaps::Act (0x4B3D60), at the join of its left and right

 * The choices only in Quick Race (the front end's game type [0x850078] 2):

 * 801539e, ExtraOptionsStuff.h: its lap and opponent controllers,
 * ShowMoreRaceOptions, ShowPercentOn1LapRaces); only the addresses are taken

 * The Quick Race settings (0x83AAB4, mode at +0): per mode m a 20-byte entry
 * at +0x10 + 20 m {humans +0, opponents +1, the track's {track id u16 +8,

#include "game.h"
#include "widescreen.h"           /* HOOK_SITE */
#include <stdio.h>

#define T_QUICKRACE  2u
#define QR           0x0083aab4u   /* the Quick Race settings */
#define RACE_LAPS    0x0089e7bcu   /* the race's laps */
#define MSG_LEFT     0x9120409eu
#define MSG_RIGHT    0xb5971bf1u
#define LAPS_MIN     1             /* 0 laps (NFSU2 Extra Options' bottom) races without a lap count or places */
#define LAPS_MAX     127
#define OPP_MAX      5
#define M_DRAG       2u            /* Quick Race's modes: 0 Circuit, 1 Sprint, 2 Drag, 4 URL, 9 Free Run */
#define KO_N         5             /* laps and opponents when Lap KO goes on */

static int quick_race(void){ return MR32(G_GAMEMODE) == T_QUICKRACE; }
static uint32_t qr_mode(void){ return MR32(QR); }
static uint32_t qr_humans_at(uint32_t m){ return m == 0xcu ? QR + 0x100u : QR + 0x10u + m * 20u; }
static uint32_t qr_opp_at(uint32_t m){ return m == 0xcu ? QR + 0x101u : QR + 0x11u + m * 20u; }
static uint32_t qr_track_at(uint32_t m){ return m == 0xcu ? QR + 0x11cu : QR + 0x18u + m * 20u; }

/* the most opponents the mode and track take now: as the count's Act works it out */
static uint32_t opp_top(uint32_t m){
    uint32_t top = m == M_DRAG ? 3u : OPP_MAX;
    if (m == M_DRAG && MR16(qr_track_at(m)) == 0x1132u) top = 2u;
    uint32_t h = MR8(qr_humans_at(m));
    return top + 1u > h ? top + 1u - h : 0u;
}

int quickrace_hook(CPU *c, uint32_t ip){
    switch (ip){
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004aa283): {            /* LapCounter::Update: test eax, eax (a track without laps) */
        if (!c->eax && MR32(RACE_LAPS) == 1u){
            static uint32_t said;
            if (said != MR32(G_RACEPARAMS)){ said = MR32(G_RACEPARAMS); fprintf(stderr, "[qr] track %u: one lap, the HUD shows COMPLETED %%\n", said); }
            c->eax = 1u;
        }
        return 1; }
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004b3d9f): {            /* TONumLaps::Act: ebx the message, edi the count the game made */
        if (!quick_race() || (c->ebx != MSG_LEFT && c->ebx != MSG_RIGHT)) return 1;
        int n = (int)MR16(qr_track_at(qr_mode()) + 2u);
        if (c->ebx == MSG_LEFT) n = n - 1 < LAPS_MIN ? LAPS_MAX : n - 1;
        else                    n = n + 1 > LAPS_MAX ? LAPS_MIN : n + 1;
        c->edi = (uint32_t)n;
        return 1; }
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004b3835):              /* the opponents' Act: ecx its top (3, URL 5) */
        if (quick_race() && qr_mode() != M_DRAG) c->ecx = OPP_MAX;
        return 1;
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004b386b):              /* the opponents' Act: eax its bottom (Quick Race 0) */
        if (quick_race() && MR8(qr_track_at(qr_mode()) + 8u) && !c->eax) c->eax = 1u;   /* Lap KO: someone to knock out */
        return 1;
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004b3e0f):              /* the laps' refresh: cl Lap KO (on: frozen) */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004b38fe):              /* the opponents' */
        if (quick_race()) c->ecx &= ~0xffu;
        return 1;
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004b4066): {            /* TOLapKO::Act: cl Lap KO, edi the message */
        if (!quick_race()) return 1;
        uint32_t m = qr_mode();
        if ((c->ecx & 0xffu) && (c->edi == MSG_LEFT || c->edi == MSG_RIGHT)){
            uint32_t top = opp_top(m), n = KO_N < top ? KO_N : top;
            MR16(qr_track_at(m) + 2u) = KO_N;
            MR8(qr_opp_at(m)) = (uint8_t)n;
            fprintf(stderr, "[qr] Lap KO on: %u laps, %u opponents\n", KO_N, n);
        }
        c->ecx &= ~0xffu;                    /* not the game's 3 and 3 */
        return 1; }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* racecars.c -- the other players' cars in a race between players (the game's
 * LAN races: free roam's multiplayer races and the LAN menu's), sent and shown
 * the way free roam sends and shows friends' cars.
 *
 * Why (2026-11-04): players saw the other cars in races wobble, jump, sit in
 * the wrong place and bump like walls, worse than friends' cars in free roam.
 * The game's own car states (CARSPAM, racenet.c) come 20 or 30 times a
 * second at most (14-16 from a phone at 16-27 fps), carry the sender's race
 * clock, which a joiner estimates from the creator's answers (11 ms off on
 * average, 116 ms at most in a live log: 6 m at 50 m/s), and racenet.c puts
 * each car where its newest state carries it to now, every step: 135-195 ms
 * of guessing for players 60-120 ms from the server.  Free roam's ghosts
 * (Ghost mode) are never guessed: drawn 100 ms in the past between states
 * that came, they are always smooth.
 *
 * What this does:
 *  - every game sends its own car to every other racer each frame, at most
 *    HZ a second, as free roam's car state (roam_core.c rc_state: place,
 *    velocity, orientation, spin, the controls, gear, rpm), stamped by a
 *    clock that runs with the world's steps and is steered to the wall clock
 *    (clock_frame: what the car moved by and the stamps agree, also in a
 *    world slower than real time, and a long frame is taken up over the next
 *    half second, never at once);
 *  - "N2RS" on the horn's port (racehorn.c), straight to each racer: the
 *    creator to its joiners, a joiner to the creator and to the others on the
 *    creator's list (racenet.c's N2PL).  Each also echoes the newest stamp it
 *    had from that racer and how long it held it: each pair knows its round
 *    trip without the game's race clock;
 *  - each other car runs through free roam's interpolator (rc_interp: the
 *    clock offset from the least delay, a jitter buffer, Hermite between
 *    states, corrections faded): far ones are drawn GHOST_US in the past
 *    between states that came (no guess, as free roam's ghosts), near ones
 *    where their owner has them now (half the least round trip carried on
 *    along the curve the car drives, as free roam's solid cars), the delay
 *    sliding between the two with the distance (NEAR_M .. FAR_M) at most
 *    SLEW of the step: a car that comes near is shown a little faster for a
 *    while, never jumps.  Each step it is put where it is at the step's
 *    start with the velocity and spin it moves at over the step (the game's
 *    physics moves it on after the blend);
 *  - (off since 2026-11-05, NFSU2_RACE_DRIVE=1 a test) a car within DRIVE_M
 *    runs on the game's own physics, its owner's controls in it, its velocity
 *    and yaw rate steered each step toward where the states say (DRIVE_TAU,
 *    DRIVE_TAU_R), its height, roll and pitch the physics' own: it meets walls
 *    and the player's car as a car does, and bumps both ways (a car put there
 *    every step was an immovable one to bumps the game does not call hits).
 *    Live, the cars it drove bounced, stood on their tails and flipped in
 *    every kind of race (players' reports and screenshots, 2026-11-04, the
 *    first night it was out): the rig measured place and heading only, never
 *    height, roll or pitch;
 *  - after a hit here (the game stamps one, racenet.c's sub_005f8d40) the car
 *    runs on its own physics until a state its owner sent after the hit has
 *    come, then glides back to where the states say; so one within reach
 *    drawn STALL_EXT_US past its newest state (a stalled link), with its
 *    owner's last controls.  One farther off is carried on along its way, up
 *    to CAP_FAR_US.  A correction the interpolator would snap (over 5 m) glides
 *    too;
 *  - each other car sounds with its own engine, as free roam's friends do
 *    (roam_game.c, carsfx.c): the game gives the other players' cars an AI
 *    racer's sound (their records' byte +0x900, 0x4690E0), one engine model
 *    of its few AI engines (a Focus heard as an S2000's) at an rpm of its own
 *    (8600 of 10000 with the car standing); so each state carries the engine
 *    as its owner's game sounds it (roam_game_engine_state: the rpm on the
 *    sound's scale and the volumes, in the state's extension), and each
 *    other car's GIN recordings (its car type's and engine upgrades', as
 *    0x4593B0 picks them: roam_game_engine_files) play at that through
 *    carsfx.c, the game's AI engine on that car silenced (roam_game.c
 *    aieng_update, racecars_engine_heard).  A car whose states carry no
 *    engine (an older game's) keeps the game's;
 *  - a car of an older game (none of these come for it) keeps racenet.c's
 *    way, and an older game drops these (an unknown message on the port).
 *
 * N2RS, version 1 (little-endian):
 *   0 "N2RS", 4 version 1, 5 flags (1: states with the extension: the engine), 6 the
 *   sender's race slot, 7 n states (1..NSTATES, newest first), 8 epoch (a
 *   change: its car was put elsewhere, snap), 9 clock epoch (a change: its
 *   stamp clock was set anew, re-sync), 10 status (roam_core.h RC_ST_*), 11 0,
 *   12 its wall clock now (u32 µs), 16 the newest such stamp it had from the
 *   addressee (0: none), 20 how long it held that one (u32 µs), 24 the states
 *   (rc_state_put).

 * race's peers (racenet_race_peers), only for the slot its game drives
 * (racenet_slot_of: the creator's race connections, on a joiner the
 * creator's list), and each address for one slot only, which no other
 * address may name in this race.  Until the 2026-11-05 security audit that
 * slot was the first it named: a joiner that named another's first spoke for

 *
 * Test knobs (read only with NFSU2_INPUT_SCRIPT set, racenet.c's test_env):
 * NFSU2_RACE_CARS=0 off (the game's and racenet.c's way), NFSU2_RACE_CARS_HZ,

 * way to the server 70 +- 15 ms with 500 ms stalls, the AI driving with a

static int64_t now_us(void){

static int finite_n(const float *a, int n){ for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!__builtin_isfinite(a[i])) return 0; return 1; }
static float len3(const float *a){ return __builtin_sqrtf(a[0] * a[0] + a[1] * a[1] + a[2] * a[2]); }
static void rq_mul(const float *a, const float *b, float *o){   /* o = a * b, (x, y, z, w) */
    float x = a[3]*b[0] + a[0]*b[3] + a[1]*b[2] - a[2]*b[1];
    float y = a[3]*b[1] - a[0]*b[2] + a[1]*b[3] + a[2]*b[0];
    float z = a[3]*b[2] + a[0]*b[1] - a[1]*b[0] + a[2]*b[3];
    float w = a[3]*b[3] - a[0]*b[0] - a[1]*b[1] - a[2]*b[2];
    o[0] = x; o[1] = y; o[2] = z; o[3] = w;
}
static void rq_conj(const float *a, float *o){ o[0] = -a[0]; o[1] = -a[1]; o[2] = -a[2]; o[3] = a[3]; }
static void rq_norm(float *q){
    float n = q[0] * q[0] + q[1] * q[1] + q[2] * q[2] + q[3] * q[3];
    if (!(n > 1e-12f) || !__builtin_isfinite(n)){ q[0] = q[1] = q[2] = 0.f; q[3] = 1.f; return; }
    float k = 1.f / __builtin_sqrtf(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) q[i] *= k;
}
static void rq_nlerp(const float *a, const float *b, float t, float *o){
    float d = a[0]*b[0] + a[1]*b[1] + a[2]*b[2] + a[3]*b[3], s = d < 0.f ? -1.f : 1.f;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) o[i] = (1.f - t) * a[i] + t * s * b[i];
    rq_norm(o);
}

static int in_race(void){
    uint32_t w = guest_rd32(G_WORLD), rc = guest_rd32(G_RACE);
    return guest_rd32(G_FLOW) == 6u && (guest_rd32(G_GAMEMODE) & 0x208u) && guest_ok(w, 0x80) && guest_rd32(rc) == RC_RACING;
}

static int in_world(uint32_t w, uint32_t car){
    uint32_t x = guest_rd32(w);
    for (int k = 0; x && x != w && k < 64 && guest_ok(x, 0x9e0); k++, x = guest_rd32(x)) if (x == car) return 1;
    return 0;
}
/* the world's car of a race slot (not ours) */
static uint32_t car_of_slot(int slot){
    uint32_t w = guest_rd32(G_WORLD), me = my_car(), x = guest_rd32(w);
    for (int k = 0; x && x != w && k < 64 && guest_ok(x, 0x9e0); k++, x = guest_rd32(x))
        if (x != me && (int16_t)MR16(x + CAR_SLOT) == slot) return x;
    return 0;
}

/* ---- our stamp clock (free roam's g_sync, roam_game.c) ---- */
static struct {
    int on; double s, vscale, irate, rate; int64_t host;   /* the clock (µs), world seconds per stamp second, its drift
                                                        learnt, its rate now (+ = faster than the world's steps),
                                                        the wall clock then */
    uint8_t clock, epoch;                         /* its epoch (set anew), our car's (put elsewhere) */
    int paused;
    float lp[3], lv[3]; int lp_ok;                /* our car last frame */
    double sent; uint32_t nsent, ndg;             /* the last state sent (stamp), how many */
    uint32_t snaps;
} K;
static void clock_frame(int racing){
    int64_t host = now_us(), hdt = host - K.host;
    if (hdt < 0 || hdt > 1000000) hdt = 0;
    float wdt = MRF32(G_WORLDDT);
    if (!__builtin_isfinite(wdt) || wdt < 0.f || wdt > 1.f) wdt = 0.f;
    if (!racing){ K.on = 0; K.host = host; return; }
    if (!K.on){ K.on = 1; K.s = (double)host; K.vscale = 1.0; K.irate = 0; K.rate = 0; K.clock++; K.paused = 0; K.lp_ok = 0; }
    else if (wdt <= 0.f){ K.paused++; K.s += (double)hdt; }
    else {
        /* the world's step, sped up or slowed down by what it is off the wall clock (a PI: K_TAU, and what it
         * keeps drifting by over K_TAU_I), at most K_RMIN .. K_RMAX of the step.  Not pulled at once as free
         * roam's clock is: a frame of 300 ms whose world step the game cut to 50 put that clock 250 ms on in one
         * frame, so the car's states said it stood still for that long, and every other car drawn from them
         * stepped (one frame in nine on a busy machine).  A world steadily slower than real time (the game's
         * step cut below 20 fps) is followed (K_RMAX: down to 2/3 of real time) */
        double e = ((double)host - (K.s + wdt * 1e6)) * 1e-6;
        if (__builtin_fabs(e) > 1.0){ K.s = (double)host; K.clock++; K.snaps++; K.irate = 0; K.rate = 0; K.vscale = 1.0; }
        else {
            /* the rate moves at most K_RSLEW a second: a frame's wall time swings by a pacer's step (16.7 ms at 30
             * fps) against its world step, and a rate that followed each frame's error moved every car drawn by
             * the clock 3 % back and forth a frame (5 cm at 50 m/s, a phone's screen) */
            K.irate += e * wdt / (K_TAU * K_TAU_I);
            K.irate = K.irate < K_RMIN ? K_RMIN : K.irate > K_RMAX ? K_RMAX : K.irate;
            double want = e / K_TAU + K.irate, lim = K_RSLEW * wdt;
            want = want < K_RMIN ? K_RMIN : want > K_RMAX ? K_RMAX : want;
            K.rate += want - K.rate > lim ? lim : want - K.rate < -lim ? -lim : want - K.rate;
            K.s += wdt * 1e6 * (1.0 + K.rate);
            K.vscale = 1.0 / (1.0 + K.rate);
        }
        K.paused = 0;
    }
    K.host = host;
}

/* ---- the other racers ---- */
typedef struct {
    uint32_t ip; int slot;                        /* its address, the slot it speaks for (-1: none yet) */
    uint32_t car;                                 /* its world car (by the slot) */
    char name[16];
    rc_interp mo;
    int64_t rx_at;                                /* our wall clock at its newest state */
    uint32_t their_tx; int64_t their_at;          /* its newest wall stamp, when it came (our echo) */
    int32_t rtt[NRTT]; int rn, rh;                /* round trips (µs) */
    int64_t delay; int dinit;                     /* the delay it is drawn with (µs; < 0: carried on) */
    int64_t last_eval; int evals;                 /* the stamp time of the last step it was drawn for */
    uint32_t hit; int own; double own_from;       /* the game's last hit stamp; on its own physics since (stamp) */
    int stalled;
    float gp[3], gq[4], gtau; int glide;          /* the glide back from its own physics: the offset, its time constant */
    float sp[3], sv[3], sq[4], sw[3];             /* the car before the game's blend this step (racecars_pre) */
    int driving; uint32_t drive_steps, drive_snaps;   /* on its own physics, steered (NFSU2_RACE_DRIVE) */
    uint32_t vfit;                                /* steps whose velocity was the drawn car's over the step */
    uint32_t bigs;                                /* steps it was put over BIG_M from where it was */
    float tp[3], tm[3]; float th; int thave;      /* NFSU2_RACECARS_TRACE: the place drawn last step, its move, the step */
    float putp[3], putv[3]; int puts;             /*   where we put it this pass, its velocity then, how often */
    float dist;
    rc_pose eng; int eng_ok;                      /* its engine as drawn last step (eng, its volumes; eng_ok: its states carry one) */
    char gin[2][32]; float idle, most;            /* its engine's GIN files (roam_game_engine_files) for ... */
    uint32_t gin_car; int heard;                  /* ... this car; carsfx.c plays it (its AI engine silenced) */
    uint32_t heard_frames;
    /* for the log */
    uint32_t n, g250, g500; int64_t gap_max;
    uint32_t steps, own_hit, own_stall, glides, snaps, near_steps, far_steps;
    float glide_max;
    double age_sum; uint32_t age_n; float age_max;
} Rc;
static Rc g_rc[NCARS];
static uint32_t g_world;
static struct { uint32_t refused, bad, sent_err; } S;

static Rc *rc_of_ip(uint32_t ip, int add){
    for (int i = 0; i < NCARS; i++) if (g_rc[i].ip == ip) return &g_rc[i];
    if (!add) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < NCARS; i++) if (!g_rc[i].ip){
        memset(&g_rc[i], 0, sizeof g_rc[i]);
        g_rc[i].ip = ip; g_rc[i].slot = -1; g_rc[i].gq[3] = 1.f;
        rc_interp_reset(&g_rc[i].mo);
        return &g_rc[i];
    }
    return 0;
}
/* the racer whose car this is, while its states come */
static Rc *rc_of_car(uint32_t car){
    if (!car) return 0;
    int64_t t = now_us();
    for (int i = 0; i < NCARS; i++){
        Rc *r = &g_rc[i];
        if (!r->ip || r->slot < 0 || !r->mo.n) continue;
        if (!r->car || !in_world(guest_rd32(G_WORLD), r->car)) r->car = car_of_slot(r->slot);
        if (r->car == car) return t - r->rx_at <= STALE_US ? r : 0;
    }
    return 0;
}
int racecars_fed(uint32_t car){ return racecars_on() && in_race() && rc_of_car(car) != 0; }
static int32_t rtt_min(const Rc *r){
    int32_t m = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < r->rn; k++) if (k == 0 || r->rtt[k] < m) m = r->rtt[k];
    return m;
}

/* ---- our car to the others (every frame, after the world's step) ---- */
static int own_state(rc_state *s, uint32_t car){
    memset(s, 0, sizeof *s);
    float f[3], l[3], u[3];
    s->t_us = (uint32_t)(uint64_t)(int64_t)K.s;
    rd3(car + CAR_POS, s->p); rd3(car + CAR_VEL, s->v); rd3(car + CAR_SPIN, s->w);
    rd3(car + CAR_ROWS, f); rd3(car + CAR_ROWS + 0x10u, l); rd3(car + CAR_ROWS + 0x20u, u);
    rc_m2q(f, l, u, s->q);
    s->speed = MRF32(car + CAR_FWD_SPEED); s->rpm = MRF32(car + CAR_RPM); s->gear = (int8_t)MR32(car + CAR_GEAR);
    uint32_t ctl = guest_rd32(car + CAR_CTL);
    if (guest_ok(ctl, 0x220)){
        s->throttle = MRF32(ctl + 0x20cu); s->brake = MRF32(ctl + 0x214u);
        s->steer = (float)(int16_t)MR16(ctl + 0x1e0u) / 32767.f;
        if (s->brake > 0.1f) s->bits |= RC_BIT_BRAKE;
        if (MRF32(ctl + 0x210u) > 0.1f) s->bits |= RC_BIT_HANDBRAKE;
    }
    if (s->speed < -0.5f) s->bits |= RC_BIT_REVERSE;
    if (!finite_n(s->p, 3) || !finite_n(s->v, 3) || !finite_n(s->q, 4)) return 0;
    if (K.paused > 1){ memset(s->v, 0, sizeof s->v); memset(s->w, 0, sizeof s->w); s->speed = 0; }
    /* velocities per stamp second (the stamp clock may run a little faster than the world) */
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++){ s->v[i] = (float)(s->v[i] * K.vscale); s->w[i] = (float)(s->w[i] * K.vscale); }
    if (!finite_n(s->w, 3)) memset(s->w, 0, sizeof s->w);
    if (!__builtin_isfinite(s->speed)) s->speed = 0;
    if (!__builtin_isfinite(s->rpm)) s->rpm = 0;
    if (!__builtin_isfinite(s->throttle)) s->throttle = 0;
    if (!__builtin_isfinite(s->brake)) s->brake = 0;
    if (!__builtin_isfinite(s->steer)) s->steer = 0;
    roam_game_engine_state(car, s);               /* the engine as our game sounds it, in the extension */
    s->ext = s->eng != 0;
    return 1;
}
static void send_frame(void){
    uint32_t car = my_car();
    if (!guest_ok(car, 0x9e0)) return;
    float wdt = MRF32(G_WORLDDT);
    float p[3]; rd3(car + CAR_POS, p);
    /* put elsewhere (the game's reset): a new epoch, the others snap instead of gliding */
    if (K.lp_ok && wdt > 0.f && wdt < 0.25f && finite_n(p, 3)){
        float d[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) d[i] = p[i] - (K.lp[i] + K.lv[i] * wdt);
        if (len3(d) > JUMP_M) K.epoch++;
    }
    memcpy(K.lp, p, sizeof p); rd3(car + CAR_VEL, K.lv); K.lp_ok = finite_n(K.lp, 3) && finite_n(K.lv, 3);
    if (K.s - K.sent < 1e6 / O.hz - 2000.0 && K.sent > 0) return;
    rc_state s;
    if (!own_state(&s, car)) return;
    uint32_t peers[NPEERS];
    int np = racenet_race_peers(peers, NPEERS);
    if (np <= 0) return;
    K.sent = K.s; K.nsent++;
    int slot = (int16_t)MR16(car + CAR_SLOT);              /* as the others find our car (the game's G_MYSLOT is not the creator's own) */
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= 6) return;
    int64_t t = now_us();
    for (int k = 0; k < np; k++){
        uint8_t m[24 + NSTATES * (RC_STATE_BYTES + RC_STATEX_BYTES)];
        rc_w w; rc_w_init(&w, m, sizeof m);
        rc_putb(&w, "N2RS", 4); rc_put8(&w, 1); rc_put8(&w, s.ext); rc_put8(&w, (uint32_t)slot); rc_put8(&w, 1);
        rc_put8(&w, K.epoch); rc_put8(&w, K.clock); rc_put8(&w, K.paused > 1 ? RC_ST_PAUSED : RC_ST_ROAM); rc_put8(&w, 0);
        rc_put32(&w, (uint32_t)t);
        Rc *r = rc_of_ip(peers[k], 0);
        int fresh = r && r->their_at && t - r->their_at < 2000000;
        rc_put32(&w, fresh ? r->their_tx : 0u);
        rc_put32(&w, fresh ? (uint32_t)(t - r->their_at) : 0u);
        rc_state_put(&w, &s, s.ext);
        if (w.err) continue;
        if (vlan_rt_send(HORN_PORT, peers[k], m, (int)w.n)) S.sent_err++;
        else K.ndg++;
    }
}

/* ---- an N2RS from the horn's port (racehorn.c, the game thread) ---- */
void racecars_heard(const uint8_t *m, int n, uint32_t from){
    if (!racecars_on() || n < 24 || m[4] != 1 || !in_race()) return;
    uint32_t peers[NPEERS];
    int np = racenet_race_peers(peers, NPEERS), known = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < np; k++) known |= peers[k] == from;
    int slot = m[6], ns = m[7];
    uint32_t me = my_car();
    if (!known || slot >= 6 || !guest_ok(me, 0x9e0) || slot == (int16_t)MR16(me + CAR_SLOT) || ns < 1 || ns > 3){ S.refused++; return; }
    /* only the slot its game drives, as the creator knows it (racenet_slot_of) */
    int want = racenet_slot_of(from);
    if (want != -2 && want != slot){ S.refused++; return; }
    /* one slot an address, one address a slot, for this race */
    for (int i = 0; i < NCARS; i++) if (g_rc[i].ip && g_rc[i].ip != from && g_rc[i].slot == slot){ S.refused++; return; }
    Rc *r = rc_of_ip(from, 1);
    if (!r){ S.refused++; return; }
    if (r->slot >= 0 && r->slot != slot){ S.refused++; return; }
    rc_r rd; rc_r_init(&rd, m + 24, (uint32_t)n - 24u);
    rc_state st[3];
    for (int k = 0; k < ns; k++) if (rc_state_get(&rd, &st[k], m[5] & 1) != RC_OK){ S.bad++; return; }
    if (r->slot < 0){ r->slot = slot; r->car = car_of_slot(slot); if (r->car) car_name(r->car, r->name); }
    int64_t t = now_us();
    uint32_t tx = (uint32_t)m[12] | (uint32_t)m[13] << 8 | (uint32_t)m[14] << 16 | (uint32_t)m[15] << 24;
    uint32_t echo = (uint32_t)m[16] | (uint32_t)m[17] << 8 | (uint32_t)m[18] << 16 | (uint32_t)m[19] << 24;
    uint32_t held = (uint32_t)m[20] | (uint32_t)m[21] << 8 | (uint32_t)m[22] << 16 | (uint32_t)m[23] << 24;
    if (echo){
        int32_t rtt = (int32_t)((uint32_t)t - echo) - (int32_t)held;
        if (rtt >= 0 && rtt < 5000000){ r->rtt[r->rh] = rtt; r->rh = (r->rh + 1) % NRTT; if (r->rn < NRTT) r->rn++; }
    }
    r->their_tx = tx; r->their_at = t;
    if (r->n){
        int64_t g = t - r->rx_at;
        if (g > r->gap_max) r->gap_max = g;
        r->g250 += g > 250000; r->g500 += g > 500000;
    }
    r->n++; r->rx_at = t;
    /* the stamp clock's time now, for the interpolator's offset (the newest state only) */
    for (int k = ns - 1; k >= 0; k--) rc_interp_insert(&r->mo, &st[k], m[8], m[9], m[10], (int64_t)K.s + (t - K.host), k == 0);
}

/* ---- the car drawn (racenet.c's override of the game's blend, after it, each world step) ---- */
/* a guest function from a lifted one's override, with the return address its own caller in the game uses (guest.h) */
static void call_game(CPU *c, uint32_t fn, uint32_t ecx, int n, const uint32_t *arg, uint32_t ret){
    guest_call_ex(c, fn, ecx, c->edx, n, arg, ret, 512u);
}
/* the car put where p, v, q, w say, as the game's blend puts it (0x5F8C98..0x5F8D07) */
static void put_car(CPU *c, uint32_t ctl, uint32_t car, const float *p, const float *v, const float *q, const float *w){
    uint32_t b = ctl + CTL_BLEND;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 3; k++){ MRF32(b + 0x10u + 4u * k) = p[k]; MRF32(b + 0x20u + 4u * k) = v[k]; MRF32(b + 0x40u + 4u * k) = w[k]; }
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 4; k++) MRF32(b + 0x30u + 4u * k) = q[k];
    uint32_t a = car;
    call_game(c, FN_APPLY, b, 1, &a, RET_APPLY);
}
static void car_now(uint32_t car, float *p, float *v, float *q, float *w){
    float f[3], l[3], u[3];
    rd3(car + CAR_POS, p); rd3(car + CAR_VEL, v); rd3(car + CAR_SPIN, w);
    rd3(car + CAR_ROWS, f); rd3(car + CAR_ROWS + 0x10u, l); rd3(car + CAR_ROWS + 0x20u, u);
    rc_m2q(f, l, u, q);
}
static void controls(uint32_t car, const rc_pose *o){
    uint32_t in = guest_rd32(car + CAR_CTL);
    if (!guest_ok(in, 0x218u)) return;
    MRF32(in + 0x20cu) = clampf(o->throttle, 0.f, 1.f); MRF32(in + 0x214u) = clampf(o->brake, 0.f, 1.f);
    MRF32(in + 0x210u) = o->bits & RC_BIT_HANDBRAKE ? 1.f : 0.f;
    MR16(in + 0x1e0u) = (uint16_t)(int16_t)(clampf(o->steer, -1.f, 1.f) * 32767.f);
}
/* racenet.c's sub_005f8af0, before the game's blend: 1 when the car is ours
 * to draw (its states come), its place, velocity, orientation and spin kept
 * (put back while it runs on its own) */
int racecars_pre(uint32_t car){
    if (!racecars_on() || !in_race() || !guest_ok(car, 0x9e0)) return 0;
    Rc *r = rc_of_car(car);
    if (!r) return 0;
    car_now(car, r->sp, r->sv, r->sq, r->sw);
    return 1;
}
/* thiscall (the controller) from racenet.c's sub_005f8af0, after the game's
 * blend (when racecars_pre said 1): 1 when the car was drawn here, 0 for
 * racenet.c's way */
int racecars_step(CPU *c, uint32_t ctl, uint32_t car){
    if (!racecars_on() || !in_race()) return 0;
    Rc *r = rc_of_car(car);
    if (!r || !guest_ok(ctl + CTL_BLEND, 0x50u) || !guest_ok(car, 0x9e0)) return 0;
    const float *sp = r->sp, *sv = r->sv, *sq = r->sq, *sw = r->sw;
    if (!r->name[0]) car_name(car, r->name);
    float h = MRF32(G_WORLDDT);
    if (!(h > 0.f && h < 0.25f)) h = 0.f;
    /* the step's start on our stamp clock: the game moves the car by the velocity put here after this (its
     * physics comes after the blend), to the step's end.  Put at the end (a step ahead), every frame moved by twice
     * its step less the one before: a 50 ms step after a 16.7 ms one jumped 1 m at 30 m/s, a 16.7 ms after a 33 ms
     * one stood (the rig, on a busy machine) */
    double te = K.s + (double)O.lead_us;
    int64_t fdt = r->evals ? (int64_t)(te - (double)r->last_eval) : 0;
    if (fdt < 0) fdt = 0;
    r->last_eval = (int64_t)te; r->evals++;
    /* the delay by the distance from our car */
    uint32_t me = my_car();
    float mp[3] = {0}, cp[3];
    if (guest_ok(me, 0x9e0)) rd3(me + CAR_POS, mp);
    rd3(car + CAR_POS, cp);
    float d[3] = { cp[0] - mp[0], cp[1] - mp[1], cp[2] - mp[2] }, dist = len3(d);
    if (!__builtin_isfinite(dist)) dist = 0.f;
    r->dist = dist;
    int32_t way = rtt_min(r) / 2;
    if (way > ONEWAY_MAX) way = ONEWAY_MAX;
    float u = clampf((dist - O.near_m) / (O.far_m - O.near_m), 0.f, 1.f);
    int64_t want = (int64_t)((1.f - u) * (float)(-way) + u * (float)O.ghost_us);
    if (!r->dinit){ r->delay = want; r->dinit = 1; }
    int64_t delay0 = r->delay;
    {
        int64_t lim = (int64_t)((double)fdt * SLEW) + 1, dd = want - r->delay;
        r->delay += dd > lim ? lim : dd < -lim ? -lim : dd;
    }
    if (u < 0.5f) r->near_steps++; else r->far_steps++;
    /* the newest state's age by our clock (its stamp + the offset - the way) */
    const rc_interp *mo = &r->mo;
    double newest = mo->n && mo->off_init ? (double)mo->t[mo->n - 1] + (double)mo->off_r - (double)way : te;
    double age = te - newest;
    if (mo->n && mo->off_init){ r->age_sum += age; r->age_n++; if ((float)age > r->age_max) r->age_max = (float)age; }
    /* a hit here: on its own physics until a state from after it */
    uint32_t hit = guest_rd32(ctl + CTL_HIT);
    if (r->evals == 1) r->hit = hit;                  /* (one from before we drew it is not ours) */
    if (hit && hit != r->hit){ r->hit = hit; if (!r->own){ r->own = 1; r->own_from = te; r->own_hit++; } }
    /* a stall: a car is carried on along its way (a driven one follows that way on its own physics: a wall still
     * stops it); only one within reach drawn STALL_EXT_US past its newest state runs on its own physics with its
     * owner's last controls (as the game ran one with no prediction left).  At 400 ms that was 26-30 times a car
     * a race on the rig's bad link (220 ms a way, 600 ms stalls), each ending in a glide back of up to 23 m; carried
     * on, as racenet.c's way does, the error stayed under 5 m.  A far car's physics with no states wandered off
     * (3 m a frame on the rig): never on its own */
    int reach = dist < O.drive_m;
    double ext = mo->n && mo->off_init ? te - (double)mo->off_r - (double)r->delay - (double)mo->t[mo->n - 1] : 0.0;
    int stall = reach && ext > (double)STALL_EXT_US;
    if (stall && !r->own){ r->own = 1; r->own_from = te; r->own_stall++; r->stalled = 1; }
    if (r->own && !stall && newest >= r->own_from){
        /* back: glide from where the car is to where the states say.  The interpolator starts its own correction
         * anew (what it held from before the car ran on its own faded at another rate than the glide: the two
         * pulled the car a metre a step apart, 2-11 m "jumps" on the rig) */
        r->own = 0; r->stalled = 0; r->glide = 1; r->mo.shown = 0;
    }
    if (r->own){
        /* the game's blend may have moved it: back to its own physics' place */
        float p[3], v[3], q[4], w[3];
        car_now(car, p, v, q, w);
        int moved = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) moved |= p[i] != sp[i];
        if (moved) put_car(c, ctl, car, sp, sv, sq, sw);
        rc_pose last; rc_interp_peek(&r->mo, mo->n ? mo->t[mo->n - 1] : 0, 0, &last);
        controls(car, &last);
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 3; k++) MRF32(ctl + CTL_PREV_V + 4u * k) = MRF32(car + CAR_VEL + 4u * k);
        return 1;
    }
    rc_pose o;
    int64_t off0 = r->mo.off_r;
    uint64_t sn0 = r->mo.n_snap;
    if (!rc_interp_eval(&r->mo, (int64_t)te, fdt, r->delay, reach ? CAP_US : CAP_FAR_US, &o)) return 0;
    r->eng = o; r->eng_ok = o.ext && o.eng > 0.f;
    /* a correction too big for the interpolator's fade (over 5 m, or its clock offset set anew): it put the car
     * there at once; glide from where it was instead */
    if (r->mo.n_snap != sn0 && r->steps) r->glide = 1;
    if (r->glide){
        r->glide = 0;
        float ic[4], e;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) r->gp[i] = sp[i] - o.p[i];
        rq_conj(o.q, ic); rq_mul(sq, ic, r->gq); rq_norm(r->gq);
        e = len3(r->gp);
        if (!finite_n(r->gp, 3) || e > SNAP_M){ memset(r->gp, 0, sizeof r->gp); r->gq[0] = r->gq[1] = r->gq[2] = 0.f; r->gq[3] = 1.f; r->snaps++; }
        else { r->gtau = clampf(e / GLIDE_V, GLIDE_TAU_MIN, GLIDE_TAU_MAX); r->glides++; if (e > r->glide_max) r->glide_max = e; }
    }
    if (h > 0.f){
        static const float id[4] = { 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 1.f };
        float k = __builtin_expf(-h / (r->gtau > 0.01f ? r->gtau : GLIDE_TAU_MIN)), t4[4];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) r->gp[i] *= k;
        rq_nlerp(id, r->gq, k, t4); memcpy(r->gq, t4, sizeof t4);
    }
    float op[3], oq[4], ov[3], ow[3], vs = (float)(K.vscale > 0.05 ? K.vscale : 1.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++){ op[i] = o.p[i] + r->gp[i]; ov[i] = o.v[i] / vs; ow[i] = o.w[i] / vs; }
    rq_mul(r->gq, o.q, oq); rq_norm(oq);
    if (!finite_n(op, 3) || !finite_n(oq, 4) || !finite_n(ov, 3) || !finite_n(ow, 3)) return 0;
    /* The velocity and spin the game moves the car by after this, to the step's end: how far the drawn car goes
     * over this step (the interpolator at the next step's time, the delay and the offset sliding on as they did
     * this step, the corrections fading on).  The states' own velocity is not that while the delay or the offset
     * slide (up to 15 %) or a correction fades, and on uneven steps (16.7 / 33 ms) the difference was 10-16 cm of
     * wobble a frame on the rig, more where the drawing changed from between states to carried on */
    if (h > 0.f){
        double dte = (double)h * 1e6 / vs;
        int64_t rt = (int64_t)te - r->mo.off_r - r->delay;
        int64_t rt2 = rt + (int64_t)dte - (r->mo.off_r - off0) - (r->delay - delay0);
        rc_pose n2;
        if (rc_interp_peek(&r->mo, rt2, CAP_US, &n2)){
            static const float id[4] = { 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 1.f };
            float ke = rc_expneg((float)dte / 100000.f), kg = __builtin_expf(-h / (r->gtau > 0.01f ? r->gtau : GLIDE_TAU_MIN));
            float p2[3], v2[3], eq2[4], gq2[4], q1[4], q2[4], ic[4], dq[4];
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++){ p2[i] = n2.p[i] + r->mo.err_p[i] * ke + r->gp[i] * kg; v2[i] = (p2[i] - op[i]) / h; }
            rq_nlerp(id, r->mo.err_q, ke, eq2); rq_nlerp(id, r->gq, kg, gq2);
            rq_mul(eq2, n2.q, q1); rq_mul(gq2, q1, q2); rq_norm(q2);
            rq_conj(oq, ic); rq_mul(q2, ic, dq); rq_norm(dq);
            if (dq[3] < 0.f) for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) dq[i] = -dq[i];
            float vn = __builtin_sqrtf(dq[0] * dq[0] + dq[1] * dq[1] + dq[2] * dq[2]), ang = 2.f * __builtin_atan2f(vn, dq[3]);
            if (finite_n(v2, 3) && len3(v2) < 150.f){ memcpy(ov, v2, sizeof v2); r->vfit++; }
            if (vn > 1e-7f && __builtin_isfinite(ang) && ang / h < 20.f) for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) ow[i] = dq[i] / vn * ang / h;
            else if (vn <= 1e-7f) memset(ow, 0, sizeof ow);
        }
    }
    /* driven (a test, above): on its own physics, its velocity and yaw rate toward the states' */
    int drive = O.drive && dist < (r->driving ? O.drive_m + 20.f : O.drive_m);
    if (drive){
        float e[3] = { op[0] - sp[0], op[1] - sp[1], op[2] - sp[2] };
        if (len3(e) < DRIVE_SNAP_M){
            float vc[3], wc[3], k = 1.f / O.drive_tau, cx = e[0] * k, cy = e[1] * k, cm = __builtin_sqrtf(cx * cx + cy * cy);
            if (cm > DRIVE_VMAX){ cx *= DRIVE_VMAX / cm; cy *= DRIVE_VMAX / cm; }
            vc[0] = ov[0] + cx; vc[1] = ov[1] + cy; vc[2] = sv[2];
            float ic[4], qe[4];
            rq_conj(sq, ic); rq_mul(oq, ic, qe); rq_norm(qe);       /* the turn from the car to the states' (world) */
            if (qe[3] < 0.f) for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) qe[i] = -qe[i];
            float vn = __builtin_sqrtf(qe[0] * qe[0] + qe[1] * qe[1] + qe[2] * qe[2]);
            float ang = 2.f * __builtin_atan2f(vn, qe[3]), rz = vn > 1e-6f ? qe[2] / vn * ang : 0.f;
            wc[0] = sw[0]; wc[1] = sw[1]; wc[2] = ow[2] + rz / O.drive_tau_r;
            if (finite_n(vc, 3) && finite_n(wc, 3)){
                put_car(c, ctl, car, sp, vc, sq, wc);
                r->driving = 1; r->drive_steps++;
                goto drawn;
            }
        }
        r->drive_snaps++;
    } else if (r->driving){
        /* out of reach: from where the physics left it, a glide to the states' place */
        r->driving = 0;
        float ic[4];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) r->gp[i] = sp[i] - o.p[i];
        rq_conj(o.q, ic); rq_mul(sq, ic, r->gq); rq_norm(r->gq);
        float e = len3(r->gp);
        if (!finite_n(r->gp, 3) || e > SNAP_M){ memset(r->gp, 0, sizeof r->gp); r->gq[0] = r->gq[1] = r->gq[2] = 0.f; r->gq[3] = 1.f; r->snaps++; }
        else { r->gtau = clampf(e / GLIDE_V, GLIDE_TAU_MIN, GLIDE_TAU_MAX); r->glides++; if (e > r->glide_max) r->glide_max = e; }
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) op[i] = o.p[i] + r->gp[i];
        rq_mul(r->gq, o.q, oq); rq_norm(oq);
    }
    put_car(c, ctl, car, op, ov, oq, ow);
drawn:
    rd3(car + CAR_POS, r->putp); rd3(car + CAR_VEL, r->putv); r->puts++;
    {
        /* a car put over BIG_M from where it was at the step's start: why (always, a few lines a race) */
        float d[3] = { r->putp[0] - sp[0], r->putp[1] - sp[1], r->putp[2] - sp[2] };
        if (len3(d) > BIG_M && r->bigs++ < BIG_LINES)
            fprintf(stderr, "[racecars] %s put %.1f m from where it was: mode %d, delay %.0f ms, %.0f ms past its newest state (%d "
                    "states, epoch %u), glide %.1f m, driving %d, own %d, interpolator's correction %.1f m, %.0f m away\n",
                    r->name, (double)len3(d), o.mode, (double)r->delay / 1e3, ext / 1e3, r->mo.n, (unsigned)r->mo.epoch,
                    (double)len3(r->gp), r->driving, r->own, (double)len3(r->mo.err_p), (double)dist);
    }
    if (O.trace){
        /* a step whose move differs from the step before's (scaled by the steps) by over 0.3 m: what made it */
        float np[3]; rd3(car + CAR_POS, np);
        if (r->thave && h > 0.f && r->th > 0.f){
            float dv[3], k = h / r->th;
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) dv[i] = (np[i] - r->tp[i]) - r->tm[i] * k;
            if (len3(dv) > 0.3f)
                fprintf(stderr, "[rctrace] %s: step %.1f ms (last %.1f), te %.1f ms on (fdt), delay %.1f ms, mode %d, off %.1f ms, "
                        "newest %.1f ms old, %d states; moved %.2f m off the last step's move; drive %d glide %.2f m\n",
                        r->name, (double)h * 1e3, (double)r->th * 1e3, (double)fdt / 1e3, (double)r->delay / 1e3, o.mode,
                        (double)r->mo.off_r / 1e3, age / 1e3, r->mo.n, (double)len3(dv), r->driving, (double)len3(r->gp));
        }
        if (r->steps % 300 == 0 && r->mo.n)
            fprintf(stderr, "[rctrace] %s every 300: %.0f m away, delay %.1f ms, mode %d, drawn %.1f ms past its newest state, "
                    "%d states over %.0f ms, newest %.1f ms old, way %.1f ms, vscale %.3f\n", r->name, (double)dist, (double)r->delay / 1e3, o.mode,
                    ((double)r->last_eval - (double)r->mo.off_r - (double)r->delay - (double)r->mo.t[r->mo.n - 1]) / 1e3, r->mo.n,
                    (double)(r->mo.t[r->mo.n - 1] - r->mo.t[0]) / 1e3, age / 1e3, (double)way / 1e3, K.vscale);
        if (h > 0.f){ for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++){ r->tm[i] = r->thave ? np[i] - r->tp[i] : 0.f; } r->th = r->thave ? h : 0.f; }
        memcpy(r->tp, np, sizeof np); r->thave = 1;
    }
    controls(car, &o);
    uint32_t drv = guest_rd32(car + 0x28u) == 3u ? guest_rd32(car + 0x34u) : 0, x = drv ? guest_rd32(drv + 0x24u) : 0;
    if (guest_ok(x, 0x139u)){ MR8(x + 0x138u) = 1; call_game(c, FN_DRIVEN, drv, 0, 0, RET_DRIVEN); }
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 3; k++) MRF32(ctl + CTL_PREV_V + 4u * k) = MRF32(car + CAR_VEL + 4u * k);
    r->steps++;
    return 1;
}

/* ---- the other cars' engines (above): carsfx.c, heard from the camera ---- */
static int g_sounding;                            /* carsfx.c was given cars last frame */
static void engines_frame(CPU *c, int racing){
    float L[3], f[3] = { 1.f, 0.f, 0.f }, v[3] = {0};
    uint32_t cam = guest_rd32(G_VIEW1 + 0x40u), me = my_car();
    int64_t t = now_us();
    int any = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < NCARS; i++){ g_rc[i].heard = 0; any |= g_rc[i].ip && g_rc[i].eng_ok; }
    if (!racing || !O.engines || !any || !guest_ok(cam, 0x60)){
        if (g_sounding){ carsfx_begin(0, f, 0); carsfx_end(); g_sounding = 0; }
        return;
    }
    rd3(cam + 0x40u, L); rd3(cam + 0x50u, f);
    if (guest_ok(me, 0x9e0)) rd3(me + CAR_VEL, v);
    carsfx_begin(L, f, v);
    for (int i = 0; i < NCARS; i++){
        Rc *r = &g_rc[i];
        if (!r->ip || r->slot < 0 || !r->eng_ok || !guest_ok(r->car, 0x9e0) || t - r->rx_at > STALE_US) continue;
        if (r->gin_car != r->car){
            uint32_t ride = guest_rd32(r->car + 0x10u);
            if (!guest_ok(ride, 0x300) || !roam_game_engine_files(c, ride, r->gin, &r->idle, &r->most)) r->gin[0][0] = 0;
            r->gin_car = r->car;
            fprintf(stderr, "[racecars] %s's engine: %s + %s\n", r->name[0] ? r->name : "?", r->gin[0][0] ? r->gin[0] : "-",
                    r->gin[0][0] ? r->gin[1] : "- (the game's AI engine)");
        }
        carsfx_state st; memset(&st, 0, sizeof st);
        roam_game_engine_sound(r->gin, r->idle, r->most, &r->eng, &st);
        if (!st.gin[0]) continue;
        float p[3], cv[3]; rd3(r->car + CAR_POS, p); rd3(r->car + CAR_VEL, cv);
        carsfx_car(0x4e325253u + (uint32_t)r->slot, r->name, p, cv, &st);   /* ("N2RS" + its slot: one per car) */
        r->heard = 1; r->heard_frames++;
        roam_game_aieng_patch();
    }
    carsfx_end();
    g_sounding = 1;
}
/* this car's engine is played here, at this rpm on the sound's scale (0: not; roam_game.c's aieng_update silences
 * the game's AI engine on it; roam.c's "roam cars") */
float racecars_engine_heard(uint32_t car){
    for (int i = 0; car && i < NCARS; i++) if (g_rc[i].heard && g_rc[i].car == car) return g_rc[i].eng.eng;
    return 0.f;
}

/* every frame, on the game thread (racenet.c's racenet_frame, after the world's step) */
void racecars_frame(CPU *c){
    opts();
    int racing = O.on && in_race();
    uint32_t w = guest_rd32(G_WORLD);
    if (!racing || w != g_world){
        if (!racing){ memset(g_rc, 0, sizeof g_rc); S.refused = S.bad = S.sent_err = 0; }
        g_world = racing ? w : 0;
    }
    clock_frame(racing);
    if (racing) send_frame();
    engines_frame(c, racing);
    /* NFSU2_RACECARS_TRACE: a car moved between our put (the world's step) and here (before the frame is drawn) */
    if (racing && O.trace) for (int i = 0; i < NCARS; i++){
        Rc *r = &g_rc[i];
        if (!r->ip || !r->car || !guest_ok(r->car, 0x9e0) || !r->mo.n) continue;
        float p[3], d[3], h = MRF32(G_WORLDDT); rd3(r->car + CAR_POS, p);
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) d[k] = p[k] - r->putp[k] - r->putv[k] * h;
        if (!r->puts && racecars_fed(r->car))
            fprintf(stderr, "[rctrace] %s: not put this pass (own %d, newest %.0f ms ago)\n", r->name, r->own, (double)(now_us() - r->rx_at) / 1e3);
        else if (r->puts && (len3(d) > 0.2f || r->puts != 1))
            fprintf(stderr, "[rctrace] %s after the step: %.3f m (%.3f %.3f %.3f) off where we put it + its velocity x the step (%.1f ms), "
                    "%d puts, own %d\n", r->name, (double)len3(d), (double)d[0], (double)d[1], (double)d[2], (double)h * 1e3, r->puts, r->own);
        r->puts = 0;
    }
}

/* the lines at the race's end (racenet.c's end) */
void racecars_log(double secs){
    if (!racecars_on()) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "[racecars]   our car: %u states to the others (%.1f/s), %u datagrams, %u not sent; %u refused, %u bad; "
            "stamp clock set anew %u times\n", K.nsent, secs > 0 ? K.nsent / secs : 0., K.ndg, S.sent_err, S.refused, S.bad, K.snaps);
    for (int i = 0; i < NCARS; i++){
        Rc *r = &g_rc[i];
        if (!r->ip) continue;
        char a[16]; snprintf(a, sizeof a, "%u.%u.%u.%u", r->ip >> 24, r->ip >> 16 & 255u, r->ip >> 8 & 255u, r->ip & 255u);
        uint32_t st = r->near_steps + r->far_steps;
        fprintf(stderr, "[racecars]   car %s (slot %d, %s): %u states (%.1f/s), longest wait %.0f ms, waits over 250/500 ms %u/%u; "
                "least round trip %.0f ms; its states %.0f ms old on average (at most %.0f); drawn %u steps, %.0f %% near; "
                "between states %llu, carried on %llu, held %llu; corrections over 5 m %llu (largest %.2f m); on its own after "
                "%u hits, %u stalls; %u glides back (largest %.1f m), %u snaps; driven %u steps, %u put right; its own engine heard "
                "%u frames\n",
                r->name[0] ? r->name : "?", r->slot, a, r->n, secs > 0 ? r->n / secs : 0., (double)r->gap_max / 1000.0, r->g250, r->g500,
                (double)rtt_min(r) / 1000.0, r->age_n ? r->age_sum / r->age_n / 1000.0 : 0., (double)r->age_max / 1000.0,
                r->steps, st ? 100.0 * r->near_steps / st : 0., (unsigned long long)r->mo.n_interp, (unsigned long long)r->mo.n_extrap,
                (unsigned long long)r->mo.n_hold, (unsigned long long)r->mo.n_snap, (double)r->mo.err_max, r->own_hit, r->own_stall,
                r->glides, (double)r->glide_max, r->snaps, r->drive_steps, r->drive_snaps, r->heard_frames);
    }
}

/* racehorn.c -- horns in races between players (the game's Online and LAN
 * races).  Free roam has its own (roam_game.c); the sound is horn.c's.
 *
 * In a network race the other players' cars are the game's own: its race
 * link moves them with datagrams on UDP 3658 between the players' games, a
 * star around the game's creator (web/server-rs/crates/online).  The horn goes beside
 * that link, between the same games, on a UDP port of the runtime's own
 * (HORN_PORT, net_lan.c's vlan_rt_*), so the game never sees it:
 *   - to whom: the games the race link exchanged datagrams with in the last
 *     PEER_MS (vlan_race_peers): every joiner for the creator, the creator
 *     for a joiner.  The creator passes each joiner's horn on to the other
 *     joiners, marked relayed (never passed on again).
 *   - what: "N2HN", version 1, flags (1 the horn sounds, 2 relayed, bits
 *     2-5 which horn: horn.h's kinds, which a build before them leaves at 0,
 *     the dual one, and ignores), a sequence number, and the name the
 *     player races under, as the game shows it over their car on every
 *     screen: the network race's player
 *     table (G_NETPLAYERS: player i's name at +0x12, which its own lookup by
 *     name 0x5F0230 compares; the HUD's names over the cars, 0x4EC0D0, pair
 *     player i with the world's car whose +0xA is i, World 0x5F0E30).  While
 *     the horn sounds, every SEND_MS; when it stops, twice.  A horn not heard
 *     of for STALE_MS stops.
 *   - where it sounds: from the car of the player with that name.  (A car's
 *     racer record names the profile, not the player: "No Profile" for a
 *     player without one, nothing for the others' cars.)
 * The port also carries the players' frame rates ("N2FS"), the joiners' car
 * states straight from their games ("N2CS") and the creator's list of the
 * joiners they go to ("N2PL"), which go to racenet.c, a racer's Quit
 * ("N2QT", which goes to mprace.c) and quick chat ("N2QC", below: qc_*).
 * Only in the browser, where Online and the virtual LAN are; the Mac's LAN
 * has no such port (the weak stand-ins below). */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "guest.h"
#include "game.h"
#include "horn.h"

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static void rd3(uint32_t a, float *o){ o[0] = MRF32(a); o[1] = MRF32(a + 4u); o[2] = MRF32(a + 8u); }
static uint32_t now_ms(void){
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint32_t)((uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000u + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000000u);
}
static uint32_t fnv1a(const char *s){
    uint32_t h = 2166136261u;
    for (; *s; s++){ h ^= (uint8_t)*s; h *= 16777619u; }
    return h;
}
/* the name of the player whose car this is (printable, at most 15
 * characters), "" for none */
static void car_name(uint32_t car, char *o){
    int i = guest_ok(car, 0x9e0) ? (int16_t)MR16(car + 0xau) : -1;
    uint32_t pl = i >= 0 && i < 6 ? guest_rd32(G_NETPLAYERS + 4u * (uint32_t)i) : 0;
    int n = 0;
    if (guest_ok(pl, NP_NAME + NAME_N))
        for (; n < NAME_N - 1; n++){ uint8_t ch = MR8(pl + NP_NAME + (uint32_t)n); if (ch < 0x20 || ch > 0x7e) break; o[n] = (char)ch; }
    o[n] = 0;
}
/* the car has hydraulics, so the stick click is not the horn (horn.h; as
 * roam_game.c's has_hydraulics: RideInfo +0x581, or G_HYD_LEVEL's when not -1) */
static int has_hydraulics(uint32_t car){
    uint32_t ride = guest_ok(car, 0x14) ? guest_rd32(car + 0x10u) : 0;
    int32_t lv = guest_ok(ride, 0x581) ? (int8_t)MR8(ride + 0x581u) : 0, ov = (int32_t)guest_rd32(G_HYD_LEVEL);
    return (ov > -1 ? ov : lv) != 0;
}
