/* "roam shopgo NAME": jump onto a career shop's marker (as career.c's shopgo;
 * shops [0x8383F0] x [0x8383F4], 0xA0 bytes, +0 name, +0x3C marker hash;
 * markers PathsData 0x88F298 +0x438 size, +0x43C blob of records with +4 x,
 * +8 y, +0xC/+0x10 heading, +0x14 z, +0x30 hash, +0x42 record size). */
static uint32_t marker_by_hash(uint32_t h){
    uint32_t m = rd32(0x88f298u + 0x43cu), end = m + rd32(0x88f298u + 0x438u);
    for (int k = 0; m && m < end && k < 4096; k++){
        if (MR32(m + 0x30u) == h) return m;
        int16_t sz = (int16_t)MR16(m + 0x42u); if (sz <= 0) break; m += (uint32_t)sz;
    }
    return 0;
}
static void shop_go(const char *nm){
    uint32_t t = rd32(0x8383f0u), n = rd32(0x8383f4u), sh = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; t && i < n && !sh; i++) if (!strcasecmp(cstr(t + i * 0xa0u), nm)) sh = t + i * 0xa0u;
    uint32_t m = sh ? marker_by_hash(MR32(sh + 0x3cu)) : 0;
    if (!m){ fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld shopgo %s: not found\n", autotest_frame(), nm); return; }
    double a = atan2((double)MRF32(m + 0x10u), (double)MRF32(m + 0xcu));
    MRF32(G_HOTPOS) = MRF32(m + 4u); MRF32(G_HOTPOS + 4) = MRF32(m + 8u); MRF32(G_HOTPOS + 8) = MRF32(m + 0x14u) + 0.5f;
    MR16(G_HOTPOS_ANGLE) = (uint16_t)(int)(a / (2.0 * 3.14159265358979) * 65536.0); MR8(G_HOTPOS_VALID) = 1; MR8(G_HOTPOS_JUMP) = 1;
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld shopgo %s: %.1f %.1f %.1f\n", autotest_frame(), nm, (double)MRF32(m + 4u), (double)MRF32(m + 8u), (double)MRF32(m + 0x14u));
}
/* "roam racego": jump onto the start marker of the first available career
 * race (Career 0x85AD40 +0x71C8: 64 CareerRace*, +0x28 marker hash, +0
 * name), as career.c's careergo does */
static void race_go(void){
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++){
        uint32_t r = rd32(G_CAREER + 0x71c8u + 4u * (uint32_t)i);
        uint32_t m = guest_ok(r, 0x40) ? marker_by_hash(MR32(r + 0x28u)) : 0;
        if (!m) continue;
        double a = atan2((double)MRF32(m + 0x10u), (double)MRF32(m + 0xcu));
        MRF32(G_HOTPOS) = MRF32(m + 4u); MRF32(G_HOTPOS + 4) = MRF32(m + 8u); MRF32(G_HOTPOS + 8) = MRF32(m + 0x14u) + 0.5f;
        MR16(G_HOTPOS_ANGLE) = (uint16_t)(int)(a / (2.0 * 3.14159265358979) * 65536.0); MR8(G_HOTPOS_VALID) = 1; MR8(G_HOTPOS_JUMP) = 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld racego %s: %.1f %.1f %.1f\n", autotest_frame(), cstr(rd32(r)), (double)MRF32(m + 4u),
                (double)MRF32(m + 8u), (double)MRF32(m + 0x14u));
        return;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld racego: no available race\n", autotest_frame());
}
static uint32_t g_world_seen; static int g_active;   /* any roam command seen */
static void world_watch(void){
    uint32_t w = rd32(G_WORLD);
    if (!g_active && !probe()){ g_world_seen = w; return; }
    if (w != g_world_seen){
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld world 0x%08x -> 0x%08x (flow %u, cars %u)\n", autotest_frame(), g_world_seen, w,
                rd32(G_FLOW), guest_ok(w, 0x20) ? MR32(w + 0x10u) : 0);
        g_world_seen = w; }
}

/* ---- guest memory snapshot (tests/asi_harness.c runs the Windows plugin on it) ---
 * "NFSUSNP1", then u32: version 1, eip (the hook), eax ecx edx ebx esp ebp esi
 * edi, fs_base, fcw, n; then n x { u32 block (address >> 14), 16 KB }. */
extern uint8_t g_cbits[1u << 15];
static void snapshot(CPU *c, const char *path){
    char p[200] = {0}; sscanf(path, "%199s", p);
    FILE *o = fopen(p, "wb");
    if (!o){ fprintf(stderr, "[roam] snapshot: cannot write %s\n", p); return; }
    uint32_t n = 0;
    for (uint32_t b = 0; b < (1u << 18); b++) if ((g_cbits[b >> 3] >> (b & 7)) & 1) n++;
    uint32_t hdr[14] = { 1u, GUEST_RET_MAINLOOP, c->eax, c->ecx, c->edx, c->ebx, c->esp, c->ebp, c->esi, c->edi, c->fs_base,
                         (uint32_t)c->fcw, n, 0 };
    fwrite("NFSUSNP1", 1, 8, o); fwrite(hdr, 4, 13, o);
    for (uint32_t b = 0; b < (1u << 18); b++){
        if (!((g_cbits[b >> 3] >> (b & 7)) & 1)) continue;
        fwrite(&b, 4, 1, o); fwrite(g_mem + ((uint64_t)b << 14), 1, 0x4000, o);
    }
    fclose(o);
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld snapshot: %u blocks (%u MB), esp 0x%08x -> %s\n", autotest_frame(), n, n >> 6, c->esp, p);
}

/* ---- main-loop hook ----------------------------------------------------------- */
static long g_carlog_every, g_carlog_next;
static int g_smsauto; static long g_sms_next;   /* "roam smsauto on": answer in-game SMS pop-ups */
static void run_job(CPU *c, const char *line){
    char sub[32] = {0}; int used = 0;
    sscanf(line, "%31s %n", sub, &used);
    const char *rest = line + used;
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "call")){
        char tok[16][64]; int nt = 0; const char *p = rest;
        while (nt < 16 && *p){
            while (*p == ' ') p++;
            if (!*p) break;
            int k = 0; while (*p && *p != ' ' && k < 63) tok[nt][k++] = *p++;
            tok[nt++][k] = 0;
        }
        if (nt < 1) return;
        uint32_t fn = eval(tok[0]), ecx = 0, edx = 0, arg[15]; int na = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < nt; i++){
            if (!strncasecmp(tok[i], "ecx=", 4)) ecx = eval(tok[i] + 4);
            else if (!strncasecmp(tok[i], "edx=", 4)) edx = eval(tok[i] + 4);
            else arg[na++] = eval(tok[i]);
        }
        uint32_t r = guest_call(c, fn, ecx, edx, na, arg);
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld call 0x%08x(ecx=0x%08x edx=0x%08x, %d args) -> eax=0x%08x (%d)\n",
                autotest_frame(), fn, ecx, edx, na, r, (int)r);
    } else if (!strcasecmp(sub, "cars")) log_cars("script", !strncasecmp(rest, "expect", 6));
    else if (!strcasecmp(sub, "types")) log_types();
    else if (!strcasecmp(sub, "loader")) log_loader("script");
    else if (!strcasecmp(sub, "rewind")) rewind_player();
    else if (!strcasecmp(sub, "spawn")) spawn_start(c);
    else if (!strcasecmp(sub, "snapshot")) snapshot(c, rest);
    else if (!strcasecmp(sub, "ghost")){
        char a1[16] = {0}, a2[16] = {0}, a3[16] = {0};
        sscanf(rest, "%15s %15s %15s", a1, a2, a3);
        char a4[16] = {0}; sscanf(rest, "%*s %*s %*s %15s", a4);
        if (!strcasecmp(a1, "on")) ghost_on(c, atoi(a2), !strcasecmp(a3, "direct"), !strcasecmp(a4, "nocol"), !strcasecmp(a3, "replay"));
        else if (!strcasecmp(a1, "ride")) ghost_ride(c, a2);
        else ghost_off(c);
    }
}
void roam_frame(CPU *c){
    while (g_qh != g_qt){ char line[200]; snprintf(line, sizeof line, "%s", g_q[g_qh]); g_qh = (g_qh + 1) % QMAX; run_job(c, line); }
    long f = autotest_frame();
    if (rd32(G_FLOW) == 6u) g_simt += (double)MRF32(G_WORLDDT);
    if (g_smsauto && f >= g_sms_next){
        const char *t = autotest_top_fng();
        if (t && !strcasecmp(t, "UI_EngageMessageDialog.fng")){
            autotest_tap(0x1cu, 6); g_sms_next = f + 60;
            fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld smsauto: RETURN on %s\n", f, t); }
        else if (t && (!strcasecmp(t, "UI_SMS_Mailbox.fng") || !strcasecmp(t, "UI_SMS_Message.fng"))){
            autotest_tap(0x01u, 6); g_sms_next = f + 60;          /* ESCAPE: back to the game */
            fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld smsauto: ESCAPE on %s\n", f, t); }
        else if (t && strcasecmp(t, "HUD_SingleRace.fng") && g_sms_next < f - 600){
            fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld smsauto: top package %s\n", f, t); g_sms_next = f + 600; }
    }
    world_watch();
    trace_tick();
    rec_tick();
    ghost_tick(c);
    ride_tick(c);
    spawn_tick(c);
    if (g_carlog_every > 0 && f >= g_carlog_next){ g_carlog_next = f + g_carlog_every; log_cars("periodic", 0); }
}
void racenet_prestep(CPU *c);                 /* racenet.c: the cars' own places back before the world's step */
void visualrep_meter(CPU *c);                 /* visualrep.c: no Visual Rating box in the shops */
void gpsdistance_hud(CPU *c);
void roam_game_hud(CPU *c);                 /* roam_game.c: its names over friends' cars */
int roam_game_cmd(CPU *c, const char *args, long *wait_start);
int coop_cmd(CPU *c, const char *args, long *wait_start);
/* the "virtual Windows friend" (roam_asipeer.c, only in out/nfsu2_asipeer):
 * the Windows plugin under Unicorn instead of roam_game.c */
__attribute__((weak)) int roam_asipeer_frame(CPU *c){ (void)c; return 0; }
__attribute__((weak)) int roam_asipeer_cmd(CPU *c, const char *args, long *wait_start){
    (void)c; (void)args; (void)wait_start;
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] asi: not in this build (ASIPEER=1 ./link.sh orig makes out/nfsu2_asipeer)\n"); return 1; }
int roam_hook(CPU *c, uint32_t ip){
    switch (ip){
    case HOOK_SITE(0x00581475): features_frame(c); return 1;   /* every frame: the features' calls (features.c) */
    /* Player::Update's HUD step (0x600590), behind its call of the HUD
     * update (0x4EC5A0), where the game places its own LAN race labels */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x006005e0): gpsdistance_hud(c); roam_game_hud(c); return 1;
    /* the main loop's call of World::DoTimestep (0x609CE0), its only one */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x00581407): racenet_prestep(c); return 1;
    /* the customization shops' push of the Visual Rating box (0x557EC0), at
     * its test of "up already?" (0x52CF60's al) */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x00557ed0): visualrep_meter(c); return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* ---- front end: from the title to free roam with a saved career -------------
 * "roam fe2roam [tmo]" presses through the screens a saved career goes
 * through (title, "Load complete.", main menu -> Career, Resume Career, the
 * crib -> Return to Explore Mode, SMS pop-ups) until the car is in free roam.
 * The screen logic is career.c's bot (feat/career), cut down to this path.
 * Active FEng packages: cFEng [0x8384C4] +8 -> manager, lists at +0xE4 and
 * +0xF4 of FNGInfo records chained through +4, name at +0xC; overlays such as
 * MC_Main.fng (memory-card prompts) are on them while GetTopPackage still
 * names the screen below. */
static uint32_t fe_mgr(void){
    uint32_t fe = rd32(G_FENG);
    if (!fe || !guest_ok(fe, 11)) return 0;
    uint32_t mg = MR32(fe + 8u);
    return guest_ok(mg, 0xf7) ? mg : 0;
}
static int fe_active(const char *want){
    uint32_t mg = fe_mgr();
    if (!mg) return 0;
    for (uint32_t head = 0xe4u; head <= 0xf4u; head += 0x10u){
        uint32_t p = MR32(mg + head);
        for (int k = 0; p && k < 64 && guest_ok(p, 0x10); k++, p = MR32(p + 4u)){
            uint32_t n = MR32(p + 0xcu);
            if (!guest_ok(n, 47)) continue;
            const char *q = (const char *)(g_mem + n); int i = 0;
            while (i < 47 && q[i] >= 0x20 && q[i] < 0x7f) i++;
            if (i > 4 && !q[i] && (want[0] == '*' ? strstr(q, want + 1) != 0 : !strcasecmp(q, want))) return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
static struct { char keys[16]; int nkeys; long next, top_since, last_poke, roam_since; char top[64]; } FE;
static void fe_keys(const char *k){ snprintf(FE.keys, sizeof FE.keys, "%s", k); FE.nkeys = (int)strlen(FE.keys); }
static int fe2roam(long f, long *wait_start, long tmo){
    if (*wait_start < 0){ *wait_start = f; memset(&FE, 0, sizeof FE); FE.roam_since = -1; }
    const char *top = autotest_top_fng(); if (!top) top = "";
    if (strcmp(top, FE.top)){ snprintf(FE.top, sizeof FE.top, "%s", top); FE.top_since = f; FE.last_poke = f;
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld fe2roam: screen %s (flow %u)\n", f, top, rd32(G_FLOW)); }
    int in = roaming() && !strcasecmp(top, "HUD_SingleRace.fng") && !fe_active("UI_EngageMessageDialog.fng");
    if (!in) FE.roam_since = -1; else if (FE.roam_since < 0) FE.roam_since = f;
    if (in && f - FE.roam_since >= 240){ fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld fe2roam: in free roam after %ld frames\n", f, f - *wait_start); *wait_start = -1; return 1; }
    if (tmo && f - *wait_start >= tmo){ fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld fe2roam TIMEOUT on %s\n", f, top); *wait_start = -1; return 1; }
    if (f < FE.next) return 0;
    if (FE.nkeys){                      /* one key every 20 frames */
        char k = FE.keys[0]; memmove(FE.keys, FE.keys + 1, sizeof FE.keys - 1); FE.nkeys--;
        autotest_tap(k == 'L' ? 0xcbu : k == 'G' ? 0xcdu : 0x1cu, 6);
        FE.next = f + (FE.nkeys ? 20 : 90); return 0;
    }
    if (fe_active("*GenericDialog")){ fe_keys("LR"); FE.next = f + 30; return 0; }
    if (fe_active("MC_Main.fng")){ fe_keys("LR"); FE.next = f + 60; return 0; }   /* memory-card prompts: the left button (yes / OK) */
    if (!strcasecmp(top, "UI_EngageMessageDialog.fng") || !strcasecmp(top, "MC_Background.fng") ||
        !strcasecmp(top, "UI_SMS_Mailbox.fng") || !strcasecmp(top, "UI_SMS_Message.fng")){ fe_keys("R"); FE.next = f + 150; return 0; }
    if (rd32(G_FLOW) == 3u){
        if (fe_active("UI_CareerCrib.fng")){ fe_keys("R"); FE.next = f + 60; return 0; }      /* Return to Explore Mode */
        if (fe_active("UI_Main.fng")){ fe_keys("LR"); FE.next = f + 240; return 0; }          /* main menu: Career */
        if (fe_active("UI_StartCareer.fng")){ fe_keys("R"); FE.next = f + 240; return 0; }    /* Resume Career */
    }
    if (!strcasecmp(top, "HUD_SingleRace.fng") && fe_active("UI_EngageMessageDialog.fng")){ fe_keys("R"); FE.next = f + 60; return 0; }
    if (!strcasecmp(top, "PC_Loading.fng") || !strcasecmp(top, "HUD_World_Loading.fng") || !strcasecmp(top, "HUD_SingleRace.fng")) return 0;
    if (f - FE.last_poke >= 600){ FE.last_poke = f; fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld fe2roam: %s for %ld frames: RETURN\n", f, top, f - FE.top_since); fe_keys("R"); }
    return 0;
}

/* ---- script commands (autotest.c) ------------------------------------------ */
/* line = "<sub> <args>".  Returns 1 when done, 0 to be called again next frame. */
int roam_cmd(CPU *c, const char *line, long *wait_start){
    char sub[32] = {0}, a1[64] = {0}, a2[64] = {0}, a3[200] = {0}; int used = 0;
    sscanf(line, "%31s %n", sub, &used);
    const char *rest = line + used;
    sscanf(rest, "%63s %63s %199s", a1, a2, a3);
    long f = autotest_frame();
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "mp")) return roam_game_cmd(c, rest, wait_start);
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "asi")) return roam_asipeer_cmd(c, rest, wait_start);
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "coop")) return coop_cmd(c, rest, wait_start);
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "racesay")){             /* quick chat in a race between players, as picked on the page */
        void racehorn_test_say(int phrase);
        racehorn_test_say(atoi(a1));
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld racesay %d\n", f, atoi(a1));
        return 1; }
    g_active = 1;
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "call") || !strcasecmp(sub, "cars") || !strcasecmp(sub, "ghost") ||
        !strcasecmp(sub, "types") || !strcasecmp(sub, "loader") || !strcasecmp(sub, "rewind") ||
        !strcasecmp(sub, "spawn") || !strcasecmp(sub, "snapshot")){ queue(line); return 1; }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "trace")){
        if (g_trace){ fclose(g_trace); g_trace = 0; }
        if (!strcasecmp(a1, "on") && (g_trace = fopen(a2, "w")))
            fprintf(g_trace, "frame,worldtimer,realtimer,sim_ms,host_s,wdt,px,py,pz,vx,vy,vz,cx,cy,cz,speed,rpm\n");
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld trace %s\n", f, g_trace ? a2 : "off");
        return 1; }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "shopgo")){ shop_go(a1); return 1; }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "racego")){ race_go(); return 1; }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "smsauto")){ g_smsauto = !strcasecmp(a1, "on"); return 1; }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "rec") && !strcasecmp(a1, "save")){     /* roam rec save FILE: CSV of the samples */
        FILE *o = fopen(a2, "w");
        if (!o){ fprintf(stderr, "[roam] rec save: cannot write %s\n", a2); return 1; }
        fprintf(o, "wt,px,py,pz,vx,vy,vz,fx,fy,fz,lx,ly,lz,ux,uy,uz,wx,wy,wz,speed,rpm,gear\n");
        for (int i = 0; i < g_nrec; i++){ const Sample *q = &g_rec[i];
            fprintf(o, "%u,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.3f,%.1f,%d\n",
                    q->wt, q->p[0], q->p[1], q->p[2], q->v[0], q->v[1], q->v[2], q->f[0], q->f[1], q->f[2], q->l[0], q->l[1], q->l[2],
                    q->u[0], q->u[1], q->u[2], q->w[0], q->w[1], q->w[2], q->spd, q->rpm, q->gear); }
        fclose(o);
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld rec save: %d samples -> %s\n", f, g_nrec, a2);
        return 1; }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "rec")){
        g_recon = !strcasecmp(a1, "on");
        if (g_recon){ g_nrec = 0; }
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld rec %s (%d samples)\n", f, g_recon ? "on" : "off", g_nrec);
        return 1; }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "carlog")){ g_carlog_every = atol(a1); g_carlog_next = f; return 1; }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "peek")){
        uint32_t a = eval(a1), n = a2[0] ? eval(a2) : 1;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && i < 64; i++){
            uint32_t q = a + 4u * i;
            if (!guest_ok(q, 3)){ fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld peek [0x%08x] = <unmapped>\n", f, q); continue; }
            uint32_t v = MR32(q); float fv; memcpy(&fv, &v, 4);
            fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld peek [0x%08x] = 0x%08x (%d, %g)\n", f, q, v, (int)v, (double)fv);
        }
        return 1;
    }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "memdump")){
        uint32_t a = eval(a1), n = eval(a2), w = 0;
        FILE *o = fopen(a3, "wb");
        if (!o){ fprintf(stderr, "[roam] memdump: cannot write %s\n", a3); return 1; }
        for (; w < n && mem_is_committed(a + w); w++) fputc(MR8(a + w), o);
        fclose(o);
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld memdump 0x%08x %u bytes -> %s\n", f, a, w, a3);
        return 1;
    }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "wait")){
        if (*wait_start < 0) *wait_start = f;
        uint32_t v = eval(a1), want = eval(a2); long tmo = a3[0] ? atol(a3) : 0;
        if (v != want){
            if (tmo && f - *wait_start >= tmo){
                fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld wait %s==%s TIMEOUT (0x%x)\n", f, a1, a2, v); *wait_start = -1; return 1; }
            return 0; }
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld wait %s==%s after %ld frames\n", f, a1, a2, f - *wait_start);
        *wait_start = -1; return 1;
    }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "fe2roam")) return fe2roam(f, wait_start, a1[0] ? atol(a1) : 0);
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "waitroam")){
        static long since = -1;
        long tmo = a1[0] ? atol(a1) : 0; const char *t = autotest_top_fng();
        if (*wait_start < 0){ *wait_start = f; since = -1; }
        int in = roaming() && t && !strcasecmp(t, "HUD_SingleRace.fng");
        if (!in) since = -1; else if (since < 0) since = f;
        if (in && f - since >= 240){
            fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld waitroam satisfied after %ld frames\n", f, f - *wait_start);
            *wait_start = -1; return 1; }
        if (tmo && f - *wait_start >= tmo){ fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld waitroam TIMEOUT\n", f); *wait_start = -1; return 1; }
        return 0;
    }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "teleport")){
        /* X Y Z [ANGLE]: numbers, or expressions starting with '*' / '(' that
         * give the float's bits (e.g. a car's +0x60) */
        char t[4][96] = {{0}}; float v[3] = {0}; unsigned ang = 0;
        int n = sscanf(rest, "%95s %95s %95s %95s", t[0], t[1], t[2], t[3]);
        if (n < 3){ fprintf(stderr, "[roam] teleport: X Y Z [ANGLE]\n"); return 1; }
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++){
            if (t[i][0] == '*' || t[i][0] == '('){ uint32_t b = eval(t[i]); memcpy(&v[i], &b, 4); }
            else v[i] = (float)atof(t[i]); }
        if (n > 3) ang = eval(t[3]);
        MRF32(G_HOTPOS) = v[0]; MRF32(G_HOTPOS + 4) = v[1]; MRF32(G_HOTPOS + 8) = v[2] + 0.5f;
        MR16(G_HOTPOS_ANGLE) = (uint16_t)ang; MR8(G_HOTPOS_VALID) = 1; MR8(G_HOTPOS_JUMP) = 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld teleport %.1f %.1f %.1f angle 0x%04x\n", f, (double)v[0], (double)v[1], (double)v[2], ang & 0xffffu);
        return 1;
    }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "watch")){ mprot_arm(eval(a1)); return 1; }
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] f=%ld unknown subcommand '%s'\n", f, sub);
    return 1;
}

/* roam_asipeer.c -- a "virtual Windows friend" (test tooling, never in the
 * player's build): the real Windows plugin NFSU2FreeRoam.asi plays the
 * free-roam multiplayer inside a port instance, as if this were the PC game.
 *
 * Built into out/nfsu2_asipeer only (ASIPEER=1 UNICORN_DIR=... ./link.sh orig);
 * on with NFSU2_ROAM_ASI=<path to out/win/dbg/NFSU2FreeRoam.asi>.  Then:
 *  - the plugin's 32-bit x86 code runs under Unicorn (tests/asi_vm.c) on the
 *    port's own guest memory: the exe's headers are put at 0x400000 first
 *    (Windows maps them; the port does not), the plugin is loaded at a free
 *    guest address, relocated, and its DllMain and InitializeASI run, which
 *    check the exe and patch the call at 0x581475, as under Ultimate ASI
 *    Loader;
 *  - at the main-loop hook (roam.c, HOOK_SITE 0x581475) the call there is
 *    followed: it points into the plugin, so its frame thunk runs; every call
 *    it makes into the game's code (.text, mapped without execute rights) goes
 *    to the port's lifted function of that address (dispatch_indirect), with
 *    the registers, the x87 stack and the SSE registers carried across, the
 *    same functions the Mac build calls; the thunk's last jump (to 0x4022C0)
 *    is such a call too;
 *  - its Win32 imports are tests/asi_win32.c: the clock is the host's
 *    monotonic clock (the same as the Mac side's, so pose logs compare), its
 *    files go into the run directory, its UDP socket is a host socket that
 *    may only bind 127.0.0.1 and only send to 127/8 (anything else is refused
 *    and logged as BLOCKED), no thread (the plugin then polls from its frame
 *    hook);
 *  - the Mac build's own game side (roam_game.c) is off in this instance.
 * Options: the plugin reads its NFSU2_ROAM_* settings from the environment
 * (tools/roam_multi.sh sets them per instance) and a generated .ini
 * (NetThread = 0).  Script commands "roam asi status|waitcars N [tmo]|
 * follow K [back]" look at the game only (the friends' cars are the inert
 * cars outside the parking spot).
 */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "asi_vm.h"
#include "asi_win32.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <strings.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>

void dispatch_indirect(CPU *c, uint32_t addr);
long autotest_frame(void);
void mem_commit(uint32_t addr, uint32_t size);

static const char *peer_getenv(void *u, const char *n){ (void)u; return !strncmp(n, "NFSU2_", 6) ? getenv(n) : 0; }
static int committed(void *u, uint32_t a){ (void)u; return mem_is_committed(a); }

/* the socket: loopback only, whatever the plugin asks for */
static int s_bind(void *u, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port){
    (void)u;
    if (ip != 0x7F000001u){ g_blocked++; fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] BLOCKED bind %08x:%u (loopback only)\n", ip, port); return -1; }
    int fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP);
    if (fd < 0) return -1;
    fcntl(fd, F_SETFL, fcntl(fd, F_GETFL, 0) | O_NONBLOCK);
    struct sockaddr_in sa; memset(&sa, 0, sizeof sa); sa.sin_family = AF_INET; sa.sin_len = sizeof sa;
    sa.sin_port = htons(port); sa.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    if (bind(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&sa, sizeof sa) < 0){ fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] bind 127.0.0.1:%u: %s\n", port, strerror(errno)); close(fd); return -1; }
    g_fd = fd;
    fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] the plugin's UDP socket: host 127.0.0.1:%u\n", port);
    return 0;
}
static int s_send(void *u, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *b, int n){
    (void)u;
    if ((ip >> 24) != 127 || g_fd < 0){ g_blocked++; fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] BLOCKED sendto %u.%u.%u.%u (loopback only)\n", ip >> 24, (ip >> 16) & 255, (ip >> 8) & 255, ip & 255); return -1; }
    struct sockaddr_in sa; memset(&sa, 0, sizeof sa); sa.sin_family = AF_INET; sa.sin_len = sizeof sa;
    sa.sin_port = htons(port); sa.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(ip);
    return (int)sendto(g_fd, b, (size_t)n, 0, (struct sockaddr *)&sa, sizeof sa);
}
static int s_recv(void *u, uint8_t *b, int cap, uint32_t *ip, uint16_t *port){
    (void)u;
    if (g_fd < 0) return -1;
    struct sockaddr_in sa; socklen_t sl = sizeof sa;
    ssize_t n = recvfrom(g_fd, b, (size_t)cap, 0, (struct sockaddr *)&sa, &sl);
    if (n < 0) return -1;
    *ip = ntohl(sa.sin_addr.s_addr); *port = ntohs(sa.sin_port);
    return (int)n;
}
static int imp(void *u, xvm *vm, int idx, const char *dll, const char *name, uint32_t esp, uint32_t *eax){
    (void)u; (void)idx; return aw32_import(&g_w, vm, dll, name, esp, eax); }

/* ---- a call from the plugin into the game: the port's lifted function ---------------- */
static void uc_to_cpu(xvm *vm, CPU *c){
    uint32_t r[XR__N]; xvm_get(vm, r);
    c->eax = r[XR_EAX]; c->ecx = r[XR_ECX]; c->edx = r[XR_EDX]; c->ebx = r[XR_EBX]; c->esp = r[XR_ESP];
    c->ebp = r[XR_EBP]; c->esi = r[XR_ESI]; c->edi = r[XR_EDI]; c->eip = r[XR_EIP];
    eflags_set(c, (r[XR_EFL] & ~0x00240000u) | (c->sysfl & 0x00240000u));
    uc_engine *uc = xvm_uc(vm);
    uint16_t sw, cw; uc_reg_read(uc, UC_X86_REG_FPSW, &sw); uc_reg_read(uc, UC_X86_REG_FPCW, &cw);
    c->top = (sw >> 11) & 7; c->fsw = (uint16_t)(sw & ~0x3800u); c->fcw = cw;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++){ uint8_t f[10]; uc_reg_read(uc, UC_X86_REG_FP0 + i, f); c->st[i] = f80_load(f); }   /* physical registers, as the port keeps them */
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) uc_reg_read(uc, UC_X86_REG_XMM0 + i, c->xmm[i].b);
}
static void cpu_to_uc(xvm *vm, const CPU *c){
    uint32_t r[XR__N] = { c->eax, c->ecx, c->edx, c->ebx, c->esp, c->ebp, c->esi, c->edi, c->eip, eflags_get(c) & ~0x00240000u };
    xvm_set(vm, r);
    uc_engine *uc = xvm_uc(vm);
    uint16_t sw = (uint16_t)((c->fsw & ~0x3800u) | ((c->top & 7) << 11)), cw = c->fcw, tag = 0;
    uc_reg_write(uc, UC_X86_REG_FPSW, &sw); uc_reg_write(uc, UC_X86_REG_FPCW, &cw); uc_reg_write(uc, UC_X86_REG_FPTAG, &tag);
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++){ uint8_t f[10]; f80_store(f, c->st[i]); uc_reg_write(uc, UC_X86_REG_FP0 + i, f); }
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) uc_reg_write(uc, UC_X86_REG_XMM0 + i, c->xmm[i].b);
}
static int bridge(void *u, xvm *vm, uint32_t target){
    (void)u;
    CPU *c = g_c;
    uc_to_cpu(vm, c);
    dispatch_indirect(c, target);       /* returns with the return address popped into c->eip */
    cpu_to_uc(vm, c);
    g_bridged++;
    return 1;
}
static int on_fault(void *u, xvm *vm, uint32_t eip, uint32_t addr, int write){
    (void)u; (void)vm;
    fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] the plugin's code faulted: %s 0x%08x at 0x%08x\n", write == 1 ? "write" : write == 8 ? "fetch" : "read", addr, eip);
    return 0;
}

static void start(CPU *c){
    g_state = -1;
    const char *asi = getenv("NFSU2_ROAM_ASI");
    char map[600]; snprintf(map, sizeof map, "%s", asi);
    char *sl = strrchr(map, '/');
    if (sl && sl - map >= 4 && !strncmp(sl - 4, "/dbg", 4)){ *(sl - 4) = 0; strcat(map, "/NFSU2FreeRoam.map"); } else map[0] = 0;
    /* the exe's headers, where Windows has them */
    const char *data = getenv("NFSU2_DATA");
    char exe[600]; snprintf(exe, sizeof exe, "%s/SPEED2.EXE", data ? data : ".");
    FILE *f = fopen(exe, "rb");
    if (!f){ fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] cannot read %s (NFSU2_DATA) for its headers: off\n", exe); return; }
    uint8_t h[0x1000]; size_t n = fread(h, 1, sizeof h, f); fclose(f);
    if (n != sizeof h){ return; }
    mem_commit(0x400000u, 0x1000u); memcpy(g_mem + 0x400000u, h, 0x1000u);
    /* a free guest range for the plugin: above modheap.c's heaps of a lifted
     * DLL (server.dll, 0x01000000-0x0F000000, committed only when LAN hosting
     * starts) and below the guest heap (heap.c, 0x10000000-0x60000000) */
    uint32_t base = 0;
    for (uint32_t b = 0x0F000000u; b < 0x10000000u && !base; b += 0x00100000u){
        int used = 0; for (uint32_t a = b; a < b + 0x00100000u; a += 0x4000u) if (mem_is_committed(a)){ used = 1; break; }
        if (!used) base = b;
    }
    if (!base){ fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] no free guest range for the plugin: off\n"); return; }
    snprintf(g_w.ini_path, sizeof g_w.ini_path, "NFSU2FreeRoam.ini");
    FILE *ini = fopen(g_w.ini_path, "w");
    if (ini){ fprintf(ini, "[FreeRoam]\nEnable = 1\nNetThread = 0\nLog = 1\n"); fclose(ini); }
    snprintf(g_w.module_path, sizeof g_w.module_path, "C:\\NFSU2\\scripts\\NFSU2FreeRoam.asi");
    snprintf(g_w.file_dir, sizeof g_w.file_dir, ".");
    g_w.now_us = host_now; g_w.getenv = peer_getenv; g_w.sock_bind = s_bind; g_w.sock_send = s_send; g_w.sock_recv = s_recv;
    xvm_cfg cf = { 0, g_mem, committed, c->fs_base, c->fcw, imp, bridge, TEXT_LO, TEXT_HI, on_fault };
    g_vm = xvm_new(&cf);
    if (!g_vm || xpe_load(&g_pe, g_vm, asi, map[0] ? map : 0, base, commit)){ fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] cannot load %s: off\n", asi); return; }
    xvm_bind_pe(g_vm, &g_pe);
    fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] %s loaded at 0x%08x (%u bytes, %d relocations, %d imports)\n", asi, base, g_pe.size, g_pe.nreloc, g_pe.nimp);
    g_c = c;
    CPU save = *c;
    uint32_t r[XR__N] = {0};
    r[XR_ESP] = (c->esp - 0x1000u) & ~15u;
    uint32_t a[4] = { 0, base, 1, 0 }; memcpy(g_mem + r[XR_ESP], a, 16);
    cpu_to_uc(g_vm, c);
    if (!xvm_call(g_vm, g_pe.entry, r) || r[XR_EAX] != 1){ fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] DllMain failed: %s\n", xvm_why(g_vm)); *c = save; return; }
    r[XR_ESP] = (c->esp - 0x1000u) & ~15u;
    if (!xvm_call(g_vm, xpe_export(&g_pe, "InitializeASI"), r)){ fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] InitializeASI failed: %s\n", xvm_why(g_vm)); *c = save; return; }
    *c = save;
    g_thunk = xpe_sym(&g_pe, "roam_frame_thunk");
    atexit(roam_asipeer_report);
    fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] DllMain and InitializeASI done; 0x581475: %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x (the plugin's thunk 0x%08x); "
                    "the Mac build's own multiplayer is off in this instance\n", MR8(HOOK_SITE), MR8(HOOK_SITE + 1), MR8(HOOK_SITE + 2),
            MR8(HOOK_SITE + 3), MR8(HOOK_SITE + 4), g_thunk);
    g_state = 1;
}

/* the main-loop hook: 1 when the plugin is here (then the Mac build's
 * roam_game_frame does not run) */
int roam_asipeer_frame(CPU *c){
    if (!g_state){ if (!getenv("NFSU2_ROAM_ASI")) { g_state = -1; return 0; } start(c); }
    if (g_state < 0) return getenv("NFSU2_ROAM_ASI") != 0;
    if (MR8(HOOK_SITE) != 0xE8) return 1;
    int32_t rel; memcpy(&rel, g_mem + HOOK_SITE + 1, 4);
    uint32_t tgt = HOOK_SITE + 5u + (uint32_t)rel;
    if (tgt < g_pe.base || tgt >= g_pe.base + g_pe.size) return 1;     /* the plugin did not hook: the game's own call */
    struct timespec t0, t1; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t0);
    CPU save = *c;
    g_c = c;
    c->esp -= 4u;                                                      /* the call's return slot */
    uint32_t r[XR__N] = { c->eax, c->ecx, c->edx, c->ebx, c->esp, c->ebp, c->esi, c->edi, 0, eflags_get(c) & ~0x00240000u };
    cpu_to_uc(g_vm, c);
    int ok = xvm_call(g_vm, tgt, r);
    if (!ok){ fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] f=%ld the plugin's frame stopped: %s -- plugin off\n", autotest_frame(), xvm_why(g_vm)); g_state = -1; }
    else if (r[XR_ESP] != save.esp || r[XR_EAX] != save.eax || r[XR_EBX] != save.ebx || r[XR_ESI] != save.esi || r[XR_EDI] != save.edi || r[XR_EBP] != save.ebp){
        static int warned; if (!warned++) fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] f=%ld the plugin's thunk came back with other registers\n", autotest_frame()); }
    *c = save;
    g_frames++;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t1);
    g_ns += (uint64_t)((t1.tv_sec - t0.tv_sec) * 1000000000 + (t1.tv_nsec - t0.tv_nsec));
    return 1;
}
void roam_asipeer_report(void){
    static int done;
    if (g_state == 0 || !g_vm || done++) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "\n  [asipeer] the Windows plugin ran %llu frames under Unicorn (%.1f us per frame with its game calls), "
                    "%llu calls into the game bridged, %llu Win32 calls, %llu bytes sent, %llu received, %llu refused (not loopback), %d thread(s) refused\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_frames, g_frames ? g_ns / 1000.0 / (double)g_frames : 0.0, (unsigned long long)g_bridged,
            (unsigned long long)g_w.calls, (unsigned long long)g_w.bytes_sent, (unsigned long long)g_w.bytes_recv,
            (unsigned long long)g_blocked, g_w.threads_refused);
    if (g_state > 0){
        /* the plugin's DLL_PROCESS_DETACH, as at game exit: its report and BYE */
        uint32_t r[XR__N] = {0}; r[XR_ESP] = 0x7FEF0000u;
        uint32_t a[4] = { 0, g_pe.base, 0, 1 }; memcpy(g_mem + r[XR_ESP], a, 16);
        CPU tmp; memset(&tmp, 0, sizeof tmp); tmp.esp = r[XR_ESP]; tmp.fcw = 0x027f; g_c = &tmp;
        if (!xvm_call(g_vm, g_pe.entry, r)) fprintf(stderr, "  [asipeer] DllMain(PROCESS_DETACH) stopped: %s\n", xvm_why(g_vm));
    }
    aw32_close(&g_w);
}

/* ---- script commands: "roam asi ..." (what the game shows, nothing of the plugin's) ---- */
static int friend_cars(uint32_t *out, int max){
    uint32_t w = mem_is_committed(G_WORLD) ? MR32(G_WORLD) : 0, me = 0, p = MR32(G_PLAYER1);
    if (p && mem_is_committed(p + 4)) me = MR32(p + 4);
    if (!w || !mem_is_committed(w)) return 0;
    int n = 0; uint32_t it = MR32(w);
    for (int k = 0; it && it != w && k < 64 && mem_is_committed(it) && mem_is_committed(it + 0x9e0); k++, it = MR32(it)){
        if (it == me) continue;
        float z = MRF32(it + 0x68u);
        /* inert (no brain, no physics), not in the parking spot: a friend's car */
        if (MR32(it + 0x24u) == 0 && MR32(it + 0x28u) == 0 && z > PARK_Z + 1000.f && n < max) out[n++] = it;
    }
    return n;
}
int roam_asipeer_cmd(CPU *c, const char *args, long *wait_start){
    (void)c;
    char sub[32] = {0}, a1[64] = {0}, a2[64] = {0};
    sscanf(args, "%31s %63s %63s", sub, a1, a2);
    long f = autotest_frame();
    uint32_t cars[8]; int n = friend_cars(cars, 8);
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "status")){
        fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] f=%ld status: plugin %s, %llu frames, %d friend car(s) shown\n", f, g_state > 0 ? "running" : "off",
                (unsigned long long)g_frames, n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++){
            uint32_t rec = MR32(cars[i] + 0x14u); char nm[17] = {0};
            if (rec && mem_is_committed(rec + 0x90cu)) for (int k = 0; k < 16 && MR8(rec + 0x90cu + (uint32_t)k) >= 0x20 && MR8(rec + 0x90cu + (uint32_t)k) < 0x7f; k++) nm[k] = (char)MR8(rec + 0x90cu + (uint32_t)k);
            fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer]   car 0x%08x (%s) at %.1f %.1f %.1f, speed %.1f, heading 0x%04x\n", cars[i], nm, (double)MRF32(cars[i] + 0x60u),
                    (double)MRF32(cars[i] + 0x64u), (double)MRF32(cars[i] + 0x68u), (double)MRF32(cars[i] + 0x42cu), MR16(cars[i] + 0x40cu));
        }
        return 1;
    }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "waitcars")){
        int want = atoi(a1); long tmo = a2[0] ? atol(a2) : 0;
        if (*wait_start < 0) *wait_start = f;
        if (n >= want){ fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] f=%ld waitcars %d satisfied after %ld frames\n", f, want, f - *wait_start); *wait_start = -1; return 1; }
        if (tmo && f - *wait_start >= tmo){ fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] f=%ld waitcars %d TIMEOUT (have %d)\n", f, want, n); *wait_start = -1; return 1; }
        return 0;
    }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "follow")){
        int k = atoi(a1); float back = a2[0] ? (float)atof(a2) : 12.f;
        if (k < 0 || k >= n){ fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] f=%ld follow %d: no friend's car there\n", f, k); return 1; }
        uint32_t car = cars[k];
        float fx = MRF32(car + 0x90u), fy = MRF32(car + 0x94u), lx = MRF32(car + 0xa0u), ly = MRF32(car + 0xa4u), side = 3.5f;
        MRF32(0x00890140u) = MRF32(car + 0x60u) - back * fx + side * lx; MRF32(0x00890144u) = MRF32(car + 0x64u) - back * fy + side * ly;
        MRF32(0x00890148u) = MRF32(car + 0x68u) + 0.5f;
        MR16(0x008900d0u) = MR16(car + 0x40cu); MR8(0x008900ceu) = 1; MR8(0x008900cdu) = 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] f=%ld follow: behind car 0x%08x at %.1f %.1f %.1f\n", f, car, (double)MRF32(car + 0x60u), (double)MRF32(car + 0x64u), (double)MRF32(car + 0x68u));
        return 1;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[asipeer] f=%ld asi: unknown '%s'\n", f, sub);
    return 1;
}

/* ---- the guard -------------------------------------------------------------- */
static void blocked(const char *what, uint32_t ip){
    char b[16];
    g_st.blocked++;
    if (g_st.blocked <= 20 || g_st.blocked % 1000 == 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] BLOCKED %s %s (test harness: loopback only; %llu refused so far)\n",
                what, roam_ip_str(ip, b), (unsigned long long)g_st.blocked);
}
int roam_plat_guard(int test_mode, uint32_t ip, int is_bcast){
    if (!test_mode) return 1;
    if (is_bcast){ blocked("broadcast to", ip); return 0; }
    if ((ip >> 24) != 127){ blocked("sendto", ip); return 0; }
    return 1;
}

/* ---- sending (called with the lock held, from either thread) ------------------ */
static void do_send(uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *buf, int len, int is_bcast){
    if (!roam_plat_guard(g_cfg.test_mode, ip, is_bcast) || g_fd < 0) return;
    struct sockaddr_in sa; memset(&sa, 0, sizeof sa);
    sa.sin_family = AF_INET; sa.sin_len = sizeof sa; sa.sin_port = htons(port); sa.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(ip);
    ssize_t n = sendto(g_fd, buf, (size_t)len, 0, (struct sockaddr *)&sa, sizeof sa);
    if (n == len){ g_st.sent++; g_st.sent_bytes += (uint64_t)len; return; }
    g_st.send_err++;
    if (g_st.send_err <= 5 || g_st.send_err % 1000 == 0){
        char b[16];
        int e = errno;
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] sendto %s:%u failed: %s%s\n", roam_ip_str(ip, b), port, strerror(e),
                (e == EHOSTUNREACH || e == EPERM || e == ENETUNREACH) && !g_cfg.test_mode ?
                " (macOS: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Local Network must allow this app)" : "");
    }
}
static void io_send(void *u, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *buf, int len){ (void)u; do_send(ip, port, buf, len, 0); }

static int if_skip(const char *n){
    return !strncmp(n, "lo", 2) || !strncmp(n, "utun", 4) || !strncmp(n, "awdl", 4) || !strncmp(n, "llw", 3) ||
           !strncmp(n, "ipsec", 5) || !strncmp(n, "gif", 3) || !strncmp(n, "stf", 3) || !strncmp(n, "anpi", 4) ||
           !strncmp(n, "ap", 2);
}
int roam_bcast_targets(const roam_if *ifs, int n, uint32_t *out, int max){
    int k = 0;
    if (k < max) out[k++] = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    for (int i = 0; i < n && k < max; i++){
        const roam_if *f = &ifs[i];
        if (!f->up || f->loopback || !f->can_broadcast || if_skip(f->name) || !f->mask || f->mask == 0xFFFFFFFFu) continue;
        if (!rc_addr_private(f->addr)) continue;            /* only private LANs */
        uint32_t b = (f->addr & f->mask) | ~f->mask;
        int dup = 0; for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) if (out[j] == b) dup = 1;
        if (!dup) out[k++] = b;
    }
    return k;
}
static void io_broadcast(void *u, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *buf, int len){
    (void)u;
    if (g_cfg.test_mode || !g_cfg.discovery){ roam_plat_guard(1, 0xFFFFFFFFu, 1); return; }
    roam_if ifs[32]; int n = 0;
    struct ifaddrs *ia = 0;
    if (getifaddrs(&ia) == 0){
        for (struct ifaddrs *p = ia; p && n < 32; p = p->ifa_next){
            if (!p->ifa_addr || p->ifa_addr->sa_family != AF_INET || !p->ifa_netmask) continue;
            roam_if *f = &ifs[n++];
            snprintf(f->name, sizeof f->name, "%s", p->ifa_name);
            f->addr = ntohl(((struct sockaddr_in *)p->ifa_addr)->sin_addr.s_addr);
            f->mask = ntohl(((struct sockaddr_in *)p->ifa_netmask)->sin_addr.s_addr);
            f->up = (p->ifa_flags & IFF_UP) && (p->ifa_flags & IFF_RUNNING);
            f->loopback = !!(p->ifa_flags & IFF_LOOPBACK);
            f->can_broadcast = !!(p->ifa_flags & IFF_BROADCAST);
        }
        freeifaddrs(ia);
    }
    uint32_t t[16]; int k = roam_bcast_targets(ifs, n, t, 16);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) do_send(t[i], port, buf, len, 1);
}
static void io_event(void *u, int ev, int peer, const char *text);   /* roam_game.c provides the log */
void roam_game_event(int ev, int peer, const char *text);
static void io_event(void *u, int ev, int peer, const char *text){ (void)u; roam_game_event(ev, peer, text); }

/* ---- impairment (test aid) ------------------------------------------------------ */
static struct { int on, loss, delay, jitter, dup; uint32_t rng; } IMP;
#define IMPQ 512
static struct { int used; int64_t at; uint32_t ip; uint16_t port; int len; uint8_t b[RC_MAX_DGRAM]; } g_q[IMPQ];
static uint32_t imp_rand(void){ uint32_t x = IMP.rng; x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >> 17; x ^= x << 5; IMP.rng = x ? x : 1u; return IMP.rng; }
static void imp_parse(const char *s){
    if (!s || !*s) return;
    IMP.rng = 0x9E3779B9u;
    const char *p = s;
    while (*p){
        char k[16] = {0}; int v = 0, nk = 0;
        while (*p && *p != '=' && *p != ',' && nk < 15) k[nk++] = *p++;
        if (*p == '='){ p++; v = atoi(p); while (*p && *p != ',') p++; }
        if (*p == ',') p++;
        if (!strcmp(k, "loss")) IMP.loss = v;
        else if (!strcmp(k, "delay")) IMP.delay = v;
        else if (!strcmp(k, "jitter")) IMP.jitter = v;
        else if (!strcmp(k, "dup")) IMP.dup = v;
        else if (!strcmp(k, "seed")) IMP.rng = (uint32_t)v ? (uint32_t)v : 1u;
    }
    IMP.on = 1;
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] impairment (test aid) on received datagrams: loss %d%%, delay %d ms, jitter +-%d ms, duplicates %d%%\n",
            IMP.loss, IMP.delay, IMP.jitter, IMP.dup);
}
static void imp_queue(int64_t now, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *b, int len){
    for (int copy = 0; copy < 2; copy++){
        if (copy == 1 && (int)(imp_rand() % 100u) >= IMP.dup) break;
        if (copy == 1) g_st.impair_dup++;
        int64_t d = (int64_t)IMP.delay * 1000;
        if (IMP.jitter) d += (int64_t)((int)(imp_rand() % (uint32_t)(2 * IMP.jitter * 1000 + 1)) - IMP.jitter * 1000);
        if (d < 0) d = 0;
        int i = 0; while (i < IMPQ && g_q[i].used) i++;
        if (i == IMPQ){ g_st.impair_drop++; return; }
        g_q[i].used = 1; g_q[i].at = now + d; g_q[i].ip = ip; g_q[i].port = port; g_q[i].len = len; memcpy(g_q[i].b, b, (size_t)len);
    }
}
static void imp_release(int64_t now){
    for (;;){
        int best = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < IMPQ; i++) if (g_q[i].used && g_q[i].at <= now && (best < 0 || g_q[i].at < g_q[best].at)) best = i;
        if (best < 0) return;
        rc_receive(g_s, g_q[best].ip, g_q[best].port, g_q[best].b, g_q[best].len, now);
        g_q[best].used = 0;
    }
}

/* ---- network thread ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
static void *net_main(void *u){
    (void)u;
    uint8_t buf[1500];
    int64_t next_tick = 0;
    while (!atomic_load(&g_stop)){
        struct pollfd pf = { g_fd, POLLIN, 0 };
        (void)poll(&pf, 1, 5);
        int64_t now = roam_plat_now_us();
        for (int k = 0; k < 256; k++){
            struct sockaddr_in sa; socklen_t sl = sizeof sa;
            ssize_t n = recvfrom(g_fd, buf, sizeof buf, MSG_DONTWAIT, (struct sockaddr *)&sa, &sl);
            if (n < 0) break;
            if (sa.sin_family != AF_INET) continue;
            uint32_t ip = ntohl(sa.sin_addr.s_addr); uint16_t port = ntohs(sa.sin_port);
            roam_plat_lock();
            g_st.recv++; g_st.recv_bytes += (uint64_t)n;
            if (n > RC_MAX_DGRAM){ g_s->rx++; g_s->rx_bad++; }
            else if (IMP.on){
                if ((int)(imp_rand() % 100u) < IMP.loss) g_st.impair_drop++;
                else imp_queue(now, ip, port, buf, (int)n);
            } else rc_receive(g_s, ip, port, buf, (int)n, now);
            roam_plat_unlock();
        }
        if (IMP.on){ roam_plat_lock(); imp_release(now); roam_plat_unlock(); }
        if (now >= next_tick){ roam_plat_lock(); rc_tick(g_s, now); roam_plat_unlock(); next_tick = now + 10000; }
    }
    return 0;
}

int roam_plat_start(const roam_plat_cfg *cfg, rc_session *s){
    g_cfg = *cfg; g_s = s;
    memset(&g_st, 0, sizeof g_st);
    if (g_cfg.test_mode && g_cfg.discovery){
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] LAN discovery DISABLED: automated run (test harness), no broadcast will be sent; "
                        "only loopback peers from NFSU2_ROAM_PEERS\n");
        g_cfg.discovery = 0;
    }
    int fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP);
    if (fd < 0){ fprintf(stderr, "[roam] socket: %s\n", strerror(errno)); return -1; }
    int fl = fcntl(fd, F_GETFL, 0); fcntl(fd, F_SETFL, fl | O_NONBLOCK);
    fcntl(fd, F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC);
    if (g_cfg.discovery){ int one = 1; setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_BROADCAST, &one, sizeof one); }
    struct sockaddr_in sa; memset(&sa, 0, sizeof sa);
    sa.sin_family = AF_INET; sa.sin_len = sizeof sa; sa.sin_port = htons(g_cfg.port);
    sa.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(g_cfg.test_mode ? INADDR_LOOPBACK : INADDR_ANY);
    if (bind(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&sa, sizeof sa) < 0){
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] cannot use UDP port %u (%s): another program has it? Set the same other port "
                        "(roam_port / NFSU2_ROAM_PORT) on every machine\n", g_cfg.port, strerror(errno));
        close(fd); return -1;
    }
    g_fd = fd;
    imp_parse(g_cfg.impair);
    rc_io io = { 0, io_send, io_broadcast, io_event };
    roam_plat_lock(); s->io = io; roam_plat_unlock();
    atomic_store(&g_stop, 0);
    if (pthread_create(&g_thr, 0, net_main, 0) != 0){ close(fd); g_fd = -1; return -1; }
    g_thr_on = 1;
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] UDP %s:%u open%s\n", g_cfg.test_mode ? "127.0.0.1" : "0.0.0.0", g_cfg.port,
            g_cfg.test_mode ? " (test harness: loopback only)" : g_cfg.discovery ? ", LAN discovery on" : "");
    return 0;
}
void roam_plat_stop(uint8_t reason){
    if (!g_thr_on) return;
    roam_plat_lock(); rc_shutdown(g_s, reason); roam_plat_unlock();
    atomic_store(&g_stop, 1);
    pthread_join(g_thr, 0); g_thr_on = 0;
    close(g_fd); g_fd = -1;
}

int roam_plat_parse_peers(const char *list, int test_mode, uint16_t defport, uint32_t *ip, uint16_t *port, int max){
    int n = 0;
    if (!list) return 0;
    const char *p = list;
    while (*p && n < max){
        /* blanks, tabs, commas and ';' separate entries (as settings.ini and
         * the Windows plugin take them) */
        while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t' || *p == ',' || *p == ';') p++;
        if (!*p) break;
        char tok[64]; int k = 0;
        while (*p && *p != ',' && *p != ';' && *p != ' ' && *p != '\t' && k < 63) tok[k++] = *p++;
        tok[k] = 0;
        unsigned a, b, c, d, pt = defport; char extra;
        int got = sscanf(tok, "%u.%u.%u.%u:%u%c", &a, &b, &c, &d, &pt, &extra);
        if ((got != 4 && got != 5) || a > 255 || b > 255 || c > 255 || d > 255 || pt == 0 || pt > 65535){
            fprintf(stderr, "[roam] peer \"%s\" ignored: write a.b.c.d or a.b.c.d:port (IPv4 numbers, no names)\n", tok);
            continue;
        }
        uint32_t v = a << 24 | b << 16 | c << 8 | d;
        if (test_mode && a != 127){
            fprintf(stderr, "[roam] peer %s REFUSED: test harness, only 127.x.x.x peers\n", tok); continue; }
        ip[n] = v; port[n] = (uint16_t)pt; n++;
    }
    return n;
}

/* CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3 / zlib polynomial, reflected), bitwise: no table */
uint32_t rc_crc32(const uint8_t *p, uint32_t n){
    uint32_t c = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++){
        c ^= p[i];
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = (c >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320u & (0u - (c & 1u)));
    }
    return ~c;
}
uint32_t rc_fnv1a(const char *s){
    if (!s || !*s) return 0;
    uint32_t h = 0x811C9DC5u;
    for (; *s; s++){ h ^= (uint8_t)*s; h *= 0x01000193u; }
    return h ? h : 1u;
}
/* one character of a Room's or a crew's name as its hash takes it (players.ts roomFold is the same): 0 for a blank
 * or an invisible one (Unicode's spaces, the zero-width ones, the soft hyphen, the byte order mark); capitals small
 * in the scripts the game's languages write with them (Latin with Latin-1, Extended-A and Romanian's commas, Greek,
 * Cyrillic), Turkish dotted and dotless i as i, final sigma as sigma, and the full-width forms of ASCII as ASCII.
 * Any other character is itself. */
static uint32_t room_fold(uint32_t c){
    if (c == ' ' || (c >= '\t' && c <= '\r') || c == 0xA0 || c == 0xAD || c == 0x1680 || (c >= 0x2000 && c <= 0x200D) ||
        c == 0x2028 || c == 0x2029 || c == 0x202F || c == 0x205F || c == 0x2060 || c == 0x3000 || c == 0xFEFF) return 0;
    if (c >= 0xFF01 && c <= 0xFF5E) c -= 0xFEE0;                      /* full width: '!' to '~' */
    if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') return c + 32;
    if (c < 0xC0) return c;
    if (c <= 0xDE) return c == 0xD7 ? c : c + 32;                     /* (x, the multiplication sign) */
    if (c >= 0x100 && c <= 0x17F){
        if (c == 0x130 || c == 0x131) return 'i';
        if (c == 0x178) return 0xFF;
        if (c <= 0x137 || (c >= 0x14A && c <= 0x177)) return c | 1;   /* capital even, small odd */
        if ((c >= 0x139 && c <= 0x148) || (c >= 0x179 && c <= 0x17E)) return c & 1 ? c + 1 : c;   /* capital odd */
        return c;
    }
    if (c >= 0x218 && c <= 0x21F) return c | 1;
    if (c >= 0x391 && c <= 0x3AB) return c == 0x3A2 ? c : c + 32;
    if (c == 0x386) return 0x3AC;
    if (c >= 0x388 && c <= 0x38A) return c + 37;
    if (c == 0x38C) return 0x3CC;
    if (c == 0x38E || c == 0x38F) return c + 63;
    if (c == 0x3C2) return 0x3C3;
    if (c >= 0x400 && c <= 0x40F) return c + 80;
    if (c >= 0x410 && c <= 0x42F) return c + 32;
    if ((c >= 0x460 && c <= 0x481) || (c >= 0x48A && c <= 0x4BF) || (c >= 0x4D0 && c <= 0x52F)) return c | 1;
    if (c == 0x4C0) return 0x4CF;
    if (c >= 0x4C1 && c <= 0x4CE) return c & 1 ? c + 1 : c;
    return c;
}
/* the UTF-8 character at s into *c, and its length; 0 for a byte that starts none (no overlong forms, no surrogates,
 * nothing past U+10FFFF).  The string's NUL ends a character as any byte but 0x80 to 0xBF does: nothing past it is
 * read. */
static int utf8_char(const uint8_t *s, uint32_t *c){
    uint32_t b = s[0];
    if (b < 0x80){ *c = b; return 1; }
    int len = b >= 0xC2 && b <= 0xDF ? 2 : b >= 0xE0 && b <= 0xEF ? 3 : b >= 0xF0 && b <= 0xF4 ? 4 : 0;
    if (!len) return 0;
    uint32_t v = b & (0x7Fu >> len);
    for (int i = 1; i < len; i++){ if ((s[i] & 0xC0) != 0x80) return 0; v = v << 6 | (s[i] & 0x3Fu); }
    if ((len == 3 && (v < 0x800 || (v >= 0xD800 && v <= 0xDFFF))) || (len == 4 && (v < 0x10000 || v > 0x10FFFF))) return 0;
    *c = v; return len;
}
/* the Room setting's hash: rc_fnv1a of the name's UTF-8 with each character as room_fold has it (its blanks and
 * invisible ones left out, its capitals small: "Blue Room" is "blueroom", "КОМНАТА" is "комната"), so friends who
 * type it a little differently still meet; 0 (no room) for a name of blanks only.  A byte that starts no UTF-8
 * character counts as it is.  The start page asks the server for a room's players by this hash (web/src/app/players.ts
 * roomHash), and a crew is the hash of its name too. */
uint32_t rc_room_hash(const char *s){
    uint32_t h = 0x811C9DC5u; int n = 0;
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)s;
    while (p && *p){
        uint32_t c; int len = utf8_char(p, &c);
        uint8_t u[4]; int k = 0;
        if (!len){ len = 1; u[k++] = p[0]; }                          /* (not UTF-8: the byte itself) */
        else if (!(c = room_fold(c))){ p += len; continue; }
        else if (c < 0x80) u[k++] = (uint8_t)c;
        else if (c < 0x800){ u[k++] = (uint8_t)(0xC0 | c >> 6); u[k++] = (uint8_t)(0x80 | (c & 0x3F)); }
        else if (c < 0x10000){ u[k++] = (uint8_t)(0xE0 | c >> 12); u[k++] = (uint8_t)(0x80 | (c >> 6 & 0x3F)); u[k++] = (uint8_t)(0x80 | (c & 0x3F)); }
        else { u[k++] = (uint8_t)(0xF0 | c >> 18); u[k++] = (uint8_t)(0x80 | (c >> 12 & 0x3F)); u[k++] = (uint8_t)(0x80 | (c >> 6 & 0x3F)); u[k++] = (uint8_t)(0x80 | (c & 0x3F)); }
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++){ h ^= u[i]; h *= 0x01000193u; }
        p += len; n++;
    }
    return !n ? 0 : h ? h : 1u;
}
uint32_t rc_fnv1a_bytes(const uint8_t *p, uint32_t n){
    uint32_t h = 0x811C9DC5u;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++){ h ^= p[i]; h *= 0x01000193u; }
    return h ? h : 1u;
}
void rc_name_clean(char *dst, const char *src, uint32_t srclen){
    uint32_t o = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; src && i < srclen && src[i] && o < RC_NAME_MAX; i++){
        uint8_t ch = (uint8_t)src[i];
        if (ch == ' ' && o == 0) continue;                  /* no leading blanks */
        dst[o++] = (ch >= 0x20 && ch < 0x7F) ? (char)ch : '?';
    }
    while (o && dst[o - 1] == ' ') o--;
    dst[o] = 0;
    if (!o || name_blocked(dst)) memcpy(dst, "Player", 7);
}

/* ---- float helpers (basic operations only) ----------------------------------- */
static int f_finite(float f){ uint32_t u = rc_fbits(f); return (u & 0x7F800000u) != 0x7F800000u; }
static float f_abs(float f){ return f < 0 ? -f : f; }
static float f_clamp(float f, float lo, float hi){ return f < lo ? lo : f > hi ? hi : f; }
/* round to nearest, saturating, NaN -> 0: the same result on every target
 * (a plain cast of NaN or of a value out of range is undefined: arm64
 * saturates, x86's cvttss2si gives 0x80000000) */
static int32_t f_round(float f){
    if (!(f == f)) return 0;
    if (f >= 2147483520.f) return 2147483647;              /* the largest float below 2^31 */
    if (f <= -2147483520.f) return -2147483647 - 1;
    return (int32_t)(f >= 0 ? f + 0.5f : f - 0.5f);
}
static void q_norm(float *q){
    float n = q[0]*q[0] + q[1]*q[1] + q[2]*q[2] + q[3]*q[3];
    if (n < 1e-12f){ q[0] = q[1] = q[2] = 0; q[3] = 1; return; }
    float k = 1.f / rc_sqrtf(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) q[i] *= k;
}
float rc_expneg(float x){
    if (!(x > 0)) return 1.f;
    if (x > 30.f) return 0.f;
    /* e^-x = (e^-1)^n * 1/e^f, n = floor(x), f in [0, 1): 8th-order Taylor
     * for e^f (relative error < 3e-6), n exact multiplications */
    int n = (int)x;
    float f = x - (float)n;
    float e = 1.f + f*(1.f + f*(1.f/2.f + f*(1.f/6.f + f*(1.f/24.f + f*(1.f/120.f + f*(1.f/720.f + f*(1.f/5040.f + f*(1.f/40320.f))))))));
    float r = 1.f / e;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) r *= 0.36787944117f;
    return r;
}
float rc_atan2f(float y, float x){
    const float pi = 3.14159265358979f, pi_2 = 1.57079632679490f, pi_6 = 0.52359877559830f;
    float ax = f_abs(x), ay = f_abs(y);
    if (!(ax > 0.f) && !(ay > 0.f)) return 0.f;
    int swap = ay > ax;
    float t = swap ? ax / ay : ay / ax;                     /* 0 .. 1 */
    /* atan t = pi/6 + atan((t*sqrt3 - 1) / (t + sqrt3)) for t > tan(pi/12):
     * the argument is then within +-0.268, where the series to t^13 is
     * below float precision */
    float base = 0.f;
    if (t > 0.26794919243f){ t = (t * 1.73205080757f - 1.f) / (t + 1.73205080757f); base = pi_6; }
    float t2 = t * t;
    float a = t * (1.f + t2*(-1.f/3.f + t2*(1.f/5.f + t2*(-1.f/7.f + t2*(1.f/9.f + t2*(-1.f/11.f + t2*(1.f/13.f)))))));
    a += base;
    if (swap) a = pi_2 - a;
    if (x < 0.f) a = pi - a;
    return y < 0.f ? -a : a;
}
/* rows (forward, left, up) of the game's orientation matrix = the columns of
 * the body->world rotation R */
void rc_m2q(const float *f, const float *l, const float *u, float *q){
    float tr = f[0] + l[1] + u[2];
    if (tr > 0){ float s = rc_sqrtf(tr + 1.f) * 2.f; q[3] = .25f * s; q[0] = (l[2] - u[1]) / s; q[1] = (u[0] - f[2]) / s; q[2] = (f[1] - l[0]) / s; }
    else if (f[0] > l[1] && f[0] > u[2]){ float s = rc_sqrtf(1.f + f[0] - l[1] - u[2]) * 2.f; q[3] = (l[2] - u[1]) / s; q[0] = .25f * s; q[1] = (l[0] + f[1]) / s; q[2] = (u[0] + f[2]) / s; }
    else if (l[1] > u[2]){ float s = rc_sqrtf(1.f + l[1] - f[0] - u[2]) * 2.f; q[3] = (u[0] - f[2]) / s; q[0] = (l[0] + f[1]) / s; q[1] = .25f * s; q[2] = (u[1] + l[2]) / s; }
    else { float s = rc_sqrtf(1.f + u[2] - f[0] - l[1]) * 2.f; q[3] = (f[1] - l[0]) / s; q[0] = (u[0] + f[2]) / s; q[1] = (u[1] + l[2]) / s; q[2] = .25f * s; }
    q_norm(q);
}
void rc_q2m(const float *q, float *f, float *l, float *u){
    float x = q[0], y = q[1], z = q[2], w = q[3];
    f[0] = 1 - 2*(y*y + z*z); f[1] = 2*(x*y + z*w);     f[2] = 2*(x*z - y*w);
    l[0] = 2*(x*y - z*w);     l[1] = 1 - 2*(x*x + z*z); l[2] = 2*(y*z + x*w);
    u[0] = 2*(x*z + y*w);     u[1] = 2*(y*z - x*w);     u[2] = 1 - 2*(x*x + y*y);
}
static void q_mul(const float *a, const float *b, float *o){   /* o = a * b */
    float x = a[3]*b[0] + a[0]*b[3] + a[1]*b[2] - a[2]*b[1];
    float y = a[3]*b[1] - a[0]*b[2] + a[1]*b[3] + a[2]*b[0];
    float z = a[3]*b[2] + a[0]*b[1] - a[1]*b[0] + a[2]*b[3];
    float w = a[3]*b[3] - a[0]*b[0] - a[1]*b[1] - a[2]*b[2];
    o[0] = x; o[1] = y; o[2] = z; o[3] = w;
}
static void q_conj(const float *a, float *o){ o[0] = -a[0]; o[1] = -a[1]; o[2] = -a[2]; o[3] = a[3]; }
static void q_nlerp(const float *a, const float *b, float t, float *o){
    float d = a[0]*b[0] + a[1]*b[1] + a[2]*b[2] + a[3]*b[3], s = d < 0 ? -1.f : 1.f;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) o[i] = (1.f - t) * a[i] + t * s * b[i];
    q_norm(o);
}
/* q advanced by world angular velocity w over dt seconds (4 first-order steps) */
static void q_integrate(const float *q0, const float *w, float dt, float *o){
    float q[4] = { q0[0], q0[1], q0[2], q0[3] }, h = dt * 0.25f;
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++){
        float wq[4] = { w[0], w[1], w[2], 0 }, d[4];
        q_mul(wq, q, d);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) q[i] += 0.5f * h * d[i];
        q_norm(q);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) o[i] = q[i];
}

/* ---- states on the wire ------------------------------------------------------ */
static int16_t q16(float f, float scale){ int32_t v = f_round(f * scale); return (int16_t)(v > 32767 ? 32767 : v < -32767 ? -32767 : v); }
static void put_state(rc_w *w, const rc_state *s){
    rc_put32(w, s->t_us);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) rc_putf(w, s->p[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) rc_putf(w, s->v[i]);
    float q[4] = { s->q[0], s->q[1], s->q[2], s->q[3] }; q_norm(q);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) rc_put16(w, (uint16_t)q16(q[i], 32767.f));
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) rc_put16(w, (uint16_t)q16(s->w[i], 1000.f));
    rc_put16(w, (uint16_t)q16(f_clamp(s->steer, -1.f, 1.f), 32767.f));
    rc_put8(w, (uint32_t)f_round(f_clamp(s->throttle, 0.f, 1.f) * 255.f));
    rc_put8(w, (uint32_t)f_round(f_clamp(s->brake, 0.f, 1.f) * 255.f));
    rc_put16(w, (uint32_t)f_round(f_clamp(s->rpm, 0.f, 65535.f)));
    rc_put16(w, (uint16_t)q16(f_clamp(s->speed, -327.f, 327.f), 100.f));
    rc_put8(w, (uint8_t)s->gear);
    rc_put8(w, s->bits);
}
/* a wheel's slip on the wire: int8 steps of RC_SLIP_STEP, at most 127 */
static int8_t q_slip(float f){ int32_t v = f_round(f_clamp(f, -1000.f, 1000.f) / RC_SLIP_STEP); return (int8_t)(v > 127 ? 127 : v < -127 ? -127 : v); }
/* the extension (RC_HF_STATEX): a state without one has the length 0; the
 * slip and surfaces only while a wheel slides (all slips 0 on the wire
 * otherwise: the shorter form, as before), the engine only while it sounds;
 * while a part is open, the longest form (slips 0 and engine 0 where none:
 * as a core before them reads them, no slide and no engine) and the open
 * parts after it */
#define ENG_MAX 20000u
static void put_statex(rc_w *w, const rc_state *s){
    if (!s->ext){ rc_put8(w, 0); return; }
    int slides = 0, eng = s->eng != 0, open = (s->open & RC_OPEN_ALL) != 0 || s->hibeam;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) slides |= q_slip(s->slip[i]) != 0;
    if (open) slides = eng = 1;
    rc_put8(w, (slides ? RC_STATEX_SLIP : RC_STATEX_HYD) + (eng ? RC_STATEX_ENG : 0) + (open ? RC_STATEX_OPEN : 0) - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) rc_put16(w, (uint16_t)q16(f_clamp(s->wz[i], -32.f, 32.f), 1000.f));
    rc_put8(w, s->nos);
    rc_put8(w, s->hyd); rc_put8(w, s->thumps);
    if (slides) for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++){
        rc_put8(w, (uint8_t)q_slip(s->slip[2 * i])); rc_put8(w, (uint8_t)q_slip(s->slip[2 * i + 1])); rc_put8(w, s->surf[i]);
    }
    if (eng){ rc_put16(w, s->eng < ENG_MAX ? s->eng : ENG_MAX); rc_put8(w, s->eng_acc); rc_put8(w, s->eng_dcl); rc_put8(w, s->eng_base); }
    if (open) rc_put8(w, (s->open & RC_OPEN_ALL) | (s->hibeam ? RC_OPEN_HIBEAM : 0u));
}
static int get_statex(rc_r *r, rc_state *s){
    uint32_t n = rc_get8(r);
    if (r->err) return RC_E_SHORT;
    if (!n) return RC_OK;
    if (n < RC_STATEX_V4 - 1) return RC_E_FIELD;
    if (!r_have(r, n)) return RC_E_SHORT;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) s->wz[i] = (float)(int16_t)rc_get16(r) / 1000.f;
    s->nos = (uint8_t)rc_get8(r);
    uint32_t k = RC_STATEX_V4 - 1;
    if (n >= RC_STATEX_HYD - 1){ s->hyd = (uint8_t)rc_get8(r); s->thumps = (uint8_t)rc_get8(r); k = RC_STATEX_HYD - 1; }
    if (n >= RC_STATEX_SLIP - 1){
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++){
            s->slip[2 * i] = (float)(int8_t)rc_get8(r) * RC_SLIP_STEP; s->slip[2 * i + 1] = (float)(int8_t)rc_get8(r) * RC_SLIP_STEP;
            s->surf[i] = (uint8_t)rc_get8(r);
        }
        s->slipx = 1; k = RC_STATEX_SLIP - 1;
    }
    if (n >= k + RC_STATEX_ENG){                                    /* the engine, after the hydraulics or the slip */
        uint32_t e = rc_get16(r);
        s->eng = (uint16_t)(e < ENG_MAX ? e : ENG_MAX); s->eng_acc = (uint8_t)rc_get8(r); s->eng_dcl = (uint8_t)rc_get8(r);
        s->eng_base = (uint8_t)rc_get8(r);
        k += RC_STATEX_ENG;
    }
    if (k == RC_STATEX_FULL - 1 && n >= k + RC_STATEX_OPEN){        /* the open parts, after the longest form */
        uint32_t b = rc_get8(r);
        s->open = (uint8_t)(b & RC_OPEN_ALL); s->hibeam = (b & RC_OPEN_HIBEAM) != 0;
        k += RC_STATEX_OPEN;
    }
    r->n += n - k;                                                  /* a newer core's fields */
    s->ext = 1;
    return RC_OK;
}
static int get_state(rc_r *r, rc_state *s){
    s->ext = 0; s->nos = 0; s->hyd = 0; s->thumps = 0; s->slipx = 0; s->eng = 0; s->eng_acc = 0; s->eng_dcl = 0; s->eng_base = 0;
    s->open = 0; s->hibeam = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++){ s->wz[i] = 0; s->surf[i] = 0; }
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) s->slip[i] = 0;
    s->t_us = rc_get32(r);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) s->p[i] = rc_getf(r);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) s->v[i] = rc_getf(r);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) s->q[i] = (float)(int16_t)rc_get16(r) / 32767.f;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) s->w[i] = (float)(int16_t)rc_get16(r) / 1000.f;
    s->steer = (float)(int16_t)rc_get16(r) / 32767.f;
    s->throttle = (float)rc_get8(r) / 255.f;
    s->brake = (float)rc_get8(r) / 255.f;
    s->rpm = (float)rc_get16(r);
    s->speed = (float)(int16_t)rc_get16(r) / 100.f;
    s->gear = (int8_t)rc_get8(r);
    s->bits = (uint8_t)rc_get8(r);
    if (r->err) return RC_E_SHORT;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) if (!f_finite(s->p[i]) || !f_finite(s->v[i])) return RC_E_RANGE;
    if (f_abs(s->p[0]) > 20000.f || f_abs(s->p[1]) > 20000.f || f_abs(s->p[2]) > 2000.f) return RC_E_RANGE;
    if (s->v[0]*s->v[0] + s->v[1]*s->v[1] + s->v[2]*s->v[2] > 200.f * 200.f) return RC_E_RANGE;
    float n = s->q[0]*s->q[0] + s->q[1]*s->q[1] + s->q[2]*s->q[2] + s->q[3]*s->q[3];
    if (n < 0.25f) return RC_E_RANGE;
    q_norm(s->q);
    return RC_OK;
}
void rc_state_put(rc_w *w, const rc_state *s, int ext){ put_state(w, s); if (ext) put_statex(w, s); }
int rc_state_get(rc_r *r, rc_state *s, int ext){
    int e = get_state(r, s);
    return e ? e : ext ? get_statex(r, s) : RC_OK;
}

/* ---- messages ------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* a flag's code: lower case letters and '-' (roam_game.c looks it up; one it does not have shows none) */
static int flag_ok(const char *s, uint32_t n){ for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!((s[i] >= 'a' && s[i] <= 'z') || s[i] == '-')) return 0; return 1; }
static uint32_t flag_len(const char *s){ uint32_t n = 0; while (n <= RC_FLAG_MAX && s[n]) n++; return n; }   /* RC_FLAG_MAX + 1: too long */
int rc_plate_ok(const char *s, uint32_t n){
    if (n > RC_PLATE_MAX) return 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!((s[i] >= 'A' && s[i] <= 'Z') || (s[i] >= '0' && s[i] <= '9'))) return 0;
    return 1;
}
static uint32_t plate_len(const char *s){ uint32_t n = 0; while (n <= RC_PLATE_MAX && s[n]) n++; return n; }   /* RC_PLATE_MAX + 1: too long */
static int printable(const char *s, uint32_t n){ for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if ((uint8_t)s[i] < 0x20 || (uint8_t)s[i] >= 0x7F) return 0; return 1; }

/* a LOBBY message's fields: a known op, state and reason, an id for the
 * lobby, a race, 2 to RC_LOBBY_MAX players at most and no more in it, no
 * player twice and none 0 */
static int lobby_ok(const rc_lobby *l){
    if (l->op < 1 || l->op >= RC_LOBBY__N || l->state >= RC_LS__N || l->arg >= RC_LL__N || !l->lobby || !l->race) return 0;
    if (l->max < 2 || l->max > RC_LOBBY_MAX || l->n > l->max) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < l->n; i++){
        if (!l->ids[i]) return 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) if (l->ids[j] == l->ids[i]) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}
/* a RACEREP's fields: a lobby and a race, 1 to RC_LOBBY_MAX cars and a place among them (0: none), a class, numbers
 * in range, a printable name */
static int in(float f, float lo, float hi){ return f_finite(f) && f >= lo && f <= hi; }
static int racerep_ok(const rc_racerep *r){
    if (!r->lobby || !r->race || r->players < 1 || r->players > RC_LOBBY_MAX || r->place > r->players) return 0;
    if (r->cls < -1 || r->cls > 3 || r->flags & ~(RC_RR_HOST | RC_RR_QUIT | RC_RR_EDITED)) return 0;
    if (r->credit > 2 || r->stage > 9 || r->lobby_bits & ~(RC_RL_STAGED | RC_RL_MATE_PAST | RC_RL_HOST_PAST)) return 0;
    if (!in(r->rating, 0.f, 5000.f) || !in(r->field, 0.f, 5000.f) || !in(r->factor, 0.01f, 100.f) || !in(r->kw, 0.f, 10000.f)
        || !in(r->kg, 0.f, 50000.f) || !in(r->kmh, 0.f, 2000.f) || !in(r->time, 0.f, 100000.f)) return 0;
    uint32_t n = 0; while (n < RC_RACEREP_NAME && r->name[n]) n++;
    return printable(r->name, n);
}
/* a RACERES's fields: a lobby and a race, 1 to RC_LOBBY_MAX rows, known flags (one row ours at most), numbers in range */
static int raceres_ok(const rc_raceres *r){
    if (!r->lobby || !r->race || r->n < 1 || r->n > RC_LOBBY_MAX) return 0;
    if (r->heats ? r->heats < 2 || r->heats > RC_RACERES_HEATS || r->heat < 1 || r->heat > r->heats : r->heat != 0) return 0;
    int ours = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < r->n; k++){
        if (r->row[k].flags & ~(RC_RS_FINISHED | RC_RS_OURS) || !in(r->row[k].time, 0.f, 100000.f) || !in(r->row[k].done, 0.f, 1000.f)
            || !in(r->row[k].dist, 0.f, 1e6f)) return 0;
        ours += (r->row[k].flags & RC_RS_OURS) != 0;
    }
    return ours <= 1;
}
int rc_encode(const rc_msg *m, uint8_t *out, int cap){
    rc_w w; rc_w_init(&w, out, (uint32_t)(cap < RC_MAX_DGRAM ? cap : RC_MAX_DGRAM));
    rc_put8(&w, RC_MAGIC0); rc_put8(&w, RC_MAGIC1); rc_put8(&w, RC_MAGIC2); rc_put8(&w, RC_MAGIC3);
    rc_put8(&w, RC_PROTO_VER); rc_put8(&w, m->h.type); rc_put16(&w, 0);   /* length below */
    rc_put32(&w, m->h.sender); rc_put16(&w, m->h.seq); rc_put16(&w, m->h.flags);
    switch (m->h.type){
    case RC_MSG_HELLO: {
        uint32_t nl = (uint32_t)strlen(m->u.hello.name);
        if (nl > RC_NAME_MAX || m->u.hello.n_seen > RC_MAX_PEERS) return -1;
        rc_put16(&w, m->u.hello.core_ver); rc_put8(&w, m->u.hello.platform); rc_put8(&w, m->u.hello.status);
        rc_put16(&w, m->u.hello.listen_port); rc_put16(&w, m->u.hello.cfg_rev); rc_put32(&w, m->u.hello.room);
        rc_put8(&w, nl); rc_putb(&w, m->u.hello.name, nl);
        rc_put8(&w, m->u.hello.n_seen);
        for (int i = 0; i < m->u.hello.n_seen; i++) rc_put32(&w, m->u.hello.seen[i]);
        uint32_t fl = flag_len(m->u.hello.flag);
        if (fl > RC_FLAG_MAX || !flag_ok(m->u.hello.flag, fl)) return -1;
        /* the plate goes with the header's flag only, and the flag with a plate only (rc_decode reads it by the flag) */
        uint32_t pl = plate_len(m->u.hello.plate);
        int plate = (m->h.flags & RC_HF_PLATE) != 0;
        if (!rc_plate_ok(m->u.hello.plate, pl) || plate != (pl > 0)) return -1;
        if (m->u.hello.n_crews || m->u.hello.links || m->u.hello.duel || fl || plate){
            if (!(m->h.flags & RC_HF_CREW) || m->u.hello.n_crews > RC_CREW_MAX || m->u.hello.links > RC_MAX_PEERS) return -1;
            rc_put8(&w, m->u.hello.n_crews);
            for (int i = 0; i < m->u.hello.n_crews; i++){ if (!m->u.hello.crews[i]) return -1; rc_put32(&w, m->u.hello.crews[i]); }
            if (m->u.hello.links || m->u.hello.duel || fl || plate) rc_put8(&w, m->u.hello.links);   /* (a core or hub before version 10 skips it) */
            if (m->u.hello.duel || fl || plate) rc_put32(&w, m->u.hello.duel);                         /* (...before version 11 this) */
            if (fl || plate){ rc_put8(&w, fl); rc_putb(&w, m->u.hello.flag, fl); }                  /* (...before version 13 this) */
            if (plate){ rc_put8(&w, pl); rc_putb(&w, m->u.hello.plate, pl); }                         /* (...before version 17 this) */
        }
        break; }
    case RC_MSG_PEERS:
        if (m->u.peers.n > RC_LIST_MAX) return -1;
        rc_put8(&w, m->u.peers.n);
        for (int i = 0; i < m->u.peers.n; i++){
            uint32_t ip = m->u.peers.e[i].ip;
            rc_put8(&w, ip >> 24); rc_put8(&w, ip >> 16); rc_put8(&w, ip >> 8); rc_put8(&w, ip);
            rc_put16(&w, m->u.peers.e[i].port); rc_put32(&w, m->u.peers.e[i].id);
        }
        if (m->h.flags & RC_HF_CREW){                                  /* the hub's crew marks */
            if (m->u.peers.n_mine > RC_CREW_MAX) return -1;
            rc_put8(&w, m->u.peers.n_mine);
            for (int i = 0; i < m->u.peers.n_mine; i++){ if (!m->u.peers.mine[i]) return -1; rc_put32(&w, m->u.peers.mine[i]); }
            for (int i = 0; i < m->u.peers.n; i++) rc_put8(&w, m->u.peers.crew[i]);
            if (m->u.peers.hints){                                     /* the hints (a hub's, core 16) */
                int nf = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < m->u.peers.n; i++) nf += m->u.peers.far[i] > 1;
                rc_put8(&w, (uint32_t)nf);
                for (int i = 0; i < m->u.peers.n; i++)
                    if (m->u.peers.far[i] > 1) rc_put8(&w, (uint32_t)i | (m->u.peers.far[i] > 4 ? RC_HINT_VERYFAR : 0));
                if (m->u.peers.n_gone > RC_GONE_MAX) return -1;
                rc_put8(&w, m->u.peers.n_gone);
                for (int i = 0; i < m->u.peers.n_gone; i++){ rc_put32(&w, m->u.peers.gone[i].id); rc_put8(&w, m->u.peers.gone[i].why); }
            }
        }
        break;
    case RC_MSG_SNAP:
        if (m->u.snap.n < 1 || m->u.snap.n > RC_SNAP_STATES) return -1;
        rc_put8(&w, m->u.snap.status); rc_put8(&w, m->u.snap.epoch); rc_put16(&w, m->u.snap.cfg_rev);
        rc_put8(&w, m->u.snap.n); rc_put8(&w, m->u.snap.clock);
        for (int i = 0; i < m->u.snap.n; i++){
            put_state(&w, &m->u.snap.s[i]);
            if (m->h.flags & RC_HF_STATEX) put_statex(&w, &m->u.snap.s[i]);
        }
        break;
    case RC_MSG_CFG:
        if (m->u.cfg.nfrag < 1 || m->u.cfg.nfrag > RC_CFG_MAXFRAG || m->u.cfg.frag >= m->u.cfg.nfrag ||
            m->u.cfg.total > RC_CFG_MAX || m->u.cfg.dlen > RC_CFG_FRAG) return -1;
        rc_put16(&w, m->u.cfg.cfg_rev); rc_put8(&w, m->u.cfg.frag); rc_put8(&w, m->u.cfg.nfrag);
        rc_put16(&w, m->u.cfg.total); rc_put16(&w, m->u.cfg.dlen); rc_putb(&w, m->u.cfg.data, m->u.cfg.dlen);
        break;
    case RC_MSG_CFG_REQ: rc_put16(&w, m->u.cfgreq.cfg_rev); rc_put8(&w, m->u.cfgreq.have_mask); break;
    case RC_MSG_PING: rc_put32(&w, m->u.ping.t0); break;
    case RC_MSG_PONG: rc_put32(&w, m->u.ping.t0); rc_put32(&w, m->u.ping.t1); rc_put32(&w, m->u.ping.t2); break;
    case RC_MSG_BYE: rc_put8(&w, m->u.bye.reason); break;
    case RC_MSG_DUEL:
        if (m->u.duel.op < 1 || m->u.duel.op >= RC_DUEL__N || !m->u.duel.to || !m->u.duel.duel) return -1;
        rc_put8(&w, m->u.duel.op); rc_put8(&w, m->u.duel.arg); rc_put32(&w, m->u.duel.to); rc_put32(&w, m->u.duel.duel);
        if (m->u.duel.op == RC_DUEL_SCORE) rc_put32(&w, m->u.duel.score);
        break;
    case RC_MSG_MAPREQ:
        rc_put16(&w, m->u.mapreq.req); rc_put16(&w, m->u.mapreq.max); rc_put16(&w, m->u.mapreq.base);
        if (m->u.mapreq.flags) rc_put16(&w, m->u.mapreq.flags);     /* (a hub before them takes none: they go only when wanted) */
        break;
    case RC_MSG_NEARREQ:
        rc_put16(&w, m->u.nearreq.req); rc_put16(&w, m->u.nearreq.max); rc_put16(&w, m->u.nearreq.base); rc_put16(&w, m->u.nearreq.radius);
        break;
    case RC_MSG_MAPD: case RC_MSG_NEARD:
        if (m->u.mapd.nparts < 1 || m->u.mapd.nparts > RC_MAPD_PARTS || m->u.mapd.part >= m->u.mapd.nparts || m->u.mapd.len > RC_MAPD_BYTES) return -1;
        rc_put16(&w, m->u.mapd.req); rc_put16(&w, m->u.mapd.base); rc_put8(&w, m->u.mapd.part); rc_put8(&w, m->u.mapd.nparts);
        rc_put16(&w, m->u.mapd.total); rc_put8(&w, m->u.mapd.n); rc_putb(&w, m->u.mapd.data, m->u.mapd.len);
        break;
    case RC_MSG_LOBBY: {
        const rc_lobby *l = &m->u.lobby;
        if (!lobby_ok(l)) return -1;
        rc_put8(&w, l->op); rc_put8(&w, l->arg); rc_put8(&w, l->state); rc_put8(&w, l->max);
        rc_put32(&w, l->to); rc_put32(&w, l->lobby); rc_put32(&w, l->race);
        rc_put16(&w, (uint16_t)l->x); rc_put16(&w, (uint16_t)l->y); rc_put16(&w, l->t_ms); rc_put8(&w, l->n);
        rc_put8(&w, l->away_s);                                           /* (reserved before it: 0) */
        for (int i = 0; i < l->n; i++) rc_put32(&w, l->ids[i]);
        break; }
    case RC_MSG_LOBBIES:
        if (m->u.lobbies.n > RC_LOBBIES_MAX) return -1;
        rc_put16(&w, m->u.lobbies.req); rc_put8(&w, m->u.lobbies.n); rc_putb(&w, m->u.lobbies.data, (uint32_t)m->u.lobbies.n * RC_LOBBIES_ENTRY);
        break;
    case RC_MSG_RACEREP: {
        const rc_racerep *r = &m->u.racerep;
        if (!racerep_ok(r)) return -1;
        rc_put32(&w, r->lobby); rc_put32(&w, r->race); rc_put8(&w, r->mode); rc_put8(&w, r->laps); rc_put16(&w, r->track);
        rc_put8(&w, r->place); rc_put8(&w, r->players); rc_put8(&w, r->flags); rc_put8(&w, r->type); rc_put8(&w, (uint8_t)r->cls);
        rc_put8(&w, r->credit); rc_put8(&w, r->stage); rc_put8(&w, r->lobby_bits);
        rc_putf(&w, r->rating); rc_putf(&w, r->field); rc_putf(&w, r->factor); rc_putf(&w, r->kw); rc_putf(&w, r->kg);
        rc_putf(&w, r->kmh); rc_putf(&w, r->time);
        uint8_t nm[RC_RACEREP_NAME] = {0};
        for (int i = 0; i < RC_RACEREP_NAME && r->name[i]; i++) nm[i] = (uint8_t)r->name[i];
        rc_putb(&w, nm, RC_RACEREP_NAME);
        break; }
    case RC_MSG_SAY: rc_put8(&w, m->u.say.phrase); rc_put8(&w, m->u.say.seq); rc_put8(&w, m->u.say.stay); rc_put8(&w, 0); break;
    case RC_MSG_DENTS:
        if (!m->u.dents.rev || (m->u.dents.op != RC_DENTS_STATE && m->u.dents.op != RC_DENTS_HAVE)) return -1;
        rc_put8(&w, m->u.dents.op); rc_put16(&w, m->u.dents.rev);
        if (m->u.dents.op == RC_DENTS_STATE){
            if (m->u.dents.n > RC_DMG_MAX || (m->u.dents.n && !m->u.dents.data)) return -1;
            rc_put8(&w, m->u.dents.epoch); rc_put16(&w, m->u.dents.first); rc_put8(&w, m->u.dents.n);
            rc_putb(&w, m->u.dents.data, (uint32_t)m->u.dents.n * RC_DMG_BYTES);
        }
        break;
    case RC_MSG_RACERES: {
        const rc_raceres *r = &m->u.raceres;
        if (!raceres_ok(r)) return -1;
        rc_put32(&w, r->lobby); rc_put32(&w, r->race); rc_put8(&w, r->mode); rc_put8(&w, r->laps); rc_put8(&w, r->n);
        rc_put8(&w, (uint8_t)(r->heats << 4 | r->heat));
        for (int k = 0; k < r->n; k++){
            rc_put32(&w, r->row[k].id); rc_put8(&w, r->row[k].flags); rc_put16(&w, r->row[k].jump); rc_put8(&w, 0);
            rc_putf(&w, r->row[k].time); rc_putf(&w, r->row[k].done); rc_putf(&w, r->row[k].dist);
        }
        break; }
    default: return -1;
    }
    if (w.err || w.n + RC_CRC > w.cap) return -1;
    uint32_t len = w.n + RC_CRC;
    out[6] = (uint8_t)len; out[7] = (uint8_t)(len >> 8);
    rc_put32(&w, rc_crc32(out, w.n));
    return w.err ? -1 : (int)w.n;
}

int rc_decode(const uint8_t *buf, int len, rc_msg *m){
    memset(m, 0, sizeof *m);
    if (len < RC_HDR + RC_CRC) return RC_E_SHORT;
    if (len > RC_MAX_DGRAM) return RC_E_LENGTH;
    if (buf[0] != RC_MAGIC0 || buf[1] != RC_MAGIC1 || buf[2] != RC_MAGIC2 || buf[3] != RC_MAGIC3) return RC_E_MAGIC;
    rc_r r; rc_r_init(&r, buf, (uint32_t)len - RC_CRC);
    r.n = 4;
    m->h.ver = (uint8_t)rc_get8(&r);
    if (m->h.ver != RC_PROTO_VER) return RC_E_VERSION;
    m->h.type = (uint8_t)rc_get8(&r); m->h.len = (uint16_t)rc_get16(&r);
    m->h.sender = rc_get32(&r); m->h.seq = (uint16_t)rc_get16(&r); m->h.flags = (uint16_t)rc_get16(&r);
    if (m->h.len != (uint32_t)len) return RC_E_LENGTH;
    uint32_t crc = (uint32_t)buf[len - 4] | (uint32_t)buf[len - 3] << 8 | (uint32_t)buf[len - 2] << 16 | (uint32_t)buf[len - 1] << 24;
    if (crc != rc_crc32(buf, (uint32_t)len - RC_CRC)) return RC_E_CRC;
    if (!m->h.sender) return RC_E_FIELD;
    switch (m->h.type){
    case RC_MSG_HELLO: {
        m->u.hello.core_ver = (uint16_t)rc_get16(&r); m->u.hello.platform = (uint8_t)rc_get8(&r);
        m->u.hello.status = (uint8_t)rc_get8(&r); m->u.hello.listen_port = (uint16_t)rc_get16(&r);
        m->u.hello.cfg_rev = (uint16_t)rc_get16(&r); m->u.hello.room = rc_get32(&r);
        uint32_t nl = rc_get8(&r);
        if (nl > RC_NAME_MAX) return RC_E_FIELD;
        rc_getb(&r, m->u.hello.name, nl); m->u.hello.name[nl] = 0;
        if (r.err) return RC_E_SHORT;
        if (!printable(m->u.hello.name, nl)) return RC_E_FIELD;
        /* every name heard comes through here: one that reads as a slur is shown as none */
        if (name_blocked(m->u.hello.name)) memcpy(m->u.hello.name, "Player", 7);
        m->u.hello.n_seen = (uint8_t)rc_get8(&r);
        if (m->u.hello.n_seen > RC_MAX_PEERS) return RC_E_FIELD;
        for (int i = 0; i < m->u.hello.n_seen; i++) m->u.hello.seen[i] = rc_get32(&r);
        if (m->u.hello.status >= RC_ST__N) return RC_E_FIELD;
        if ((m->h.flags & RC_HF_CREW) && !r.err && r.n < r.len){
            m->u.hello.n_crews = (uint8_t)rc_get8(&r);
            if (m->u.hello.n_crews > RC_CREW_MAX) return RC_E_FIELD;
            for (int i = 0; i < m->u.hello.n_crews; i++) m->u.hello.crews[i] = rc_get32(&r);
            if (r.err) return RC_E_SHORT;
            for (int i = 0; i < m->u.hello.n_crews; i++) if (!m->u.hello.crews[i]) return RC_E_FIELD;
            if (r.n < r.len) m->u.hello.links = (uint8_t)rc_get8(&r);
            if (r.n + 4 <= r.len) m->u.hello.duel = rc_get32(&r);
            if (r.n < r.len){                                         /* the flag (core 13): one that is not a code, none */
                uint32_t fl = rc_get8(&r);
                if (fl <= RC_FLAG_MAX && r.n + fl <= r.len){
                    rc_getb(&r, m->u.hello.flag, fl); m->u.hello.flag[fl] = 0;
                    if (!flag_ok(m->u.hello.flag, fl)) m->u.hello.flag[0] = 0;
                }
            }
            /* the license plate (core 17), with the header's flag: one that is not capitals and digits, or reads as a
             * slur (every plate heard comes through here, as every name), none: the game's own plate */
            if ((m->h.flags & RC_HF_PLATE) && r.n < r.len){
                uint32_t pl = rc_get8(&r);
                if (pl <= RC_PLATE_MAX && r.n + pl <= r.len){
                    rc_getb(&r, m->u.hello.plate, pl); m->u.hello.plate[pl] = 0;
                    if (!rc_plate_ok(m->u.hello.plate, pl) || name_plate_blocked(m->u.hello.plate)) m->u.hello.plate[0] = 0;
                }
            }
            r.n = r.len;                                              /* (a newer core's additions) */
        }
        break; }
    case RC_MSG_PEERS:
        m->u.peers.n = (uint8_t)rc_get8(&r);
        if (m->u.peers.n > RC_LIST_MAX) return RC_E_FIELD;
        for (int i = 0; i < m->u.peers.n; i++){
            uint32_t a = rc_get8(&r), b = rc_get8(&r), c = rc_get8(&r), d = rc_get8(&r);
            m->u.peers.e[i].ip = a << 24 | b << 16 | c << 8 | d;
            m->u.peers.e[i].port = (uint16_t)rc_get16(&r); m->u.peers.e[i].id = rc_get32(&r);
